entries.source_text:
生活在遗迹中的机关造物，它们曾被用来记录文字、存储信息。
周身是古老的青铜所制，其上金属光泽黯淡，偶有锈迹。
身体上有古老神秘的天蓝色花纹。
这些机关没有攻击能力但移动速度较快。

文明早已消逝，造物却依然在等待着它们逝去的主人再度归来。
没人知道它究竟在守护什么。
entries.current_text:
Dwelling in ruins, they are responsible for storing information.
Covered in patches of rust, they have lost their metallic sheen.
Furnished with ancient and mysterious cerulean-colored patterns, they move at incredible speeds despite lacking attack abilities.

While their civilization has long withered away, they seem to be waiting for their masters to return and guarding something unknown.

entries.source_text: 蟹型青铜机关，表现呆萌有趣，在帮助它完成寻人的指令后，它便一直跟随着你。
entries.current_text: A crab-shaped bronze mechanism that looks cute and interesting. After helping it complete its search mission, it will follow you around.

entries.source_text:
幽噩的身影，具形的梦魇。
令人心悸的修长伯屠，隐藏在阴影与梦境之中伺机而动。
紫羽下的暗影是猎物最后的记忆，其手持的月刃乃是作为独猎者的荣耀。
月刃伯屠脱胎于梦境，与周围的一切本就是一体。
振翼穿梭自如，华丽的斩击犹如幻影一般。

它撕裂了一个又一个梦境，它穿越了一场又一场幻想。
幽暗的步履只是狩猎的间奏，庸人的美梦才是它赖以生存的食粮。
entries.current_text:
A dark, eerie figure, an incarnate nightmare.
The tall, slender Dreamslayer lurks in the shadows and dreams, waiting for the perfect moment to strike.
The shadows beneath its purple feathers are the prey's final memory, and the moon-blade it wields is the pride of a lone hunter.
The Moon-blade Dreamslayer is born from dreams, one with everything around it.
It moves through the air with ease, its gorgeous slashes like phantoms.

It tears through dream after dream, traversing fantasy after fantasy.
Its dark footsteps are merely the prelude to the hunt; the dreams of the mediocre are the food it survives on.

entries.source_text:
“墟成之秋，水滥成灾。众匠以夺天之工，造通玄之役。”
形似硕大屋脊的青铜造物，遮蔽着往日辛密。
巨大粗壮的节肢腿部，灵活的难以置信。
相得益彰的防御与冲击力，匹配了最原始的作战方式。
它要碾压一切入侵者。

稷下几乎无边际的地底世界，隐藏着错综复杂的河路与匪夷所思的生物。
古代工匠们利用驻墟玄守移山填海，是为了搭构什么？
entries.current_text:
"This place was ruined by excessive flooding. The craftsmen worked around the clock to come up with a solution."

Station Ruins Sentry, shaped like a bastion, hides the secrets of the past.

Its large, many-jointed legs give it remarkable flexibility.

With strong defenses and powerful attacks, it is built for simple, brutal tactics that crush invaders.

Station Ruins Sentry was created to move stones and hold back the sea, leaving behind a vast underground world of winding rivers and strange creatures.

entries.source_text:
被云根包裹着的怪物，曾是朝歌战场上的英雄。
为了让他活下去，人们将他的伤口与云根连接在一起。
云根的神力修复了他的躯体，却也占据了他的灵魂。

漫长的岁月里，一切情感与记忆都化为尘土，只剩下不灭的战意。
因此目力所及的一切，都成了他的敌人。
他仅剩的理智，渴望着救赎，以及期待已久的解脱……
entries.current_text:
"For the ideal I hold dear, I'd die a thousand times without regret."



Between the thin divide of life and death, a figure lingers between two realms. Life was traded for honor, forsaking the mortal form to bring an end to strife, but the power from the imprint was too much to handle. But even in rust, the glory remains eternal.



Like Volcanic Stone leaping into the fire, brilliance fades into silence. The dust of time forms a mountain of fate that weighs on all. Beneath the lofty mountain, the foolish stand proud and unyielding. They rise above the choice of life or death, heading towards an uncertain future.

entries.source_text:
“稷北有巨兽，生四足，喜藏于雷间，常与火死斗。”
燎火灭时，雷云升。
操弄雷的巨蜥，与燎原巨蜥互为死敌。
隐隐闪动着辉光的硕大的身躯，常隐于雷电之中。
会在出现的瞬间赐予受害者无痛苦的毙亡。
它是雷电的宠儿，是原野顶端的霸者。

它盘若苍岩，岿然不动。
只有当天敌之火开始燎原，才会抬起自己高贵的头颅发出震慑的吼叫。
entries.current_text:
"A giant beast in the north, with four legs. It hides among thunder and often fights to the death with fire."

When the flames are extinguished, storm clouds rise.

This thunder manipulator is a mortal enemy of the Wreckflame Lizard. Discreet flashes of light surround its large body, hidden within the thunder and lightning.

It deals a painless, instantaneous death to its victims.

Beloved by thunder and lightning, it reigns supreme.

Steady as a stone, it is not easily moved from its perch. Only when the flames of its nemesis begin burning will it raise its head and roar.

entries.source_text:
”犯长城者，有死无回。“
这个步履蹒跚的失心者，曾是守卫军的先锋官。
他曾与铠切磋武艺，也和花木兰把酒言欢。
直到那一战，为了保护木兰，他被魔物之力感染。
他曾想自我了断，却被自己的母亲阻拦。

魔性无法抑制，他将自己关进囚牢。
唯有拿起手中的刻刀，才能安抚他狂躁的杀意。
不仅因为那些石像，更因为那无法忘怀的往昔。
entries.current_text:
"Those who cross the Great Wall shall not return alive."
This stumbling, lost soul was once a vanguard of the Great Wall Garrison.
He once sparred with Kai and shared wine with Hua Mulan.
Until that battle, to protect Mulan, he was infected by the power of monsters.
He once wanted to end his own life, but was stopped by his mother.

Unable to suppress the demonic influence, he locked himself in a cell.
Only by picking up the carving knife in his hand could he soothe his manic bloodlust.
Not just because of those stone statues, but because of the past he could never forget.

entries.source_text:
“势伏凶也，仁者勿衿。”
作为鲁班大师的造物，它的威力与智慧同样令人称奇。
明明承担着守护的职责，却最终犯下伤人的过错。
无与伦比的杰作，只能被锁进封闭的牢笼。

有时，它也会怀念自己在学院的日子。
在晴朗的夜空之下，烤肉冒出阵阵热气。
想到这些，就连冰冷的钢铁，心跳也会变得鲜活。
entries.current_text:
"The dragon that lurks below, yet untouched by festive clouds, finds companionship not in the skies but amongst the fish and turtles below."
Submerged at the lake's bottom, the Mechanoid never frets over the careless disturbances of the fish and shrimp below. 
Sunlight dapples the lake surface, crinkling into shattered gold, decorating the vista between colorful clouds and clear waters.
It silently peers through the glistening waves, observing the people on the shore, golden in their comings and goings.
Like an aged elder or a dedicated mentor, it serves with deep respect.

It knows, though long accompanied by algae and debris, 
under the protective care of a fatherly figure, not a single crevice in its joints has been tainted by mud.
It waits in the waters, ready to sternly rebuke the arrogant and foolish,
and also to assist those promising talents, like koi leaping through the dragon gate, to achieve their potential.

entries.source_text:
比翼之鸟已经分离，叛离者回归故土。
跟随日升，从天海边际飞抵稷下的艳阳红隼。
它是天空的狩猎的王者，俯冲捕猎时犹如天火陨落。
傲火隼对猎物的挑选已经远远超越了裹腹的范畴，唯有强大的个体才能被它选中。
狩猎是一场逐命的祭奠，唯有生还者才能享受片刻安宁。

没人知道它到底要在这片土地上寻找什么，但实际上傲火隼并没有在寻找，这片大陆对于它来说只是歇脚的枝丫。
entries.current_text:
The two birds have parted. The defector has returned to the homeland.

With the breaking of the dawn, a Red Falcon flew from across the sea to Jixia, illuminated in the sun's glow.

It is the apex hunter of winged creatures, and each time it dives at its prey, it resembles a ball of divine flame falling from the sky.

Its choice of prey goes far beyond filling its belly. Only the strong are selected.

Hunting is a life-or-death ceremony, only the survivor can enjoy a moment of peace.

No one knows what it is looking for on this land. In fact, it is not looking for anything. This continent is just a branch for it to rest.

entries.source_text:
幽噩的身影，具形的梦魇。
令人心悸的修长伯屠，隐藏在阴影与梦境之中伺机而动。
紫羽下的暗影是猎物最后的记忆，其手持的月刃乃是作为独猎者的荣耀。
月刃伯屠脱胎于梦境，与周围的一切本就是一体。
振翼穿梭自如，华丽的斩击犹如幻影一般。

它撕裂了一个又一个梦境，它穿越了一场又一场幻想。
幽暗的步履只是狩猎的间奏，庸人的美梦才是它赖以生存的食粮。
entries.current_text:
A dark, eerie figure, an incarnate nightmare.
The tall, slender Dreamslayer lurks in the shadows and dreams, waiting for the perfect moment to strike.
The shadows beneath its purple feathers are the prey's final memory, and the moon-blade it wields is the pride of a lone hunter.
The Moon-blade Dreamslayer is born from dreams, one with everything around it.
It moves through the air with ease, its gorgeous slashes like phantoms.

It tears through dream after dream, traversing fantasy after fantasy.
Its dark footsteps are merely the prelude to the hunt; the dreams of the mediocre are the food it survives on.

entries.source_text:
提起这位前帮主，喵喵帮的帮众们都忍不住叹息。
明明是个破门生，却拼了命要加入长城守卫军。
也许是为了照顾收养自己的母亲。
也许是不想荒废哥哥传授的武艺。
总之，这位不可一世的”喵老大“，毅然决然的选择了新的活法。

没人知道，得知哥哥的遭遇时，她在想些什么……
只是一遍又一遍的重复着那些招式，即便她早已烂熟于心。
之后的她依旧经营着那家驿馆，热情地接待来往旅人。
可有人发现，她腰间多出的令牌，刻着守卫军的印记。
entries.current_text:
The members of the Meow Gang can't help but sigh when mentioning their former leader.
She was just a lowly student, yet she fought tooth and nail to join the Great Wall Garrison.
Perhaps it was to take care of the mother who adopted her.
Perhaps it was to not let the martial arts passed down by her brother go to waste.
In any case, this arrogant "Boss Meow" resolutely chose a new way of life.

No one knows what she was thinking when she learned of her brother's fate...
She just repeated those moves over and over, even though she already knew them by heart.
Afterward, she continued to run the post house, warmly welcoming travelers.
But some noticed that the token hanging from her waist bore the mark of the Garrison.

entries.source_text:
比翼之鸟已经分离，失意者落于山巅。
携带暴雨，从山峰一侧降临荒地的孤傲蓝隼。
扇动翅膀，它携来了云霄之雷。
它闪烁的双眸，凝视世间最有价值的事物。
它无常的愤怒，轰灭所有碍眼的磐石。
它的美丽与孤僻，同样出名。
除了宣泄情绪外，它几乎不会与任何生物产生交集。
这就是山城流传最广的天雷隼故事。

对传奇生灵产生臆断，是说书人的通病。
它的进攻性其实并不强，大多数时候，天雷隼只想在清爽的夜晚享受微风。
entries.current_text:
The twin birds have parted, and the broken-hearted have fallen to the mountain peak.
Carrying a torrential storm, the proud blue falcon descends upon the wasteland from the side of the peak.
Flapping its wings, it brings the thunder of the clouds.
Its shimmering eyes gaze upon the most valuable things in the world.
Its fickle rage obliterates all the rocks that stand in its way.
Its beauty and reclusive nature are equally famous.
Beyond venting its emotions, it rarely interacts with any living creature.
This is the most widely circulated story of the Sky-Thunder Falcon in the mountain city.

Making assumptions about legendary creatures is a common flaw of storytellers.
It is actually not very aggressive; most of the time, the Sky-Thunder Falcon just wants to enjoy the breeze on a cool night.

entries.source_text:
力士常年徘徊在稷下学院之外，远眺那一方书声朗朗。
伙伴总爱称他一句“天火锤星”，因着那把流火重锤轻易就能把石头碾作岩浆。
但他从未提起过，自己叛离师门时也留下了火焰的锤痕。
师长的克己被他视为懦弱，火痕的炽热才能代表他的义心。

但被这群破门少年视作大哥后，他也逐渐察觉到了个中道理。
只是参悟的过程不比练武简单，对恩师表达歉意一事，他还没有做好准备。
entries.current_text:
This strongman always gazes upon Jixia Academy from a distance.

With his devastating hammer, he can easily shatter boulders into dust. Yet, he never speaks of the flaming hammer prints he left behind when he abandoned his mentor.

Viewing his mentor's self-restraint as weakness, he believed that only the heat of flames could manifest true righteousness.

Now appointed as the leader of the youthful Rebels, he has slowly begun to understand his mentor's wisdom. However, this learning curve is as challenging as mastering Martial Arts, and he is not yet ready to offer an apology.

entries.source_text:
流落在彩云盆地的熊猫魔种。
他带着证明自己的梦想来到学院，却因为偏科被拒之门外。
可有位老者曾对他说：“三人行，必有我师焉。”
他将这句话奉为圭臬，于是向学子们讨教成了他的修炼。

自此，彩云盆地多了一个古怪的“青竹大侠”。
学子间传言，有个武力不凡的怪人，四处逢人便打。
奇怪的是，他一边出招，一边大喊着话本里的招式名。
而当他打完离开时，附近的食物也跟着不翼而飞。
比起他的武艺，这份食量，更让人在意。
entries.current_text:
A panda demonkin who drifted into the Colorful Cloud Basin.
He came to the academy with dreams of proving himself, only to be turned away for his uneven academic performance.
But an old man once told him: "Among any three people, there must be one who can be my teacher."
He took these words to heart, and seeking advice from students became his form of cultivation.

Since then, a strange "Green Bamboo Hero" has appeared in the Colorful Cloud Basin.
Rumor has it among the students that there is a formidable eccentric who challenges everyone he meets to a fight.
Strangely, he shouts out move names from storybooks as he fights.
And when he leaves after a fight, the nearby food often disappears with him.
More than his martial arts, it is this appetite that people find most concerning.

entries.source_text:
云根贯空之巅，无它者存立。
硕根之上的霸主，鬃毛已化为光莹的晶体。
漆黑的阴影随日落笼罩山麓，肆意的鼾声响破黎明。
它生于云根核心，长于云流富足之所。
它屡战屡胜，却日益孤独。
过剩的能量，让它无处宣泄。
把磐石拍碎，摧万树折腰。
芒鬓巨熊寻不得一个匹敌的对手。

对它持续无数年的悬赏令，早已替换成勿近的警示。
然现在，城镇也已破败，只剩下腐蚀的残木与零碎的断章。
entries.current_text:
It reigns atop the Aerux, leaving no space for anything else to endure.

Its mane has crystallised into glittering shards, while its vast shadow stretches across the mountains at dusk.

Born at the Aerux's core, where Aerflow runs densest, it wields overwhelming power—yet finds no worthy foe, and with each passing day, grows ever more alone.

With ease, it shatters boulders and snaps trees, its strength unmatched. Still, no opponent has risen to challenge it.

For years, a nearby town offered rewards for its defeat. Now, that town lies abandoned and in ruins—nothing remains but rotting wood and scattered pages, a silent warning to all who would come near.

entries.source_text:
“云腾致雨，露结为霜。”
相传，在极北以北的远方流传着一种古老的信仰。
他们说走到生命尽头的云会坠落到世界的边际，逐渐堆叠起一座蔚蓝的山岭。
而山岭上的冰雪会化为新的云雾，如此周而复始，滋润众生。

无数探险者试图探明巨山的奥秘，却冻毙荒原。
为了避免惨剧的继续发生，百家曾联合发布过一份调查书，警醒人们那山峰实际上是休眠的异兽，喷吐出的寒气连时间都能冻结。
请放弃贸然前往的计划，除非做好了面对刺骨冰霜的十足准备。
entries.current_text:
"Clouds rise to bring rain, dew condenses into frost."
Legend has it that an ancient belief exists far beyond the extreme north.
They say that clouds reaching the end of their lives fall to the edge of the world, gradually piling up into a blue mountain range.
And the ice and snow on the mountains turn into new clouds, repeating the cycle to nourish all living things.

Countless explorers have tried to uncover the secrets of the giant mountain, only to freeze to death in the wilderness.
To prevent further tragedies, the Hundred Schools once jointly issued an investigative report, warning people that the peak is actually a dormant exotic beast, and the cold it exhales can freeze even time itself.
Please abandon any plans to go there rashly, unless you are fully prepared to face the biting frost.

entries.source_text:
“幼芽灌躯，蹒跚学步。”
当稚嫩蔓芽盘入化作养分的旧躯壳，新生伊始。
它荆棘密布的身躯保护了脆弱的主芽。
面具上的脸孔也只是伪装。
此时此刻，它饱含憧憬。
一定要与初见的每个生物，真诚地拥抱交流。

它们周而复始的生命，究竟算不算自我的延续？
当归属自身的大部分被替换，它们意识主导的核心，能否记起曾经的自我？
entries.current_text:
"Tender buds fill the body, learning to walk clumsily."
When delicate vines take root in the old shell that has become nutrients, a new life begins.
Its thorn-covered body protects the fragile main bud.
The face on the mask is merely a disguise.
At this moment, it is full of longing.
It must embrace and communicate sincerely with every creature it meets for the first time.

Does their cyclical life count as a continuation of the self?
When most of what belongs to the self is replaced, can the core that guides their consciousness remember the former self?

entries.source_text:
守关人岿然不动，一夫当关，千骑莫开。
巨盾阻敌，虽枯不倒，立如峰峦。
取英雄遗盾，锻机关之皇。
冰岩坠落崖间，敌我无路可退。
不屈的坚定信念已嵌入枢核，抵御之技牢不可破。

卑劣铁骑涌入关隘，卫国之躯已背对故土。
当残阳只剩余晖，被拉长的身影中出现了援军。
entries.current_text:
An unyielding gatekeeper, one who can hold the pass against a thousand riders. With a massive shield, it blocks all who stand before it, enduring like a mountain even in ruin. Forged from a fallen hero's shield, it stands as the pinnacle of mechanised defence.

When icy boulders fall off the cliff, there is no retreat. Its core is etched with unbreakable resolve, its defence impenetrable.

Its back faced the country it fought to defend as the underhanded cavalry streamed into the pass. In the dying light of dusk, as shadows stretch long, reinforcements emerge.

entries.source_text:
抵抗者双刀赴会，嘲弄未息，寇首已落。
万刃加身，其躯殒灭，双刀存立。
取英侠遗刀，佩与机关之皇。
寒霜冻结兵戈，烈焰融化甲胄。
迅捷的矫健身手已被继承，速攻之技已臻化境。

恶师狂寇席卷村落，止殇之人已经现身。
敌人还在嘲笑，其首已经分离。
entries.current_text:
The resister faced the enemy with twin blades; before the mockery could fade, the leader's head had fallen.
Pierced by a thousand blades, the body perished, yet the twin blades remained.
Take the hero's lost blades and bestow them upon the Emperor of Mechanisms.
Frost freezes the weaponry, flames melt the armor.
The swift and agile combat style has been inherited; the art of rapid strikes has reached perfection.

The wicked master and his bandits swept through the village, but the one who ends the sorrow has appeared.
The enemy still mocks, but their head is already severed.

entries.source_text:
被悲伤围绕的古老玉泪果，常人所不可接近。
衰败叶片簇拥的花冠，漫溢着催人泪下的气体。
受者会难以自制的感到悲伤，野兽甚至也会失去食欲。
所以，它只能孤独的生存在自己的位置，无法被其它生物接纳。

传有群无嗅鸟常与之为伴。
它们衔来远方之逸闻，它提供安稳庇护之树荫。
然一日间，无嗅鸟群消失于苍穹。
此后岁月，遗世只剩戚风，故事已成绝响。
entries.current_text:
An ancient Jade Tear Fruit surrounded by sorrow, unapproachable by ordinary people.
The corolla, crowded with withered leaves, overflows with a gas that brings people to tears.
Those affected will feel uncontrollable sadness, and even beasts will lose their appetite.
Therefore, it can only live alone in its own place, unable to be accepted by other creatures.

It is said that a flock of Scentless Birds often kept it company.
They brought anecdotes from afar, and it provided a stable, sheltering shade.
But one day, the Scentless Bird flock vanished from the sky.
In the years since, only the sorrowful wind remains, and the story has become a lost echo.

entries.source_text:
绮影梦魔是梦境中黑暗的化身，如今它的野心膨胀，将众人的梦境扭曲成的灾厄。

【三相幻形】：绮影梦魔在狼、熊、人三种形态间循环作战，各具独特战法。

【梦魇攫取】：当其化为熊或人形态时，它会召唤魇蝶抓起一名玩家飞向梦魇裂隙，队友须及时击落魇蝶，否则在坠入梦魇裂隙时，将引发毁灭性的爆炸。
entries.current_text:
The Dream Demon of Painted Shadows is the embodiment of darkness in the dream. Now, its ambition has expanded, twisting everyone's dreams into a disaster.

[Three-Phase Illusion]: The Dream Demon of Painted Shadows cycles between wolf, bear, and human forms, each with unique combat tactics.

[Nightmare Seizure]: When in bear or human form, it summons Nightmare Butterflies to snatch a player and fly toward a Nightmare Rift. Teammates must shoot down the butterflies in time, or a devastating explosion will be triggered upon falling into the rift.

entries.source_text:
【群藤缚杀】：木篱王释放藤蔓束缚所有玩家，并召唤木篱枪卫全场冲锋，须尽快挣脱藤蔓以躲开攻击。

【汲灵巨化】：木篱王汲取周围小木篱的生命力，身形急剧膨胀并覆盖上一层坚不可摧的荆棘护甲。此时场边出现投弹卫兵投掷火弹，唯有拾取火弹掷向木篱王的护甲才能逐步瓦解其防御，否则它的力量将随着体型不断增长，直至碾压全场。
entries.current_text:
[Vine Binding Kill]: The Wooden Fence King releases vines to bind all players and summons Wooden Fence Spear Guards to charge across the field. You must break free from the vines as soon as possible to avoid attacks.

[Spirit-Absorbing Giantization]: The Wooden Fence King absorbs the vitality of surrounding small wooden fences, its body expanding rapidly and covering itself with an indestructible thorn armor. At this time, Bombardment Guards appear on the sidelines throwing fire bombs. Only by picking up the fire bombs and throwing them at the Wooden Fence King's armor can you gradually dismantle its defense; otherwise, its power will continue to grow with its size until it crushes the entire field.

entries.source_text: 【坚果诱敌】：铠鼠大王召出多只小甲鼠翻滚捣乱，其中一只携带特殊坚果，击倒后坚果留在场上；随后铠鼠大王将全体玩家拉近，并为其中两人缠上共鸣藤蔓（被缠者沉默且二人距离过远会被弹回），其余队友须抱起坚果吸引大王冲锋。被藤蔓相连的两人须反向拉开藤蔓作为绊索，方能绊倒冲锋中的巨鼠。
entries.current_text: [Nut Bait]: The Armored Rat King summons several small armored rats to roll around and cause chaos. One of them carries a special nut; defeating it leaves the nut on the field. The Armored Rat King then pulls all players in and binds two of them with resonance vines (the bound are silenced, and if they get too far apart, they are pulled back). The remaining teammates must pick up the nut to lure the King's charge. The two players connected by vines must pull in opposite directions to use the vines as a tripwire to trip the charging giant rat.

entries.source_text: 【绝境火盾】：劫刃铸灵的四个幻影分身发起的冲锋必须全部引导至孤戟铸灵的火盾上，任何一次失误都会导致破盾失败，极其考验团队的精准执行与协同能力。
entries.current_text: [Desperate Fire Shield]: The charges initiated by the four phantom clones of the Blade-Severing Spirit must all be lured into the Lone Halberd Spirit's Fire Shield. Any mistake will result in failure to break the shield, testing the team's precise execution and coordination.

entries.source_text: 铠鼠大王常年受云流滋养，它体型硕大，坚甲厚皮，每逢社戏便潜入田间窃取粮食。
entries.current_text:
The Armadillo Rat King has long thrived on Aerflow, developing a thick hide and a massive frame. During the Festive Fire Opera, it sneaks into the granaries to raid the crops.

Nut Lure: The King summons several little Armadillo Rats to wreak havoc, one of which carries a special nut. When the nut-bearer is defeated, the nut remains on the field. The Rat King then drags all players closer, ensnaring two with vines. Entangled players will be silenced, and straying too far will snap them back. 

Unbound allies must pick up the nut to bait the King's charge, while the entwined pair must pull their vines in opposite directions to trip the charging King. Timing and coordination are key—fail, and the colossal rat keeps rampaging.

entries.source_text:
手握炽热战刃的机关战将。
黑金铠甲之下那炽热的核心，一刻不息地燃烧着。
万锻神刃将十分擅长近距离搏斗，攻击袭来之时如同泰山压顶。
那把巨大火刃的高温足以流金烁石。

几乎没有生物敢于招惹万锻神刃将，而它也不会主动挑起争端。
战斗已不是它的使命，而是既定的宿命。
entries.current_text: A Mechcraft warrior wielding a blade of fire. Beneath the black-gold armor, a fiery core burns ceaselessly. The Ten-Thousand-Forge Blade is highly skilled in close-quarters combat, striking with the weight of a mountain. The intense heat of its massive fire blade is enough to melt metal. Few creatures dare to provoke the Ten-Thousand-Forge Blade, and it does not provoke others. Combat is no longer its mission, but its fated destiny.

entries.source_text:
伯屠大君乃是堕入梦境的冷峻猎手，他裹挟着黑暗而来，誓要将这片梦境拖入彻底的毁灭。

【至暗梦魇】：伯屠大君唤来吞噬一切的深沉黑暗，而魇光台周围的光明区域，可庇护玩家免受黑暗的持续侵蚀。唯有寻找到黑暗中浮现的两名梦魇羽卫，将其击败夺取魇光，并成功护送至魇光台点亮，方能驱散黑暗，逼其现身。
entries.current_text:
Lord Botu is a cold hunter who has fallen into the dream. He comes wrapped in darkness, vowing to drag this dream into total destruction.

[Deepest Nightmare]: Lord Botu summons a deep darkness that devours everything. The bright area around the Nightmare Light Platform can protect players from the continuous erosion of the darkness. Only by finding the two Nightmare Feather Guards that appear in the darkness, defeating them to seize the Nightmare Light, and successfully escorting it to the Nightmare Light Platform to light it up, can the darkness be dispelled and force him to appear.

entries.source_text:
【幻影冲锋】：劫刃铸灵会分出四个幻影分身锁定不同玩家冲锋。

【精准引导】：孤戟铸灵的火盾依然在场中，需要四名玩家准确识别并引导各自面对的分身冲撞火盾，且须保持分散，避免路径重叠。
entries.current_text:
[Phantom Charge]: The Blade-Severing Spirit splits into four phantom clones to lock onto different players and charge.

[Precision Guidance]: The Halberd-Severing Spirit's fire shield is still on the field. Four players must accurately identify and guide their respective clones to crash into the fire shield, while staying spread out to avoid overlapping paths.

entries.source_text:
蛰伏于稷下遗迹的青铜机关守卫，形似龟兽坐立。
用于防守的固定青铜炮台。
面临敌人时，四方暗门后的遗落炮机便会转过身来，一起发射。

它牺牲了移动力换来的强大威力让所有觊觎遗迹宝藏的人望而却步。
一部分研究火器的破门生会出高价收购这种机关。
entries.current_text: A bronze mechanical guard dormant in the Jixia ruins, shaped like a sitting tortoise. A stationary bronze turret used for defense. When facing enemies, the hidden cannons behind the four dark doors will turn and fire in unison. Its immense power, gained at the cost of mobility, deters anyone coveting the ruins' treasures. Some Gate-Breakers who study firearms will pay a high price for these mechanisms.

entries.source_text:
遗落枪卒是驻守在稷下遗迹的青铜机关士兵。
青铜的构造上遍布奇异的纹路。
它们手中紧握着锋利的古老长枪，攻击迅速且致命。

偶尔有一些破门生或者好奇的学生闯入遗迹，等待他们的大多只有寒冷的锋刃。
entries.current_text:
They are tasked with guarding Jixia's ruins.
Adorned with glowing patterns etched into their bronze bodies, they wield ancient pikes with deadly precision, delivering swift and lethal strikes.

Rebels or curious students alike who venture into the ruins are met with their cold steel.

entries.source_text:
“毕方，木之精也，状如鸟，不食五谷。”
青铜巨鸟，日夜鸣啼。其声雄厉，而听者无一不哀哀恸哭。
毕方忘记了许多事情，唯独牢记着自己的名字。
独脚锈蚀，双翼斑驳，但它的眼瞳仍和身体上深刻的流纹一起燃烧着青色的炽热火光。

楼船赋予它飞翔的使命，还有守护，以及奋战。
但如今楼船倾覆，它仍试图履行自己的使命，尽管它能守护的一切都已化作废墟。
于是它鸣叫，为了至少守住自己的名字，以一种近乎碎裂的骄傲：
毕方、毕方。
entries.current_text:
"Bi Fang, the essence of wood; it looks like a bird and does not eat the five grains."
A giant bronze bird, chirping day and night. Its cry is fierce, and all who hear it weep in sorrow.
Bi Fang has forgotten many things, but it remembers its own name.
Its single leg is rusted, its wings are mottled, but its eyes still burn with a cyan, scorching fire, matching the deep flow-patterns on its body.

The tall ship gave it the mission to fly, to guard, and to fight.
But now the ship has capsized, and it still tries to fulfill its mission, even though everything it could protect has turned to ruins.
So it cries out, to at least hold onto its name, with a pride that is almost shattering:
Bi Fang, Bi Fang.

entries.source_text:
幽噩的身影，具形的梦魇。
令人心悸的修长伯屠，隐藏在阴影与梦境之中伺机而动。
紫羽下的暗影是猎物最后的记忆，其手持的月刃乃是作为独猎者的荣耀。
月刃伯屠脱胎于梦境，与周围的一切本就是一体。
振翼穿梭自如，华丽的斩击犹如幻影一般。

它撕裂了一个又一个梦境，它穿越了一场又一场幻想。
幽暗的步履只是狩猎的间奏，庸人的美梦才是它赖以生存的食粮。
entries.current_text:
A dark, eerie figure, an incarnate nightmare.
The tall, slender Dreamslayer lurks in the shadows and dreams, waiting for the perfect moment to strike.
The shadows beneath its purple feathers are the prey's final memory, and the moon-blade it wields is the pride of a lone hunter.
The Moon-blade Dreamslayer is born from dreams, one with everything around it.
It moves through the air with ease, its gorgeous slashes like phantoms.

It tears through dream after dream, traversing fantasy after fantasy.
Its dark footsteps are merely the prelude to the hunt; the dreams of the mediocre are the food it survives on.

entries.source_text:
绮影梦魔对梦境的掌控愈发深邃，它撕裂出更多梦魇裂隙，却也让自身的造物变得不堪一击。

【裂隙增殖】：绮影梦魔形态转换时，场上出现的梦魇裂隙数量增加，队友的救援压力骤增。同时，抓走玩家的魇蝶防护大幅减弱，变得更为脆弱易碎。
entries.current_text:
The Dream Demon of Painted Shadows' control over the dream realm deepens, tearing open more Nightmare Rifts, but also making its own creations vulnerable.

[Rift Proliferation]: When the Dream Demon of Painted Shadows changes form, the number of Nightmare Rifts on the field increases, significantly increasing the pressure on teammates to rescue. At the same time, the protection of the Nightmare Butterflies that snatch players is greatly weakened, making them more fragile and easily shattered.

entries.source_text:
自诞生起便于守护使命中沉眠的青钺铸将，在瓦砾间苏醒，其铜躯铭记的唯一指令，便是驱逐一切入侵者。

【遗落援军】：青钺铸将召唤两台遗落炮机协同作战，需优先清理。

【磐石御阵】：青钺铸将于场地中央展开护盾，并在四角召唤石柱，接着循环点名单一玩家或全部玩家，众人需以石柱为掩体躲避，再齐心协力推倒石柱砸向青钺铸将，方能击破护盾使其昏厥。
entries.current_text:
A Bronze Axe General that has been dormant since its creation to fulfill its duty of protection. It awakens among the rubble, its only directive inscribed on its bronze body: expel all intruders.

[Lost Reinforcements]: The Bronze Axe General summons two Lost Cannons to fight alongside it; these should be cleared first.

[Rock Shield Formation]: The Bronze Axe General deploys a shield in the center of the arena and summons stone pillars at the four corners. It then cycles through targeting a single player or all players. Everyone must use the stone pillars as cover to hide, then work together to push the pillars over onto the Bronze Axe General to break its shield and stun it.

entries.source_text:
它潜行于学子的梦魇之中，
汲取人心中的执念与黑暗来重塑自身。
从狂狼的撕咬到巨熊的怒扑，
它在无尽的兽性中渐渐凝结出毁灭的力量。
这诞生于梦境的影子，妄图打破虚实的界限，用利刃彻底撕裂现世。

“梦境里越是清醒，现实中便越是困顿。”
苏醒的黑影将灵魂深处的绝望与阴影投射入人们的梦境，
于是梦境便扭曲成这般幽暗的灾厄化身。
entries.current_text:
It lurks in the nightmares of students,
absorbing the obsessions and darkness in people's hearts to reshape itself.
From the bite of a mad wolf to the pounce of a giant bear,
it gradually condenses the power of destruction within endless bestiality.
This shadow born of dreams attempts to break the boundary between reality and illusion, using sharp blades to tear the present world apart.

"The more awake you are in a dream, the more trapped you are in reality."
The awakened shadow projects the despair and darkness from the depths of the soul into people's dreams,
and thus the dream twists into this dark incarnation of disaster.

entries.source_text:
【亘古壁垒】：此刻覆盖木篱王躯干的荆棘护甲变得异常坚韧，需要更多火弹才能击破。

【狂怒汲取】：木篱王巨大化期间的攻击力急速攀升，团队必须极高效率地拦截火弹并投掷，任何延迟都会导致生存空间急剧恶化。
entries.current_text:
[Eternal Barrier]: The thorn armor covering the Wood Fence King's torso becomes exceptionally tough, requiring more fire bombs to break.

[Fury Drain]: The Wood Fence King's attack power rises rapidly while in its giant form. The team must intercept and throw fire bombs with extreme efficiency; any delay will cause the survival space to shrink drastically.

entries.source_text:
“石埋遗像丹青落，泉绕虚堂岁月深。”
自诞生之日起，它就陷入了长久的沉眠。
唯有屈指可数的几次醒来，
面前霜髯老者负手而立，身后弱冠青年勤学苦练。

星移斗转，沧海桑田。撑天之柱倾颓，拄地之釜崩陷。
青钺铸将浑然不觉，
安睡于空室之内，梦醒于瓦砾之间。
它不知昔日喧闹散去了何处，只记得熔铸在铜躯中的使命：
守护、守护，直到千军溃退，直到长梦无忧。
entries.current_text:
"Stone relics fade with time, as the years deepen around the empty hall."

It was awakened only few times. The old man with a white beard stood before it, followed by diligent young men.

As time passed, the pillar collapsed and the land cracked.

Dual-Axe General woke up amidst the ruins. It didn't know where the liveliness of the past had gone, but it remembered its mission: To protect and defend, until the enemy armies retreat, and until people can dream without concerns.

entries.source_text:
驻墟玄守乃古代工匠所铸的青铜巨物，形如屋脊，以巨力碾碎一切入侵者。

【青铜巡行】：这尊巨物锁定燃山机枢为目标，迈动节肢无情地推进，并在抵达后持续攻击燃山机枢直至毁坏。玩家必须全力阻止它的前进。
entries.current_text:
The Ruin-Guarding Mystic Sentinel is a giant bronze construct forged by ancient craftsmen. Shaped like a roof ridge, it crushes all intruders with immense force.

[Bronze March]: This giant construct locks onto the Burning Mountain Pivot as its target, relentlessly advancing on its limbs, and will continuously attack the pivot upon arrival until it is destroyed. Players must do everything in their power to stop its advance.

entries.source_text:
【群藤缚杀】：木篱王释放藤蔓束缚所有玩家，并召唤木篱枪卫全场冲锋，须尽快挣脱藤蔓以躲开攻击。

【汲灵巨化】：木篱王汲取周围小木篱的生命力，身形急剧膨胀并覆盖上一层坚不可摧的荆棘护甲。此时场边出现投弹卫兵投掷火弹，唯有拾取火弹掷向木篱王的护甲才能逐步瓦解其防御，否则它的力量将随着体型不断增长，直至碾压全场。
entries.current_text:
[Vine Binding Kill]: The Wooden Fence King releases vines to bind all players and summons Wooden Fence Spear Guards to charge across the field. You must break free from the vines as soon as possible to avoid attacks.

[Spirit-Absorbing Giantization]: The Wooden Fence King absorbs the vitality of surrounding small wooden fences, its body expanding rapidly and covering itself with an indestructible thorn armor. At this time, Bombardment Guards appear on the sidelines throwing fire bombs. Only by picking up the fire bombs and throwing them at the Wooden Fence King's armor can you gradually dismantle its defense; otherwise, its power will continue to grow with its size until it crushes the entire field.

entries.source_text:
威声如震，动若霄鸣。
曾奔驰于广袤平原的通雷巨牛，硕大的牛角蕴藏着雷霆。
现在它故步自封，只与紫霄为伴。
苍黑的毛不断汹动，犹如狂澜怒涛。
它的领地就是它的雷池，它的营垒。
踏足的生物，将迎千钧雷击。
也许它也曾试图群居，但亲近者想必已成飞灰。

它游走，它静止。
它毁灭，它迷茫。
现在，是时候了。
entries.current_text:
Might as thunder, movement like the sky's roar.
The Thunder-Bull that once galloped across the vast plains carries thunder in its massive horns.
Now it keeps to itself, keeping company only with the purple clouds.
Its dark fur ripples constantly, like a raging sea.
Its territory is its thunder pool, its fortress.
Any creature that steps foot here will face a thousand-fold thunder strike.
Perhaps it once tried to live in a herd, but those who drew near have surely turned to ash.

It wanders, it stands still.
It destroys, it is lost.
Now, the time has come.

entries.source_text:
铸铜炮机是在遗迹中的防卫机关。
四足聚拢，双炮临门，驻足而立随即蓄能待发。
单发的炮轰足以击碎任何护甲，唯有趁隙绕开才能破局。

不知为何，这些机关终日运转不息，似乎这里从未被遗忘。
entries.current_text:
Bronze Turrets are defensive Mechanoids found in the ruins.
Their four legs are bunched together, charging for a powerful blast with their two cannons.
A single blast is enough to shatter any armor. The only way around them is to avoid them.

For some reason, they have been restless, a sign that this place has never been forgotten.

entries.source_text:
【幻影冲锋】：劫刃铸灵会分出四个幻影分身锁定不同玩家冲锋。

【精准引导】：孤戟铸灵的火盾依然在场中，需要四名玩家准确识别并引导各自面对的分身冲撞火盾，且须保持分散，避免路径重叠。

[Precision Guidance]: The Halberd-Severing Spirit's fire shield is still on the field. Four players must accurately identify and guide their respective clones to crash into the fire shield, while staying spread out to avoid overlapping paths.

entries.source_text:
【煞气护盾冲锋】：蛮虎冲锋时盾牌盾值巨幅提升，团队需集火造成大量伤害才能将其击破。

【震地撼击】：蛮虎冲锋后立刻跃至场中连续砸地，产生全屏震感攻击。唯有拾取掉落的机关重盾方可阻挡，任何跳跃或闪避皆无济于事。
entries.current_text:
[Evil Shield Charge]: The Savage Tiger's shield durability is greatly increased during its charge. The team must focus fire to deal massive damage to break it.

[Earth-Shattering Impact]: After charging, the Savage Tiger immediately leaps to the center of the field and slams the ground repeatedly, causing screen-wide shockwave damage. Only by picking up the dropped Mechanical Heavy Shield can you block it; jumping or dodging is useless.

entries.source_text:
古老的防御型阵地机关人。
千淬凝盾俑在设计的时候充分考虑了实用性。
塔盾上的机关纹路引导了卓越的属性能量，让其更加难以撼动。

学院研发的机关人的盾牌很大程度上借鉴了这种盾牌的构造。
很难想象究竟是何种敌人需要用防御力如此强劲的机关人防守。
entries.current_text:
An ancient defensive stationary mechanical construct.
The Qiancui Shield Automaton was designed with practicality in mind.
The mechanical patterns on the tower shield channel superior elemental energy, making it even harder to shake.

The shields of the mechanical constructs developed by the Academy are largely based on this construction.
It is hard to imagine what kind of enemy would require a mechanical construct with such powerful defensive capabilities.

entries.source_text:
机关核心彻底暴走，开场即召唤四台遗落机炮协同作战。

【狂雷绝阵】：石柱在雷霆加持下坚不可摧，玩家必须合力先将其击破后方可推倒。同时，铸将的冲锋与释放毁灭光束期间，将伴随全场大范围落雷。

【震渊双煞】：驻墟玄守将被唤醒，加入战斗。期间，青钺铸将间歇性地引发无法闪避的震地星火攻击全场。玩家须在雷暴与星火的双重压迫下快速击破驻墟玄守。
entries.current_text:
The mechanism core has gone completely berserk, summoning four abandoned turrets to fight alongside it at the start.

[Thunder Array]: The stone pillars are indestructible under the blessing of thunder; players must work together to break them before they can be toppled. Meanwhile, the General's charge and destructive beam will be accompanied by large-scale lightning strikes across the field.

[Twin Abyssal Terrors]: The Ruin Guardians will be awakened and join the battle. During this time, the Bronze Halberd General will intermittently trigger unavoidable ground-shaking sparks across the field. Players must quickly defeat the Ruin Guardians under the dual pressure of lightning storms and sparks.

entries.source_text: 【火盾冲撞】：劫刃铸灵会锁定玩家进行冲锋，同时孤戟铸灵在场地中央开启火盾。玩家须引导劫刃铸灵连续三次冲撞火盾，才能成功破盾，否则将承受巨额全屏伤害。
entries.current_text: [Fire Shield Collision]: The Blade-Severing Spirit locks onto a player to charge, while the Lone Halberd Spirit activates a Fire Shield in the center of the field. Players must lure the Blade-Severing Spirit to collide with the Fire Shield three times to successfully break the shield; otherwise, they will suffer massive screen-wide damage.

entries.source_text:
“石埋遗像丹青落，泉绕虚堂岁月深。”
自诞生之日起，它就陷入了长久的沉眠。
唯有屈指可数的几次醒来，
面前霜髯老者负手而立，身后弱冠青年勤学苦练。

星移斗转，沧海桑田。撑天之柱倾颓，拄地之釜崩陷。
青钺铸将浑然不觉，
安睡于空室之内，梦醒于瓦砾之间。
它不知昔日喧闹散去了何处，只记得熔铸在铜躯中的使命：
守护、守护，直到千军溃退，直到长梦无忧。
entries.current_text:
"Stone relics fade with time, as the years deepen around the empty hall."

It was awakened only few times. The old man with a white beard stood before it, followed by diligent young men.

As time passed, the pillar collapsed and the land cracked.

Dual-Axe General woke up amidst the ruins. It didn't know where the liveliness of the past had gone, but it remembered its mission: To protect and defend, until the enemy armies retreat, and until people can dream without concerns.

entries.source_text:
“幼芽灌躯，蹒跚学步。”
当稚嫩蔓芽盘入化作养分的旧躯壳，新生伊始。
它荆棘密布的身躯保护了脆弱的主芽。
面具上的脸孔也只是伪装。
此时此刻，它饱含憧憬。
一定要与初见的每个生物，真诚地拥抱交流。

它们周而复始的生命，究竟算不算自我的延续？
当归属自身的大部分被替换，它们意识主导的核心，能否记起曾经的自我？
entries.current_text:
"Tender buds fill the body, learning to walk clumsily."
When delicate vines take root in the old shell that has become nutrients, a new life begins.
Its thorn-covered body protects the fragile main bud.
The face on the mask is merely a disguise.
At this moment, it is full of longing.
It must embrace and communicate sincerely with every creature it meets for the first time.

Does their cyclical life count as a continuation of the self?
When most of what belongs to the self is replaced, can the core that guides their consciousness remember the former self?

entries.source_text:
遗落百将是驻守在稷下遗迹的青铜机关将领。
青铜的构造上遍布奇异的纹路。
它们手中紧握着锋利的古老长枪，攻击迅速且致命。

它们已将战法内化于心，它们代表着青铜机关军队的最高命令。
entries.current_text:
The Relic Hundred-General is a bronze mechanical commander guarding the Jixia ruins.
Strange patterns cover its bronze structure.
They hold sharp, ancient spears, attacking quickly and lethally.

They have internalized combat tactics and represent the highest command of the bronze mechanical army.

entries.source_text:
“青铜为脊，片鳞相系。
刻纹于鳍，浮空游弋。”
效潜蛟游鱼之态而造的精巧机关，
巡卫沧渊千载，岩穹下吞吐风霜。
倘若入侵者觊觎楼船贮藏的至宝，	
长鸣响起，贪婪之辈皆难逃鱼口。	

战火的余烬早已化为了遗迹的落尘，
故人离去，它仍在履行守护的使命，
直到那支渔歌越过大海，回到家乡。
entries.current_text:
"Bronze for a spine, scales linked in rows.
Engraved patterns on fins, gliding through the air."
An exquisite automaton crafted in the likeness of a diving dragon and fish,
Patrolling the Abyss for a thousand years, breathing wind and frost beneath the stone dome.
Should any intruder covet the treasures stored on the tall ship,
The long alarm will sound, and the greedy shall not escape the fish's maw.

The embers of war have long turned to the dust of ruins,
The old masters are gone, yet it still fulfills its mission of protection,
Until that fisherman's song crosses the sea and returns home.

entries.source_text:
它潜行于学子的梦魇之中，
汲取人心中的执念与黑暗来重塑自身。
从狂狼的撕咬到巨熊的怒扑，
它在无尽的兽性中渐渐凝结出毁灭的力量。
这诞生于梦境的影子，妄图打破虚实的界限，用利刃彻底撕裂现世。

“梦境里越是清醒，现实中便越是困顿。”
苏醒的黑影将灵魂深处的绝望与阴影投射入人们的梦境，
于是梦境便扭曲成这般幽暗的灾厄化身。
entries.current_text:
It lurks in the nightmares of students,
absorbing the obsessions and darkness in people's hearts to reshape itself.
From the bite of a mad wolf to the pounce of a giant bear,
it gradually condenses the power of destruction within endless bestiality.
This shadow born of dreams attempts to break the boundary between reality and illusion, using sharp blades to tear the present world apart.

"The more awake you are in a dream, the more trapped you are in reality."
The awakened shadow projects the despair and darkness from the depths of the soul into people's dreams,
and thus the dream twists into this dark incarnation of disaster.

entries.source_text: 在进阶挑战中，双生铸灵展开默契的战术配合，迅猛的分身奇袭令人防不胜防，只有依靠敏锐的洞察力才能找到破敌之策。
entries.current_text:
In the advanced challenge, the two Sentinels use stronger teamwork and summon phantom clones to catch you off guard. Sharp eyes are your best defense.

Doomblade Sentinel splits into four phantom clones, each charging a different player.

ALL four phantom clones must hit Pickaxe Sentinel's Inferno Shield to break it. Stay spread out so the clones don't cross paths.

entries.source_text:
手握炽热战刃的机关战将。
黑金铠甲之下那炽热的核心，一刻不息地燃烧着。
万锻神刃将十分擅长近距离搏斗，攻击袭来之时如同泰山压顶。
那把巨大火刃的高温足以流金烁石。

几乎没有生物敢于招惹万锻神刃将，而它也不会主动挑起争端。
战斗已不是它的使命，而是既定的宿命。
entries.current_text: A Mechcraft warrior wielding a blade of fire. Beneath the black-gold armor, a fiery core burns ceaselessly. The Ten-Thousand-Forge Blade is highly skilled in close-quarters combat, striking with the weight of a mountain. The intense heat of its massive fire blade is enough to melt metal. Few creatures dare to provoke the Ten-Thousand-Forge Blade, and it does not provoke others. Combat is no longer its mission, but its fated destiny.

entries.source_text: 【火盾冲撞】：劫刃铸灵会锁定玩家进行冲锋，同时孤戟铸灵在场地中央开启火盾。玩家须引导劫刃铸灵连续三次冲撞火盾，才能成功破盾，否则将承受巨额全屏伤害。
entries.current_text: [Fire Shield Collision]: The Blade-Severing Spirit locks onto a player to charge, while the Lone Halberd Spirit activates a Fire Shield in the center of the field. Players must lure the Blade-Severing Spirit to collide with the Fire Shield three times to successfully break the shield; otherwise, they will suffer massive screen-wide damage.

entries.source_text:
受到云蚕影响而变异的蘑菇。
有着如撑开的花伞般引人注目的紫色菌盖。
华盖霆菇会向外吐出孢子核，作为保护自身的一种手段。

选择刀枪剑戟作为武器的人都对华盖霆菇敬而远之。
倒不是说它本身有多么强大不可战胜，只是它那让人手脚酥麻的孢子实在烦人。
entries.current_text:
Mutated under the Aercocoon's influence, they bear striking purple caps that resemble open umbrellas and expel spore cores as a form of self-defence.

Even seasoned warriors armed with swords and spears keep their distance—not because these creatures are invincible, but because their numbing spores are relentlessly troublesome.

entries.source_text:
效仿游鱼之态所铸的青铜机关，千年来于遗迹中孤独巡守，以长鸣与利齿驱逐一切觊觎至宝的入侵者。

【重炮破鳞】：操作场地中的机关炮台持续攻击，并利用炮台护盾抵御机关铜鱼的片鳞弹幕。持续的轰击将瓦解机关铜鱼的韧性，使这尊巨鱼坠落地面，陷入短暂的失控。
entries.current_text:
Bronze automatons forged in the likeness of swimming fish, they have patrolled the ruins alone for a thousand years, using long cries and sharp teeth to drive away any intruders coveting their treasures.

[Heavy Cannon Armor-Piercing]: Operate the mechanical turrets in the arena to continuously attack, and use the turret shields to defend against the mechanical copper fish's scale barrages. Sustained bombardment will break the mechanical copper fish's resilience, causing this giant fish to crash to the ground and fall into a brief state of malfunction.

entries.source_text:
守关人岿然不动，一夫当关，千骑莫开。
巨盾阻敌，虽枯不倒，立如峰峦。
取英雄遗盾，锻机关之皇。
冰岩坠落崖间，敌我无路可退。
不屈的坚定信念已嵌入枢核，抵御之技牢不可破。

卑劣铁骑涌入关隘，卫国之躯已背对故土。
当残阳只剩余晖，被拉长的身影中出现了援军。
entries.current_text:
An unyielding gatekeeper, one who can hold the pass against a thousand riders. With a massive shield, it blocks all who stand before it, enduring like a mountain even in ruin. Forged from a fallen hero's shield, it stands as the pinnacle of mechanised defence.

When icy boulders fall off the cliff, there is no retreat. Its core is etched with unbreakable resolve, its defence impenetrable.

Its back faced the country it fought to defend as the underhanded cavalry streamed into the pass. In the dying light of dusk, as shadows stretch long, reinforcements emerge.

entries.source_text:
幽噩的身影，具形的梦魇。
令人心悸的修长伯屠，隐藏在阴影与梦境之中伺机而动。
紫羽下的暗影是猎物最后的记忆，其手持的月刃乃是作为独猎者的荣耀。
月刃伯屠脱胎于梦境，与周围的一切本就是一体。
振翼穿梭自如，华丽的斩击犹如幻影一般。

它撕裂了一个又一个梦境，它穿越了一场又一场幻想。
幽暗的步履只是狩猎的间奏，庸人的美梦才是它赖以生存的食粮。
entries.current_text:
A dark, eerie figure, an incarnate nightmare.
The tall, slender Dreamslayer lurks in the shadows and dreams, waiting for the perfect moment to strike.
The shadows beneath its purple feathers are the prey's final memory, and the moon-blade it wields is the pride of a lone hunter.
The Moon-blade Dreamslayer is born from dreams, one with everything around it.
It moves through the air with ease, its gorgeous slashes like phantoms.

It tears through dream after dream, traversing fantasy after fantasy.
Its dark footsteps are merely the prelude to the hunt; the dreams of the mediocre are the food it survives on.

entries.source_text:
“所谓巧，利于人谓之巧，不利于人谓之拙。”
由珍稀材料打造的最强机关人，发挥出了材料所能承载的极致。
机巧之术，分为两途。
其一为尊材。凡是材料皆有承载极限，利用复杂的设计来规避材料弱点是最常见的理念。
其二为探极。万枢重锤就是这种设计理念的极致展现。
当材料过于强韧的情况下，究竟能做到何种程度？
它的出现给出了诠释。

万枢重锤的构造实际上并不复杂，大巧若拙的理念，在这具巨型机关的设计上体现的淋漓尽致。
然而，鲜有生物能接下它哪怕一次的随意锤击。
它的能力已经远远超越考验级别，所以，这具超乎常理的机关人究竟为何而生？
entries.current_text:
"What is clever is that which benefits people; what is clumsy is that which does not."
Built from rare materials, the strongest automaton pushes its components to their absolute limit.
Mechanic arts follow two paths.
The first is 'Material Supremacy.' Every material has a breaking point, and using complex design to circumvent material weaknesses is the most common philosophy.
The second is 'Exploring the Limit.' The Myriad-Pivot Hammer is the ultimate expression of this design philosophy.
When materials are exceptionally tough, what can be achieved?
Its existence provides the answer.

The construction of the Myriad-Pivot Hammer is actually not complex; the philosophy of 'great skill appearing clumsy' is perfectly embodied in the design of this giant automaton.
However, few creatures can withstand even a single casual strike from it.
Its power far exceeds that of a test subject. So, why was this unnatural automaton created?

entries.source_text:
”莫笑少年痴狂语，天河尽处有孤寒。“
自星之队拿下归虚梦演冠军，稷下学子无不知星辰之子这么一号人物，他热烈奔放，言行夸张，他在观星台刻诗，剑指光辉银河中，最闪亮的星。
却无人知他每夜挥剑，只因对”天赋平庸“四字的恐惧。
无人知他的奋力一击中，凝聚了多少次倒在镜面前时的不甘。
无人知他张扬自信之下，内心始终因离去的父母而有阴影笼罩。

或许，连星辰之子本人也不清楚，他的自卑，他的怀疑，他对孤独的恐惧……
阴暗滋生在他的心底，从未在一个梦临之际轻饶过他。
直到与噩梦能量相拥那刻，他的嘶吼有了确切的声音。
他是星辰之子的梦魇，或许，也会成为你的……
entries.current_text:
"Mock not the youth for his foolish words, for there is cold solitude at the end of the Heavenly River."
Since the Star Team won the Pinnacle of Dreams, every student at Jixia knows the name of the Child of Stars. He is passionate and unrestrained, with exaggerated speech and actions. He carves poems into the Star-Gazing Platform, his sword pointing toward the brightest star in the glorious galaxy.
Yet, no one knows he swings his sword every night, driven by a fear of being "mediocre."
No one knows how many times his desperate strikes were fueled by the frustration of collapsing before the mirror.
No one knows that beneath his flamboyant confidence, his heart remains shrouded in shadows from his departed parents.

Perhaps even the Child of Stars himself does not realize that his inferiority, his doubts, his fear of loneliness...
Darkness breeds in the depths of his heart, never sparing him when a dream descends.
Until the moment he embraces the nightmare energy, his roar finds a definitive voice.
He is the nightmare of the Child of Stars, and perhaps, he will become yours as well...

entries.source_text:
手握炽热战刃的机关战将。
黑金铠甲之下那炽热的核心，一刻不息地燃烧着。
万锻神刃将十分擅长近距离搏斗，攻击袭来之时如同泰山压顶。

entries.source_text:
受梦境影响的箭羽隼。
它们有着梦蝶般五彩缤纷的羽翼。
魇影隼攻击迅速且对敌人有致幻效果，让人分不清其所在何处。

在梦境之地，魇影隼的叫声最为鲜明，其婉转哀鸣，凄凄冷冷。
一些说法认为梦到魇影隼的人，会遭遇不幸。
entries.current_text:
A falcon affected by dreams.
It has colorful wings like dream butterflies.
Nightshadow Falcons attack quickly and have a hallucinogenic effect on enemies, making it impossible to tell where they are.

In the Dreamland, the cry of the Nightshadow Falcon is the most distinct—melancholy and cold.
Some say that those who dream of a Nightshadow Falcon will meet with misfortune.

entries.source_text:
生活在沼泽地区的芦篱。
它们身材矮小，随蒲草迎风而动。
而隐匿在芦苇丛间，用吹箭伏击敌人是芦篱箭酋的拿手好戏。

附近的人们会用“芦篱毒箭”来形容喜欢背后捣鬼且心狠手辣的人。
entries.current_text:
Reed Hedgehogs live in swamp areas.
They are short and move with the wind along with the reeds.
Ambushing enemies with blowdarts while hiding in the reeds is the specialty of the Reed Hedgehog Arrow Chief.

People nearby use "Reed Hedgehog Poison Dart" to describe people who like to scheme behind others' backs and are ruthless.

“青铜为脊，片鳞相系。
刻纹于鳍，浮空游弋。”

entries.source_text: 【坚果诱敌】：铠鼠大王召出多只小甲鼠翻滚捣乱，其中一只携带特殊坚果，击倒后坚果留在场上；随后铠鼠大王将全体玩家拉近，并为其中两人缠上共鸣藤蔓（被缠者沉默且二人距离过远会被弹回），其余队友须抱起坚果吸引大王冲锋。被藤蔓相连的两人须反向拉开藤蔓作为绊索，方能绊倒冲锋中的巨鼠。
entries.current_text: [Nut Bait]: The Armored Rat King summons several small armored rats to roll around and cause chaos. One of them carries a special nut; defeating it leaves the nut on the field. The Armored Rat King then pulls all players in and binds two of them with resonance vines (the bound are silenced, and if they get too far apart, they are pulled back). The remaining teammates must pick up the nut to lure the King's charge. The two players connected by vines must pull in opposite directions to use the vines as a tripwire to trip the charging giant rat.

entries.source_text:
蛰伏于稷下遗迹的青铜机关守卫，形似龟兽负行。
用于防守的可移动青铜炮台。
遗落玄守诱敌深入，它们则担任最后的收网工作。

当入侵者被其他青铜守卫围困之时，遗落炮甲就已经在蓄力充能，
随后便马上移动到制高点来瞄准这些不速之客。
entries.current_text: A bronze mechanical guard dormant in the Jixia ruins, shaped like a tortoise carrying a load. A mobile bronze turret used for defense. The Lost Xuan-Guard lures enemies deep, and these turrets handle the final cleanup. When intruders are surrounded by other bronze guards, the Lost Cannon-Shells are already charging up, ready to move to high ground and target these uninvited guests.

entries.source_text:
”莫笑少年痴狂语，天河尽处有孤寒。“
自星之队拿下归虚梦演冠军，稷下学子无不知星辰之子这么一号人物，他热烈奔放，言行夸张，他在观星台刻诗，剑指光辉银河中，最闪亮的星。
却无人知他每夜挥剑，只因对”天赋平庸“四字的恐惧。
无人知他的奋力一击中，凝聚了多少次倒在镜面前时的不甘。
无人知他张扬自信之下，内心始终因离去的父母而有阴影笼罩。

或许，连星辰之子本人也不清楚，他的自卑，他的怀疑，他对孤独的恐惧……
阴暗滋生在他的心底，从未在一个梦临之际轻饶过他。
直到与噩梦能量相拥那刻，他的嘶吼有了确切的声音。
他是星辰之子的梦魇，或许，也会成为你的……
entries.current_text:
"Mock not the youth for his foolish words, for there is cold solitude at the end of the Heavenly River."
Since the Star Team won the Pinnacle of Dreams, every student at Jixia knows the name of the Child of Stars. He is passionate and unrestrained, with exaggerated speech and actions. He carves poems into the Star-Gazing Platform, his sword pointing toward the brightest star in the glorious galaxy.
Yet, no one knows he swings his sword every night, driven by a fear of being "mediocre."
No one knows how many times his desperate strikes were fueled by the frustration of collapsing before the mirror.
No one knows that beneath his flamboyant confidence, his heart remains shrouded in shadows from his departed parents.

Perhaps even the Child of Stars himself does not realize that his inferiority, his doubts, his fear of loneliness...
Darkness breeds in the depths of his heart, never sparing him when a dream descends.
Until the moment he embraces the nightmare energy, his roar finds a definitive voice.
He is the nightmare of the Child of Stars, and perhaps, he will become yours as well...

entries.source_text:
它潜行于学子的梦魇之中，
汲取人心中的执念与黑暗来重塑自身。
从狂狼的撕咬到巨熊的怒扑，
它在无尽的兽性中渐渐凝结出毁灭的力量。
这诞生于梦境的影子，妄图打破虚实的界限，用利刃彻底撕裂现世。

“梦境里越是清醒，现实中便越是困顿。”
苏醒的黑影将灵魂深处的绝望与阴影投射入人们的梦境，
于是梦境便扭曲成这般幽暗的灾厄化身。
entries.current_text:
It lurks in the nightmares of students,
absorbing the obsessions and darkness in people's hearts to reshape itself.
From the bite of a mad wolf to the pounce of a giant bear,
it gradually condenses the power of destruction within endless bestiality.
This shadow born of dreams attempts to break the boundary between reality and illusion, using sharp blades to tear the present world apart.

"The more awake you are in a dream, the more trapped you are in reality."
The awakened shadow projects the despair and darkness from the depths of the soul into people's dreams,
and thus the dream twists into this dark incarnation of disaster.

entries.source_text:
“青铜为脊，片鳞相系。
刻纹于鳍，浮空游弋。”
效潜蛟游鱼之态而造的精巧机关，
巡卫沧渊千载，岩穹下吞吐风霜。
倘若入侵者觊觎楼船贮藏的至宝，	
长鸣响起，贪婪之辈皆难逃鱼口。	

战火的余烬早已化为了遗迹的落尘，
故人离去，它仍在履行守护的使命，
直到那支渔歌越过大海，回到家乡。
entries.current_text:
"Bronze for a spine, scales linked in rows.
Engraved patterns on fins, gliding through the air."
An exquisite automaton crafted in the likeness of a diving dragon and fish,
Patrolling the Abyss for a thousand years, breathing wind and frost beneath the stone dome.
Should any intruder covet the treasures stored on the tall ship,
The long alarm will sound, and the greedy shall not escape the fish's maw.

The embers of war have long turned to the dust of ruins,
The old masters are gone, yet it still fulfills its mission of protection,
Until that fisherman's song crosses the sea and returns home.

entries.source_text:
梦境中的奇异生物。
怪异的伞形身体延出四条粗壮且悠长的触须。
缚梦枝棘遇到猎物便会召唤梦棘困住猎物，
吸食猎物身上的梦。
entries.current_text:
A strange creature from the dream realm.
Its bizarre umbrella-shaped body extends into four thick and long tentacles.
When the Dream-Binding Thorn encounters prey, it summons dream thorns to trap them and feed on their dreams.

entries.source_text:
手握炽热战刃的机关战将，以熔毁一切的高温与重斩，无情履行着战斗的宿命。

【炽刃光幕】：火焰形态的炎雷神刃将跃至场地一侧，持续挥出覆盖全场的火焰刀光。利用其间坠落的烈焰剑柄进行格挡。

【炎铸雷兵】：被刀光击碎的剑柄会化为追踪玩家的雷霆剑，若巧妙引导雷剑的方向，便可重创炎雷神刃将。

【引雷剑阵】：雷电形态炎雷神刃将跃至场地另一侧，直接召唤雷剑如雨落般轰击全场。
entries.current_text:
A mechanical warrior wielding a scorching blade, ruthlessly fulfilling its combat destiny with high temperatures that melt everything and heavy slashes.

【Blazing Blade Light Curtain】: The flame-form Flame-Thunder God Blade will leap to one side of the arena, continuously unleashing flame blade waves that cover the entire field. Use the falling flame sword hilts to block.

【Flame-Cast Thunder Soldier】: Sword hilts shattered by blade waves will turn into thunder swords that track the player. If you skillfully guide the direction of the thunder swords, you can severely damage the Flame-Thunder God Blade.

【Thunder-Drawing Sword Array】: The thunder-form Flame-Thunder God Blade will leap to the other side of the arena, directly summoning thunder swords to bombard the entire field like rain.

entries.source_text: 【重锤震域】：万枢重锤蓄力后释放全屏冲击波，一名玩家须迅速拾取场地中掉落的机关盾格挡攻击，其余玩家紧贴持盾者身后躲避。冲击波将连续爆发两次，需及时调整站位。
entries.current_text: [Heavy Hammer Shock Zone]: The Ten-Pivot Heavy Hammer charges and releases a screen-wide shockwave. One player must quickly pick up the mechanical shield dropped on the field to block the attack, while other players stay close behind the shield-bearer to hide. The shockwave will erupt twice in succession; adjust your position in time.

entries.source_text:
机关铜鱼以孤注一掷的姿态，意图摧毁挑战者赖以反击的炮垒，将战斗拖入最残酷的消耗。

【绝境炮垒】：可供操作的机关炮台减少为两座，且机关铜鱼会集中火力攻击炮台，使其损坏直至彻底瘫痪。

【机匣抢修】：必须击败场中不断涌现的遗落机关，获取它们掉落的维修机匣并运送至炮台进行抢修。修复后的炮台若得到持续维护，将进一步强化其炮击威力。
entries.current_text:
The Mechanical Bronze Fish attempts to destroy the artillery batteries the challenger relies on for counterattacks, dragging the battle into a brutal war of attrition.

[Desperate Battery]: The number of operable mechanical turrets is reduced to two, and the Mechanical Bronze Fish will focus its fire on the turrets, damaging them until they are completely paralyzed.

[Repairing the Magazine]: You must defeat the abandoned mechanisms that constantly emerge in the field, obtain the repair kits they drop, and transport them to the turrets for emergency repairs. If the repaired turrets are continuously maintained, their firepower will be further enhanced.

entries.source_text:
威声如震，动若霄鸣。
曾奔驰于广袤平原的通雷巨牛，硕大的牛角蕴藏着雷霆。
现在它故步自封，只与紫霄为伴。
苍黑的毛不断汹动，犹如狂澜怒涛。
它的领地就是它的雷池，它的营垒。
踏足的生物，将迎千钧雷击。
也许它也曾试图群居，但亲近者想必已成飞灰。

它游走，它静止。
它毁灭，它迷茫。
现在，是时候了。
entries.current_text:
Might as thunder, movement like the sky's roar.
The Thunder-Bull that once galloped across the vast plains carries thunder in its massive horns.
Now it keeps to itself, keeping company only with the purple clouds.
Its dark fur ripples constantly, like a raging sea.
Its territory is its thunder pool, its fortress.
Any creature that steps foot here will face a thousand-fold thunder strike.
Perhaps it once tried to live in a herd, but those who drew near have surely turned to ash.

It wanders, it stands still.
It destroys, it is lost.
Now, the time has come.

entries.source_text:
“石埋遗像丹青落，泉绕虚堂岁月深。”
自诞生之日起，它就陷入了长久的沉眠。
唯有屈指可数的几次醒来，
面前霜髯老者负手而立，身后弱冠青年勤学苦练。

星移斗转，沧海桑田。撑天之柱倾颓，拄地之釜崩陷。
青钺铸将浑然不觉，
安睡于空室之内，梦醒于瓦砾之间。
它不知昔日喧闹散去了何处，只记得熔铸在铜躯中的使命：
守护、守护，直到千军溃退，直到长梦无忧。
entries.current_text:
"Stone relics fade with time, as the years deepen around the empty hall."

It was awakened only few times. The old man with a white beard stood before it, followed by diligent young men.

As time passed, the pillar collapsed and the land cracked.

Dual-Axe General woke up amidst the ruins. It didn't know where the liveliness of the past had gone, but it remembered its mission: To protect and defend, until the enemy armies retreat, and until people can dream without concerns.

entries.source_text:
一种古老的远程作战机关俑。
百炼炮俑双手被改造成了重炮，镀金的炮管耐受力极强，弹无虚发。

它们游荡在战争的遗迹中，虽然失去了使命，但依旧恪守岗位。
entries.current_text:
An ancient long-range combat automaton.
The Bailian Cannon Automaton's arms have been modified into heavy cannons, and its gold-plated barrels are extremely durable, never missing a shot.

They wander the ruins of war; though they have lost their mission, they still hold their posts.

entries.source_text:
幽噩的身影，具形的梦魇。
令人心悸的修长伯屠，隐藏在阴影与梦境之中伺机而动。
紫羽下的暗影是猎物最后的记忆，其手持的月刃乃是作为独猎者的荣耀。
月刃伯屠脱胎于梦境，与周围的一切本就是一体。
振翼穿梭自如，华丽的斩击犹如幻影一般。

它撕裂了一个又一个梦境，它穿越了一场又一场幻想。
幽暗的步履只是狩猎的间奏，庸人的美梦才是它赖以生存的食粮。
entries.current_text:
A dark, eerie figure, an incarnate nightmare.
The tall, slender Dreamslayer lurks in the shadows and dreams, waiting for the perfect moment to strike.
The shadows beneath its purple feathers are the prey's final memory, and the moon-blade it wields is the pride of a lone hunter.
The Moon-blade Dreamslayer is born from dreams, one with everything around it.
It moves through the air with ease, its gorgeous slashes like phantoms.

It tears through dream after dream, traversing fantasy after fantasy.
Its dark footsteps are merely the prelude to the hunt; the dreams of the mediocre are the food it survives on.

entries.source_text: 万枢重锤的机关核心在进阶挑战中超载运转，将其机体性能推向极致，通过瞬移与多角度打击构建出精密的杀阵。
entries.current_text:
In the advanced challenge, Megadrive Hammer's Mech Core goes into overdrive. It teleports and attacks from multiple sites.

Triple Shock: Megadrive Hammer fires three full-screen shockwaves in a row. Before each shockwave, it teleports to the edge of the arena, so each wave comes from a different direction.

Shield Relay: After a player uses the Shield to block a shockwave, that player cannot use the Shield again for a short time. Another teammate must pick up and use the Shield to block the next shockwave coming from a different direction.

entries.source_text:
冰与火的平衡被彻底打破，机关展露末日般的毁灭姿态。

【天降寒渊】：遗冰火卫跃至半空，向全场倾泻大量冰柱，若未及时清除，冰柱将连环爆裂，覆盖全场。在倾泻冰柱后，遗冰火卫因能量消耗过度而短暂昏厥，此刻便是终结它的最佳时机。
entries.current_text:
The balance between ice and fire has been completely shattered, and the mechanism reveals a cataclysmic, apocalyptic form.

【Sky-Falling Cold Abyss】: The Relic Ice-Fire Guardian leaps into the air, pouring a massive amount of icicles across the arena. If not cleared in time, the icicles will detonate in a chain reaction, covering the entire field. After pouring the icicles, the Relic Ice-Fire Guardian becomes briefly stunned due to excessive energy consumption—this is the perfect moment to finish it off.

entries.source_text:
“墟成之秋，水滥成灾。众匠以夺天之工，造通玄之役。”
形似硕大屋脊的青铜造物，遮蔽着往日辛密。
巨大粗壮的节肢腿部，灵活的难以置信。
相得益彰的防御与冲击力，匹配了最原始的作战方式。
它要碾压一切入侵者。

稷下几乎无边际的地底世界，隐藏着错综复杂的河路与匪夷所思的生物。
古代工匠们利用驻墟玄守移山填海，是为了搭构什么？
entries.current_text:
"This place was ruined by excessive flooding. The craftsmen worked around the clock to come up with a solution."

Station Ruins Sentry, shaped like a bastion, hides the secrets of the past.

Its large, many-jointed legs give it remarkable flexibility.

With strong defenses and powerful attacks, it is built for simple, brutal tactics that crush invaders.

Station Ruins Sentry was created to move stones and hold back the sea, leaving behind a vast underground world of winding rivers and strange creatures.

entries.source_text: 【火盾冲撞】：劫刃铸灵会锁定玩家进行冲锋，同时孤戟铸灵在场地中央开启火盾。玩家须引导劫刃铸灵连续三次冲撞火盾，才能成功破盾，否则将承受巨额全屏伤害。
entries.current_text: [Fire Shield Collision]: The Blade-Severing Spirit locks onto a player to charge, while the Lone Halberd Spirit activates a Fire Shield in the center of the field. Players must lure the Blade-Severing Spirit to collide with the Fire Shield three times to successfully break the shield; otherwise, they will suffer massive screen-wide damage.

entries.source_text:
“墟成之秋，水滥成灾。众匠以夺天之工，造通玄之役。”
形似硕大屋脊的青铜造物，遮蔽着往日辛密。
巨大粗壮的节肢腿部，灵活的难以置信。
相得益彰的防御与冲击力，匹配了最原始的作战方式。

古代工匠们利用驻墟玄守移山填海，是为了搭构什么？

With strong defenses and powerful attacks, it is built for simple, brutal tactics that crush invaders.

Station Ruins Sentry was created to move stones and hold back the sea, leaving behind a vast underground world of winding rivers and strange creatures.

entries.source_text:
遗落火裂甲是留弃在稷下遗迹的特种机关造物。
主体为青铜而制，上半身似炉壶，下半身似蜘蛛。
触发机关时纹路会闪烁火光，预警着接下来的燃爆。

据说在爆炸后，其存余的核心会吸引周围的青铜重塑身躯。
entries.current_text:
The Relic Fire-Crack Armor is a specialized mechanical construct abandoned in the Jixia ruins.
Made of bronze, the upper body resembles a furnace, and the lower body resembles a spider.
When the mechanism is triggered, the patterns flash with fire, warning of an impending explosion.

It is said that after an explosion, the remaining core attracts surrounding bronze to reshape its body.

entries.source_text:
【蛮横冲锋】：蛮虎举起盾牌锁定玩家连续冲锋。被锁定者需调整身位避免波及队友，其他玩家可趁机攻击蛮虎背部。最后一段冲锋为红光技能，需及时闪避。

【震地惊雷】：蛮虎跃至场地中央连续砸地，产生扩散的冲击波。玩家可通过跳跃或闪避躲开，最后一击为红光技能，需格外留意。
entries.current_text:
[Brutal Charge]: The Savage Tiger raises its shield and locks onto a player to charge continuously. The locked player must adjust their position to avoid hitting teammates, while other players can take the opportunity to attack the Savage Tiger's back. The final charge is a red-light skill; dodge in time.

[Earth-Shattering Thunder]: The Savage Tiger leaps to the center of the field and slams the ground repeatedly, creating expanding shockwaves. Players can avoid them by jumping or dodging; the final strike is a red-light skill, so pay extra attention.

entries.source_text:
【三重震爆】：万枢重锤连续释放三次全屏冲击波，释放前它会瞬移至场地边缘，三次冲击朝向各不相同；

【机关护援】：万枢重锤在发动全屏攻击前召唤两名机关小怪，其中一名将抢先拾取场上的护盾；团队必须优先集火击杀持盾小怪，夺回护盾，否则将无法格挡后续那毁灭性的全屏攻击。
entries.current_text:
[Triple Shockwave]: The Megadrive Hammer releases three consecutive full-screen shockwaves. Before releasing them, it teleports to the edge of the arena, with each shockwave facing a different direction;

[Mechanism Support]: Before launching a full-screen attack, the Megadrive Hammer summons two mechanical minions, one of which will grab a shield from the field first. The team must prioritize killing the shield-bearing minion to reclaim the shield; otherwise, they will be unable to block the subsequent devastating full-screen attack.

entries.source_text:
【星璇破击】：天煞铸灵回到场地中央引导星辰之力，召唤五颗星座环绕自身旋转，玩家必须迅速击碎所有星辰节点以中断其咏唱，成功则可令其灵体溃散，反之则将遭受星辰坠落的全屏攻击。

【天垣穿梭】：天煞铸灵将召唤五颗隐匿的星座之影，并驱使四面不断旋转的星辉墙体，墙上留有可供逃生的缺口，玩家需灵活穿梭于缺口之间，将所有隐匿的星座之影寻出并击破。
entries.current_text:
[Star Vortex Strike]: The Celestial Spirit returns to the center of the field to channel star power, summoning five constellations to rotate around it. Players must quickly destroy all star nodes to interrupt its chant. Success causes its spirit to collapse; failure results in a screen-wide Starfall attack.

[Heavenly Barrier Shuttle]: The Celestial Spirit summons five hidden constellation shadows and drives four constantly rotating starlight walls. There are gaps in the walls for escape. Players must nimbly shuttle between the gaps to find and destroy all hidden constellation shadows.

entries.source_text: 【重锤震域】：万枢重锤蓄力后释放全屏冲击波，一名玩家须迅速拾取场地中掉落的机关盾格挡攻击，其余玩家紧贴持盾者身后躲避。冲击波将连续爆发两次，需及时调整站位。
entries.current_text: [Heavy Hammer Shock Zone]: The Ten-Pivot Heavy Hammer charges and releases a screen-wide shockwave. One player must quickly pick up the mechanical shield dropped on the field to block the attack, while other players stay close behind the shield-bearer to hide. The shockwave will erupt twice in succession; adjust your position in time.

entries.source_text:
这尊遗落的战争机关，是古代匠人对“冰火相生”之理的极致演绎。其炮管内红蓝能量流转相生，交织激荡。

【冰封炎破】：遗冰火卫发射寒流，将一至两名玩家封入冰柱，并向其余玩家发射追踪熔火飞弹。需引导飞弹破除冰柱解救队友，否则飞弹会击中自身，持续灼烧。
entries.current_text:
This lost war machine is the ultimate expression of the ancient craftsmen's theory of 'Ice and Fire Coexistence.' Red and blue energy flows and intertwines within its barrels.

[Frostfire Break]: The Frostfire Guard fires a cold current, trapping one or two players in ice pillars, while firing homing molten missiles at the others. You must lure the missiles to break the ice pillars and save your teammates, otherwise, the missiles will hit you and cause continuous burning.

entries.source_text: 【绝境粮守】：小甲鼠的生命值显著提升，需更高火力才能快速清除；同时坚果落地后的引诱范围收缩极快，持坚果者与拉藤蔓队友的配合须毫秒不差，任何延迟都可能导致绊索失败、粮仓失守。
entries.current_text: [Desperate Grain Guard]: The HP of small armored rats is significantly increased, requiring higher firepower to clear quickly. At the same time, the lure range after the nut lands shrinks extremely fast. The coordination between the nut carrier and the vine-pulling teammate must be millisecond-perfect; any delay may lead to failed tripwires and the loss of the granary.

entries.source_text:
蛰伏于稷下遗迹的青铜机关守卫，形似龟兽走地。
遗落玄守会阻拦入侵者，它拦截的方式也很简单——利用身体。

当闯入者发现被堵截，已经为时已晚，他们脱困的速度会被这些青铜机关的厚重外壳拖延，最终无可奈何地陷入重重包围中。
entries.current_text: A bronze mechanical guard dormant in the Jixia ruins, shaped like a walking tortoise. The Lost Xuan-Guard blocks intruders, and its method of interception is simple—using its body. By the time intruders realize they are blocked, it is already too late; their escape speed is slowed by the heavy shells of these bronze mechanisms, and they are inevitably trapped in layers of encirclement.

entries.source_text:
【蛮横冲锋】：蛮虎举起盾牌锁定玩家连续冲锋。被锁定者需调整身位避免波及队友，其他玩家可趁机攻击蛮虎背部。最后一段冲锋为红光技能，需及时闪避。

【震地惊雷】：蛮虎跃至场地中央连续砸地，产生扩散的冲击波。玩家可通过跳跃或闪避躲开，最后一击为红光技能，需格外留意。
entries.current_text:
[Brutal Charge]: The Savage Tiger raises its shield and locks onto a player to charge continuously. The locked player must adjust their position to avoid hitting teammates, while other players can take the opportunity to attack the Savage Tiger's back. The final charge is a red-light skill; dodge in time.

[Earth-Shattering Thunder]: The Savage Tiger leaps to the center of the field and slams the ground repeatedly, creating expanding shockwaves. Players can avoid them by jumping or dodging; the final strike is a red-light skill, so pay extra attention.

entries.source_text: 【绝境火盾】：劫刃铸灵的四个幻影分身发起的冲锋必须全部引导至孤戟铸灵的火盾上，任何一次失误都会导致破盾失败，极其考验团队的精准执行与协同能力。
entries.current_text: [Desperate Fire Shield]: The charges initiated by the four phantom clones of the Blade-Severing Spirit must all be lured into the Lone Halberd Spirit's Fire Shield. Any mistake will result in failure to break the shield, testing the team's precise execution and coordination.

entries.source_text:
“百日冰封蛮寨，千里火烧连营。”
被镌刻在了这具青铜造物之上。
这是古代匠人对战争的极致理解，亦是这具机关的诠释。
红蓝两种能量相生相融，增幅的炮击没有任何城池能阻挡。
然而，它却被弃置在废墟之下。

它作为进攻者的作用，没有机会得到展现。
反攻的号角还未吹响，而制造燃冰极铳的工匠们，已经牺牲在保卫它的战役之中。
entries.current_text:
"Freeze the camp with ice, and burn it with fire."

Those words are carved into the Mechanoid. They show the creator's understanding of war and explain its purpose.

Two energies fused and fed each other, amplifying the cannon fire so no defense could hold.

Yet the Mechanoid lay abandoned beneath the ruins. It never got a chance to be used. The horn for the counterattack never sounded—the craftsmen who built it had already died defending it.

entries.source_text:
遗冰火卫的核心能量逐渐失衡，机关的攻伐本能被推至极限。

【冰噬炎熔】：被封入冰柱的玩家将受到刺骨严寒，持续流失生命，并在冰冻结束时受到冰爆重创。引导熔火飞弹的解救行动刻不容缓。
entries.current_text:
The core energy of the Ice-Fire Sentinel is losing balance, pushing its combat instincts to the limit.

[Ice-Fire Consumption]: Players trapped in ice pillars will suffer from biting cold, continuously losing HP, and take heavy damage from an ice explosion when the freezing ends. Guiding molten missiles to save them is urgent.

entries.source_text:
“群绒之首，其发如火，爪如刃。其火虽盛，发却不燃。”
历战成王，率领群绒的首领。
吐息的烈焰烧灼着咽喉，让它更加兴奋。
被燃烧的猎物，是戏谑的玩物。它才能掌控，而挑战者只配抵挡。
灼绒也曾挑战，但现在的它，业已成王。
此刻，矗立在群兽中的赤影，将震撼所有生灵。

伴随着它的到来，火燃了起来。
伴随着它的离去，火终会熄灭。
entries.current_text:
"Its hair is like fire, and its claws are like blades. Although its fire is intense, its hair does not burn."

After numerous battles, the Embermane became the king of its kin. Its flaming breath scorches its throat, further exciting its ferocity.

Burning prey are mere toys to it, as it maintains total control, leaving challengers always on the defensive.

Once a challenger itself, the Embermane has now ascended the throne. It stands head and shoulders above all beasts as a fearsome symbol to all living creatures.

Its arrival brings fire, and its departure hints at the death of those flames.

entries.source_text:
毕方将守护的执念化作了无差别的毁灭，它展开由炽雷构成的无形护盾，开始执行一场冷酷的、循环不止的清除程序。

【无尽天雷】：毕方进入护盾状态，并依次对所有玩家降下落雷。随后，它将开始循环随机抓取，每一次成功的擒获都意味着一次毁灭打击。

【惊雷破局】：唯一的生路在于场地四角被封印的炮台。须引导毕方的落雷精准命中炮台以将其激活，再操纵炮台轰击护盾。
entries.current_text:
Bifang has turned its obsession with protection into indiscriminate destruction. It deploys an invisible shield made of scorching lightning and begins a cold, endless cleanup cycle.

[Endless Sky-Thunder]: Bifang enters a shielded state and calls down lightning on all players in sequence. It then begins a cycle of random captures; every successful capture means a devastating blow.

[Thunderbreak]: The only way to survive lies in the sealed turrets at the four corners of the arena. You must lure Bifang's lightning to hit the turrets to activate them, then operate the turrets to bombard the shield.

entries.source_text:
“毕方，木之精也，状如鸟，不食五谷。”
青铜巨鸟，日夜鸣啼。其声雄厉，而听者无一不哀哀恸哭。
毕方忘记了许多事情，唯独牢记着自己的名字。
独脚锈蚀，双翼斑驳，但它的眼瞳仍和身体上深刻的流纹一起燃烧着青色的炽热火光。

楼船赋予它飞翔的使命，还有守护，以及奋战。
但如今楼船倾覆，它仍试图履行自己的使命，尽管它能守护的一切都已化作废墟。
于是它鸣叫，为了至少守住自己的名字，以一种近乎碎裂的骄傲：
毕方、毕方。
entries.current_text:
"Bi Fang, the essence of wood; it looks like a bird and does not eat the five grains."
A giant bronze bird, chirping day and night. Its cry is fierce, and all who hear it weep in sorrow.
Bi Fang has forgotten many things, but it remembers its own name.
Its single leg is rusted, its wings are mottled, but its eyes still burn with a cyan, scorching fire, matching the deep flow-patterns on its body.

The tall ship gave it the mission to fly, to guard, and to fight.
But now the ship has capsized, and it still tries to fulfill its mission, even though everything it could protect has turned to ruins.
So it cries out, to at least hold onto its name, with a pride that is almost shattering:
Bi Fang, Bi Fang.

entries.source_text:
“墟成之秋，水滥成灾。众匠以夺天之工，造通玄之役。”
形似硕大屋脊的青铜造物，遮蔽着往日辛密。
巨大粗壮的节肢腿部，灵活的难以置信。
相得益彰的防御与冲击力，匹配了最原始的作战方式。
它要碾压一切入侵者。

稷下几乎无边际的地底世界，隐藏着错综复杂的河路与匪夷所思的生物。
古代工匠们利用驻墟玄守移山填海，是为了搭构什么？
entries.current_text:
"This place was ruined by excessive flooding. The craftsmen worked around the clock to come up with a solution."

Station Ruins Sentry, shaped like a bastion, hides the secrets of the past.

Its large, many-jointed legs give it remarkable flexibility.

With strong defenses and powerful attacks, it is built for simple, brutal tactics that crush invaders.

Station Ruins Sentry was created to move stones and hold back the sea, leaving behind a vast underground world of winding rivers and strange creatures.

entries.source_text:
【机关重盾冲锋】：蛮虎举盾冲锋时盾牌具备独立盾值，玩家需集火击破才能使其陷入瘫痪，否则最后一段不可闪避的红光冲锋将造成毁灭性的打击。

【震地撼击】：蛮虎冲锋后立刻跃至场中连续砸地，产生全屏震感攻击。唯有拾取掉落的机关重盾方可阻挡，任何跳跃或闪避皆无济于事。
entries.current_text:
[Mechanical Heavy Shield Charge]: When the Savage Tiger charges with its shield, the shield has independent durability. Players must focus fire to break it to paralyze the boss; otherwise, the final unavoidable red-light charge will deal devastating damage.

[Earth-Shattering Impact]: After charging, the Savage Tiger immediately leaps to the center of the field and slams the ground repeatedly, causing screen-wide shockwave damage. Only by picking up the dropped Mechanical Heavy Shield can you block it; jumping or dodging is useless.

entries.source_text:
一种古老的远程作战机关俑。
百炼炮俑双手被改造成了重炮，雷电霹雳之声不绝于耳。

在炮管永不消逝的雷鸣声中，它偶尔也会想起记忆里的暴雨之夜吗？
entries.current_text:
An ancient long-range combat automaton.
The Bailian Cannon Automaton's arms have been modified into heavy cannons, with the sound of thunder and lightning echoing endlessly.

Amidst the eternal thunder of its cannons, does it occasionally recall the stormy nights of its memories?

entries.source_text:
【星璇破击】：天煞铸灵回到场地中央引导星辰之力，召唤五颗星座环绕自身旋转，玩家必须迅速击碎所有星辰节点以中断其咏唱，成功则可令其灵体溃散，反之则将遭受星辰坠落的全屏攻击。

【天垣穿梭】：天煞铸灵将召唤五颗隐匿的星座之影，并驱使四面不断旋转的星辉墙体，墙上留有可供逃生的缺口，玩家需灵活穿梭于缺口之间，将所有隐匿的星座之影寻出并击破。
entries.current_text:
[Star Vortex Strike]: The Celestial Spirit returns to the center of the field to channel star power, summoning five constellations to rotate around it. Players must quickly destroy all star nodes to interrupt its chant. Success causes its spirit to collapse; failure results in a screen-wide Starfall attack.

[Heavenly Barrier Shuttle]: The Celestial Spirit summons five hidden constellation shadows and drives four constantly rotating starlight walls. There are gaps in the walls for escape. Players must nimbly shuttle between the gaps to find and destroy all hidden constellation shadows.

entries.source_text:
遗落甲士是驻守在稷下遗迹的青铜机关队长。
青铜的构造上遍布奇异的纹路。
它们手中紧握着锋利的古老长枪，攻击迅速且致命。

据说只有战功显赫的人，才能得到百将的称号。
击败一百个敌人，才能统率一百名士兵。
entries.current_text:
The Relic Armored Soldier is a bronze mechanical captain guarding the Jixia ruins.
Strange patterns cover its bronze structure.
They hold sharp, ancient spears, attacking quickly and lethally.

It is said that only those with distinguished military service can earn the title of 'Hundred-General'.
Only by defeating one hundred enemies can one command one hundred soldiers.

entries.source_text:
驻墟玄守唤醒了沉寂于地底的古老造物，一场联合围剿就此展开。

【遗落追兵】：遗落炮机将优先轰击燃山机枢，玩家必须立即吸引其火力。

【锈蚀钳制】：遗落钳甲会阻碍玩家的行动，需分兵清理。 请在多重干扰下，尽快击杀驻墟玄守。
entries.current_text:
The Ruin-Guarding Mystic Sentinel has awakened ancient constructs buried deep underground, triggering a joint siege.

[Lost Pursuers]: Lost Artillery will prioritize bombarding the Burning Mountain Pivot; players must immediately draw their fire.

[Corroded Clamp]: Lost Clamps will hinder player movement; you must split your forces to clear them. Please defeat the Ruin-Guarding Mystic Sentinel as quickly as possible amidst these multiple interferences.

entries.source_text:
遗落灼枪甲是留弃在稷下遗迹的青铜机关造物。
左边的机关钳被替换成了喷火铳，管口处冒着余热的光。
在遗迹里进行维修工作，偶尔也会遇上需要火力清扫障碍的情况。

“要是它把火铳对准自己的钳子，那钳子也会融化吗？”一位新人工巧家不禁发问。
entries.current_text:
Lost in the Jixia ruins, they possess a crab-like pincer and a flamethrower that glows with heat.
They perform maintenance within the ruins and use their flamethrowers to clear obstacles as needed.

A novice Crafter curiously asks, "Would the flamethrower melt its pincer?"

entries.source_text:
伯屠大君乃是堕入梦境的冷峻猎手，他裹挟着黑暗而来，誓要将这片梦境拖入彻底的毁灭。

【至暗梦魇】：伯屠大君唤来吞噬一切的深沉黑暗，而魇光台周围的光明区域，可庇护玩家免受黑暗的持续侵蚀。唯有寻找到黑暗中浮现的两名梦魇羽卫，将其击败夺取魇光，并成功护送至魇光台点亮，方能驱散黑暗，逼其现身。
entries.current_text:
Lord Botu is a cold hunter who has fallen into the dream. He comes wrapped in darkness, vowing to drag this dream into total destruction.

[Deepest Nightmare]: Lord Botu summons a deep darkness that devours everything. The bright area around the Nightmare Light Platform can protect players from the continuous erosion of the darkness. Only by finding the two Nightmare Feather Guards that appear in the darkness, defeating them to seize the Nightmare Light, and successfully escorting it to the Nightmare Light Platform to light it up, can the darkness be dispelled and force him to appear.

entries.source_text:
遗落火裂甲是留弃在稷下遗迹的特种机关造物。
主体为青铜而制，上半身似炉壶，下半身似蜘蛛。
触发机关时纹路会闪烁火光，预警着接下来的燃爆。

据说在爆炸后，其存余的核心会吸引周围的青铜重塑身躯。
entries.current_text:
The Relic Fire-Crack Armor is a specialized mechanical construct abandoned in the Jixia ruins.
Made of bronze, the upper body resembles a furnace, and the lower body resembles a spider.
When the mechanism is triggered, the patterns flash with fire, warning of an impending explosion.

It is said that after an explosion, the remaining core attracts surrounding bronze to reshape its body.

entries.source_text:
遗落钳甲是留弃在稷下遗迹的青铜机关造物。
模仿虫蟹的样子举着机关钳，外壳有发光的神秘纹路。
通常情况下使用双钳进行维修工作，根据环境会替换对应的属性部件。

它们究竟如何有条不紊地履行职责，一直是工巧家们想攻破的谜题。
entries.current_text:
The Relic Clamp Armor is a bronze mechanical construct abandoned in the Jixia ruins.
It mimics the appearance of a crab, holding mechanical clamps, with mysterious glowing patterns on its shell.
It usually uses its dual clamps for maintenance work and replaces corresponding attribute parts based on the environment.

How they perform their duties so methodically has always been a puzzle that craftsmen want to solve.

entries.source_text:
它潜行于学子的梦魇之中，
汲取人心中的执念与黑暗来重塑自身。
从狂狼的撕咬到巨熊的怒扑，
它在无尽的兽性中渐渐凝结出毁灭的力量。
这诞生于梦境的影子，妄图打破虚实的界限，用利刃彻底撕裂现世。

“梦境里越是清醒，现实中便越是困顿。”
苏醒的黑影将灵魂深处的绝望与阴影投射入人们的梦境，
于是梦境便扭曲成这般幽暗的灾厄化身。
entries.current_text:
It lurks in the nightmares of students,
absorbing the obsessions and darkness in people's hearts to reshape itself.
From the bite of a mad wolf to the pounce of a giant bear,
it gradually condenses the power of destruction within endless bestiality.
This shadow born of dreams attempts to break the boundary between reality and illusion, using sharp blades to tear the present world apart.

"The more awake you are in a dream, the more trapped you are in reality."
The awakened shadow projects the despair and darkness from the depths of the soul into people's dreams,
and thus the dream twists into this dark incarnation of disaster.

entries.source_text:
随着核心加速运转，古老的青铜之躯与废墟中残存的雷光之力共鸣，令攻势愈发凌厉。

【怒雷重阵】：石柱重若千钧，合力推倒的时长大幅增加。青钺铸将的攻势亦变得极度狂暴，伴随落雷的轰击。
entries.current_text:
As the core accelerates, the ancient bronze body resonates with the remaining thunder power in the ruins, making the attacks increasingly fierce.

[Thunderous Formation]: The stone pillars are heavy, and the time required to push them down together is significantly increased. The Qingyue General's attacks also become extremely violent, accompanied by lightning strikes.
