entries.source_text:
炎雷神刃将的攻势变得更为狂暴，火焰与雷霆在更短的间歇内切换。

【炽浪连峰】：火焰刀光的频率、数量与威力均大幅提升，生存空间被急剧压缩。

【怒炎迅燃】：施展完火焰连斩后，它将以更快的速度恢复行动，发动下一轮攻势。
entries.current_text:
The Flame-Thunder Blade General's offensive becomes more violent, switching between fire and thunder at shorter intervals.

[Scorching Wave Peaks]: The frequency, quantity, and power of the fire blade light are significantly increased, and the living space is drastically compressed.
[Angry Flame Rapid Burn]: After performing the fire combo slash, it will recover its actions at a faster speed and launch the next round of attacks.

entries.source_text:
沉沦于噩梦的绮影梦魔将其狂想推向极致，其梦魇造物变得极具压迫感。

【执念加护】：被召唤出的魇蝶生命之力显著提升，难以被迅速击破；

【涟漪疾涌】：从梦魇裂隙中溢出的梦魇涟漪，其扩散速度急剧加快，迅速侵蚀着本已有限的生存空间。

【星环爆裂】：天煞铸灵回到场地蓄力并召唤五个星座环绕旋转，同时还额外施放三层逐渐扩大的环形范围伤害，玩家必须在躲避连续地火的同时完成对星座节点的击破；

【碎星追魂】：二阶段的墙体旋转加速，且天煞铸灵将锁定每位玩家生成三颗追踪能量球持续追击，极大干扰移动路径，团队需在规避能量球攻击的同时寻找墙体缺口，以击破隐匿的星座之影。
entries.current_text:
[Star Ring Burst]: The Celestial Spirit returns to the field to charge up and summons five constellations that rotate around it. It also releases three layers of expanding ring-shaped area damage. Players must destroy the constellation nodes while dodging continuous ground fire.

[Star-Shattering Soul Chaser]: The wall rotation in the second phase accelerates, and the Celestial Spirit locks onto each player, spawning three tracking energy orbs that persist in pursuit, severely disrupting movement paths. The team must find gaps in the walls to destroy the hidden constellation shadows while evading the energy orbs.

entries.source_text: 【狂鼠冲阵】：除原有机制外，场中会额外出现一只铠鼠精英，沿固定路线反复冲撞，若持坚果者被撞则坚果掉落；此时须安排一名玩家专职拦截精英，并清剿四处翻滚的小甲鼠，否则阵型极易被打乱。
entries.current_text: [Mad Rat Charge]: In addition to the original mechanics, an Armored Rat Elite will appear on the field, charging along a fixed route. If the nut carrier is hit, the nut will be dropped. A player must be assigned to intercept the elite and clear the rolling small armored rats; otherwise, the formation will be easily disrupted.

entries.source_text:
【爆种环伺】：巨大化时会在每位玩家脚下生成即将爆炸的自爆木篱，须立即远离。

【焚盾死线】：投弹卫的火弹落地一会后会爆炸，玩家须在时限内拾起并朝木篱王投掷，否则将失去破甲的关键时机。
entries.current_text:
[Seed-Explosion Surround]: When giant-sized, it generates self-destructing wooden fences at each player's feet that will explode soon; move away immediately.

[Burning Shield Deadline]: The fire bombs thrown by the Bombardment Guard explode after a short time. Players must pick them up and throw them at the Wooden Fence King within the time limit, or they will lose the key opportunity to break its armor.

entries.source_text:
此刻的梦境已化为吞噬一切的绝望牢狱，每一缕微光都伴随着生命的灼烧。

【无间梦狱】：玩家受至暗梦魇的持续侵蚀大幅提升，而治愈的效果被极大压制。

【魇光焚身】：手持魇光所付出的代价变得更为沉重，流失生命上限的速度急剧加快，迫使团队以最快速度完成接力与护送。
entries.current_text:
The dream realm has now turned into a prison of despair that devours everything, and every glimmer of light is accompanied by the burning of life.

[Abyssal Dream Prison]: The player's continuous erosion by the Dark Nightmare is significantly increased, while healing effects are greatly suppressed.

[Nightmare Light Burning]: The price of holding the Nightmare Light has become heavier, and the rate of losing maximum health has accelerated sharply, forcing the team to complete relays and escorts as quickly as possible.

entries.source_text:
遗落凝枪甲是留弃在稷下遗迹的青铜机关造物。
右边的机关钳被替换成了冰射炮，管口处散着寒冷的气。
在遗迹里，不时会有机关装置过载高温，唯有极寒才能消除危急。

每有一位新手探险遗迹，百草园就会新增一名前来治愈冻伤的病患。
entries.current_text:
The Relic Condensing Gun Armor is a bronze mechanical construct abandoned in the Jixia ruins.
The mechanical clamp on the right has been replaced with an ice cannon, emitting cold air from the nozzle.
In the ruins, mechanical devices often overheat, and only extreme cold can eliminate the danger.

For every novice who explores the ruins, a new patient arrives at the Herb Garden to treat frostbite.

entries.source_text:
炎雷神刃将的两种狂暴力量近乎失衡，它企图降下湮灭一切的雷霆，唯有借力打力方能破局。

【雷陨剑阵】：炎雷神刃将飞至空中积蓄毁灭雷电，并朝玩家降下密集的雷剑。玩家须在规避攻击的同时击破掉落的雷剑，捡取并将它投掷回去，才能将炎雷神刃将从空中击落。
entries.current_text:
The two berserk powers of the Flame-Thunder Blade General are nearly unbalanced. It attempts to bring down thunder that annihilates everything; only by using its own power against it can you break the deadlock.

[Thunder Meteor Sword Formation]: The Flame-Thunder Blade General flies into the air to accumulate destructive thunder and rains down dense thunder swords on the players. Players must destroy the falling thunder swords while avoiding attacks, pick them up, and throw them back to knock the General out of the air.

entries.source_text: 暴怒的灼绒喷吐出猛烈的火焰，其火海攻势愈发汹涌，考验着团队在烈焰中的协同与预判。
entries.current_text:
The enraged Embermane sends out waves of fire that put your team's coordination to the test.

Synchronized Flames: All stone pillars rise at the same time, but each one stays up for much less time than usual.

Dance of Survival: Plan your moves so everyone uses each pillar efficiently. Any hesitation or delay by a team member can lead to casualties.

entries.source_text:
古老的防御型阵地机关人。
千淬震盾俑在设计的时候充分考虑了实用性。
塔盾上的机关纹路引导了卓越的震属性能量，让其具备了强劲的反击能力。

即使放到现在，这种利用能量赋予盾牌反击能力的设计仍然是一座机关上的丰碑。
entries.current_text:
An ancient defensive stationary mechanical construct.
The Qiancui Shock Shield Automaton was designed with practicality in mind.
The mechanical patterns on the tower shield channel superior shock elemental energy, giving it powerful counterattack capabilities.

Even today, this design of using energy to grant a shield counterattack capabilities remains a monument in mechanical engineering.

entries.source_text: 【火盾冲撞】：劫刃铸灵会锁定玩家进行冲锋，同时孤戟铸灵在场地中央开启火盾。玩家须引导劫刃铸灵连续三次冲撞火盾，才能成功破盾，否则将承受巨额全屏伤害。
entries.current_text: [Fire Shield Collision]: The Blade-Severing Spirit locks onto a player to charge, while the Lone Halberd Spirit activates a Fire Shield in the center of the field. Players must lure the Blade-Severing Spirit to collide with the Fire Shield three times to successfully break the shield; otherwise, they will suffer massive screen-wide damage.

entries.source_text:
云根贯空之巅，无它者存立。
硕根之上的霸主，鬃毛已化为光莹的晶体。
漆黑的阴影随日落笼罩山麓，肆意的鼾声响破黎明。
它生于云根核心，长于云流富足之所。
它屡战屡胜，却日益孤独。
过剩的能量，让它无处宣泄。
把磐石拍碎，摧万树折腰。
芒鬓巨熊寻不得一个匹敌的对手。

对它持续无数年的悬赏令，早已替换成勿近的警示。
然现在，城镇也已破败，只剩下腐蚀的残木与零碎的断章。
entries.current_text:
It reigns atop the Aerux, leaving no space for anything else to endure.

Its mane has crystallised into glittering shards, while its vast shadow stretches across the mountains at dusk.

Born at the Aerux's core, where Aerflow runs densest, it wields overwhelming power—yet finds no worthy foe, and with each passing day, grows ever more alone.

With ease, it shatters boulders and snaps trees, its strength unmatched. Still, no opponent has risen to challenge it.

For years, a nearby town offered rewards for its defeat. Now, that town lies abandoned and in ruins—nothing remains but rotting wood and scattered pages, a silent warning to all who would come near.

entries.source_text:
绮影梦魔是梦境中黑暗的化身，如今它的野心膨胀，将众人的梦境扭曲成的灾厄。

【三相幻形】：绮影梦魔在狼、熊、人三种形态间循环作战，各具独特战法。

【梦魇攫取】：当其化为熊或人形态时，它会召唤魇蝶抓起一名玩家飞向梦魇裂隙，队友须及时击落魇蝶，否则在坠入梦魇裂隙时，将引发毁灭性的爆炸。
entries.current_text:
The Dream Demon of Painted Shadows is the embodiment of darkness in the dream. Now, its ambition has expanded, twisting everyone's dreams into a disaster.

[Three-Phase Illusion]: The Dream Demon of Painted Shadows cycles between wolf, bear, and human forms, each with unique combat tactics.

[Nightmare Seizure]: When in bear or human form, it summons Nightmare Butterflies to snatch a player and fly toward a Nightmare Rift. Teammates must shoot down the butterflies in time, or a devastating explosion will be triggered upon falling into the rift.

entries.source_text: 在进阶挑战中，双生铸灵展开默契的战术配合，迅猛的分身奇袭令人防不胜防，只有依靠敏锐的洞察力才能找到破敌之策。
entries.current_text:
In the advanced challenge, the two Sentinels use stronger teamwork and summon phantom clones to catch you off guard. Sharp eyes are your best defense.

Doomblade Sentinel splits into four phantom clones, each charging a different player.

ALL four phantom clones must hit Pickaxe Sentinel's Inferno Shield to break it. Stay spread out so the clones don't cross paths.

entries.source_text:
驻墟玄守的守护本能被完全激发，其推进之势更加决绝，每一步都让大地震颤。

【不屈进击】：它无视所有干扰，向燃山机枢悍然推进。与基础挑战的区别在于，其步伐更为迅捷，留给玩家的截击时间大幅缩短。
entries.current_text:
The Ruin-Guarding Mystic Sentinel's protective instincts have been fully triggered, making its advance even more resolute, with every step shaking the earth.

[Relentless Advance]: It ignores all interference and charges toward the Burning Mountain Pivot. Unlike the basic challenge, its pace is faster, significantly shortening the time players have to intercept it.

entries.source_text:
雷电充斥全身的青铜机关，比一般的遗落筑甲外形更大。
巨钳之间紫电外溢，滋滋作响的嘈杂外示着危险的信号。
释放轰雷前所发出的声音会逐渐增大，敌人只有在此时才拥有为数不多的反应的时间。

据推测，除了维修工作外，遗落雷甲在遗迹里还承担着能量补给的职责。
稷下机关师正在想办法弄清它们经久耐用的原因。
entries.current_text: A bronze mechanism crackling with lightning, larger than the average Relic Armor. Purple electricity spills from its giant pincers, the buzzing noise a clear warning of danger. The sound it makes before unleashing a thunderbolt grows louder, giving enemies only a brief window to react. It is speculated that besides maintenance, the Relic Thunder Armor also serves as an energy supply unit within the ruins. Jixia mechanists are trying to figure out the secret to their durability.

entries.source_text: 与木篱王心意相通的木篱眷属陷入狂热，誓死守护自己的族群与君王。它们携带着致命陷阱，逼迫玩家在有限时间内做出精准反击。
entries.current_text:
Linked telepathically to the Saepes King, the minions enter a frenzy, ready to die for their liege. They carry deadly traps, forcing players to act quickly and with precision.

Explosive Traps: When enlarged, self-destructing Saepes appear beneath each player. Move away immediately to avoid instant damage.

Blazing Shield: Fireballs from Catapultors explode shortly after landing. Pick them up and chuck them at the Saepes King before they blow, or you'll miss the chance to break its parts.

entries.source_text: 铠鼠大王常年受云流滋养，它体型硕大，坚甲厚皮，每逢社戏便潜入田间窃取粮食。
entries.current_text:
The Armadillo Rat King has long thrived on Aerflow, developing a thick hide and a massive frame. During the Festive Fire Opera, it sneaks into the granaries to raid the crops.

Nut Lure: The King summons several little Armored Rats to wreak havoc, one of which carries a special nut. When the nut-bearer is defeated, the nut remains on the field. The Rat King then drags all players closer, ensnaring two with vines. Entangled players will be silenced, and straying too far will snap them back. 

Unbound allies must pick up the nut to bait the King's charge, while the entwined pair must pull their vines in opposite directions to trip the charging King. Timing and coordination are key—fail, and the colossal rat keeps rampaging.

entries.source_text:
机关铜鱼陷入狂怒，遗迹机关全面启动，弹幕攻势如怒涛般密集。

【裂甲唤潮】：更多的遗落火裂甲加入战场，从多方协同攻击。

【怒涛倾泻】：机关铜鱼的片鳞弹幕变得更加迅疾且难以预测，考验着玩家操作炮台的精准与护盾开启的时机。
entries.current_text:
The Mechanical Bronze Fish falls into a rage, all ruin mechanisms are activated, and the barrage is as dense as a raging sea.

[Armor-Cracking Tide]: More abandoned Fire-Splitter Armors join the battlefield, attacking from multiple sides.

[Raging Tide]: The Mechanical Bronze Fish's scale barrage becomes faster and more unpredictable, testing the player's precision in operating the turrets and the timing of shield activation.

entries.source_text:
理想中的朋友该是什么样子呢？

性格要温柔，还要有幽默感；要有超强战斗力，还要能一起古古怪怪……

这许许多多的幻想与期望杂糅在一起该是什么样呢？

孙尚香抱着巨大的火器，笑得没心没肺。

“火器就是本小姐最好的朋友！”

她或许也没有想到，自己会在遥远的稷下，与那个来自南荒的少女倾盖如故。
entries.current_text:
What should an ideal friend be like?

Gentle, humorous, possess incredible combat power, and be able to do weird things together...

What would it look like when all these fantasies and expectations are blended together?

Lady Sun hugged her massive firearm and laughed carefreely.

"Firearms are my best friends!"

Perhaps she never expected that in the distant Jixia, she would meet a girl from the Southern Wilderness and become fast friends.

entries.source_text:
做生意这事儿，自古以来都是言之易，行之难。
在各个铁匠铺辗转的这几年，将龙牙过去的淳朴观念冲击得摇摇欲坠。
噱头是什么？营销又是什么？为什么品质相同的武器，价格却天差地别？
其中太过复杂的弯弯绕绕，可让龙牙吃尽了苦头。
放弃可不是她的风格，纵使一路跌跌撞撞地碰得满头是包，但成功的曙光也终于开始闪耀！
与圭蝶组队，参加归虚梦演，等到拿下冠军的那一天，龙牙经营的铁匠铺一定能传遍稷下，让姑射山老家的人刮目相看！
entries.current_text: In business, it has always been easier said than done. These past few years of drifting between various blacksmith shops have shaken Longya's simple, old-fashioned views to their core. What is a gimmick? What is marketing? Why do weapons of the same quality have such vastly different prices? The overly complex ins and outs have caused Longya a great deal of trouble. But giving up isn't her style. Even after stumbling and getting bruised along the way, the dawn of success is finally beginning to shine! By teaming up with Guidie to participate in the Dream of Return, once they take the championship, the blacksmith shop run by Longya will surely spread throughout Jixia, making her folks back in Guxie Mountain look at her with new respect!

entries.source_text:
许多人不知道的是，妃寒其实在第一次见面时就很喜欢圭蝶。
那是个伶俐又敏感的女孩，总是迈着优雅的脚步接近，高傲又可爱，举手投足间却又能叫人瞥到她内心深处的良善。
二人的友谊水到渠成地变得日渐深厚真挚，在共赴归虚梦演的旅程上，她们之间又会开出怎么样的友谊之花呢？
entries.current_text: What many don't know is that Nivie actually liked Gui Die from the moment they first met. She was a clever and sensitive girl who always approached with elegant steps—haughty yet adorable—and in every gesture, one could catch a glimpse of the kindness deep within her heart. Their friendship blossomed naturally, growing deeper and more sincere with time. As they embark on the journey to the Dream of Return, what kind of friendship will bloom between them?

entries.source_text:
她看似是稷下学院最“不靠谱”的访客：横冲直撞，对农事机关意兴盎然，对市价行情了若指掌。这真是江郡的公主？

然而，在顺手解决了密探风波后，她已将在稷下的所见所思，从律法、农工到商贸，悉数凝练成革新治理方略的蓝图。那份专注与干练，便是她鲜活灵魂的另一面风采。

生于战火，长于乱世，她注定无法成为一朵娇柔的花。她将以自己的方式，与兄长一同，托举着江郡走向未来。
entries.current_text:
She seemed like the most "unreliable" visitor to the Jixia Academy: reckless, obsessed with agricultural mechanisms, and intimately familiar with market prices. Could she really be the Princess of Jiangjun?

Yet, after casually resolving the spy incident, she condensed everything she saw and thought about in Jixia—from laws and agriculture to trade—into a blueprint for reform. That focus and capability were just another side of her vibrant soul.

Born in the fires of war and raised in chaotic times, she was never destined to be a delicate flower. She will, in her own way, join her brother in carrying Jiangjun toward the future.

entries.source_text:
太阳遥不可及，旅人还在路上。
天灾夺走了父亲的生命，也毁掉了妃寒的家乡。
那一日她站在废墟之中，面对着父亲冰冷的身体，徒劳地一次又一次地施放自己从小学习的祭司魔道术，直到那只熟悉的兔子连拖带抱的将她带离危险的地方。
妃寒捶打、哭喊，兔子却始终一言不发，直到妃寒哭哑了嗓子，打没了力气，兔子才开口。
“北荒太冷了，我答应了你的父亲，要带你去一个温暖的地方。”
他们就是这样踏上旅程的。
……通天塔越来越近了。
entries.current_text:
The sun is out of reach, and the traveler is still on the road.
Natural disasters took her father's life and destroyed Nivie's hometown.
That day, she stood amidst the ruins, facing her father's cold body, fruitlessly casting the priest's magic she had learned since childhood, over and over, until that familiar rabbit dragged and carried her away from the danger.
Nivie pounded and cried, but the rabbit remained silent until Nivie's voice grew hoarse and she ran out of strength. Only then did the rabbit speak.
"The Northern Wasteland is too cold. I promised your father I would take you to a warm place."
That is how they began their journey.
...The Tower of Babel is getting closer.

entries.source_text:
三分之地暗流汹涌，世人皆把目光对准孙家兄弟的一举一动。
然而，在两人身后，手持火铳、带着三分可爱七分挑衅神情的江郡公主孙尚香，却是他们的秘密武器。
所谓家人，就是相互扶持、不计得失，她可以是铁血都督麾下一马当先的海盗克星，也可以是曹魏军阵中来去自如的公主先锋，但她最重要的身份，永远是孙家三兄妹的一员，孙家的事，哥哥的事，便是她孙尚香最大的事。
“大小姐驾到，统统闪开！”
炮火之后，常有惊喜。
entries.current_text:
The Three Kingdoms are rife with undercurrents, and the world watches every move of the Sun brothers.
However, behind them stands the Princess of Jiangjun, Lady Sun, wielding a firelock with a look that is three parts cute and seven parts provocative—their secret weapon.
Family means supporting each other through thick and thin. She can be the pirate-slayer charging at the forefront for the iron-blooded Viceroy, or the vanguard princess moving freely through Cao Wei's formations. But her most important identity will always be as one of the three Sun siblings. The Sun family's affairs, and her brother's affairs, are Lady Sun's top priority.
"The Young Miss is here, move aside!"
There's always a surprise after the cannon fire.

撷取沧浪楼船水域深处的浪蕊蓝珊研磨成粉，再与爪荀果一同放入冰袋轻揉，静置后便凝为这方晶莹剔透的冰蓝胶冻。
入口滑润清冽，口感清爽回甘，食后还能提神醒脑、舒缓倦意。老练的肴馔家更会搭配鲜脆水果、清甜蜜露与百味粉调和滋味，让口感层次更丰富。

“这么晶莹剔透，看着就忍不住一口吃光！”
entries.current_text:
Made by grinding the 'Wave-Stamen Blue Coral' from the deep waters of the Littoral Towership, then gently kneading it with Claw-Bamboo Fruit in an ice bag. After setting, it forms this crystal-clear, ice-blue jelly.
It is smooth and cool on the palate, with a refreshing, sweet aftertaste that clears the mind and eases fatigue. Experienced gourmets often pair it with crisp fruit, sweet nectar, and spice powder for a richer texture.

"It's so crystal clear, I can't help but eat it all in one bite!"

entries.source_text: 用稷狐麦为原材料制作的大饼，是织梦原上百姓的日常主食。采用了几十年前百草家研制的新品种稷狐麦为主原料。并承载了稷下学院与织梦原对丰收的祈愿。现于丰云集也有销售，更开发了跑腿业务，只为让更多人品尝到织梦原的特色美食。
entries.current_text: A flatbread made from Jihu Wheat, a daily staple for the people of the Dreamweave Plains. It uses a new variety of Jihu Wheat developed by the Baicao family decades ago, carrying the prayers for a bountiful harvest from both Jixia Academy and the Dreamweave Plains. It is now sold at Fengyun Market, with a delivery service even developed just so more people can taste this specialty of the Dreamweave Plains.

entries.source_text: 玲心苑的百草家们采集云流凝结的露水混合药草芬芳淬炼而成的药品。使用后不仅可以恢复伤势，更伴有云流化成的披帛环绕周身，抵御外来的伤害。“云间芳华凝朝露，天地精粹养神息。”
entries.current_text: Fast-acting healing medicine developed by the Herbalists for the Enlightenment Trials. It is made from rare, aromatic flowers and plants grown in the Garden of Solace. When used, the herbs work together in perfect harmony, and a protective shield is formed around the user's body.

entries.source_text: 用稷狐麦为原材料制作的大饼，是织梦原上百姓的日常主食。采用了几十年前百草家研制的新品种稷狐麦为主原料。并承载了稷下学院与织梦原对丰收的祈愿。现于丰云集也有销售，更开发了跑腿业务，只为让更多人品尝到织梦原的特色美食。
entries.current_text: A flatbread made from Jihu Wheat, a daily staple for the people of the Dreamweave Plains. It uses a new variety of Jihu Wheat developed by the Baicao family decades ago, carrying the prayers for a bountiful harvest from both Jixia Academy and the Dreamweave Plains. It is now sold at Fengyun Market, with a delivery service even developed just so more people can taste this specialty of the Dreamweave Plains.

entries.source_text:
曾经的归虚梦演赛事中，使用大锤的魔种混血学子所穿的头盔。
传闻其可使穿戴者在遭受巨力时，化解冲击，凝练神智，使之反成自身战意薪柴。
entries.current_text:
A helmet worn by a half-beast student who used a great hammer in a former Dream-Reverie Championship.
Rumor has it that it allows the wearer to dissipate impact when struck by great force, focusing their mind and turning the blow into fuel for their own fighting spirit.

entries.source_text:
曾经的归虚梦演赛事中，使用大锤的魔种混血学子所佩戴的饰品。
传闻其乃来自南荒凶蛮野兽，披挂在铠甲上时，仿若并非死物，而是战士战意与怒火的延申。
entries.current_text:
An accessory worn by a half-beast student who used a great hammer in a former Dream-Reverie Championship.
Rumor has it that it comes from a fierce beast of the Southern Wilds; when worn on armor, it seems not like a dead object, but an extension of the warrior's fighting spirit and rage.

entries.source_text:
与魇魔为伍者所佩戴的足具。
浓重的阴影自这双足具下散开，其间不断传来低沉魇语之声，融于黑暗之中，直至再无分别。
entries.current_text:
Footwear worn by those who consort with Nightmares.
Thick shadows spread from beneath these shoes, from which low, whispering Nightmare voices constantly emerge, merging into the darkness until they are indistinguishable.

由永夜祝福所镌刻的胸甲。
永夜笼罩之下，危险丛生，无数凶恶野兽潜于夜色，于黑暗中蛰伏等待。
唯得其祝福者可无惧伤害。
entries.current_text: A chest piece engraved by the Blessing of Eternal Night. Under the shroud of Eternal Night, danger abounds, and countless ferocious beasts lurk in the darkness, waiting. Only those blessed can fear no harm.

entries.source_text: 沧浪楼船地下水域孕育的蓝色珊瑚，状若绽放的花束，通体呈幽蓝之色。时光流转中，它静静记录过往，曾见证百年前楼船的盛景，枝桠里封存着岁月的回声。
entries.current_text: The blue coral nurtured in the underwater realm of the Canglang Treasure Ship resembles a blooming bouquet, glowing with a deep blue hue. As time flows, it quietly records the past, having witnessed the ship's glory a century ago; its branches hold the echoes of the ages.

entries.source_text: 其叶片呈现漩涡状包裹花蕊，散发出淡淡幽光。在人迹罕至的地下遗迹，多少采药人苦苦寻觅那微弱的光亮，却因错综复杂的古道和机关最终止步，无功而返。今盛不见古城衰，后世只留青照殿，叹！叹！叹！
entries.current_text:
Mostly found in the Underhall, this rare medicinal herb has leaves spiraling around the center of the flower, giving off a soft, gentle glow.

In the rarely visited ruins below, many herb gatherers search for this faint light, but they are often forced to turn back by confusing paths and hostile Mechanoids.

The once-great halls have fallen into ruin. Now, only a few herbs remain. Alas...

entries.current_text:
Mostly found in West Aerfall Highlands, this nutrient-rich plant usually grows by clinging to trellises.

Because it looks like a golden plate, some farmers hold contests during the full moon to see whose Goldplate Gourd is the largest and roundest.

多产自千峰关附近。多以菱刺状分布在矿脉区，有着优秀的塑形特性。

每一位稷下新生在接受临时武器特训时，都会拿着兰菱石的一角尖锥来迎战机关人。
entries.current_text:
An ore embedded with bright blue crystals, mostly found near Mountain Pass. Often forming in rhombus-spike clusters across mining zones, it offers excellent shaping properties.

Every new Jixia student uses Orchid Stone's pointed corner to face Mechanoids in their provisional weapon training.

entries.source_text: 果实甘甜的粮食作物，多产自春溪原，会结在灌木一样的植株枝干上。据传有人曾培育出巨大的品种，不但有着酒壶一样的肚子，还能在稷下到处奔跑行走。
entries.current_text:
Mostly found in Springbrook Plains, this sweet-tasting plant, a staple food, grows on bushy stalks.

According to legend, someone once grew a giant version of it that had a round belly and could run across the land.

他永远不会忘记，那个寒冷冬夜里，父亲热望的双眸。
楼船来到洞穴不知几载，他记事起，那硕大的青铜造物便屹立于此。
漫长的年月早已冲淡人们对故乡的眷恋。
父亲口中的楼船传说疯狂虚幻，却成为了现在与过去的唯一纽带。
他记得父亲整日伏案研究，可当那把神兵出世之际，魔种也接踵而至。
为了避免人们受伤，他将魔种引到隘口决战，但却低估了魔种的数量。
寒夜里，勇士怒吼，鲜血凝结。
父亲用力望了他一眼，随后兵器喷射出耀眼寒冰，将魔种和炙热之心一同冰封。
他继承了父亲的衣钵。
前人虽已作古，但只要那把双刀还在手中，自己便可以带着那份梦想回到家乡。
对应共鸣：绯瞳刃舞
entries.current_text:
He will never forget his father's eager eyes on that cold winter night.
The ship had been in the cave for who knows how many years; as far back as he could remember, that massive bronze construct had stood there.
Long years had long since washed away people's longing for their homeland.
The legend of the ship his father spoke of was wild and illusory, yet it became the only link between the present and the past.
He remembered his father hunched over his research all day, but when that divine weapon was forged, the monsters followed in its wake.
To prevent people from getting hurt, he lured the monsters to the pass for a final stand, but he underestimated their numbers.
In the cold night, the warrior roared, and blood froze.
His father looked at him intently, then the weapon unleashed a dazzling frost, sealing the monsters and his own burning heart together.
He inherited his father's mantle.
Though his predecessors are long gone, as long as those twin blades remain in his hands, he can return home with that dream.
Resonance: Crimson Blade Dance

entries.source_text:
朝阳徐升之时，年轻剑士的呼喝早已响彻山岗；
落日垂坠之时，暮年勇者的修行却才拉开序幕。
群山中长大的孩子都怀揣着一颗成为侠客的梦种。
他们传颂着陈年的英雄史诗，期待着像英雄一样，手持长剑站在山巅，有亲朋带着骄傲的笑容为他们鼓掌。
蓬勃的朝气伴着追逐打闹声洒满世间，滋润了一个又一个梦，却从来无人知晓，故事中的英雄就在这山中和他们共饮同餐。
老人不抢传说的光环，也无意打压年轻人的志向，他将白日的青山让给茁壮的幼苗，而自己往往迎着夕雾拔剑起舞。
那无尽的流光抚摸着他的宝剑，守望着归家的稚子，遍照着苍翠的山岗。
entries.current_text:
When the morning sun rises, the shouts of young swordsmen already ring across the hills;
When the sunset falls, the training of the aging warrior is only just beginning.
Children who grow up in the mountains all carry a dream of becoming a hero.
They recite ancient heroic epics, looking forward to standing on the mountaintop with a long sword like a hero, with friends and family clapping for them with proud smiles.
Boundless vitality, accompanied by chasing and laughter, spreads across the world, nourishing one dream after another, yet no one ever knows that the hero in the story is drinking and eating with them in these mountains.
The old man does not steal the spotlight of the legends, nor does he intend to suppress the ambitions of the young. He leaves the green mountains of the day to the thriving seedlings, while he himself often dances with his sword in the evening mist.
That endless flowing light caresses his sword, watches over the children returning home, and illuminates the verdant hills.

entries.source_text: 天生木滴落的树脂凝积成珀，剔透明澈，内里有宛如脉络的游丝随光流转，蕴含着重塑生命形貌的能量。神明陨落时，庇佑云梦的神木被赋予母神最后的怜悯，使赐福者们拥有脱胎换骨的可能。泥塑之器，拘于形骸；返本还真，乃化万象。
entries.current_text: Resin dripping from the Heavenly Wood condenses into amber, clear and transparent, with filaments like veins flowing within the light, containing the energy to reshape life. When the gods fell, the sacred wood that protected Yunmeng was granted the Mother Goddess's final mercy, giving the blessed the possibility of rebirth. Clay vessels are bound by form; returning to the origin reveals all manifestations.

entries.source_text:
北荒曾有部族恪守旧俗，首领身死后，需将其杖立于风眼百日，任霜雪日夜剥蚀。待气息散尽，杖身便沁出绛色纹络，自柄端蔓延至杖首，如冻土之下缓缓苏醒的脉动。

有老人曾言，每至月晦之时，杖中似有低语溢出，细若游丝，转瞬便被风声吞没。无人能辨是祈祷还是叹息，只知霜停后，杖首晶石已悄然转红。

此杖择主无声。风雪大作的夜里，它自会向某个方向微微倾斜——那便是为寻找部族的下一任首领，指明了来路。
entries.current_text:
There was once a tribe in the Northern Wasteland that upheld an old custom: after a leader died, their staff had to be planted in the eye of the wind for a hundred days, left to be eroded by frost and snow day and night. Once the life force faded, crimson patterns would seep from the handle to the head, like a pulse slowly awakening beneath the frozen earth.

Elders once said that during the dark of the moon, whispers would spill from the staff, thin as silk, only to be swallowed by the wind. No one could tell if they were prayers or sighs, only that when the frost stopped, the crystal at the head of the staff had quietly turned red.

This staff chooses its master in silence. On a night of heavy snow, it will tilt slightly in a certain direction—pointing the way to find the tribe's next leader.

entries.source_text:
仿若由一朵寒莲生长而成的法杖，触握时，从掌心传来阵阵寒意，手中杖柄似是冰晶，也似某种根茎。

相传于极北冻土之下，一朵永不凋谢的寒莲扎根于冰冷岩层，静静绽放。相传其本是寻常植物，却因得冰雪眷顾的神女一滴指尖血，而化为了他物。风雪经年，其花萼现如冰霜雕琢，层叠之中深藏着彻骨的寒意。这股冰寒，究竟是对生命的救赎，抑或是毁灭？

最后，寒冰以花萼的形状替她铭记——那些永冻于记忆之中，再未归来的春天。
entries.current_text:
A staff that looks like it grew from a cold lotus. When touched, a chill emanates from the palm; the handle feels like ice crystal, or perhaps some kind of root.

Legend has it that beneath the permafrost of the far north, a cold lotus that never withers took root in the cold rock layer and bloomed quietly. It is said that it was originally an ordinary plant, but it transformed into something else due to a drop of blood from the fingertip of a goddess favored by ice and snow. Through years of wind and snow, its calyx now looks like it was carved from frost, hiding a bone-chilling cold within its layers. Is this ice a salvation for life, or destruction?

In the end, the ice remembered for her in the shape of the calyx—those springs that were frozen in memory and never returned.

entries.source_text:
由北荒古木削制而成的法杖。

相传，北荒深处有一棵枯而不朽的古木，名为“冻弦”。其枝干如冰弦凝冻，风过时发出呜咽低鸣，部族中总是传说，那是大地在梦中呓语，在雪原留下的痕迹。

曾有祭司以此木削成一柄法杖，从此代代相传。每任祭司成年礼上，须以指尖轻触杖身——若冻弦为之鸣响，便是北荒万径冰雪认可了你的祈愿。
entries.current_text:
A staff carved from ancient Northern Wasteland wood.

Legend has it that deep in the Northern Wasteland stands an ancient, immortal dead tree called "Frost-String." Its branches are like frozen ice strings, emitting a low, mournful wail when the wind blows. The tribes say it is the earth whispering in its sleep, leaving traces across the snowfields.

A priest once carved a staff from this wood, and it has been passed down through generations. At every coming-of-age ceremony, the new priest must touch the staff with their fingertip—if the Frost-String rings, the ice and snow of the Northern Wasteland have accepted your prayer.

entries.source_text: 王昭君金法杖2
entries.current_text: Princess Frost Gold Staff 2

entries.source_text:
北荒祭司取雪兔遗骨磨成铃珠，串于杖环所制成的骨杖。

北境寒风掠过，铃音清脆，似是故友轻唤。铃音轻鸣间，只只雪兔幻影现于眼前，先祖之声自远方的风雪中遥遥传来，诉说那些被埋于积雪之下的故事。
entries.current_text:
A bone staff made by a Northern Wasteland priest, who ground the remains of snow rabbits into beads and strung them onto the staff's rings.

As the cold northern wind blows, the bells chime crisply, like the gentle call of an old friend. Amidst the light ringing, phantoms of snow rabbits appear before one's eyes, and the voices of ancestors drift from the distant snow, telling stories buried beneath the drifts.

entries.source_text:
弦鸣惊碎沧海，矢出划破长空。

此弩生于逆命之问：天道有疆，何物不可摧？
机括怒响之际，寻常战理尽皆颠覆，乾坤之势顷刻逆转。
凡此弩所向之处，胜利天平，只为无尽战意倾斜。

猛虎的子嗣们以汹涌的战意守卫江郡的自由。
entries.current_text:
The twang of strings shatters the vast sea, arrows pierce the sky.

This crossbow was born from a question of defiance: If the heavens have boundaries, what cannot be destroyed?
When the mechanism roars, conventional warfare is overturned, and the tides of fate shift in an instant.
Wherever this crossbow points, the scales of victory tip in favor of endless fighting spirit.

The descendants of the fierce tiger guard the freedom of Jiang Prefecture with their surging battle intent.

entries.source_text: 王昭君专法杖2
entries.current_text: Princess Frost Exclusive Staff 2

entries.source_text:

统一由军队工匠所制作，材质选用精钢与上等乌木，极大程度提升了重弩的射程与威力。
entries.current_text:
A standard heavy crossbow used by soldiers in the Three Kingdoms' Jiangjun region.

Manufactured by military craftsmen, it uses refined steel and high-quality ebony, significantly increasing its range and power.

entries.source_text:
由野兽皮毛与骨骼所制成的简易法杖。

北荒异族中，每逢新生儿降生，祭司便会以简易材料制作一把法杖，以求新生儿能得先祖之灵庇佑。
entries.current_text:
A simple staff made from beast fur and bones.

Among the Northern Wasteland tribes, whenever a child is born, the priest crafts a simple staff to ensure the newborn is protected by the spirits of their ancestors.

entries.source_text:
杖首悬浮着寒晶的法杖，似由整块冰晶雕琢而成。

相传于北境极寒之渊，有一奇物，形如冰棱，内蕴微光，每至风雪呼啸，其上光芒闪烁，仿若呼吸般吸纳着飘散的冰雪。

北境传说之中，奇物名为寒晶，乃是由万千北境生灵的执念凝结而成。众生的声声叹息，飘散于辽远天际，最终凝为冰雪，重归大地。
entries.current_text:
A staff with a cold crystal suspended at its head, appearing as if carved from a single piece of ice.

Legend has it that in the Abyssal Cold of the North, there exists a strange object shaped like an icicle, containing a faint light. Whenever the wind and snow howl, it flickers as if breathing, absorbing the drifting ice and snow.

In Northern legends, this object is known as the Cold Crystal, formed from the obsessions of thousands of Northern creatures. The sighs of all living things drift into the distant sky, eventually condensing into ice and snow, returning to the earth.

entries.source_text:
由北荒异族大祭司亲手所制的法杖。

祭礼的舞蹈在风雪之中代代传承，大祭司也随法杖交迭而更换。月下的第一支祭舞，便是少女祭司之路的起点。
entries.current_text:
A staff personally crafted by the High Priest of the Northern Wasteland tribes.

The ritual dance is passed down through generations amidst the snow, and the High Priest changes as the staff is handed down. The first ritual dance under the moon marks the beginning of a young priestess's journey.

entries.source_text:
谜题一：我矗立于峡谷，无言无语，回响着英雄的呐喊。我磨砺勇气，淬炼意志，是守望的壁垒，也是迈向胜利的阶梯。

谜题二：我巡游于赛场，挥翅方遒，汇聚着荣耀的思潮。我洞察全局，映照得失，是博弈的见证，也是智慧传承的灯塔。（另，翅字旁边有一行极小的批注：疑为错别字。）

谜题三：我沉睡于荒野，无声无息……（此道谜题不全，下方有一行匆忙补上的小字：尚在调查，诚邀各位学子共同探索！）
entries.current_text:
Riddle 1: I stand in the canyon, silent and wordless, echoing with the shouts of heroes. I sharpen courage and temper the will; I am a bulwark of watchfulness and a ladder to victory.

Riddle 2: I patrol the arena, wings fluttering, gathering the tide of glory. I observe the big picture and reflect on gains and losses; I am a witness to the game and a beacon of wisdom. (Note: There is a tiny annotation next to the word 'wings': Suspected typo.)

Riddle 3: I sleep in the wilderness, silent and still... (This riddle is incomplete. Below is a hastily added note: Still under investigation, we invite all students to explore together!)

entries.source_text: 本来稷下并无适合栽培辛炽果的环境，只能依靠海外进口。直到某日一名百草家突发奇想，居然将其种子撒在了赤红灵兽的附近。虽然产量少得可怜，但从此稷下也有了本地产的辛炽果。
entries.current_text: Originally, Jixia had no environment suitable for growing Xinchihuo fruit, so it had to be imported from overseas. One day, a herbalist had a sudden inspiration and scattered the seeds near a red spirit beast. Although the yield is pitifully small, Jixia has had its own locally grown Xinchihuo fruit ever since.

entries.source_text:
目前有已有五名游猎家外出调查各自的目标，根据反馈的信息，
凌霜接下了玄冰坠天盾的调查委托，地点在<69D0FF>珠玑湖畔靠东北的湖岸</>。
荆知林去往了<69D0FF>迷津洞</>，一同前往的还有她的徒弟，她们两人一起应该会安全一些。
幽木深则是在<69D0FF>春潭湿地</>，听说那边有狂暴的四足木篱的目击报告，只是湿地相对平坦，那么大体型的木篱会藏在哪儿呢？难道是钻到地下躲起来了？
火颜和雷殷殷本来是一同寻找傲火隼和天雷隼的，但似乎追踪到痕迹的这两只并没有在一起行动。
最新的报告反馈，火颜从<69D0FF>溯洄营地往古丘城的路上</>发现了傲火隼。
同样的雷殷殷也有收获，在<69D0FF>幽径城靠海的悬崖附近</>。
最后是去调查离群燎原巨蜥的景燎，在<69D0FF>翠箩野</>终于是追上了筑巢了的蜥蜴，目前没有收到什么特别的消息，应该是比较顺利吧。
entries.current_text:
Five Rangers have already gone out to investigate their respective targets. According to their reports:
Ling Shuang has accepted the commission to investigate the Frost-Sky Shield, located at the <69D0FF>northeastern shore of Zhuji Lake</>.
Jing Zhilin has gone to the <69D0FF>Maze Cave</>, accompanied by her apprentice; they should be safer together.
Youmu Shen is in the <69D0FF>Chuntan Wetlands</>. I've heard reports of a rampaging Quadrupedal Wood-Hedge there, but the wetlands are relatively flat—where would such a large creature hide? Could it have burrowed underground?
Huo Yan and Lei Yinyin were supposed to search for the Pride-Fire Falcon and the Sky-Thunder Falcon together, but it seems they are no longer acting in tandem after tracking the signs.
The latest report indicates Huo Yan spotted the Pride-Fire Falcon on the <69D0FF>road from Suhui Camp to Guqiu City</>.
Lei Yinyin also had success, finding her target <69D0FF>near the cliffs by the sea in Youjing City</>.
Finally, Jing Liao, who went to investigate the stray Blazing Giant Lizard, finally caught up to the nesting lizard in <69D0FF>Cuiluo Wilds</>. No special news has been received, so it should be going smoothly.

entries.source_text:
<span color="#ffe398">玩法介绍</>
     神机推演有多个难度，每个难度均需要通关上一难度，并达到所需的波流境界才能解锁
<span color="#ffe398">基础规则</>
     玩家可随己方炮车推进敌方防御塔，摧毁所有防御塔，击破敌方水晶方可获胜。
<span color="#ffe398">金币使用规则</>
     在玩法中，击败敌人后所有队员均可获得等量金币。当金币足够时可点击左侧购买按钮，消耗金币并从随机到的多个能力中选取一个作为奖励。
<span color="#ffe398">灵兽规则</>
     在神机推演的场地中，左右两侧平台分别会生成赤红灵兽、湛蓝灵兽。
     击败对应灵兽后，全队均可获得红、蓝Buff，以及大量金币。
     红Buff效果：每秒恢复一定生命值
     蓝Buff效果：定期为绝技进行充能
<span color="#ffe398">奖励规则</>
     各个难度首次通关后会发放该难度的首通奖励。首通奖励不会重置，仅首次通关可获得
entries.current_text:
<span color="#ffe398">Introduction</>
     Divine Deduction has multiple difficulties. Each difficulty requires clearing the previous one and reaching the required Flow Realm to unlock.
<span color="#ffe398">Basic Rules</>
     Players can advance their siege engines to push enemy towers. Destroy all towers and the enemy crystal to win.
<span color="#ffe398">Gold Usage</>
     During the mode, all team members receive an equal amount of gold after defeating enemies. When you have enough gold, click the purchase button on the left to spend it and select one ability from several random options as a reward.
<span color="#ffe398">Spirit Beast Rules</>
     On the Divine Deduction map, Crimson and Azure Spirit Beasts will spawn on the left and right platforms respectively.
     Defeating the corresponding Spirit Beast grants the entire team Red or Blue Buffs, as well as a large amount of gold.
     Red Buff: Restores a certain amount of HP per second.
     Blue Buff: Periodically charges your Ultimate.
<span color="#ffe398">Reward Rules</>
     First-clear rewards are granted for each difficulty. These rewards do not reset and can only be obtained once.

entries.source_text:
<span color="#ffe398">排行规则</>
     灾兽·双影排行榜每次活动开启后重置。
     参与灾兽·双影将根据最佳成绩进行排名。
     最佳成绩：当挑战成功时，优先依据挑战时间进行排名；未挑战成功时，则依据击败顶峰怪物最大生命值进行排名。

<span color="#ffe398">温度机制</>
     该玩法下猩红神兽、蔚蓝神兽的技能和环境将会影响玩家温度，当温度失衡时将受到相应温度机制的惩罚。
             高温：被爆炸击飞，并受到巨额伤害，一段时间内治疗效果降低。
             低温：清空体力，并受到巨额伤害，一段时间内体力恢复速度减慢。
     顶峰怪物单独在场时，另一场外顶峰怪物会随机向场内释放远程冰柱、炎柱攻击。
     玩家可以通过摧毁冰晶柱、熔岩柱来调控温度，摧毁柱子后，处于范围内的玩家会持续的降温或升温。

<span color="#ffe398">最终时刻</>
     当顶峰怪物处于25%生命值以下时，将会始终合力集火同一名玩家，此时无法再被其他仇恨技能拉扯仇恨。
entries.current_text:
<span color="#ffe398">Rankings</>

Rankings for Scourges: Twindread reset at the start of each event.

Your ranking uses your best performance: for successful runs, faster completion times rank higher; for unsuccessful runs, lower enemy remaining Health ranks higher.

<span color="#ffe398">Temperature</>

Temperature changes based on the environment and when Crimson Beast or Azure Beast uses their skills.

High Temperature: Causes an explosion that launches you into the air, deals heavy damage, and temporarily reduces healing effects.

Low Temperature: Drains Stamina, deals heavy damage, and temporarily slows Stamina recovery.

While only one enemy is active on the battlefield, the other will send ice or lava pillars from offstage. Destroy these pillars to help you cool down or heat up.

<span color="#ffe398">Final Stand</>

When an enemy's health drops below 25%, it locks onto one player, and its target cannot be changed.

entries.current_text: A loyal little guard from the vegetable garden. It loves to shake its cabbage leaves and has a keen sense of smell, able to distinguish a hundred plant scents. It loves helping people pick up dropped flower seeds and vegetable seeds. When it runs over, it gently scatters tiny green sprouts, keeping your combo streak alive and helping you score high with steady play!

entries.source_text:
漂浮于稷下各处的奇异果实。
表面长满了粗壮且柔软的绒毛。
为了保护自身，飞雷果会向外放电，攻击打算“摘走”它的生物。

当晴天听到惊雷的轰鸣，
不一定是要下雨了，也可能是谁不小心惊扰了它们。
entries.current_text:
Strange fruits that float throughout Jixia.
Their surfaces are covered in thick, soft fuzz.
To protect themselves, Thunderfruits discharge electricity at any creature that tries to "pick" them.

When you hear a thunderclap on a sunny day,
it doesn't necessarily mean it's going to rain; it might just mean someone accidentally disturbed them.

entries.source_text:
迷离兔与一般兔子的区别在于其双耳进化出一种伪装色。
它们耳朵上的花纹看上去就像一双巨大的眼睛。
这种特殊的花纹可以起到迷惑天敌的作用。
从正面看去，那双眼睛就仿佛来自梦境的丧煞。
恫吓着一切怀着不轨心思靠近的敌人。 

这双眼睛从何而来，为何而来，从来都是众说纷纭。
但不可否认，这对诡异的眼睛，确实让迷离兔在弱肉强食的环境中，换来了难得的安宁。
entries.current_text: The difference between a Blurry Rabbit and a normal rabbit is that its ears have evolved a form of camouflage. The patterns on their ears look like a pair of giant eyes. This special pattern serves to confuse natural predators. Seen from the front, those eyes look like spirits from a dream, intimidating any enemy that approaches with ill intent. Where these eyes came from and why has always been a subject of debate. But there is no denying that these eerie eyes have indeed earned the Blurry Rabbit a rare peace in a survival-of-the-fittest environment.

entries.source_text:
受到云蚕影响的萝卜。
短小的四肢、迟缓的动作、不屑的表情，以及一颗敏感的心。
隐袭萝卜有着极强的自我保护意识，会向任何接近他的生物投掷萝卜。

一些百草家研究了萝卜飞镖的组成。
其成分包括了萝卜、云丝以及一些起到粘合作用的无法消化的废物……
entries.current_text:
A radish affected by Cloud Silkworms.
Short limbs, sluggish movements, a disdainful expression, and a sensitive heart.
Stealth Radishes have a strong sense of self-preservation and will throw radishes at any creature that approaches them.

Some herbalists have studied the composition of these radish darts. They consist of radish, cloud silk, and some indigestible waste that acts as a binder...

entries.source_text: 果鹊（绿）
entries.current_text: Fruit Magpie (Green)

entries.source_text:
它的样貌从未被人类窥探过，在各式传说中，它有着截然不同的形象。
有人说它有酷似骨叶狐的骨叶，也有人说它有如云踪狐一般的云雾相随。

它以最柔美的步伐游走在稷下。
旷野，山巅，湿地，甚至梦境之森，它悠闲无束地变换着姿态。
虽或许有人见过它的形，但没有人能描绘出它确切的模样。
entries.current_text:
Its appearance has never been glimpsed by humans, and it has vastly different images in various legends.
Some say it has bone leaves resembling a Bone-Leaf Fox, while others say it is accompanied by clouds like a Cloud-Trace Fox.

It walks through Jixia with the most graceful steps.
Wilderness, mountain peaks, wetlands, and even the Forest of Dreams—it changes its posture leisurely and unrestrainedly.
Although some may have seen its form, no one can describe its exact appearance.

entries.source_text:
生活在遗迹中的机关造物，它们曾被用来记录文字、存储信息。
周身是古老的青铜所制，其上金属光泽黯淡，偶有锈迹。
身体上有古老神秘的天蓝色花纹。
这些机关没有攻击能力但移动速度较快。

文明早已消逝，造物却依然在等待着它们逝去的主人再度归来。
没人知道它究竟在守护什么。
entries.current_text:
Mechanical constructs living in ruins, once used to record text and store information.
Their bodies are made of ancient bronze, with dull metallic luster and occasional rust.
There are ancient and mysterious sky-blue patterns on their bodies.
These constructs have no attack ability but move relatively fast.

Civilization has long since vanished, but the constructs are still waiting for their departed masters to return.
No one knows what it is guarding.

entries.source_text:
迷鼻鼠是稷下常见的动物之一，喜欢捕食昆虫。
它总是把自己全身埋在土里，只留下形似花瓣的尾巴，吸引小飞虫。
如果有人靠近，迷鼻鼠就会从土里钻出来逃走。安全之后重新钻回土里。

由于经常在花丛中活动，它的爪子和尾巴都沾有花粉。
稷下学院的很多年轻人都喜欢这种可爱的鼠类。
但是迷鼻鼠可不管是谁对它的喜爱，无论是谁靠近，它都会逃之夭夭。
entries.current_text: The Snout-Mouse is a common animal in Jixia that feeds on insects. It always buries its entire body in the soil, leaving only its petal-shaped tail exposed to attract small flies. If someone approaches, the Snout-Mouse will burrow out of the soil and flee, only to return once it is safe. Because it often moves through flower beds, its claws and tail are covered in pollen. Many young students at Jixia Academy love these cute rodents. However, the Snout-Mouse doesn't care who likes it; it will run away from anyone who gets too close.

entries.source_text:
一种生活在织梦原野的紫色蜘蛛，小巧可爱讨人喜欢。
在夜深人静众人酣睡之时，它会悄无声息地辛勤劳作，编织出细密的蛛网。
晨间日光照耀，蛛网会点缀上许多晶莹剔透的露珠，宛如珍珠项链。

不少孩子相信，取屋蜘蛛是梦境的创作者之一。
它们那身神秘的紫色，说不定就是聆听了孩童们梦境中的呓语而成。
勤劳的小蜘蛛们用丝线拾取梦境的碎片，编织出梦的雏形，等待着沉睡者来认领。
entries.current_text:
A small, cute, and lovable purple spider that lives in the Dreamweave Plains.
In the dead of night when everyone is fast asleep, it works silently and diligently to weave fine spiderwebs.
When the morning sun shines, the webs are adorned with many crystal-clear dewdrops, looking like pearl necklaces.

Many children believe that these spiders are among the creators of dreams.
Perhaps their mysterious purple color comes from listening to the whispers in children's dreams.
The industrious little spiders use silk to collect fragments of dreams, weaving them into the shape of dreams, waiting for the sleepers to claim them.

entries.source_text:
果鹊是春溪原常见的鸟类。
它们的胆子和体格一样小，因此经常挤在一起。
大部分时间它们会用翅膀把全身包裹起来，倒挂在树枝上。
与环境融为一体的它们，看起来就像是翠绿色的果子。

传说果鹊的颜色，与它吃了不少绿色蔬果息息相关。
或许就是因为这点，绿色植物会对这些几乎没有威胁的生物们出于本能的敬而远之。
entries.current_text:
Fruit Magpies are common birds in Springbrook Plains.
They are as timid as they are small, so they often huddle together.
Most of the time, they wrap themselves in their wings and hang upside down from branches.
Blending into their environment, they look just like green fruits.

Legend has it that the color of a Fruit Magpie is closely related to the green fruits and vegetables it eats.
Perhaps because of this, green plants instinctively keep their distance from these harmless creatures.

entries.source_text:
分布在稷下各地的鹿，传说最早来自遥远的苦寒之地。
毛色呈梦幻优雅的冷蓝色，因而得名“幽岚”。
这种无法融于环境中蓝色的皮毛使得他们更容易吸引捕食者。
雄性幽岚鹿生长着巨大的角，宛若盘根错节的古老树冠。
雌性幽岚鹿只长着一对鹿茸般的短角，虽然难以抵御捕食者，但却让它们更加灵活。

尽管严寒天气在稷下并不常见，但仍有人发现，幽岚鹿群会在寒冷时聚成一团，并且将老弱个体护在中央。
游猎家认为，这可能源自于它们从寒冷故土上传承下来的古老习性。

幽岚鹿角在稷下以外的地方价值不菲，这给它们带来了莫名的祸端。
直到游猎家们开始对它们实施严格保护前，它们几乎绝迹。
entries.current_text:
Deer found throughout Jixia, legend says they originally came from the distant, bitter cold lands.
Their fur is a dreamy, elegant cold blue, hence the name "Gloom-Orchid".
This blue fur, which does not blend into the environment, makes them more attractive to predators.
Male Gloom-Orchid Deer grow massive antlers, resembling the tangled canopy of an ancient tree.
Female Gloom-Orchid Deer only grow a pair of short, velvet-like antlers; while difficult to defend against predators, this makes them more agile.

Although severe cold is rare in Jixia, it has been observed that Gloom-Orchid Deer herds huddle together during cold weather, protecting the old and weak in the center.
Explorers believe this may stem from ancient habits inherited from their cold homeland.

Their antlers are highly valuable outside of Jixia, which brought them unexpected disaster.
They were nearly extinct until explorers began to strictly protect them.

entries.source_text:
吸收云流结出的奇异果实。
有着比正常果实大数十倍的体型。
膨葫果对声音极其敏感，会用庞大的身躯压住任何发出异响的东西。

膨葫果酸甜可口，有着蜂蜜般的清香。
冰镇膨葫果汁在稷下的夏日十分畅销。
entries.current_text:
Absorbs the strange fruit produced by cloud currents.
It is dozens of times larger than a normal fruit.
Peng-Hu Fruit is extremely sensitive to sound and will use its massive body to crush anything that makes a strange noise.

Peng-Hu Fruit is sweet and sour, with a honey-like fragrance.
Iced Peng-Hu juice is very popular in Jixia during the summer.

entries.source_text:
形似玉环的魔道造物，通体墨绿，光泽温润。
其中迸射而出的能量光束迅捷而炽烈，能够轻易地洞穿岩石。

在古老的传说中，质地上佳的玉环代表着长久而稳定的和平。
事实上，唯有强大的力量才是太平盛世最重要的那块基石。
entries.current_text:
A magic-path creation shaped like a jade ring, dark green throughout with a warm luster.
The energy beams shot from it are swift and intense, capable of easily piercing rock.

In ancient legends, a high-quality jade ring represents long-lasting and stable peace.
In fact, only powerful strength is the most important cornerstone of a peaceful and prosperous age.

entries.source_text:
云踪狐浑身雪白，其间点缀着点点蓝色，繁复如古老的云纹在它们身上流动。
云踪狐行踪不定，只是喜好云雾，在云雾多发地区等候，多半能寻得它们的身影。

所以有传言，云踪狐能够吞云吐雾，驾云驭雨。
有两位游猎家，风物家兄弟追寻云踪狐多年，期望可以找出稷下气候变迁的规律。
entries.current_text:
The Cloud-Trace Fox is snow-white, dotted with specks of blue, with intricate patterns like ancient cloud motifs flowing over its body.
The Cloud-Trace Fox is elusive, but it loves mist and can often be found in areas where mist is frequent.

Thus, there is a rumor that the Cloud-Trace Fox can swallow clouds and spit mist, and ride the clouds to command the rain.
Two hunters, brothers who are naturalists, have been tracking the Cloud-Trace Fox for years, hoping to discover the patterns behind Jixia's climate changes.

entries.source_text:
浑身青绿，只有头冠、翅膀末端和尾部有少许红色羽毛点缀。
由于红色的羽毛较少，时常被人认为是全身青绿，使人看碧成朱。
但见青衣的赤色羽毛是的确存在的。

见青衣喜好洁净，经常出现在水域边濯洗羽翼，也因此亲近水边的生灵。
它们似乎能感受到生物的状态，曾有它们为处于极端缺水的旅者指引水源的记载。
entries.current_text:
Entirely green, with only a few red feathers adorning the crest, wingtips, and tail.
Because there are so few red feathers, people often mistake it for being entirely green, seeing green as red.
But the red feathers on the Green-Clad are indeed real.

Green-Clads love cleanliness and are often seen washing their wings by the water, which makes them close to water-dwelling creatures.
They seem to sense the state of other living things; there are records of them guiding travelers suffering from extreme dehydration to water sources.

entries.source_text:
高贵优雅的鸟类，身姿纤长。
其额上蓝紫色的冰洁长羽，如远山含黛，让人感觉高不可攀。

与云不见不同的是，远山黛不喜亲近人类。
遇见前来探访的人也是匆匆一瞥便飞走，像是诉说对扰鹤清净的不满。
它们也时常被当做专注之人的代称。
entries.current_text:
A noble and elegant bird with a slender figure.
The long, blue-purple icy feathers on its forehead, like distant mountains, make it seem unreachable.

Unlike the Cloud-Unseen, the Distant-Mountain-Dai does not like to be close to humans.
Even when it encounters visitors, it flies away after a fleeting glance, as if expressing its dissatisfaction with the disturbance to its peace.
They are also often used as a metaphor for focused individuals.

entries.source_text: 我曾连续一周记录某只润兔出洞时间与天气变化的关系，村民们也常常视它为活的晴雨表。
entries.current_text: I spent a week recording the relationship between a certain rabbit's emergence from its burrow and weather changes. The villagers often treat it as a living barometer.

entries.source_text:
周身洁白的润兔非常惹人喜爱，常常被拿来作为小孩子的玩具灵感。

传闻中润兔对天气特别敏感，也许这与它们喜爱吃新鲜的植物有关。
游猎家常观测到它们在雨天后觅食。
村落的人们也会通过观察润兔的动静预测天气什么时间放晴。
entries.current_text:
The snow-white Run Rabbit is very lovable and is often used as inspiration for children's toys.

It is rumored that Run Rabbits are particularly sensitive to the weather, which may be related to their love for fresh plants.
Travelers often observe them foraging after rain.
Villagers also predict when the weather will clear up by observing the movements of the Run Rabbits.

entries.source_text:
有着奇幻的皮毛色彩的兔子。
藏匿于黑暗之时人们只能看见那双迷幻的眼睛，时常能恐吓到进入梦境的学子。
朦兔时常出现在梦境之中，不过与藏于黑暗时凶狠的外表不同，它们性格友善，传言中时常帮助人类。

有幼童丢失后曾言，他们追逐着四只眼睛的兔子走进了紫色的乐园。
不过孩童之言算不了数，只是给传说增添了一点微末的真实。
entries.current_text:
A rabbit with fantastical fur colors.
When hiding in the dark, people can only see its hypnotic eyes, which often terrify students who wander into dreams.
Mengtu often appear in dreams, but unlike their fierce appearance in the dark, they are friendly and are rumored to often help humans.

Children who have gone missing once claimed they followed a four-eyed rabbit into a purple paradise.
However, the words of children don't count for much, just adding a touch of reality to the legend.

entries.source_text:
生活在临水区域的金舆龟。
相比于安淳龟的质朴，金舆龟的外壳上有着浅色的纹路。
在阳光的照射下这层纹路就仿佛是龟壳上华丽的镀金，显得尊贵无比。

很久以前，人们就把这种外壳嵌着金光的乌龟作为财富的象征。
因此，金舆龟时常被富贵人家饲养在水池中。
富贵一事，古往今来多是人追逐。
只要和它沾上一点点关系，哪怕只是一只普通的乌龟，也会因此被人所推崇。
entries.current_text:
The Golden Carriage Turtle lives in waterside areas.
Compared to the simple Anchun Turtle, the Golden Carriage Turtle has light-colored patterns on its shell.
Under the sunlight, these patterns look like gorgeous gilding on the shell, appearing incredibly noble.

Long ago, people used these turtles with golden-embedded shells as a symbol of wealth.
Therefore, Golden Carriage Turtles are often kept in ponds by wealthy families.
Wealth is something people have chased throughout history.
As long as one is even slightly associated with it, even an ordinary turtle will be highly praised.

entries.source_text: 同学，可以来武道学院广场一趟吗？有件事想拜托你一下呢。
entries.current_text: Classmate, could you come to the Martial Arts Academy plaza? There's something I'd like to ask of you.

entries.source_text: 同学，好久不见，还记得我吗？我是当初凌霜潭脚崴了的风物家甘策，去那里深度调查的。      多亏了你的帮助，我的文章预计要作为头版头条，刊登在新一期的彩云风物特刊上了！编辑内部阅读后，都说深受感动，现下稷下困难，这篇文章能很好的鼓舞同学们，学习那位学长，为稷下做力所能及的贡献。另外，这个发现对我们风物家内部来说也影响重大。一方面这个发现确实再次证明，我们对彩云盆地的调查并不够深入严谨，还有许多疏漏。另一方面，也证明了我们确实有相应的能力，去调查清楚这片土地曾经发生的事情。现下大家对彩云的调查都动力满满，也算好事。      哦对了，因为这个是我们俩共同发现的，所以我在文章上把你和我标注成了共同作者。嘿嘿，这个功劳，应该有你的一份。      再次感谢你的帮助，希望我们以后有缘再见。
entries.current_text:
Classmate, long time no see! Do you remember me? I'm Gan Ce, the chronicler who twisted his ankle at Ling-Shuang Pond while conducting an in-depth investigation. Thanks to your help, my article is expected to be the front-page headline in the new special edition of the Colorful Clouds Chronicle! After reading it, the editors were deeply moved. With Jixia facing difficulties, this article will be a great inspiration to our classmates, encouraging them to follow that senior's example and contribute what they can to Jixia. Furthermore, this discovery has significant implications for us chroniclers. On one hand, it proves that our investigation of the Colorful Clouds Basin was not thorough enough and had many oversights. On the other hand, it proves that we do have the capability to uncover what happened in this land. Everyone is now highly motivated to investigate the Colorful Clouds, which is a good thing.
     Oh, right! Since we discovered this together, I listed you as a co-author on the article. Hehe, you deserve credit for this.
     Thanks again for your help. I hope we meet again soon.

To thank you for your contribution to the rescue, the Lingyun Guard has decided to award you a medal. Unfortunately, I have other urgent matters to attend to, so I've asked Teacher Ling Jing, who is stationed at the camp, to pass it to you. Teacher Ling Jing usually treats students on the upper level of the Mengyu Lake Feiyu Terrace camp. Remember to go get it when you have time!

彻底失控的万枢重锤召唤机关护卫协同作战，机关核过载导致的指令失控，已经让“探极”理念已扭曲为纯粹的毁灭逻辑。

【三重震爆】：万枢重锤连续释放三次全屏冲击波，释放前它会瞬移至场地边缘，三次冲击朝向各不相同；

【机关护援】：万枢重锤在发动全屏攻击前召唤两名机关小怪，其中一名将抢先拾取场上的护盾；团队必须优先集火击杀持盾小怪，夺回护盾，否则将无法格挡后续那毁灭性的全屏攻击。
entries.current_text:
The completely out-of-control Megadrive Hammer summons mechanical guards to fight in coordination. The instruction failure caused by the core overload has twisted the "Polar Exploration" philosophy into pure logic of destruction.

[Triple Shockwave]: The Megadrive Hammer releases three consecutive full-screen shockwaves. Before releasing, it will teleport to the edge of the arena, with each of the three shocks facing a different direction.

[Mechanical Support]: The Megadrive Hammer summons two mechanical minions before launching its full-screen attack, one of which will grab the shield on the field first. The team must prioritize killing the shielded minion to reclaim the shield, otherwise, they will be unable to block the subsequent devastating full-screen attack.

曾啸聚山林的破门生首领蛮虎，在初战受挫后亮出了从机关学院掠取的实验型盾牌，他的狂暴蛮力在机关术的加持下更加恐怖，誓要碾碎一切挑战者。

【机关重盾冲锋】：蛮虎举盾冲锋时盾牌具备独立盾值，玩家需集火击破才能使其陷入瘫痪，否则最后一段不可闪避的红光冲锋将造成毁灭性的打击。

【震地撼击】：蛮虎冲锋后立刻跃至场中连续砸地，产生全屏震感攻击。唯有拾取掉落的机关重盾方可阻挡，任何跳跃或闪避皆无济于事。
entries.current_text:
Manhu, the leader of the rogue 'Broken Gate' faction who once terrorized the mountains, has unveiled an experimental shield looted from the Institute of Mechanics after his initial defeat. His savage strength, augmented by mechanical arts, is now even more terrifying as he vows to crush all challengers.

[Mechanical Shield Charge]: When Manhu charges with his shield, the shield has its own health bar. Players must focus fire to break it and paralyze him; otherwise, the final, undodgeable red-glow charge will deal devastating damage.

[Earth-Shaking Slam]: After charging, Manhu immediately leaps to the center of the arena and slams the ground repeatedly, creating a full-screen shockwave attack. Only by picking up the dropped Mechanical Heavy Shield can you block it; jumping or dodging will be of no use.

entries.source_text:
伯屠大君乃是堕入梦境的冷峻猎手，他裹挟着黑暗而来，誓要将这片梦境拖入彻底的毁灭。

【至暗梦魇】：伯屠大君唤来吞噬一切的深沉黑暗，而魇光台周围的光明区域，可庇护玩家免受黑暗的持续侵蚀。唯有寻找到黑暗中浮现的两名梦魇羽卫，将其击败夺取魇光，并成功护送至魇光台点亮，方能驱散黑暗，逼其现身。
entries.current_text:
Lord Botu is a cold hunter who has fallen into the dream. He comes wrapped in darkness, vowing to drag this dream into total destruction.

[Deepest Nightmare]: Lord Botu summons a deep darkness that devours everything. The bright area around the Nightmare Light Platform can protect players from the continuous erosion of the darkness. Only by finding the two Nightmare Feather Guards that appear in the darkness, defeating them to seize the Nightmare Light, and successfully escorting it to the Nightmare Light Platform to light it up, can the darkness be dispelled and force him to appear.

木篱王以霸道之姿主宰着木篱族群的意志。它持握的权杖象征王者威严，既无情奴役弱小的子民，也悍然击退来犯的外敌。

【群藤缚杀】：木篱王释放藤蔓束缚所有玩家，并召唤木篱枪卫全场冲锋，须尽快挣脱藤蔓以躲开攻击。

【汲灵巨化】：木篱王汲取周围小木篱的生命力，身形急剧膨胀并覆盖上一层坚不可摧的荆棘护甲。此时场边出现投弹卫兵投掷火弹，唯有拾取火弹掷向木篱王的护甲才能逐步瓦解其防御，否则它的力量将随着体型不断增长，直至碾压全场。
entries.current_text:
The Fence King dominates the will of the Fence tribe with an overbearing presence. The scepter it wields symbolizes royal authority, used both to ruthlessly enslave its weak subjects and to fiercely repel invading enemies.

[Vine Bind]: The Fence King releases vines to bind all players and summons Fence Spearmen to charge across the field. Break free from the vines quickly to avoid the attack.

[Spirit Absorption Giantization]: The Fence King absorbs the life force of nearby small Fences, causing its body to swell rapidly and become covered in an indestructible thorn armor. During this time, Bombing Guards will appear on the sidelines to throw fire bombs. You must pick up the fire bombs and throw them at the Fence King's armor to gradually dismantle its defenses; otherwise, its power will continue to grow along with its size until it crushes everyone.

entries.source_text:
这尊遗落的战争机关，是古代匠人对“冰火相生”之理的极致演绎。其炮管内红蓝能量流转相生，交织激荡。

【冰封炎破】：遗冰火卫发射寒流，将一至两名玩家封入冰柱，并向其余玩家发射追踪熔火飞弹。需引导飞弹破除冰柱解救队友，否则飞弹会击中自身，持续灼烧。
entries.current_text:
This lost war machine is the ultimate expression of the ancient craftsmen's theory of 'Ice and Fire Coexistence.' Red and blue energy flows and intertwines within its barrels.

[Frostfire Break]: The Frostfire Guard fires a cold current, trapping one or two players in ice pillars, while firing homing molten missiles at the others. You must lure the missiles to break the ice pillars and save your teammates, otherwise, the missiles will hit you and cause continuous burning.

entries.source_text:
炎雷神刃将的两种狂暴力量近乎失衡，它企图降下湮灭一切的雷霆，唯有借力打力方能破局。

【雷陨剑阵】：炎雷神刃将飞至空中积蓄毁灭雷电，并朝玩家降下密集的雷剑。玩家须在规避攻击的同时击破掉落的雷剑，捡取并将它投掷回去，才能将炎雷神刃将从空中击落。
entries.current_text:
The two berserk powers of the Flame-Thunder Blade General are nearly unbalanced. It attempts to bring down thunder that annihilates everything; only by using its own power against it can you break the deadlock.

[Thunder Meteor Sword Formation]: The Flame-Thunder Blade General flies into the air to accumulate destructive thunder and rains down dense thunder swords on the players. Players must destroy the falling thunder swords while avoiding attacks, pick them up, and throw them back to knock the General out of the air.

entries.current_text: Flame-Thunder Blade General Strategy

entries.source_text:
解放了全部本源的天煞铸灵已然化身为天灾本身，漫天星辰在他手中流转不休，无可比拟的毁灭之力降临于此。

【绝煞星陨】：此刻出现的灾厄陨星获得了灾星本源的强化，其稳定性极大提升，需要玩家倾注更强的攻击才能将之击碎。

【宙涡风暴】：星辉墙体的旋转速度变得极快，生路缺口瞬息即逝，因而追踪星座之影的压迫感也大幅增强，对团队的输出与协同能力是极大的考验。
entries.current_text:
The Heavenly Fiend Casting, having unleashed its full origin, has become a natural disaster itself. The stars swirl endlessly in its hands, bringing incomparable destructive power.

[Absolute Fiend Meteor]: The disaster meteorites appearing now are empowered by the Disaster Star origin. Their stability is greatly increased, requiring players to exert more powerful attacks to shatter them.

[Cosmic Vortex Storm]: The rotation speed of the starlight walls has become extremely fast, and the safe gaps vanish in an instant. Consequently, the pressure of tracking the constellation shadows has also increased significantly, posing a great test to the team's output and coordination.

entries.source_text:
铠鼠大王常年受云流滋养，它体型硕大，坚甲厚皮，每逢社戏便潜入田间窃取粮食。

【坚果诱敌】：铠鼠大王召出多只小甲鼠翻滚捣乱，其中一只携带特殊坚果，击倒后坚果留在场上；随后铠鼠大王将全体玩家拉近，并为其中两人缠上共鸣藤蔓（被缠者沉默且二人距离过远会被弹回），其余队友须抱起坚果吸引大王冲锋。被藤蔓相连的两人须反向拉开藤蔓作为绊索，方能绊倒冲锋中的巨鼠。
entries.current_text:
The Armored Rat King has been nourished by cloud currents for years. It is massive with thick, hard armor, and it sneaks into the fields to steal grain during village festivals.

[Nut Lure]: The Armored Rat King summons multiple small Armored Rats to roll around and cause chaos. One of them carries a special nut; defeat it to leave the nut on the field. The Armored Rat King then pulls all players closer and binds two of them with resonance vines (the bound players are silenced, and if they move too far apart, they are pulled back). Other teammates must pick up the nut to lure the King into charging. The two players connected by the vines must pull in opposite directions to use the vines as a tripwire to trip the charging giant rat.

entries.source_text:
效仿游鱼之态所铸的青铜机关，千年来于遗迹中孤独巡守，以长鸣与利齿驱逐一切觊觎至宝的入侵者。

【重炮破鳞】：操作场地中的机关炮台持续攻击，并利用炮台护盾抵御机关铜鱼的片鳞弹幕。持续的轰击将瓦解机关铜鱼的韧性，使这尊巨鱼坠落地面，陷入短暂的失控。
entries.current_text:
Bronze automatons forged in the likeness of swimming fish, they have patrolled the ruins alone for a thousand years, using long cries and sharp teeth to drive away any intruders coveting their treasures.

[Heavy Cannon Armor-Piercing]: Operate the mechanical turrets in the arena to continuously attack, and use the turret shields to defend against the mechanical copper fish's scale barrages. Sustained bombardment will break the mechanical copper fish's resilience, causing this giant fish to crash to the ground and fall into a brief state of malfunction.

entries.current_text: Legacy of Divine Refining: Bronze Fish Mechanism | Normal Guide

entries.source_text:
自诞生起便于守护使命中沉眠的青钺铸将，在瓦砾间苏醒，其铜躯铭记的唯一指令，便是驱逐一切入侵者。

【遗落援军】：青钺铸将召唤两台遗落炮机协同作战，需优先清理。

【磐石御阵】：青钺铸将于场地中央展开护盾，并在四角召唤石柱，接着循环点名单一玩家或全部玩家，众人需以石柱为掩体躲避，再齐心协力推倒石柱砸向青钺铸将，方能击破护盾使其昏厥。
entries.current_text:
A Bronze Axe General that has been dormant since its creation to fulfill its duty of protection. It awakens among the rubble, its only directive inscribed on its bronze body: expel all intruders.

[Lost Reinforcements]: The Bronze Axe General summons two Lost Cannons to fight alongside it; these should be cleared first.

[Rock Shield Formation]: The Bronze Axe General deploys a shield in the center of the arena and summons stone pillars at the four corners. It then cycles through targeting a single player or all players. Everyone must use the stone pillars as cover to hide, then work together to push the pillars over onto the Bronze Axe General to break its shield and stun it.

entries.source_text:
驻墟玄守唤醒了沉寂于地底的古老造物，一场联合围剿就此展开。

【遗落追兵】：遗落炮机将优先轰击燃山机枢，玩家必须立即吸引其火力。

【锈蚀钳制】：遗落钳甲会阻碍玩家的行动，需分兵清理。 请在多重干扰下，尽快击杀驻墟玄守。
entries.current_text:
The Ruin-Guarding Mystic Sentinel has awakened ancient constructs buried deep underground, triggering a joint siege.

[Lost Pursuers]: Lost Artillery will prioritize bombarding the Burning Mountain Pivot; players must immediately draw their fire.

[Corroded Clamp]: Lost Clamps will hinder player movement; you must split your forces to clear them. Please defeat the Ruin-Guarding Mystic Sentinel as quickly as possible amidst these multiple interferences.

entries.source_text:
灼绒不再轻视对手，将释放其真正的王者烈焰，火海之威足以焚尽一切，将猎物的生存空间压缩至极限。

【焚地烈狱】：地面火焰的伤害大幅提升，即使短暂触碰也可能致命；

【绝境柱舞】：场上升起的石柱数量减少了，且石柱崩塌速度更快，团队必须在极端紧迫的时间内做出最精准的移动决策。
entries.current_text:
Scorch-Fuzz no longer underestimates its opponents and will unleash its true kingly flames. The power of the sea of fire is enough to incinerate everything, compressing the prey's living space to the limit.

[Burning Hell]: Ground fire damage is significantly increased; even brief contact can be fatal.
[Desperate Pillar Dance]: The number of stone pillars rising on the field has decreased, and they collapse faster. The team must make precise movement decisions within an extremely tight timeframe.

entries.source_text:
曾啸聚山林的破门生首领蛮虎，以铜筋铁爪践踏武道准则。他悄然潜入三院争锋的会场，企图以蛮力粉碎这场盛典，证明唯有破坏才是真正的“强大”。

【蛮横冲锋】：蛮虎举起盾牌锁定玩家连续冲锋。被锁定者需调整身位避免波及队友，其他玩家可趁机攻击蛮虎背部。最后一段冲锋为红光技能，需及时闪避。

【震地惊雷】：蛮虎跃至场地中央连续砸地，产生扩散的冲击波。玩家可通过跳跃或闪避躲开，最后一击为红光技能，需格外留意。
entries.current_text:
Manhu, the leader of the rogue 'Broken Gate' faction who once terrorized the mountains, tramples upon the martial code with his bronze-sinewed limbs and iron claws. He has infiltrated the venue of the Three Academies' tournament, attempting to crush this grand event with brute force to prove that destruction is the only true 'strength'.

[Brutal Charge]: Manhu raises his shield and locks onto a player, charging repeatedly. The target must adjust their position to avoid hitting teammates, while others can seize the opportunity to attack Manhu's back. The final charge is a red-glow skill; dodge it in time.

[Earth-Shattering Thunder]: Manhu leaps to the center of the arena and slams the ground repeatedly, creating spreading shockwaves. Players can jump or dodge to avoid them. The final strike is a red-glow skill; pay extra attention.

entries.source_text: 三院争锋·万枢重锤|挑战攻略
entries.current_text: Three-school Showdown: Wanshu Hammer | Challenge Guide

entries.source_text:
绮影梦魔为无端的梦魇制造了更多变数，令幻形与造物愈发纷乱。

【梦魔狂化】：绮影梦魔召唤更多魇蝶，但魇蝶的防御力降低。此外，所有首领的攻击力和血量提升。
其他额外词条，可能令绮影梦魔的机制更具威胁，如额外的催眠技能，魇蝶血量提升，或令所有首领强化。

需要优先快速清除魇蝶，并且注意规避绮影梦魔高额的伤害！
entries.current_text:
The Dream Demon of Painted Shadows has created more variables for groundless nightmares, making illusions and creations increasingly chaotic.

[Dream Demon Frenzy]: The Dream Demon of Painted Shadows summons more Nightmare Butterflies, but their defense is reduced. Additionally, all bosses' attack power and HP are increased.
Other additional affixes may make the Dream Demon's mechanics more threatening, such as extra hypnosis skills, increased Nightmare Butterfly HP, or strengthening all bosses.

Prioritize clearing the Nightmare Butterflies quickly and be careful to avoid the high damage from the Dream Demon of Painted Shadows!

entries.source_text:
饿极了的铠鼠大王拿出了真本事，召唤来的小甲鼠体魄强壮，更为耐打，而坚果诱饵的生效时间大幅缩短。

【绝境粮守】：小甲鼠的生命值显著提升，需更高火力才能快速清除；同时坚果落地后的引诱范围收缩极快，持坚果者与拉藤蔓队友的配合须毫秒不差，任何延迟都可能导致绊索失败、粮仓失守。
entries.current_text:
The starving King Armadillo has brought out his true skills. The summoned Armadillos are stronger and more durable, and the effective duration of the Nut Bait is significantly reduced.

[Desperate Grain Guard]: The Armadillos' HP is significantly increased, requiring more firepower to clear quickly. Meanwhile, the lure range of the nuts shrinks rapidly after landing. The coordination between the nut-holder and the vine-pulling teammate must be millisecond-perfect; any delay could lead to a failed trap and a lost granary.

entries.source_text:
灼绒乃历战成王的兽群之首，此兽吞吐焰海，利爪如刃，以燃烧戏谑猎物为乐，赤色身影矗立之处便是永燃的烈焰之域。

【赤焰焚场】：灼绒喷吐炽焰将全场化为火海，此时友善的木篱将在场地四周依次升起石柱。

【焰柱舞】：玩家须及时跳上石柱规避地面烈焰。喷火结束后灼绒会陷入能量耗尽的疲态，此时是全力输出的最佳时机。
entries.current_text:
Scorch-Fuzz is the leader of a beast herd that has become king through many battles. This beast breathes seas of flames, its claws are like blades, and it enjoys teasing its prey with fire. Where its red figure stands is a realm of eternal flame.

[Crimson Burning Field]: Scorch-Fuzz breathes scorching flames, turning the entire field into a sea of fire. Friendly wooden fences will rise in sequence around the field.
[Flame Pillar Dance]: Players must jump onto the stone pillars in time to avoid the ground flames. After the fire-breathing ends, Scorch-Fuzz will enter a state of exhaustion, which is the best time to go all out.

entries.source_text:
劫刃铸灵勇烈如火，孤戟铸灵坚韧如山，二者于灾星中显现，只为恪守神铸者的责任。

【火盾冲撞】：劫刃铸灵会锁定玩家进行冲锋，同时孤戟铸灵在场地中央开启火盾。玩家须引导劫刃铸灵连续三次冲撞火盾，才能成功破盾，否则将承受巨额全屏伤害。
entries.current_text:
The spirit of the Calamity Blade is forged with fiery courage, while the spirit of the Lone Halberd is forged with mountain-like resilience. Both appear amidst the disaster, solely to uphold the duty of the Divine Smith.

【Fire Shield Charge】: The Calamity Blade spirit will lock onto a player and charge, while the Lone Halberd spirit activates a fire shield in the center of the arena. The player must lure the Calamity Blade spirit to charge into the fire shield three consecutive times to break it; otherwise, they will suffer massive full-screen damage.

entries.current_text: Armadillo Rat King

entries.source_text:
万枢重锤是机关学院“探极”理念的终极造物，以前所未见的坚韧材料突破承载极限，大巧若拙的设计使其每一记锤击皆蕴含摧山撼岳之威。

【重锤震域】：万枢重锤蓄力后释放全屏冲击波，一名玩家须迅速拾取场地中掉落的机关盾格挡攻击，其余玩家紧贴持盾者身后躲避。冲击波将连续爆发两次，需及时调整站位。
entries.current_text:
The Megadrive Hammer is the ultimate creation of the Academy's "Extreme Exploration" philosophy. It uses unprecedentedly tough materials to push load-bearing limits, and its deceptively simple design ensures that every strike carries the power to crush mountains.

[Hammer Shockwave]: The Megadrive Hammer charges up and releases a full-screen shockwave. One player must quickly pick up a mechanical shield dropped on the field to block the attack, while others hide behind the shield-bearer. The shockwave will erupt twice in succession, so adjust your positioning accordingly.

entries.source_text: 炎雷神刃将攻略
entries.current_text: Flame-Thunder Blade General Strategy

entries.source_text:
遗冰火卫的核心能量逐渐失衡，机关的攻伐本能被推至极限。

【冰噬炎熔】：被封入冰柱的玩家将受到刺骨严寒，持续流失生命，并在冰冻结束时受到冰爆重创。引导熔火飞弹的解救行动刻不容缓。
entries.current_text:
The core energy of the Ice-Fire Sentinel is losing balance, pushing its combat instincts to the limit.

[Ice-Fire Consumption]: Players trapped in ice pillars will suffer from biting cold, continuously losing HP, and take heavy damage from an ice explosion when the freezing ends. Guiding molten missiles to save them is urgent.

entries.source_text:
彻底激发远古魔种血脉的蛮虎已经失去了理智，周身沸腾的煞气给予了他更加强悍的力量与防御，俨然是一头上古凶兽再世。

【煞气护盾冲锋】：蛮虎冲锋时盾牌盾值巨幅提升，团队需集火造成大量伤害才能将其击破。

【震地撼击】：蛮虎冲锋后立刻跃至场中连续砸地，产生全屏震感攻击。唯有拾取掉落的机关重盾方可阻挡，任何跳跃或闪避皆无济于事。
entries.current_text:
The Savage Tiger, having fully unleashed its ancient demon bloodline, has lost its sanity. The baleful energy boiling within its body grants it even more formidable strength and defense, making it look like an ancient beast reborn.

[Baleful Shield Charge]: The Savage Tiger's shield value increases significantly during its charge. The team must focus fire to deal massive damage to break it.

[Earth-Shattering Slam]: After charging, the Savage Tiger immediately leaps into the center of the arena and slams the ground repeatedly, creating a full-screen shockwave attack. Only by picking up the dropped mechanical heavy shield can you block it; jumping or dodging will be of no use.

entries.source_text: 双生铸灵攻略
entries.current_text: Twin Spirit Forgers Guide

entries.source_text:
驻墟玄守乃古代工匠所铸的青铜巨物，形如屋脊，以巨力碾碎一切入侵者。

【青铜巡行】：这尊巨物锁定燃山机枢为目标，迈动节肢无情地推进，并在抵达后持续攻击燃山机枢直至毁坏。玩家必须全力阻止它的前进。
entries.current_text:
The Ruin-Guarding Mystic Sentinel is a giant bronze construct forged by ancient craftsmen. Shaped like a roof ridge, it crushes all intruders with immense force.

[Bronze March]: This giant construct locks onto the Burning Mountain Pivot as its target, relentlessly advancing on its limbs, and will continuously attack the pivot upon arrival until it is destroyed. Players must do everything in their power to stop its advance.

entries.source_text:
嘴馋的铠鼠大王为了抢走粮食唤来了更强的同伙！铠鼠精英身手灵活，干扰与冲锋更为刁钻，稍有不慎就会被它撞翻在地！

【狂鼠冲阵】：除原有机制外，场中会额外出现一只铠鼠精英，沿固定路线反复冲撞，若持坚果者被撞则坚果掉落；此时须安排一名玩家专职拦截精英，并清剿四处翻滚的小甲鼠，否则阵型极易被打乱。
entries.current_text:
The gluttonous Armored Rat King has summoned stronger allies to steal the food! The Elite Armored Rats are agile, with more devious interference and charging tactics. One wrong move and you'll be knocked flat!

[Frenzied Rat Charge]: In addition to the original mechanics, an Elite Armored Rat will appear in the arena, repeatedly charging along a fixed path. If the nut-carrier is hit, the nut will be dropped. A player must be assigned to intercept the elite and clear out the rolling small rats, or the formation will easily be disrupted.

entries.source_text:
机关核心彻底暴走，开场即召唤四台遗落机炮协同作战。

【狂雷绝阵】：石柱在雷霆加持下坚不可摧，玩家必须合力先将其击破后方可推倒。同时，铸将的冲锋与释放毁灭光束期间，将伴随全场大范围落雷。

【震渊双煞】：驻墟玄守将被唤醒，加入战斗。期间，青钺铸将间歇性地引发无法闪避的震地星火攻击全场。玩家须在雷暴与星火的双重压迫下快速击破驻墟玄守。
entries.current_text:
The mechanism core has gone completely berserk, summoning four abandoned turrets to fight alongside it at the start.

[Thunder Array]: The stone pillars are indestructible under the blessing of thunder; players must work together to break them before they can be toppled. Meanwhile, the General's charge and destructive beam will be accompanied by large-scale lightning strikes across the field.

[Twin Abyssal Terrors]: The Ruin Guardians will be awakened and join the battle. During this time, the Bronze Halberd General will intermittently trigger unavoidable ground-shaking sparks across the field. Players must quickly defeat the Ruin Guardians under the dual pressure of lightning storms and sparks.

entries.source_text:
驻墟玄守的守护本能被完全激发，其推进之势更加决绝，每一步都让大地震颤。

【不屈进击】：它无视所有干扰，向燃山机枢悍然推进。与基础挑战的区别在于，其步伐更为迅捷，留给玩家的截击时间大幅缩短。
entries.current_text:
The Ruin-Guarding Mystic Sentinel's protective instincts have been fully triggered, making its advance even more resolute, with every step shaking the earth.

[Relentless Advance]: It ignores all interference and charges toward the Burning Mountain Pivot. Unlike the basic challenge, its pace is faster, significantly shortening the time players have to intercept it.

entries.current_text: Three-school Showdown: Savage Tiger | Enhanced Guide

entries.source_text:
冰与火的平衡被彻底打破，机关展露末日般的毁灭姿态。

【天降寒渊】：遗冰火卫跃至半空，向全场倾泻大量冰柱，若未及时清除，冰柱将连环爆裂，覆盖全场。在倾泻冰柱后，遗冰火卫因能量消耗过度而短暂昏厥，此刻便是终结它的最佳时机。
entries.current_text:
The balance between ice and fire has been completely shattered, and the mechanism reveals a cataclysmic, apocalyptic form.

【Sky-Falling Cold Abyss】: The Relic Ice-Fire Guardian leaps into the air, pouring a massive amount of icicles across the arena. If not cleared in time, the icicles will detonate in a chain reaction, covering the entire field. After pouring the icicles, the Relic Ice-Fire Guardian becomes briefly stunned due to excessive energy consumption—this is the perfect moment to finish it off.

在进阶挑战中，双生铸灵展开默契的战术配合，迅猛的分身奇袭令人防不胜防，只有依靠敏锐的洞察力才能找到破敌之策。

【幻影冲锋】：劫刃铸灵会分出四个幻影分身锁定不同玩家冲锋。

【精准引导】：孤戟铸灵的火盾依然在场中，需要四名玩家准确识别并引导各自面对的分身冲撞火盾，且须保持分散，避免路径重叠。
entries.current_text:
In the advanced challenge, the Twin Casting Spirits deploy tacit tactical coordination. Their swift clone surprise attacks are hard to guard against, and only by relying on keen insight can you find a strategy to defeat the enemy.

[Phantom Charge]: The Blade Casting Spirit will split into four phantom clones, locking onto different players to charge.

[Precision Guidance]: The Halberd Casting Spirit's fire shield is still on the field. Four players must accurately identify and guide their respective clones to crash into the fire shield, while staying dispersed to avoid overlapping paths.

entries.source_text:
机关铜鱼以孤注一掷的姿态，意图摧毁挑战者赖以反击的炮垒，将战斗拖入最残酷的消耗。

【绝境炮垒】：可供操作的机关炮台减少为两座，且机关铜鱼会集中火力攻击炮台，使其损坏直至彻底瘫痪。

【机匣抢修】：必须击败场中不断涌现的遗落机关，获取它们掉落的维修机匣并运送至炮台进行抢修。修复后的炮台若得到持续维护，将进一步强化其炮击威力。
entries.current_text:
The Mechanical Bronze Fish attempts to destroy the artillery batteries the challenger relies on for counterattacks, dragging the battle into a brutal war of attrition.

[Desperate Battery]: The number of operable mechanical turrets is reduced to two, and the Mechanical Bronze Fish will focus its fire on the turrets, damaging them until they are completely paralyzed.

[Repairing the Magazine]: You must defeat the abandoned mechanisms that constantly emerge in the field, obtain the repair kits they drop, and transport them to the turrets for emergency repairs. If the repaired turrets are continuously maintained, their firepower will be further enhanced.

被逼至绝境的木篱王疯狂地向自己的子民索取力量，它的身躯变得坚不可摧，狂暴的力量足以摧山断岳。

【亘古壁垒】：此刻覆盖木篱王躯干的荆棘护甲变得异常坚韧，需要更多火弹才能击破。

【狂怒汲取】：木篱王巨大化期间的攻击力急速攀升，团队必须极高效率地拦截火弹并投掷，任何延迟都会导致生存空间急剧恶化。
entries.current_text:
Driven to a dead end, the Wood-Fence King frantically demands power from its subjects. Its body becomes indestructible, and its violent power is enough to shatter mountains and break cliffs.

[Ancient Bastion]: The thorn armor covering the Wood-Fence King's torso becomes exceptionally tough, requiring more fire bombs to break.

[Fury Drain]: The Wood-Fence King's attack power rises rapidly during its giant form. The team must intercept and throw fire bombs with high efficiency; any delay will cause the survival space to deteriorate rapidly.

entries.source_text:
万枢重锤的机关核心在进阶挑战中超载运转，将其机体性能推向极致，通过瞬移与多角度打击构建出精密的杀阵。

【三重震爆】：万枢重锤连续释放三次全屏冲击波，释放前它会瞬移至场地边缘，三次冲击朝向各不相同；

【护盾协同】：每名玩家持盾格挡后将进入冷却，必须由不同队员接力拾盾，才能应对来自随机方向的连续攻击。
entries.current_text:
The Megadrive Hammer's mechanical core overloads during advanced challenges, pushing its performance to the limit and creating a precise killing formation through teleportation and multi-angle strikes.

[Triple Shockwave]: The Megadrive Hammer releases three consecutive full-screen shockwaves. Before each, it teleports to the edge of the arena, with each shockwave facing a different direction.

[Shield Synergy]: Each player enters a cooldown after blocking with the shield. Teammates must take turns picking up the shield to handle the continuous attacks from random directions.

entries.source_text:
绮影梦魔是梦境中黑暗的化身，如今它的野心膨胀，将众人的梦境扭曲成的灾厄。

【三相幻形】：绮影梦魔在狼、熊、人三种形态间循环作战，各具独特战法。

【梦魇攫取】：当其化为熊或人形态时，它会召唤魇蝶抓起一名玩家飞向梦魇裂隙，队友须及时击落魇蝶，否则在坠入梦魇裂隙时，将引发毁灭性的爆炸。
entries.current_text:
The Dream Demon of Painted Shadows is the embodiment of darkness in the dream. Now, its ambition has expanded, twisting everyone's dreams into a disaster.

[Three-Phase Illusion]: The Dream Demon of Painted Shadows cycles between wolf, bear, and human forms, each with unique combat tactics.

[Nightmare Seizure]: When in bear or human form, it summons Nightmare Butterflies to snatch a player and fly toward a Nightmare Rift. Teammates must shoot down the butterflies in time, or a devastating explosion will be triggered upon falling into the rift.

entries.source_text:
双生铸灵心念合一，他们以无间的配合统治战场，任何微小的失误都将引发能量的彻底暴走。

【绝境火盾】：劫刃铸灵的四个幻影分身发起的冲锋必须全部引导至孤戟铸灵的火盾上，任何一次失误都会导致破盾失败，极其考验团队的精准执行与协同能力。
entries.current_text:
The Twin Spirit Forgers are one in mind and spirit. They dominate the battlefield with seamless coordination; any minor mistake will trigger a complete energy runaway.

[Desperate Fire Shield]: The charges initiated by the four phantom clones of the Jie Blade Spirit Forger must all be guided into the Fire Shield of the Guji Spirit Forger. Any mistake will lead to a failure to break the shield, putting the team's precision and coordination to the ultimate test.

entries.source_text:
随着核心加速运转，古老的青铜之躯与废墟中残存的雷光之力共鸣，令攻势愈发凌厉。

【怒雷重阵】：石柱重若千钧，合力推倒的时长大幅增加。青钺铸将的攻势亦变得极度狂暴，伴随落雷的轰击。
entries.current_text:
As the core accelerates, the ancient bronze body resonates with the remaining thunder power in the ruins, making the attacks increasingly fierce.

[Thunderous Formation]: The stone pillars are heavy, and the time required to push them down together is significantly increased. The Qingyue General's attacks also become extremely violent, accompanied by lightning strikes.

entries.source_text:
炎雷神刃将的攻势变得更为狂暴，火焰与雷霆在更短的间歇内切换。

【炽浪连峰】：火焰刀光的频率、数量与威力均大幅提升，生存空间被急剧压缩。

【怒炎迅燃】：施展完火焰连斩后，它将以更快的速度恢复行动，发动下一轮攻势。
entries.current_text:
The Flame-Thunder Blade General's offensive becomes more violent, switching between fire and thunder at shorter intervals.

[Scorching Wave Peaks]: The frequency, quantity, and power of the fire blade light are significantly increased, and the living space is drastically compressed.
[Angry Flame Rapid Burn]: After performing the fire combo slash, it will recover its actions at a faster speed and launch the next round of attacks.

entries.current_text: Echoes of Burning Mountain: Relic Ice-Fire Guardian | Normal Guide

entries.source_text:
暗影悄然随行，每一次受伤都将加深暗影的腐蚀，只有精准的反击方能撕裂暗影。

【暗影值】：受到伤害会积累暗影值，积满后引发爆炸，对自己造成伤害和眩晕。成功反制红光攻击可降低暗影值。
其他额外词条，可能令暗影值更易积累，更难消除，或产生更多伤害。

避免积累暗影值，多反制红光攻击以降低暗影值！
entries.current_text:
The shadow follows silently; every injury deepens its corruption. Only precise counterattacks can tear through the shadow.

[Shadow Value]: Taking damage accumulates Shadow Value. Once full, it triggers an explosion, causing damage and stun to yourself. Successfully countering red-light attacks reduces Shadow Value.
Other additional affixes may make Shadow Value accumulate faster, harder to remove, or deal more damage.

Avoid accumulating Shadow Value and counter red-light attacks to reduce it!
