entries.current_text: #Protect the Little Bunny

entries.source_text: 术解机关
entries.current_text: Unraveling Mechanism

entries.source_text: 巨铜方间解密
entries.current_text: Giant Bronze Room Puzzle

entries.source_text:
用于神纹机关的制造，切换输入的神纹图谱与行为模式，便可构铸塑造机关，并测试不同机关的行为序列与性能。
其中亦包含仿生机关的设计与制作，例如龟形玄守、蟹形铜甲等，皆是神铸者以生物为原型打造的精巧机关。
entries.current_text:
Used for the manufacture of Divine Pattern mechanisms. By switching the input Divine Pattern patterns and behavioral modes, one can construct and shape mechanisms and test the behavioral sequences and performance of different mechanisms.
It also includes the design and production of bionic mechanisms, such as turtle-shaped Xuan-Guard, crab-shaped Copper Armor, etc., all of which are exquisite mechanisms created by the God-Forged using organisms as prototypes.

entries.source_text: 青铜巨柱可以通过机关踏板控制，来进行合闭激活。
entries.current_text: The giant bronze pillars can be controlled via mechanism pedals to close and activate them.

entries.source_text:
唯有被力量的涟漪触及，浮梦石的华光才能得以绽放。
用技能攻击唤醒“沉睡”许久的浮梦石，让梦能得以释放，石台升起之时，阶梯也随之浮现。
entries.current_text:
Only when touched by the ripples of power can the Floating Dream Stone bloom with brilliance.
Use skills to awaken the long-dormant Floating Dream Stone to release its dream energy. As the stone platform rises, the stairs will emerge.

entries.source_text: 机关开关
entries.current_text: Mechanism Switch

entries.source_text: 使用对应的燃山钥石可以开启位于天柱墟外围三个区域的驭光台。
entries.current_text: Use the corresponding Burning Mountain Keystone to activate the Light-Driving Platforms in the three areas on the outskirts of the Heavenly Pillar Ruins.

entries.source_text: 珠玑湖试炼阵
entries.current_text: Zhuji Lake Trial Array

entries.source_text: 隐匿草丛
entries.current_text: Hide in Grass

entries.source_text:
看似寻常的机关构造，暗藏着精密的机巧之理。
仔细观察附近的线索，便能找到开启机关的玄机。
entries.current_text:
A seemingly ordinary mechanism, yet it hides the principles of intricate craftsmanship.
Observe the clues nearby to find the secret to activating it.

entries.source_text:
悬浮流光的机关核心，承载着天才的共鸣与宿命的对抗。
通关云台之试，立于中央圆形踏板与核心交互，微光流转，即可启动云台。
entries.current_text:
A mechanical core of suspended light, bearing the resonance of genius and the confrontation of fate.
Clear the Trial of the Cloud Platform, stand on the central circular pedal to interact with the core, and the shimmering light will activate the platform.

entries.source_text: 可灵敏感应火焰的机关，应是原初时期的遗物。
entries.current_text: But a mechanism sensitive to flames should be a relic from the Primordial Era.

entries.source_text: 以神纹之力驱动的装置，可以与其他神纹机关同调，控制机关运作。
entries.current_text: A device driven by the power of divine patterns that can synchronize with other divine pattern mechanisms to control their operation.

entries.source_text:
靶形状的机关，被攻击击中后会切换状态。
工匠们以它为灵感，衍生出千般机巧谜题。解开谜题，即可获得丰厚的奖励。
entries.current_text:
A target-shaped mechanism that switches states when hit by an attack.
Craftsmen took inspiration from it to derive thousands of clever puzzles. Solve the puzzles to receive generous rewards.

entries.source_text: 当巨柱均已合闭，发射光束对准适宜位置，可激活机关大门开启青焰华庭。
entries.current_text: When all giant pillars are closed, aim the light beams at the appropriate positions to activate the mechanism and open the gate to the Azure Flame Court.

entries.source_text: 枯藤历经岁月，早已盘结如铁，刀剑难断其结，唯有烈火才能将其化解。
entries.current_text: The withered vines have become as tough as iron over time. Blades cannot sever them; only fire can break their hold.

entries.source_text: 古旧机关梯
entries.current_text: Old Mechanical Ladder

entries.source_text:
凌云之筹，采云为用。
稷下学子可消耗云能筹激活山区机关，亦可用云能筹在兑筹机关处换取奖励。
entries.current_text:
Cloud-reaching tokens, gathering clouds for use.
Jixia students can consume Cloud Energy Tokens to activate mountain mechanisms, or exchange them for rewards at the Token Exchange mechanism.

entries.source_text: 天柱墟·光瀑
entries.current_text: Tianzhu Ruins: Lightfall

entries.source_text:
以云丝塑织而成，柔韧质轻，能悬浮空中的奇妙机关。
既可润泽田野，亦可为行人指引旅途。
entries.current_text: A marvelous mechanism woven from cloud silk. Lightweight and flexible, it can hover in the air. It can both nourish the fields and guide travelers on their journey.

entries.source_text:
梦能时空产生了大面积的<ffdda4>幻梦之境</>，闯入此区域会持续受到<ffdda4>幻梦萦绕</>的负面效果。
<ffdda4>幻梦萦绕</>效果会让玩家陷入幻境，并不断降低玩家<ffdda4>生命值上限</>，但同时获<ffdda4>攻击力</>和<ffdda4>生命转化能力提升</>。
entries.current_text:
The Dream Energy space-time has generated large areas of <ffdda4>Dream Illusions</>. Entering this area will continuously apply the <ffdda4>Dream Haunting</> debuff.
<ffdda4>Dream Haunting</> will trap players in an illusion, continuously reducing their <ffdda4>Max HP</>, while simultaneously increasing their <ffdda4>Attack</> and <ffdda4>Life Steal</>.

entries.source_text:
生之所往，皆有回响。
触碰流的残影，元流之环可重构影像，再现往昔的景象。
entries.current_text:
Where life goes, there is an echo.
Touch the lingering shadows of the flow, and the Ring of Origin can reconstruct images to reproduce scenes of the past.

entries.source_text:
平日稳固的机关爪钩，总会在关键时刻松劲——
但谁又能拒绝可爱玩偶的诱惑，不再试一次手气呢？
幸好，身为工巧家总能巧制一枚呱呱币，再试一次手气！
entries.current_text:
The sturdy mechanical claw always seems to lose its grip at the most critical moment—
But who could resist the temptation of a cute doll and not try their luck again?
Fortunately, as a master craftsman, one can always forge a Gwa-Gwa Coin and give it another shot!

entries.source_text:
茂盛的草丛，是绝佳的天然隐匿之所。
未探明的每一簇绿意之中，都可能藏着致命伏击。
entries.current_text:
Lush grass is an excellent natural hiding place.
Every patch of unexplored greenery may hide a deadly ambush.

entries.source_text: 普通机关门
entries.current_text: Common Mechanism Door

entries.source_text: 由重重精密机关锁定的大门。唯有找到那把独一无二的钥匙，方能解开禁锢。
entries.current_text: A gate locked by complex, precision mechanisms. Only by finding the one-of-a-kind key can the confinement be undone.

entries.source_text:
前时代遗留下来的古代机关梯，虽然古老但是依然能够运行，连接进学广场和稷下山区东部崖壁。
需于虎啸堂寻得隐藏开关，方可启动此梯。
entries.current_text:
An ancient mechanical lift from a previous era. Though old, it still functions, connecting the Academy Plaza to the eastern cliff of the Jixia mountain range.
You must find the hidden switch in the Tiger Roar Hall to activate it.

entries.source_text:
非涉险境，焉获奇珍。
需俯身潜行，借助机关的视野盲区谨慎接近，并在侦测视野接近时保持静止。
接近宝箱后打破机关枢纽，即可打开宝箱。
entries.current_text:
No risk, no reward.
You must crouch and sneak, using the blind spots of the mechanisms to approach cautiously, and remain still when the detection field is near.
Once you reach the chest, break the mechanism hub to open it.

entries.source_text: 通过光瀑，可传送到撑天主柱。
entries.current_text: Pass through the light waterfall to teleport to the Main Pillar of Heaven.

entries.source_text: 青铜重炮能够造成高额韧性削减，可将机关铜鱼击落。
entries.current_text: The Bronze Heavy Cannon deals high Toughness damage and can knock down Mechanical Bronze Fish.

entries.source_text: 暗影裂隙会不断召唤浮梦枝棘，长按交互键一段时间可以关闭暗影裂隙
entries.current_text: The Shadow Rift will continuously summon Dream-Floating Thorns. Hold the interaction key to close the Shadow Rift.

entries.source_text:
珍宝深埋大地，唯有舆图记录其所在。
寻找埋藏之处，以元流之环感应，方能令宝藏重现于世。
entries.current_text: Treasures are buried deep in the earth, recorded only on maps. Find the burial site and use the Ring of Origin to sense them, so the treasure may be revealed to the world once more.

entries.source_text: 能够感知光线的机关。调整光束角度， 利用其折射特性，将光束射向感光机关会有意想不到的收获。
entries.current_text: A mechanism that senses light. Adjust the beam angle and use its refraction to hit the light-sensitive mechanism for unexpected results.

entries.source_text: 开启三个燃能枢后，方可激活萃石机。
entries.current_text: The extractor can only be activated after enabling three Energy Hubs.

entries.source_text: 无需乘客劳神，全程自助运行的机关梯。
entries.current_text: An automated elevator that requires no effort from passengers.

entries.source_text: 符钥机关门
entries.current_text: Rune Key Mechanism Door

entries.source_text:
常力难以摧毁的屏障，唯以云能方可化解。
将云能筹嵌入云能机关，即可解除魔道屏障。
entries.current_text: Barriers that are hard to destroy with brute force can only be dissolved with Cloud Energy. Insert a Cloud Energy Token into the Cloud Energy Mechanism to dispel the Sorcery barrier.

entries.source_text:
术解光引，序启封印。
触碰机关开关，观察术解之光的轨迹，依序激活对应机关，即可解除机关封印。
entries.current_text:
Unravel the light to break the seal.
Touch the mechanism switch, observe the trajectory of the unraveling light, and activate the corresponding mechanisms in order to break the seal.

entries.source_text: 天柱墟驭光台已全部重启，光瀑已重新激活。
entries.current_text: All Light-Riding Platforms in the Tianzhu Ruins have been restarted, and the Lightfall has been reactivated.

entries.source_text:
石碑碎散各处，真言湮落尘土。
收集残片，拼合石碑后，可用元流之环拓印完整碑文，获得的拓片可在区域商店换取奖励。
entries.current_text:
The stele is shattered, its true words buried in dust.
Collect the fragments and reassemble the stele to use the Meta-Ring to make a rubbing of the complete inscription. The rubbings can be exchanged for rewards at the regional shop.

entries.source_text:
鲁班大师改良后的新一代酿造机关，将稷狐麦酿造成丰云野的特产丰云酿。
他改良了过去繁复的酿造过程，提高了酿造的效率和成功率。如今只需要踩下踏板维持机关动力后，击中左右两侧的标靶保证温度和湿度同时达标即可。但若动力、温度、湿度三者任意一项归零则酿造失败。
entries.current_text:
Master Luban's improved, next-generation brewing mechanism turns Jixia Fox-Wheat into the Fengyun Wilds' specialty, Fengyun Brew.
He simplified the complex brewing process of the past, increasing both efficiency and success rates. Now, you only need to step on the pedal to maintain the mechanism's power, then hit the targets on the left and right to ensure both temperature and humidity reach the required levels. However, if power, temperature, or humidity drops to zero, the brewing fails.

entries.source_text:
神秘的机关附于宝箱之上，魔道能量如暗潮般涌动不息。
接近宝箱时，需灵活跳跃，闪避振荡的魔道能量攻击。
贴近宝箱后破坏机关枢纽，即可开启宝箱。
entries.current_text:
A mysterious mechanism is attached to the treasure chest, with magic energy surging like a dark tide.
When approaching the chest, you must jump nimbly to dodge the oscillating magic energy attacks.
Once close to the chest, destroy the mechanism hub to open it.

entries.source_text: 灵机所检测舱
entries.current_text: Spirit Mechanism Detection Chamber

entries.source_text:
用以解开谜题的装置，可打开封印的机关。
击败守卫或解开谜题，可打开封印的机关。
留心机关中光芒的颜色，它将随机关的状态而改变。
entries.current_text:
A device used to solve puzzles, which can open sealed mechanisms.
Defeat guards or solve puzzles to open sealed mechanisms.
Pay attention to the color of the light in the mechanism; it will change according to the state of the mechanism.

entries.source_text:
用于为沧浪楼船中的青铜机关造物供能，可在一些特殊的运输机关身上找到。
楼船区域铜矿产丰富，神铸者就地取材，以此为原料制造灵驱核及各类机关造物。
entries.current_text:
Used to power the bronze mechanical constructs in the Littoral Towership, it can be found on some special transport constructs.
The tower ship area is rich in copper mines, and the God-Forged used local materials to manufacture Spirit Drive Cores and various mechanical constructs.

entries.source_text: 遗落在东云落高地的八种古老试炼柱。寻找并启动三枚铜球机关，将铸灵石柱完全升起。
entries.current_text: Eight ancient trial pillars left on the Dongyunluo Highlands. Find and activate the three bronze ball mechanisms to fully raise the Spirit-Casting Stone Pillar.

entries.source_text:
踏上平台，用云能筹激活机关，那位天才少年馈赠的轻巧双翼便会为你展开。
感受机关齿轮咬合的震颤，在升腾的气流中直冲云霄吧。
entries.current_text:
Step onto the platform and use the Cloud Energy Chip to activate the mechanism, and the lightweight wings gifted by that genius youth will unfold for you.
Feel the vibration of the interlocking gears and soar into the clouds on the rising currents.

entries.source_text: 启动萃石机
entries.current_text: Start the stone extraction machine

entries.source_text: 使用冰冻果破除沧渊迷踪中怪物隐身状态。
entries.current_text: Use Frozen Fruit to reveal invisible monsters in the Cangyuan Mystery.

entries.source_text:
踏云而上的挑战者，自会得到勇于触碰天际的馈赠。
躲避机关的干扰、翻越重重障碍，最快速到达终点之人即为胜者。
entries.current_text:
Challengers who ascend through the clouds will be rewarded for their courage to touch the sky.
Dodge the mechanism's interference, overcome obstacles, and the first to reach the finish line wins.

entries.source_text: 云能筹机关组
entries.current_text: Aer-Energy Mechanism Group

entries.source_text: 使用冰冻果破除沧渊迷踪中怪物护盾。
entries.current_text: Use Frozen Fruit to break monster shields in the Cangyuan Mystery.

entries.source_text: 铸灵八柱
entries.current_text: The Eight Trial Pillars

entries.source_text:
湖光掠影，战意铮鸣。
击败珠玑湖试炼阵的守卫，即可获取奖励。
entries.current_text:
Lake light flickers, battle intent rings out.
Defeat the guards of the Zhuji Lake Trial Array to obtain rewards.

entries.source_text:
这只本应怡然飞行的鸢鸟，因核心齿轮的失控成了随时都会发狂的机关兽。没人能预测下一秒它会冲往天际，还是撞向你的后背……
帮助杜沁在界北回收失控的机关鸢鸟，完成后可在云根镇向她兑换奖励。
entries.current_text:
This kite-bird, which should have flown gracefully, has become a mechanical beast that could go berserk at any moment due to a malfunctioning core gear. No one can predict if it will soar into the sky or crash into your back in the next second...
Help Du Qin recover the runaway mechanical kite-birds in the northern border. Once completed, you can exchange for rewards with her in Yungen Town.

entries.source_text: 以机关灯芯点亮归途盏，唤醒往昔的誓言。它曾是神铸者的路标，如今在龙旗谷的转角静候新的旅人。长夜漫漫不必畏惧，这缕微光将为你指引方向。
entries.current_text: Light the Return Lamp with a mechanism wick to awaken the vows of the past. It was once a signpost for the God-Forged, and now it waits for new travelers at the corner of Dragon Valley. Do not fear the long night; this glimmer will guide your way.

entries.source_text:
抛物线的尽头，有着神秘馈赠。
瞄准、蓄力、投掷——成功命中机关中心的圆环，即可获取奖励。
entries.current_text:
At the end of the parabola lies a mysterious gift.
Aim, charge, and throw—hit the ring in the center of the mechanism to get the reward.

entries.source_text:
机关技术与魔道技艺巧妙结合，创造出隐形石板帮助学子指明隐藏的通路。
看似无路可去处，却会显形出隐藏的石板。
entries.current_text:
Mechanical technology and magic arts are cleverly combined to create invisible stone slabs that guide students to hidden paths.
Where there seems to be no way forward, hidden slabs will appear.

entries.source_text: 生命回响
entries.current_text: Echoes

entries.source_text: 战时留守龙旗谷的神铸者制造的机关，用以感应从龙骨中蕴含的能量，能量汇入其中的启明芯后，散发着明亮的辉光。将灯芯取下，点亮归途盏。
entries.current_text: A mechanism built by the Godsmiths who guarded Dragon Banner Valley during the war, used to sense the energy contained within dragon bones. Once energy flows into the Enlightenment Core within, it emits a bright glow. Remove the wick to light the Return Lamp.

entries.source_text: 踏板机关
entries.current_text: Pressure Plate Mechanism

entries.source_text:
机关启动之时，云丝球便已迎风飞舞，散落各处。
趁它们尚未消散风中，将云丝球一网打尽，统统收入囊中吧。
entries.current_text:
When the mechanism starts, the Cloud Silk Orbs will dance in the wind and scatter everywhere.
Catch them all before they dissipate into the wind.

entries.source_text: 可精准选层的机关梯。只需选择停靠楼层，梯厢便能沿不同滑轨灵活升降。
entries.current_text: A precision-floor-selecting elevator. Simply select the desired floor, and the cabin will move flexibly along the rails.

entries.source_text:
形态随负重而改变的特殊机关。
通过踩压，即可触发联动装置，激活机关。
entries.current_text:
A special mechanism that changes form based on weight.
Step on it to trigger the linkage device and activate the mechanism.

entries.source_text:
飞索掠影，踏空而行。
机关平台暗藏钩锁，接触平台即可激活。
entries.current_text:
Grapple through the air and step on the void.
Mechanical platforms contain hidden hooks; touch the platform to activate them.

entries.source_text: 手动机关梯
entries.current_text: Manual Mechanical Ladder

entries.source_text: 收取云根滴露，用于开启云根桥连接云根洞天探索道路。
entries.current_text: Collect Cloud-Root Dew to activate the Cloud-Root Bridge and open the path to explore the Cloud-Root Grotto-Heaven.

entries.source_text: 定阶机关梯
entries.current_text: Staircase of Order

entries.source_text:
战事如火如荼，既奉命于此后山要处守望幽径城，须当心如铁石，慎重其事。如此，方可不负所托，抵御外敌。

吾将珍宝藏于<69D0FF>映暮亭之北的军营中</>，后来者有缘可寻。
entries.current_text:
The war rages on. Having been ordered to guard the path to the city at this vital mountain pass, one must be as firm as iron and treat the matter with gravity. Only then can one fulfill the mission and repel the enemy.

I have hidden my treasures in the <69D0FF>military camp north of Yingmu Pavilion</>. Those who come after may find them if fate allows.

entries.source_text:
战祸将起，我等避难于此，恐有不测。将多年积攒的家底拾掇好，留给将来以备不时之需。

吾将珍宝藏于<69D0FF>议事厅水下的青铜石碑旁</>，后来者有缘可寻。
entries.current_text:
War is coming, and we are taking refuge here, fearing the worst. I have gathered the family fortune accumulated over the years to leave behind for a rainy day.

I have hidden my treasures beside the <69D0FF>bronze stele underwater in the Council Hall</>. Those who come after may find them if fate allows.

entries.source_text:
当年初试铸灵八柱，意气风发，渴望有大展身手的机会。而如今战火连绵，才察觉是过去的平和年岁更值得珍惜。

吾将珍宝藏于<69D0FF>阑珊丘北部的八柱试炼之中</>，后来者有缘可寻。
entries.current_text:
I was full of spirit when I first tested the Eight Pillars of Casting Spirits, eager for a chance to show my skills. Now, with the war raging, I realize that the peaceful years of the past were more worth cherishing.

I have hidden my treasures in the <69D0FF>Eight Pillar Trial in the north of Lanshan Hill</>. Those who are fated may find them.

entries.source_text:
兵库重地，不容有失，吾奉上令，于此地各处埋藏补给，以便战时取用，或可解燃眉之急。

吾将珍宝藏于<69D0FF>落云崖渡石东北，藏兵城之南的小丘上</>，后来者有缘可寻。
entries.current_text:
This is a vital military stronghold; it must not fall. By order of my superiors, I have buried supplies throughout this area for use in wartime, or perhaps to resolve an urgent crisis.

I have hidden the treasure on <69D0FF>the small hill northeast of the stone crossing at Luoyun Cliff and south of the Armory City</>. May those who come after find it.

entries.source_text:
未曾想敌军突袭，双方兵力悬殊，我军颓势已显……但我绝无苟且偷生之念，只求此番与同袍共死。

吾将珍宝藏于<69D0FF>荣铸碑林石碑下</>，后来者有缘可寻。
entries.current_text:
I never expected the enemy to launch a surprise attack. Our forces were vastly outnumbered, and our defeat was inevitable... But I have no intention of living in disgrace; I only wish to die alongside my comrades.

I have hidden the treasure <69D0FF>under the stele in the Rongzhu Stele Forest</>. Those who come after may find it if fate allows.

entries.source_text:
敌兵将至，众将仍在坚守，若说此处已是末路还为时尚早。毕竟绝云桥后，那云落之东还有生途。

吾将珍宝藏于<69D0FF>绝云桥南端</>，后来者有缘可寻。
entries.current_text:
The enemy approaches, but our troops still hold the line. It is too early to say this is the end. After all, beyond Jueyun Bridge, there is still a path to survival to the east of Yunluo.

I have hidden my treasure at the <69D0FF>southern end of Jueyun Bridge</>. Those who come after may find it if fate allows.

entries.source_text:
伤口血流不止，气力亦是枯竭，此番恐怕是回天乏术……

吾将珍宝藏于<69D0FF>沉碑潭之南，环形水潭中央</>，后来者有缘可寻。
entries.current_text:
The wound is bleeding non-stop, and my strength is exhausted. I'm afraid there's no saving me now...

I have hidden the treasure <69D0FF>south of the Sunken Stele Pool, in the center of the circular pool</>. Those who come later may find it if they are fated.

entries.source_text: 这本先祖手抄《春溪古战录》记载，燃山钥石唯萃石厅的神工役知晓，你可前去找寻它。
entries.current_text: The Springbrook War Chronicle says the Servants know about the keys.

entries.source_text: 铜鱼巍巍，青焰熊熊，守将庄严，神鸟肃穆……如此之地，可谓神炼之遗。
entries.current_text: The bronze fish are towering, the green flames are roaring, the guards are solemn, and the divine bird is reverent... A place like this can be called a relic of divine forging.

entries.source_text: 铜鱼巍巍，青焰熊熊，守将庄严，神鸟肃穆……如此之地，可谓神炼之遗。
entries.current_text: The bronze fish are towering, the green flames are roaring, the guards are solemn, and the divine bird is reverent... A place like this can be called a relic of divine forging.

entries.source_text: 沧浪楼船扬帆起航，又有几人能到达彼岸……真是令人热泪盈眶啊。
entries.current_text: The Canglang Treasure Ship sets sail, but how many can truly reach the other shore... It's enough to bring tears to one's eyes.

entries.source_text: 昔年太公带领几位<001>神铸者</>抵御外敌，以勇气和谋略阻挡敌军的穷追不舍，确保族人能够跨过汪洋，顺利到达新的家园。
entries.current_text: In the past, the Grand Duke led several <001>God-Forgers</> to resist foreign enemies, using courage and strategy to block the enemy's relentless pursuit, ensuring the clanspeople could cross the ocean and successfully reach their new home.

entries.source_text: 神铸者？我怎么从没听说过……
entries.current_text: Divine Forger? I've never heard of such a thing...

entries.source_text: 试炼机关设计颇为精巧。
entries.current_text: The trial mechanism is quite ingeniously designed.

entries.source_text: 你告诉二人，此地曾是稷下族群的试炼场，其中造物皆围绕几位勇士的事迹所制。傅兰恍然大悟，昔年太公带领神铸者抵御外敌，或许此地正是其亲手打造，为铭记先驱，承袭遗志。思及此，他决定将今日见闻上报学院。
entries.current_text: You tell the two that this place was once a trial ground for the Jixia tribes, and the creations here were all made based on the deeds of several warriors. Fu Lan suddenly realizes that in the past, the Grandmaster led the Divine Smiths to resist foreign enemies, and perhaps this place was built by his own hands to commemorate the pioneers and carry on their legacy. Thinking of this, he decides to report what he saw today to the academy.

entries.source_text: 嘿，同学，我是你的地狼骑士。
entries.current_text: Hey, student, I'm your Earth-Wolf Knight.

entries.source_text: 我的地狼已经吃饱回家了。
entries.current_text: My Earth Wolf has eaten its fill and gone home.

entries.source_text: 你……你不是地狼骑士……
entries.current_text: You... you are not the Earth Wolf Knight...

entries.source_text: 你……你不是地狼骑士，也没有身长八尺，你只是百草家……
entries.current_text: You... you are not the Earth Wolf Knight, and you aren't eight feet tall. You're just from the Baicao family...

entries.source_text: 不用谢，我只是一名乐于助人的“地狼骑士”罢了。
entries.current_text: You're welcome. I'm just a helpful "Earth Wolf Knight."

entries.source_text: 是你！那个地狼骑士！
entries.current_text: It's you! That Earth Wolf Knight!

entries.source_text: 我想见识一下地狼骑士。
entries.current_text: I want to see the Earth Wolf Knight.

entries.source_text: 方才我在试吃新菜之时，突然一个身形高大的地狼骑士出现！
entries.current_text: Just as I was tasting the new dish, a tall Earth Wolf Knight suddenly appeared!

entries.source_text: 光天化日之下怎么会有地狼骑士出现……
entries.current_text: How could a Earth Wolf Knight appear in broad daylight...

entries.source_text: 你是不是觉得我在说胡话？是真的，那个地狼足有两米高！
entries.current_text: Do you think I'm talking nonsense? It's true, that Earth Wolf was at least two meters tall!

entries.source_text: 什么地狼骑士？骑着地狼的人？
entries.current_text: What Earth-Wolf Knight? Someone riding an Earth-Wolf?

entries.source_text: 什么地狼骑士？骑着地狼的人？
entries.current_text: What Earth-Wolf Knight? Someone riding an Earth-Wolf?

entries.source_text: 请问有没有看到过地狼骑士？
entries.current_text: Excuse me, have you seen a Ground Wolf Knight?

entries.source_text: 庄侍告诉你，自己没听说过地狼骑士，也没见过咕呱，但是羽洛来得更早，可以向他打听。
entries.current_text: Zhuangshi tells you that he has never heard of the Earth Wolf Knight, nor has he seen a Gugu, but Yulu arrived earlier and you can ask him.

entries.source_text: 你见到被人带走的咕呱么？据说……也许还骑着地狼？
entries.current_text: Have you seen Gugu who was taken away? It's said... maybe they were even riding a Earth Wolf?

entries.source_text: 你见到被人带走的咕呱么？据说……也许还骑着地狼？
entries.current_text: Have you seen Gugu who was taken away? It's said... maybe they were even riding a Earth Wolf?

entries.source_text: 骑着地狼的咕呱？比我奶奶讲的故事还奇怪。
entries.current_text: A Gugu riding a Ground Wolf? That's even stranger than the stories my grandma tells.

entries.source_text: 它被一个骑着地狼的人抓走了！
entries.current_text: It was snatched away by someone riding an earth wolf!

entries.source_text: 什么地狼，别吓人。
entries.current_text: What Earth-Wolf? Don't scare me.

entries.source_text: 周围根本没有地狼。
entries.current_text: There are no Earth Wolves around here at all.

entries.source_text: 糟糕！馋馋被地狼包围了！
entries.current_text: Oh no! Canchan is surrounded by Earth Wolves!

entries.source_text: 哪里有地狼？两只小木篱而已。
entries.current_text: Where are the Earth Wolves? It's just two little wooden fences.

entries.source_text: 哪里有地狼？两只小木篱而已。
entries.current_text: Where are the Earth Wolves? It's just two little wooden fences.

entries.source_text: 千万小心，这些地狼很特别，头顶有奇怪的魔道标记。
entries.current_text: Be extremely careful. These Earth Wolves are special; they have strange magic markings on their heads.

entries.source_text: 是你从地狼骑士手中救下的它么？
entries.current_text: Was it you who saved it from the Earth Wolf Knight?

entries.source_text: 是你从地狼骑士手中救下的它么？
entries.current_text: Was it you who saved it from the Earth Wolf Knight?

entries.source_text: 嗯……他的举止有些怪异，先是看见了地狼骑士，又是头顶有东西的村民。
entries.current_text: Hmm... his behavior is a bit strange. First he saw the Earth Wolf Knight, and then there were villagers with things on their heads.

entries.source_text: 嗯……他的举止有些怪异，先是看见了地狼骑士，又是头顶有东西的村民。
entries.current_text: Hmm... his behavior is a bit strange. First he saw the Earth Wolf Knight, and then there were villagers with things on their heads.

entries.source_text: 赵木生向你介绍，自己是一位百草家，在路边遇到了因食物中毒而昏厥的咕呱。而孙允成因为精神错乱，将他认成地狼骑士。赵木生打算为他们制作药物，拜托你找些兽涎木。
entries.current_text: Zhao Musheng introduces himself as a herbalist who encountered Gu Gua, who had fainted from food poisoning, by the roadside. Sun Yuncheng, due to his mental instability, mistook him for a Earth Wolf Knight. Zhao Musheng plans to make medicine for them and asks you to find some Beast Saliva Wood.

entries.source_text: 这些日子你参与试炼、和幽影对峙、找回了青岚，现在又跑了这么远来修复灵驱核……
entries.current_text: In these past few days, you've participated in trials, confronted the shadows, retrieved Qinglan, and now you've traveled so far to repair the Spirit-Drive Core...

entries.source_text: 还记得溯洄营地的澜光吗？之前我推荐你去找他帮忙修复那枚核心。
entries.current_text: Remember Languang from the Retracing Camp? I suggested you ask him to help fix that core.

entries.source_text: 你认识青岚吧？这是青岚和一支风物家小队在沧浪洞附近的收获。
entries.current_text: You know Qinglan, right? This is what Qinglan and a team of Wind-Chasers gathered near Littoral Cave.

entries.source_text: 你认识青岚吧？这是青岚和一支风物家小队在沧浪洞附近的收获。
entries.current_text: You know Qinglan, right? This is what Qinglan and a team of Wind-Chasers gathered near Littoral Cave.

entries.source_text: 知道，圭蝶队的嘛。我确实听说学院派出了一支特殊小队，来抢修春溪原上的各类古迹。
entries.current_text: I know, the Guidie team. I did hear that the academy sent a special squad to repair the various ancient ruins on Chunxi Plain.

entries.source_text: 千万小心，无论它从前是多厉害的角色，现在也只是一个小小的机关造物。
entries.current_text: Be extremely careful. No matter how powerful it was in the past, it's just a small mechanical construct now.

entries.source_text: 奇怪，取不下来。似乎有机关密锁保护……要用大眼枭联系一下澜光吗？
entries.current_text: Strange, it won't come off. It seems to be protected by a mechanical lock... Should I use the Big-Eyed Owl to contact Languang?

entries.source_text: 奇怪，取不下来。似乎有机关密锁保护……要用大眼枭联系一下澜光吗？
entries.current_text: Strange, it won't come off. It seems to be protected by a mechanical lock... Should I use the Big-Eyed Owl to contact Languang?

entries.source_text: 素素，我刚遇到一群伏地萝卜袭击我，一副苦大仇深的样子。
entries.current_text: Susu, I just ran into a group of Earth Radishes that attacked me, looking all bitter and vengeful.

entries.source_text: 素素，我刚遇到一群伏地萝卜袭击我，一副苦大仇深的样子。
entries.current_text: Susu, I just ran into a group of Earth Radishes that attacked me, looking all bitter and vengeful.

entries.source_text: 唔，据一些游猎家依照动物行为分析，说这是因为我们伤害了它们的同类。
entries.current_text: Hmm, according to some hunters' analysis of animal behavior, it's because we harmed their kind.

entries.source_text: 我没有伤害它们吧……
entries.current_text: I didn't hurt them, did I...

entries.source_text: 我没有伤害它们吧……
entries.current_text: I didn't hurt them, did I...

entries.source_text: 几根白萝卜……伏地萝卜是因为包里有白萝卜才袭击我？
entries.current_text: A few white radishes... Did the Ground-Dwelling Radish attack me because I have white radishes in my bag?

entries.source_text: 几根白萝卜……伏地萝卜是因为包里有白萝卜才袭击我？
entries.current_text: A few white radishes... Did the Ground-Dwelling Radish attack me because I have white radishes in my bag?

entries.source_text: 所以，伏地萝卜认为我们在伤害它们的同类？
entries.current_text: So, the Earth-Burrowing Radishes think we're hurting their kind?

entries.source_text: 所以，伏地萝卜认为我们在伤害它们的同类？
entries.current_text: So, the Earth-Burrowing Radishes think we're hurting their kind?

entries.source_text: 对了……我感觉你可能已经被伏地萝卜们盯上了，以后不论走到那里都要小心点。
entries.current_text: By the way... I feel like you might have been targeted by the Ground-Hiding Radishes. Be careful wherever you go from now on.

entries.source_text: 素素推测，伏地萝卜认为人类伤害了它们的同类，”物伤其类“，才会袭击你。
entries.current_text: Susu speculates that the Earth Radishes think humans harmed their kind, and are attacking you out of 'sympathy for their own kind'.

entries.source_text: 卜卜，力，还！
entries.current_text: Bubu, strength, return!

entries.source_text: 卜卜，痛！唔……
entries.current_text: Bubu, pain! Ugh...

entries.source_text: 甚至会和我们一起玩闹，时常会让人忘了，他是万人敬仰、开山立派的宗师。
entries.current_text: He even plays around with us, often making one forget that he is a revered grandmaster who founded his own school.

entries.source_text: 没错，这把是我初入稷下时，武道学院统一派发的练习用剑。
entries.current_text: That's right. This is the practice sword issued to me when I first entered the Jixia Martial Arts Academy.

entries.source_text: 千真万确！同学你若是喜欢，就卖你十环金，怎么样？
entries.current_text: It's absolutely true! If you like it, student, I'll sell it to you for ten gold rings. How about it?

entries.source_text: 这种事我就只好意思找虎头，结果一问才知道，他正忙着凑钱给金糜救急，而且还打着紫翠大姐的名头……
entries.current_text: I only felt comfortable asking Hu Tou about this, but when I did, I found out he was busy scraping together money to help Jin Mi, and he was even using Big Sister Zicui's name...

entries.source_text: 居然还有这种事……虎头和金糜也不给大家说一声，你们几个真是一个比一个犟。
entries.current_text: To think something like this happened... Hu Tou and Jin Mi didn't even tell anyone. You lot are all more stubborn than the last.

entries.source_text: 机关傀儡之道，真是令人高山仰止啊！
entries.current_text: His skill is truly awe-inspiring!

entries.source_text: 关于机关码头。
entries.current_text: About the harbor.

entries.source_text: 没错，这是墨子老师倾力打造的机关码头，进出口货物全靠机关传输。
entries.current_text: Master Mozi's wisdom birthed this harbor. All imports and exports rely on his creations.

entries.source_text: 百鸣港的货流量比之前少了些，不过越是这种时候，就越是不能放松，要对得起学院的信任才行啊。
entries.current_text: Cargo traffic at Baiming Port is a bit lower than before, but we can't afford to let our guard down, especially now. We must live up to the Academy's trust.

entries.source_text: 你好，我是绫罗，也是百鸣港的负责人，
entries.current_text: Hello, I am Lingluo, the person in charge of Baiming Port.

entries.source_text: 百鸣港是稷下的门户，稷下进出口的物资多半经由这里，由我们物币家负责管理运营。
entries.current_text: Baiming Port is the gateway to Jixia. Most of Jixia's imports and exports pass through here, and it is managed and operated by us, the Merchant Guild.

entries.source_text: 妙算仪比常见的机关算盘更加准确高效。多亏它，我们如今才能勉强维持住港口经济。
entries.current_text: The Calculation Instrument is more accurate and efficient than common mechanical abacuses. Thanks to it, we can barely maintain the port's economy.

entries.source_text: 融合才是稷下菜的特色，能将众多食材混合烹饪调和出最适合的味道，这才是真功夫。
entries.current_text: Its magic is innovation—blending diverse ingredients into perfect harmony.

entries.source_text: 除了特色稷下菜，各国美食我也多有涉猎。只要你能说出来，我就能做出来！
entries.current_text: I've mastered many exotic dishes. Describe it, and I'll make it!

entries.source_text: 唉，云蚕出事了，百鸣港的航运和生意自然也会受到波及。
entries.current_text: Sigh, with the Cloud Silkworms in trouble, shipping and business at Baiming Port will naturally be affected.

entries.source_text: 哈，那你可问对人了，无论在什么时候，春溪原都是个游玩的好去处！
entries.current_text: Ha, you've asked the right person. No matter the time, Chunxi Plain is always a great place to visit!

entries.source_text: 不过我得提醒你，春溪原有不少遗迹都是受风物家保护的，不要误闯。
entries.current_text: Just a heads-up, the Seekers protect many of the ruins that you may come across. Please avoid those sites.

entries.source_text: 百鸣港什么时候才能恢复正常呢……
entries.current_text: When will Baiming Port ever return to normal...

entries.source_text: 我？我是百草家谢芷清，前辈们派我来溯洄营地，把新研制的制药台介绍给大家使用。
entries.current_text: Me? I'm Mint from the Herb Society. I was sent here to help everyone learn the all-new Medicine Stand.

entries.source_text: 百草制药，其实就是调和百草，搭配出不同的药性。
entries.current_text: By blending herbs, we create medicines with diverse benefits.

entries.source_text: 我们研制机关时也要审时度势，多多使用替代材料。
entries.current_text: When developing mechanisms, we must assess the situation and make more use of alternative materials.

entries.source_text: 关于古怪的机关。
entries.current_text: About the peculiar device.

entries.source_text: 墨子老师还在稷下时，常常会来机关学院讲课，如果能够学会一星半点，在机关一途上也是受用无穷！
entries.current_text: When Master Mozi was still at Jixia, he often came to the Mechanism Academy to give lectures. If one could learn even a little bit, it would be infinitely useful in the field of mechanism arts!

entries.source_text: 怎么样了同学，我的小机关人还能修好么？
entries.current_text: How is it, classmate? Can my little automaton still be fixed?

entries.source_text: 太好了，还有其他出故障的机关也能找你帮忙么？
entries.current_text: Great, can I ask you for help with other malfunctioning mechanisms too?

entries.source_text: 柔如丝，韧如茧，不动如根！我们武道学院，讲究的是一个身形相合，以武入道。
entries.current_text: We're flexible as silk, resilient as cocoons, and steadfast as roots! Here, we train to align mind and body.

entries.source_text: 听今早巡逻的凌云卫来修武器时提起过云蚕的事。
entries.current_text: I heard the Lingyun Guards mention the Cloud Silkworms when they came to repair their weapons this morning.

entries.source_text: 特意邀请了稷下商会的商人入驻溯洄营地。
entries.current_text: So we've invited the Jixia Merchant Guild to set up shop here.

entries.source_text: 好在有学事委和凌云卫立刻出动，他们随时待命，尽全力保障学院的安全。
entries.current_text: Fortunately, the Student Affairs Committee and the Lingyun Guards were dispatched immediately. They are on standby, doing their best to ensure the safety of the academy.

entries.source_text: 牛小二怎么不动了，是被我的行李很多压坏的吗？
entries.current_text: Why isn't Niu Xiaoer moving? Did I crush him with all my luggage?

entries.source_text: 不是的，学妹。近期学院的云流供给不足，因此这些机关载具暂时停运。
entries.current_text: No, Junior. The academy's cloud-flow supply is insufficient recently, so these mechanical vehicles are temporarily out of service.

entries.source_text: 喂，同学，这遗迹里面有个机关阵，你要是感兴趣可以进去看看。
entries.current_text: Hey, student, there's a mechanism array inside these ruins. If you're interested, you can go in and take a look.

entries.source_text: 引到别人地盘上？等下，我说之前怎么无缘无故有只刺熊突然冲到我帐篷里来，是你搞的鬼？
entries.current_text: Lure them to someone else's territory? Wait, I was wondering why a thorn bear suddenly rushed into my tent for no reason. Was that your doing?

entries.source_text: 就在这藏兵城的最高处，可沿途十分凶险，前去挑战之人无一成功抵达。
entries.current_text: It's at the very top of this Hidden Soldier City, but the path is extremely dangerous; no one who has gone to challenge it has ever successfully arrived.

entries.source_text: 突破危险才攀登至这藏兵城的最高处，这一回的日落观景，比先前更添了份难得之感……
entries.current_text: I climbed to the highest point of this Weapon-Hiding City despite the danger. Watching the sunset this time feels even more precious than before...

entries.source_text: 突破危险才攀登至这藏兵城的最高处，这一回的日落观景，比先前更添了份难得之感……
entries.current_text: I climbed to the highest point of this Weapon-Hiding City despite the danger. Watching the sunset this time feels even more precious than before...

entries.source_text: 还有你，快起来和我炫耀你的机关术啊……
entries.current_text: And you, hurry up and get up here to show off your mechanical skills...

entries.source_text: 你怎么会来云深营地啊？也是来寻找勇士遗宝的吗？
entries.current_text: How did you end up at the Yunshen camp? Are you here to look for the warrior's relics too?

entries.source_text: 啊！你不是那个通过特别测试入学的新生吗，我在溯洄营地见过你！
entries.current_text: Ah! Aren't you the new student who passed the special test? I saw you at the Retracing Camp!

entries.source_text: 怎么样，都是从溯洄营地出来的，有没有兴趣组队一起找？
entries.current_text: How about it? We're both from the Suhui camp, interested in teaming up to look for it?

entries.source_text: 真没想到还能在云深营地遇见，我名为登志，是名风物家，幸会幸会！
entries.current_text: I never expected to meet you at the Yunshen Camp. My name is Dengzhi, I'm a collector of curiosities. Nice to meet you!

entries.source_text: 那是云深营地里，掌握线索最多的一支三人小队。
entries.current_text: That is the three-person squad in the Cloud-Breath Camp that holds the most clues.

entries.source_text: 幽藏是魔道天才，百里是机关大师，而月歌好像是擅长医术。
entries.current_text: Youcang is a genius of sorcery, Baili is a master of mechanics, and Yuege seems to be skilled in medicine.

entries.source_text: 姬玉告诉你，三名勇士的身份分别是魔道天才幽藏，机关大师百里，以及擅长医术的月歌。附近的一个山坡上，还有他们的纪念碑。
entries.current_text: Ji Yu told you that the three warriors were the magic genius You Zang, the mechanical master Baili, and the skilled healer Yue Ge. There is also a monument to them on a nearby hillside.

entries.source_text: 这就是天柱墟吗……学姐的心愿实现了。
entries.current_text: Is this the Pillar Ruins... The senior's wish has been fulfilled.

entries.source_text: 沉碑潭……确实有埋藏宝藏的传闻，不少人都想去探索，只是被附近的怪物所阻。
entries.current_text: Shenbei Pool... there are indeed rumors of buried treasure. Many want to explore it, but they are blocked by the monsters nearby.

entries.source_text: 不能拖了，同学，麻烦你沿着去沉碑潭的路区找找吧！得及时把他带回来！
entries.current_text: We can't delay any longer. Student, please go find him along the road to Chenbei Pool! We must bring him back in time!

entries.source_text: 有人说，他想去探索沉碑潭，想探险，还想要能够飞行的装备。
entries.current_text: They say he wants to explore the Sunken Stele Pool, go on an adventure, and get some flight-capable gear.

entries.source_text: 有人说，他想去探索沉碑潭，想探险，还想要能够飞行的装备。
entries.current_text: They say he wants to explore the Sunken Stele Pool, go on an adventure, and get some flight-capable gear.

entries.source_text: 你将线索告诉伏露，伏露猜测他是想用飞行装备绕开怪物前往沉碑潭，但是这十分危险，因此她拜托你赶紧去沉碑潭将他带回来。
entries.current_text: You tell Fu Lu about the clue. She guesses he intends to use flight gear to bypass the monsters and reach Shenbei Pool, but it's extremely dangerous, so she asks you to hurry to Shenbei Pool and bring him back.

entries.source_text: 不然，你以为只会遇见这头地狼？
entries.current_text: Otherwise, did you think you'd only run into this Earth Wolf?

entries.source_text: 前些天你到处打听沉碑潭之事，我就发现你有这个想法了。
entries.current_text: I realized you had this idea when you were asking around about the Sunken Stele Pool the other day.

entries.source_text: 凭你的实力，探索沉碑潭绝无可能成功。
entries.current_text: Given your strength, exploring the Sunken Stele Pool is impossible.

entries.source_text: 我总不能对你说，营地里那些精通龙学、身手非凡的学子都还未出手呢……
entries.current_text: I can't exactly tell you that the students in the camp who are experts in dragon studies and highly skilled haven't even made a move yet...

entries.source_text: 他？前几天不知从哪儿听说，沉碑潭下沉有龙族遗产，嚷嚷着要去探险，但被我劝住了。
entries.current_text: Him? A few days ago, he heard from somewhere that there were dragon relics under the Shenbei Pool and kept shouting about going on an adventure, but I talked him out of it.

entries.source_text: 这传闻倒并非空穴来风，只是那沉碑潭可不适合他这样手无缚鸡之力的人。
entries.current_text: This rumor isn't entirely groundless, but the Sunbei Pool is no place for someone as frail as him.

entries.source_text: 赵元吾告诉你，海讴听说沉碑潭下有龙族遗产，一直想去探险但被自己劝阻，如今很可能去了那里。
entries.current_text: Zhao Yuanwu tells you that Hai Ou heard there were dragon relics under the Sinking Stele Pool and wanted to explore, but was dissuaded. Now, it's very likely he went there anyway.

entries.source_text: 是啊，当初他来龙闻营地，就是想收购一些与龙有关的物件，不过结果没能让他满意。
entries.current_text: Yeah, when he first came to the Longwen camp, he wanted to buy some dragon-related items, but the results didn't satisfy him.

entries.source_text: 喂！小心背后！有地狼！
entries.current_text: Hey! Watch your back! There are Earth Wolves!

entries.source_text: 也怪我太想当然，想着只去沉碑潭附近瞧瞧，不会遇上什么麻烦，谁知道……
entries.current_text: It's my fault for being too presumptuous, thinking I'd just take a look around Chenbei Pool and wouldn't run into any trouble. Who knew...

entries.source_text: 上面绣了字……若拾到请送归龙闻营地海讴。
entries.current_text: There's writing embroidered on it... If found, please return to Hai Ou at the Longwen camp.

entries.source_text: 上面绣了字……若拾到请送归龙闻营地海讴。
entries.current_text: There's writing embroidered on it... If found, please return to Hai Ou at the Longwen camp.

entries.source_text: 这是……云根茶饮？
entries.current_text: Is this... Cloud Root tea?

entries.source_text: 这是……云根茶饮？
entries.current_text: Is this... Cloud Root tea?

entries.source_text: 云根茶饮的气味特别，即使你用水清理，也还是会留下痕迹。
entries.current_text: Cloud root tea has a distinct scent; even if you clean it with water, it will still leave a trace.

entries.source_text: 难道我打不过这个守卫就没资格战斗了吗？我精通的是和动物搏杀，而不是和人战斗。
entries.current_text: Does the fact that I can't beat this guard mean I'm not qualified to fight? I specialize in fighting animals, not people.

entries.source_text: 警告！警告！未能侦测到初级防卫系统信号，正在启动隐藏防卫者巨神兵。
entries.current_text: Warning! Warning! Primary defense system signal not detected. Initiating hidden defender: Titan.

entries.source_text: 系统错误，未能侦测到巨神兵信号。启用调试模式，请尝试手动开启大门……
entries.current_text: System error: Titan signal not detected. Enabling debug mode. Please try opening the gate manually...

entries.source_text: 我在那边似乎看到了破门生在改造学院曾经的大型机关人。
entries.current_text: I think I saw the Gate-Breakers modifying the academy's old, large-scale automatons over there.

entries.source_text: 蒋欣，你看，这些破门生使用了许多运输机关，远处也有大型运输机关运作的痕迹。
entries.current_text: Jiang Xin, look, these remnants have used many transport mechanisms, and there are traces of large-scale transport mechanisms operating in the distance.

entries.source_text: 当然。破门生从不重视机关术。所以我怀疑有一个机关术超群的人帮助他们修复了大炮。
entries.current_text: Of course. The Po Men students never value mechanism arts. So I suspect someone with superb mechanism skills helped them repair the cannon.

entries.source_text: 很有可能，可就连机关学院能修复这么大的大炮的人也屈指可数，这人会是谁呢？
entries.current_text: It's very likely, but even in the Mechanics Academy, there are only a handful of people who can repair such a large cannon. Who could this person be?

entries.source_text: 还好，情况已经稳定了，不会有生命问题。接下来只需要卧床治疗就可以了。
entries.current_text: It's fine, the situation has stabilized and there's no life-threatening danger. Now you just need to stay in bed and recover.

entries.source_text: 谢谢你的帮助，这是启动机关的道具，用这个就可以前往大鸟巢穴了。
entries.current_text: Thank you for your help. This is the item to activate the mechanism; you can use it to reach the giant bird's nest.

entries.source_text: 将<001>此物放入机关中</>即可启动机关前往山顶。
entries.current_text: Place <001>this item into the mechanism</> to activate it and head to the mountain top.

entries.source_text: <001>上课</>时禁止操作机关或者机械装置。但是可以了解很多信息。
entries.current_text: Operating mechanisms or mechanical devices is prohibited during <001>class</>. However, you can learn a lot of information.

entries.source_text: <001>下课</>时允许学生自由操作机关，解开一些谜题，能解开者还能获得奖励。
entries.current_text: Students are allowed to operate mechanisms freely after <001>class</> to solve puzzles, and those who succeed can receive rewards.

entries.source_text: 同学你好，请不要伤害那些动物！
entries.current_text: Hello, student. Please don't hurt those animals!

entries.source_text: 再见！记得不要伤害那些动物哦！
entries.current_text: Goodbye! Remember not to hurt those animals!

entries.source_text: 你看，这里的青铜材质是不是跟在山区的那些遗迹很像。这两个地方之间会不会有什么联系？
entries.current_text: Look, isn't the bronze material here very similar to those in the mountain ruins? Could there be a connection between these two places?

entries.source_text: 之前我还看到个古代遗物，上面有一种我从没见过的机关，我现在还没研究明白呢，
entries.current_text: I also saw an ancient relic earlier with a mechanism I've never seen before. I haven't figured it out yet.

entries.source_text: 夜晚再派精锐小队趁敌人守备最松弛的时候突袭大炮。如何？
entries.current_text: How about we send an elite squad at night to raid the cannons when the enemy's guard is at its weakest?

entries.source_text: 它经常来我们的营地里偷东西，还会伤害我们的同学。
entries.current_text: It often comes to our camp to steal things and even hurts our classmates.

entries.source_text: 这个是曾经置于大型机关人体内的原初机关核？
entries.current_text: Is this the original Mech-core that was once inside the giant mechanical body?

entries.source_text: 这是学院的校风，争鸣之璋。
entries.current_text: This is the academy's ethos: The Badge of Contention.

entries.source_text: 为了修复争鸣之璋，我已经成功注入了一股能量。
entries.current_text: I have successfully injected a burst of energy to repair the Zhangming Zhang.

entries.source_text: 但是仍有三座能量无法注入，因为它们缺少了关键的原初机关核。
entries.current_text: But there are still three energy sources that cannot be injected because they lack the key Primal Mechanism Core.

entries.source_text: 其二，为了战事植入于大型机关人中，其机体情况未卜。
entries.current_text: The second was implanted into a large mechanical construct for the war. Its current status is unknown.

entries.source_text: 是啊，你不觉得这间小屋很不错吗，离海很近，离溯洄营地也不远。
entries.current_text: Yeah, don't you think this little cabin is nice? It's close to the sea and not far from the Suhui camp.

entries.source_text: 院子北面的山坡上，不知什么时候起，出现了一只<001>傲火隼</>。
entries.current_text: On the hillside north of the courtyard, an <001>Arrogant Fire Falcon</> has appeared out of nowhere.

entries.source_text: 不行，西施嘱托过不能让人随便进屋子。
entries.current_text: No, Xishi specifically asked not to let anyone into the room.

entries.source_text: 三、二、一，砰！哈哈，西施，你的助攻来得很及时嘛！
entries.current_text: Three, two, one, bang! Haha, Xishi, your assist came just in time!

entries.source_text: 听听这怨气，都快把彩云潭的水煮开了。
entries.current_text: Listen to that resentment; it's almost enough to boil the water in Colorful Cloud Pool.

entries.source_text: 先去完成其他防御塔的挑战再回来吧，到时候我肯定能修好！
entries.current_text: Go complete the challenges of the other defensive towers first and come back later; I'll definitely have it fixed by then!

entries.source_text: 挑战机关二塔。
entries.current_text: Challenge the second mechanism tower.

entries.source_text: 关于夫子的第三个谜题，我总觉得和机关有关，所以想来问问你。
entries.current_text: Regarding Master's third riddle, I always feel it has something to do with the mechanisms, so I wanted to ask you about it.

entries.source_text: 关于夫子的第三个谜题，我总觉得和机关有关，所以想来问问你。
entries.current_text: Regarding Master's third riddle, I always feel it has something to do with the mechanisms, so I wanted to ask you about it.

entries.source_text: 事情在当时闹得很大，之后很长一段时间，学院都收紧了对各类机关的审核。
entries.current_text: It caused quite a stir back then, and for a long time after, the Academy tightened its review process for all kinds of mechanisms.

entries.current_text: Welcome to the Path of Ingenuity: Finale. The fastest clear record has been parsed. Please review the instructions before starting the challenge.

entries.source_text: 飞弹投射，轮回往复；棋局落子，因果相连。
entries.current_text: Missiles fly in cycles; moves on the board are linked by cause and effect.

entries.source_text: 偶遇赤红灵兽，浑身火焰强如怪物，拼尽全力无法战胜……
entries.current_text: Ran into a crimson spirit beast, covered in flames and as strong as a monster. Tried my best, but couldn't defeat it...

entries.source_text: 再打下去我要叫凌云卫啦！
entries.current_text: If you keep attacking, I'm calling the Lingyun Guards!

entries.source_text: 你的机关武器火力很强啊，想必碧蓝神兽也扛不住你的攻击！
entries.current_text: Your mechanical weapon has strong firepower; I bet even the Azure Divine Beast couldn't withstand your attack!

entries.source_text: 这赤红灵兽到底在哪啊？不是说就在附近吗？
entries.current_text: Where exactly is this crimson spirit beast? Didn't they say it was nearby?

entries.source_text: 缮机亭是沿着巧才之路往东走吗。
entries.current_text: Is the Mechanism Pavilion along the Path of Ingenuity to the east?

entries.source_text: 嗯，机关玲珑塔方向，应该就是这边。
entries.current_text: Hmm, the direction of the Exquisite Mechanism Tower should be this way.

entries.source_text: 我们在云来驿看到<001>缮机亭</>在招勤工俭学的学子。
entries.current_text: We saw <001>Machine Repair Hall</> hiring students at Cloudhaven.

entries.source_text: 于是就来找<001>缮机亭</>，没记错的话应该是沿这条路走。
entries.current_text: So I came to find <001>Mechcraft Hall</>. If I remember correctly, it should be along this road.

entries.source_text: 听说在缮机亭进修过的学子因为熟悉运作原理都<001>精通挑战玲珑塔</>的方法。
entries.current_text: Disciples who studied in the Mechanoid Lab are <001>adept at the Treasure Tower challenges</>.

entries.source_text: 它是最精密的机关，夫子。它会完美执行每一条指令——这就足够了。
entries.current_text: It is the most precise mechanism, Master. It will perfectly execute every command—that is enough.

entries.source_text: 孩子，你给了它看清世界的眼睛，却没有给它守护世界的心。
entries.current_text: Child, you gave it eyes to see the world, but you didn't give it a heart to protect it.

entries.source_text: 守护……心。
entries.current_text: Protect... the heart.

entries.source_text: 偏转仪作为基础机关元件，其排列组合方式有很多种。
entries.current_text: As a basic mechanical component, the deflector has many possible permutations and combinations.

entries.source_text: 如果与其他机关元件做联动设计，可作为进阶挑战方向。
entries.current_text: If you link it with other mechanism components, it could serve as an advanced challenge.

entries.source_text: 继续向前，即可挑战巧才之路·终。
entries.current_text: Continue forward to challenge the Path of Talent: Finale.

entries.source_text: 峡谷里最寒冷的地方……要数<001>湛蓝灵兽</>处了……
entries.current_text: The coldest place in the canyon... has to be where the <001>Azure Cub</> is...

entries.source_text: 没错没错，不休息好不许走，可别在挑战赤红灵兽的时候出岔子。
entries.current_text: That's right, that's right. You aren't allowed to leave until you've rested properly. Don't mess up when you challenge the Crimson Spirit Beast.

entries.source_text: 呵，区区赤红灵兽，都不够我热身的！
entries.current_text: Heh, a mere Crimson Spirit Beast isn't even enough to warm me up!

entries.source_text: 哦？好，那一会你去把赤红灵兽解决掉，我们帮你掠阵。
entries.current_text: Oh? Alright, you go take care of that Crimson Spirit Beast, and we'll cover you.

entries.source_text: 切，圭蝶姐姐比那啥孙膑厉害多了！
entries.current_text: Tch, Sister Guidie is way better than that Sun Bin guy!

entries.source_text: 不过……不知道你听说了吗，最近破门生活动愈发猖獗，连我们店的供货商<001>邬露</>女士的<001>牛小二</>也丢了。
entries.current_text: However... I don't know if you've heard, but the 'Door-Breaking' activities have been rampant lately. Even our supplier, Ms. <001>Wu Lu</>, lost her <001>Niu Xiao'er</>.

entries.source_text: 这牛小二怎么独自在草地里……而且还会说话？
entries.current_text: Why is this Niu Xiao'er alone in the grass... and can it talk?

entries.source_text: 这牛小二怎么独自在草地里……而且还会说话？
entries.current_text: Why is this Niu Xiao'er alone in the grass... and can it talk?

entries.source_text: 它应该就是<001>邬露女士</>丢失的牛小二了，先想办法将它带回<001>云来驿</>吧。
entries.current_text: This must be Niu Er, which Ms. <001>Wu Lu</> lost. Let's find a way to take it back to <001>Cloudhaven</> first.

entries.source_text: 它应该就是<001>邬露女士</>丢失的牛小二了，先想办法将它带回<001>云来驿</>吧。
entries.current_text: This must be Niu Er, which Ms. <001>Wu Lu</> lost. Let's find a way to take it back to <001>Cloudhaven</> first.

entries.source_text: 这位同学，麻烦问下，你有看见我的牛小二吗？
entries.current_text: Classmate, sorry to bother you, but have you seen my Niu Xiao'er?

entries.source_text: 你的牛小二丢了？
entries.current_text: Did you lose your Niu Xiao'er?

entries.source_text: 而我那名为<001>邬露货运</>的<001>牛小二</>也突然故障失灵，独自向<001>山上</>跑了去，不知所踪。
entries.current_text: And my <001>Niu Xiao'er</> from <001>Wu Lu Freight</> suddenly malfunctioned and ran off toward the <001>mountains</> alone, and is nowhere to be found.

entries.source_text: 同学，如果你看见了我的牛小二，请你一定要<001>将它带回来</>好吗？
entries.current_text: Classmate, if you see my Niu Xiaoer, please make sure to <001>bring it back</>, okay?

entries.source_text: 云来驿的货物都在牛小二里。
entries.current_text: The goods for the Cloud-Arrival Post are all with Niu Xiao'er.

entries.source_text: 我在云来驿等你？
entries.current_text: I'll wait for you at Yunlai Inn?

entries.source_text: 是啊，怎么了？它不过是只机关牛马罢了，我难道还要像对人一样对待吗？
entries.current_text: Yeah, what's the matter? It's just a mechanical ox-horse; do I really have to treat it like a person?

entries.source_text: 看来平时，它受了不少心灵的伤害呢……
entries.current_text: Looks like it has suffered quite a bit of emotional trauma...

entries.source_text: 看来平时，它受了不少心灵的伤害呢……
entries.current_text: Looks like it has suffered quite a bit of emotional trauma...

entries.source_text: 这牛小二怎么独自在草地里，难道<001>走丢了</>吗？……而且还会说话？
entries.current_text: Why is this Niu Xiao'er alone in the grass? Did <001>it get lost</>? ...And it can talk?

entries.source_text: 这牛小二怎么独自在草地里，难道<001>走丢了</>吗？……而且还会说话？
entries.current_text: Why is this Niu Xiao'er alone in the grass? Did <001>it get lost</>? ...And it can talk?

entries.source_text: 牛小二。
entries.current_text: Niu Xiaoer.

entries.source_text: ……机关牛马也会犯困的吗？
entries.current_text: ...Do mechanical oxen and horses get sleepy too?

entries.source_text: ……机关牛马也会犯困的吗？
entries.current_text: ...Do mechanical oxen and horses get sleepy too?

entries.source_text: 怎么样同学，你有看见我丢失的牛小二吗？
entries.current_text: How about it, classmate? Have you seen my lost Niu Xiao'er?

entries.source_text: 辛炽果，嗯……确实是提神醒脑的好物，不过一般都生长在<001>赤红灵兽</>附近，那边比较危险。
entries.current_text: Xinchi Fruit, hmm... it's indeed good for refreshing the mind, but it usually grows near <001>Crimson Spirit Beasts</>, which is quite dangerous.

entries.source_text: 它应该就是<001>邬露女士</>丢失的牛小二了，先想办法将它带回<001>云来驿</>吧。
entries.current_text: This must be Niu Er, which Ms. <001>Wu Lu</> lost. Let's find a way to take it back to <001>Cloudhaven</> first.

entries.source_text: 它应该就是<001>邬露女士</>丢失的牛小二了，先想办法将它带回<001>云来驿</>吧。
entries.current_text: This must be Niu Er, which Ms. <001>Wu Lu</> lost. Let's find a way to take it back to <001>Cloudhaven</> first.

entries.source_text: 滋滋……牛牛只有三千环金一月，还要天天加班。
entries.current_text: Bzz... Niu Niu only makes 3,000 Huan Gold a month, and has to work overtime every day.

entries.source_text: 奇怪，那边怎么会有一头<001>牛小二</>？
entries.current_text: Strange, why is there a <001>Niu Xiao'er</> over there?

entries.source_text: 就是趁现在，消灭掉那些<001>毒泡芽</>！
entries.current_text: Now's our chance! Take out those <001>Poison Spore Buds</>!

entries.source_text: 这杜巳初不知道从什么途径获得了玲珑兽园的经营权，最初一段时间还算正常。
entries.current_text: This Du Sichi somehow obtained the operating rights to the Exquisite Beast Garden. It was normal for the first little while.

entries.source_text: 这杜巳初竟然贩卖未经许可的毒物，其中有不少就是她用贪墨的兽用草药所炼制。
entries.current_text: This Du Sichi was actually selling unauthorized poisons, many of which she refined using embezzled veterinary herbs.

entries.source_text: 果然，以她跟<001>龚未成</>和<001>陆酉劫</>的关系，一定也牵扯了进来。
entries.current_text: As expected, given her relationship with <001>Gong Weicheng</> and <001>Lu Youjie</>, she must be involved too.

entries.source_text: 小心那些<001>华盖蚀菇</>，它们喷吐的孢子也有毒！
entries.current_text: Watch out for those <001>Canopy Corrosive Mushrooms</>, the spores they spray are poisonous too!

entries.source_text: 注意别长时间置身毒雾，否则会有生命危险！
entries.current_text: Be careful not to stay in the toxic mist for too long, or your life will be in danger!

entries.source_text: 毒泡芽，拦住他们！
entries.current_text: Poison Spore Buds, stop them!

entries.source_text: 可恶！没想到我杜巳初竟然栽在两个稷下学生手里……
entries.current_text: Dammit! I never expected to be defeated by two Jixia students...

entries.source_text: 如果你已经去过玲珑峡谷内的话，相信你一定对它们不陌生。
entries.current_text: If you've already been inside the Exquisite Canyon, I'm sure you're no stranger to them.

entries.source_text: 如果想了解更多峡谷试炼的运营工作，可以去<001>云息营地</>，或者<001>缮机亭</>参观。
entries.current_text: If you want to learn more about the operations of the Canyon Trials, you can visit the <001>Cloud Breath Camp</> or the <001>Mechanism Pavilion</>.
