entries.current_text: If you've already been inside the Exquisite Canyon, I'm sure you're no stranger to them.

entries.source_text: 如果想了解更多峡谷试炼的运营工作，可以去<001>云息营地</>，或者<001>缮机亭</>参观。
entries.current_text: If you want to learn more about the operations of the Canyon Trials, you can visit the <001>Cloud Breath Camp</> or the <001>Mechanism Pavilion</>.

entries.source_text: 一个传说而已，说是夫子在彩云盆地留下了谜题，指向一份宝藏。
entries.current_text: It's just a legend. They say the Master left a riddle in the Colorful Cloud Basin that points to a treasure.

entries.source_text: 如果是<001>陆酉劫</>和<001>龚未成</>那两个蠢货的人就免谈了，我就是扔了也不会给他们。
entries.current_text: If it's for those two fools, <001>Lu Youjie</> and <001>Gong Weicheng</>, then forget it. I'd rather throw it away than give it to them.

entries.source_text: 老大，机关布置好了。
entries.current_text: Boss, the traps are set.

entries.source_text: 少抱怨了，你们这帮废物，还不如杜巳初和龚未成那两个家伙省心。
entries.current_text: Stop complaining, you bunch of losers. You're not even as reliable as those two, Du Sichi and Gong Weicheng.

entries.source_text: 你们这帮蠢货是不是又欠揍了？这机关是打算砸我吗！
entries.current_text: Are you idiots looking for a beating again? Are you trying to crush me with this mechanism?!

entries.source_text: 看来可以先一步<001>割断机关的绳索</>，给他们个“惊喜”。
entries.current_text: Looks like we can take the first step and <001>cut the mechanism's rope</>, giving them a 'surprise'.

entries.source_text: 看来可以先一步<001>割断机关的绳索</>，给他们个“惊喜”。
entries.current_text: Looks like we can take the first step and <001>cut the mechanism's rope</>, giving them a 'surprise'.

entries.source_text: 老子当时一门心思只顾着把那<001>蠢鹅</>抓回来，后来才知道钥匙是被<001>龚未成</>拿去了。
entries.current_text: I was so focused on catching that <001>stupid goose</> at the time, I didn't realize until later that <001>Gong Weicheng</> had taken the key.

entries.source_text: 这症状怎么这么耳熟？哦，融枝病啊。白梅馆来的？
entries.current_text: Why do these symptoms sound so familiar? Oh, Molten Branch Disease. From the White Plum Pavilion?

entries.source_text: <001>料峭散</>可不是给人吃的啊，哦，我知道了，你是<001>白梅馆</>来的吧？
entries.current_text: <001>Liaoqiao Powder</> isn't for eating... Oh, I see, you're from <001>White Plum Pavilion</>, right?

entries.source_text: 他们分别是：<001>陆酉劫、龚未成、杜巳初</>。他们盘踞在各自的地盘，很是棘手。
entries.current_text: They are: <001>Lu Youjie, Gong Weicheng, and Du Sichi</>. They are entrenched in their respective territories, which is quite troublesome.

entries.source_text: 那是一种<001>长条形</>的机关宝物，外观呈<001>瓷白色</>。
entries.current_text: It is a <001>long, strip-shaped</> mechanical treasure, with a <001>porcelain-white</> appearance.

entries.source_text: 在那里，你需要与勇猛的机关人<001>战斗</>，并将它们打败。
entries.current_text: You'll need to <001>fight</> the brave Mechanoid and defeat it.

entries.source_text: 西北方有<001>云来驿</>，那里是学院建造的食堂，参与比赛的学子经常会去那里品尝美食，休息。
entries.current_text: To the northwest is <001>Cloud-Arrival Post</>, the academy's cafeteria. Students participating in the competition often go there to enjoy food and rest.

entries.source_text: 你若是参与了峡谷运营，则可以去北方的<001>云深营地</>，那里是工作人员们的休息场所。
entries.current_text: If you are involved in the Canyon's operations, you can go to the <001>Yunshen Camp</> in the north; that's where the staff rest.

entries.source_text: 在那里，你需要与勇猛的机关人<001>战斗</>，并将它们打败。
entries.current_text: You'll need to <001>fight</> the brave Mechanoid and defeat it.

entries.source_text: 不过……这段时间同学还是要小心一点，最好不要进入玲珑峡谷……
entries.current_text: However... you should still be careful during this time. It's best not to enter Linglong Canyon...

entries.source_text: 西北方有<001>云来驿</>，那里是学院建造的食堂，参与比赛的学子经常会去那里解解渴饿，稍作休息。
entries.current_text: To the northwest is <001>Cloud-Arrival Post</>, the academy's cafeteria. Students participating in the competition often go there to quench their thirst and hunger and take a break.

entries.source_text: 你若是参与了峡谷运营，则可以去北方的<001>云深营地</>，那里是工作人员们的休息场所。
entries.current_text: If you are involved in the Canyon's operations, you can go to the <001>Yunshen Camp</> in the north; that's where the staff rest.

entries.source_text: 同学，感谢你为缮机亭做出的贡献！<001>后面箱子</>里的东西，就送给你当作谢礼了！
entries.current_text: Classmate, thank you for your contribution to the Repair Pavilion! The items in the <001>box behind</> are a thank-you gift for you!

entries.source_text: 我知道<001>龚未成</>身为破门生头领，一定很难对付吧。
entries.current_text: <001>Gong Weicheng</> is the leader of the Rebels. He's no ordinary man. Even with your skills, it's not a sure win.

entries.source_text: 真的吗，那可太好了！你先去问问机关学姐<001>泷霞</>吧，她现在非常需要帮手。
entries.current_text: Start by asking Senior <001>Long Xia</>. She needs help right now.

entries.source_text: 同学，操作之前一定要先阅读三根<001>柱子上张贴</>的维修机关<001>说明</>，牢记安全第一！
entries.current_text: Classmate, before operating, be sure to read the maintenance mechanism <001>instructions</> posted on the three <001>pillars</>, and remember that safety comes first!

entries.source_text: 太好了，终于有人来了！机关维修师已经快累趴下了！
entries.current_text: Great, someone's finally here! The mechanism repairman is about to collapse from exhaustion!

entries.source_text: 缮机亭这<001>三个大型机关</>虽然能自动修理，但仍有大部分工作需要人工手动精修。
entries.current_text: The Mechanism Pavilion has <001>three large mechanisms</> that can repair themselves, but most of the work still requires manual precision.

entries.source_text: 哈哈，不过身为机关维修师，我们也乐在其中！
entries.current_text: Haha, but as mechanism repairers, we enjoy it!

entries.source_text: 完蛋了！这是我找鲁班大师借的实验型鲁班五号。你一定要帮我修好呀！
entries.current_text: Oh no! This is the experimental Luban No. 5 I borrowed from Master Luban. You have to help me fix it!

entries.source_text: 是那只刺熊！
entries.current_text: It's that Thorn Bear!

entries.source_text: 按照机关的对称性原则，这里应该准备了两块配重石才对​​，怎么会少了一个？
entries.current_text: According to the principle of symmetry for these mechanisms, there should be two counterweight stones here. Why is one missing?

entries.source_text: 这种机关门需要<001>重物</>压下踏板才能开启，踏板应该就在附近。
entries.current_text: This type of mechanical door requires a <001>heavy object</> to press down on the pedal to open. The pedal should be nearby.

entries.source_text: 控制石门的机关就在上面，我的腿受伤了，你能去把<001>机关打开</>吗？
entries.current_text: The mechanism for the stone door is right above. My leg is injured, can you go and <001>activate the mechanism</>?

entries.source_text: 控制石门的机关就在上面，我的腿受伤了，你能去把<001>机关打开</>吗？
entries.current_text: The mechanism for the stone door is right above. My leg is injured, can you go and <001>activate the mechanism</>?

entries.source_text: 我记得……他以前常去<001>彩云潭</>边，看水面的浮光，那也是我早年为他打造的<001>静水机关</>所在。
entries.current_text: I remember... he used to go to the <001>Colorful Cloud Pool</> to watch the shimmering water. That's also where I built his <001>Still Water Mechanism</> years ago.

entries.source_text: 你没事吧？我看到门口有机关能量残留。
entries.current_text: Are you okay? I saw residual mechanism energy at the entrance.

entries.source_text: 我没事，那些机关似乎是五号留下的，很……独特。
entries.current_text: I'm fine. Those mechanisms seem to have been left by Number Five. They're very... unique.

entries.source_text: 我没事，那些机关似乎是五号留下的，很……独特。
entries.current_text: I'm fine. Those mechanisms seem to have been left by Number Five. They're very... unique.

entries.source_text: 别担心。现场没有打斗痕迹，门口的机关也是刚布置的，五号是自己离开的。而且……
entries.current_text: Don't worry. There are no signs of a struggle at the scene, and the mechanism at the door was just set up. Number Five left on their own. Besides...

entries.source_text: 得知五号失踪，鲁班大师推测幕后之人可能是对五号很熟悉的苑如松，而谜题真正指向的其实是五号。鲁班大师打算去找演梦机动队，并建议你去彩云潭寻找线索，那里有他为五号打造的“静水机关”。
entries.current_text: Upon learning of No. 5's disappearance, Master Luban speculates that the mastermind might be Yuan Rusong, who is very familiar with No. 5, and that the riddle actually points to No. 5. Master Luban plans to find the Dream-Acting Task Force and suggests you look for clues at Caiyun Pool, where he built a "Still Water Mechanism" for No. 5.

entries.source_text: 他说，机关无心，但赋予它生命的人有心。
entries.current_text: He said, mechanisms have no heart, but the person who gives them life does.

entries.source_text: 让五号常去<001>彩云潭</>吧，那里宽敞，他也自在。
entries.current_text: Let Number Five go to <001>Caiyun Pool</> more often. It's spacious there, and he'll be more at ease.

entries.source_text: 原来夫子曾在事故发生后委婉提醒过鲁班大师，那并不是五号的错，可惜他未能领会。如今他决定让五号留在彩云潭，并希望你能常去陪陪他。
entries.current_text: So it turns out the Master had subtly reminded Master Luban after the accident that it wasn't No. 5's fault, but unfortunately, he didn't understand. Now he has decided to let No. 5 stay in Caiyun Pool and hopes you will visit him often.

entries.source_text: 对了！是班叔实验室里的<001>静水机关</>！
entries.current_text: Right! It's the <001>Still-Water Mechanism</> in Uncle Ban's lab!

entries.source_text: 对了！是班叔实验室里的<001>静水机关</>！
entries.current_text: Right! It's the <001>Still-Water Mechanism</> in Uncle Ban's lab!

entries.source_text: 不久之前……我来彩云潭边玩，遇到几个稷下学子。他们……很害怕。
entries.current_text: Not long ago... I came to play by the Colorful Cloud Pool and met some Jixia students. They were... very scared.

entries.source_text: 我怕……伤害到他们，像那次一样，所以……就躲了起来。
entries.current_text: I was afraid... of hurting them, just like that time, so... I hid away.

entries.source_text: 然后呢？你怎么，怎么跑到机关里了？
entries.current_text: And then? How, how did you end up inside the mechanism?

entries.source_text: 三把钥匙化作了一封邀请函，线索似乎指向了荣耀塔顶……
entries.current_text: The three keys have formed an invitation letter, and the clues seem to point to the top of the Tower of Glory...

entries.source_text: 近一个月内，与鲁班大师一同调试校验机关——三十七次。
entries.current_text: In the past month, I have debugged and calibrated the mechanisms with Master Luban—thirty-seven times.

entries.source_text: 什么意思？！我早就说，五号的问题不在机关本身，那个榆木脑袋还不信！
entries.current_text: What do you mean?! I told you, the problem with Number Five isn't the mechanism itself, but that blockhead wouldn't believe me!

entries.source_text: 毕竟，机关术的尽头是人心。
entries.current_text: After all, the end of mechanism arts is the human heart.

entries.source_text: 苑如松，演梦机动队负责人。欢迎来到玲珑峡谷。
entries.current_text: Yuan Rusong, head of the Dream-Weaving Task Force. Welcome to Linglong Canyon.

entries.source_text: 旁边的这铳名曰<001>鹰扬铳</>，是我的故乡北荒十分流行的狩猎装备，送给你当做谢礼了。
entries.current_text: This firearm nearby is called <001>Eagle-Soar Gun</>. It's a popular hunting tool from my hometown in the Northern Wilderness. Take it as a token of my gratitude.

entries.source_text: <001>梁子仪</>啊，我让他在<001>赤红灵兽西侧河谷的石头上</>磨炼耐心。
entries.current_text: <001>Liang Ziyi</>? I told him to hone his patience <001>on the rocks in the valley west of the Crimson Spirit Beast</>.

entries.source_text: <001>梁子仪</>啊，我让他在<001>赤红灵兽西侧河谷的石头上</>磨炼耐心。
entries.current_text: <001>Liang Ziyi</>? I told him to hone his patience <001>on the rocks in the valley west of the Crimson Spirit Beast</>.

entries.source_text: 玲珑峡谷内的参赛学子们往往面临着高强度的挑战，身体和心理上都承受着巨大的压力。
entries.current_text: Students competing in the Linglong Canyon often face high-intensity challenges, enduring immense physical and mental pressure.

entries.source_text: 玲心苑内有丰富的心灵疗愈设施，比如令人愉悦的熏香芳疗、轻松休闲的水上瑜伽、平和心绪凉亭冥想。
entries.current_text: Lingxin Garden has a wealth of mental healing facilities, such as pleasant incense aromatherapy, relaxing water yoga, and peaceful pavilion meditation.

entries.source_text: 玲心苑内有丰富的心灵疗愈设施，比如令人愉悦的熏香芳疗、轻松休闲的水上瑜伽、平和心绪凉亭冥想。
entries.current_text: Lingxin Garden has a wealth of mental healing facilities, such as pleasant incense aromatherapy, relaxing water yoga, and peaceful pavilion meditation.

entries.source_text: 体验心灵疗愈的<001>芳疗</>、<001>瑜伽</>、<001>冥想</>、及<001>帮助其他同学</>，还可获得玲心苑特别送出的小礼物噢！
entries.current_text: Experience spiritual healing through <001>Aromatherapy</>, <001>Yoga</>, <001>Meditation</>, and <001>Helping Other Students</>, and you can even receive a special gift from Lingxin Garden!

entries.source_text: 请先参与<001>芳疗</>、<001>瑜伽</>、<001>冥想</>三项体验后，再帮助其他同学吧。
entries.current_text: Please complete the <001>Aromatherapy</>, <001>Yoga</>, and <001>Meditation</> experiences before helping other students.

entries.source_text: 关于冥想。
entries.current_text: Chat.

entries.source_text: 冥想点就设在我身后的凉亭内，不知道干啥的时候就去躺一躺吧！
entries.current_text: The meditation spot is in the pavilion behind me. If you don't know what to do, just go lie down there!

entries.source_text: 玲珑峡谷内的参赛学子们往往面临着高强度的挑战，身体和心理上都承受着巨大的压力。
entries.current_text: Students competing in the Linglong Canyon often face high-intensity challenges, enduring immense physical and mental pressure.

entries.source_text: 说来奇怪，老师他人不见了，只留下了<001>一封信</>，好像是关于他的师兄……羌无终？
entries.current_text: It's strange. He just disappeared and left <001>a letter</>. I still had questions to ask him...

entries.source_text: 那位羌师兄似乎就在<001>云笼湿地</>，要不我们这就<001>前去撺掇撺掇</>？
entries.current_text: That Senior Brother Qiang seems to be in the <001>Cloud-Veiled Wetlands</>. Shall we <001>go over and stir things up</> now?

entries.source_text: 谁知道云笼湿地到底发生了什么？
entries.current_text: Who knows what really happened in the Cloud-Caged Wetlands?

entries.source_text: 你好烦，能不能别打扰我和青眠兽培养感情。
entries.current_text: You're so annoying. Can you stop interrupting me while I'm bonding with the Qingmian Beast?

entries.source_text: 倾注了那么多心血，寄予厚望的“最强机关”……
entries.current_text: The "Ultimate Mechanism" that I poured so much effort and hope into...

entries.source_text: 对了，玲珑塔……或许可以反过来，调高限流机关的阈值？
entries.current_text: Oh, right, the Linglong Tower... maybe we could reverse it and increase the threshold of the flow-limiting mechanism?

entries.source_text: 龚未成呢喃着自己犯了与当年同样的错误，彼时玲珑塔的失控似乎与他有关。
entries.current_text: Gong Weicheng mutters that he made the same mistake as he did back then; the loss of control of the Linglong Tower at that time seems to be related to him.

entries.source_text: 都怪杜巳初那家伙！她总有些稀奇古怪的手段……
entries.current_text: It's all that Du Sichi's fault! She always has some strange tricks up her sleeve...

entries.source_text: 那破钥匙你拿走就是，我的“最强机关”……我会亲手修好他！
entries.current_text: You can take that broken key. My 'Ultimate Mechanism'... I will repair it with my own hands!

entries.source_text: 有了这些遗迹守卫……就不愁没有机关零件改造机关了！
entries.current_text: With these Ruin Guards... I won't have to worry about not having mechanical parts to modify my contraptions!

entries.source_text: 龚未成激活了机关人，但失控的机关人却将他也当成了目标……
entries.current_text: Gong Weicheng activated the automaton, but the out-of-control automaton targeted him as well...

entries.source_text: 当年之事并非羌无终一人之过，步陆陵恳请师兄给他一个弥补过往的机会。
entries.current_text: The events of that year were not solely Qi Wuzhong's fault. Bu Lu Ling implores his senior brother to give him a chance to make amends for the past.

entries.source_text: 这不是稷下的雪，这是……北荒的雪！
entries.current_text: This isn't snow from Jixia. This is... snow from the Northern Wilderness!

entries.source_text: 没关系，以后有机会，我们再回北荒！
entries.current_text: It's okay, we'll have a chance to return to the Northern Wilderness in the future!

entries.source_text: 客官，这是受北荒神女庇佑的雕像，保您平安！买一个试试？
entries.current_text: Customer, this is a statue blessed by the Goddess of the Northern Wilderness. It will keep you safe! Want to buy one and see?

entries.source_text: 我会带你向北荒神女请罪，她一定会宽恕你的。
entries.current_text: I will take you to plead for mercy before the Goddess of the Northern Wilderness; she will surely forgive you.

entries.source_text: 我颠沛流离时她在哪儿？我痛苦沉沦时她又在哪儿？
entries.current_text: Where was she when I was drifting from place to place? Where was she when I was sinking into misery?

entries.source_text: 不要再说了！我可是北荒第一猎手，我没有错！更不可能错！
entries.current_text: Say no more! I am the greatest hunter in the Northern Wilderness. I am not wrong! And I certainly couldn't be!

entries.source_text: 你来彩云盆地做什么？
entries.current_text: What are you doing in the Colorful Cloud Basin?

entries.source_text: 学院的老师却告诉俺夫子要主持归虚梦演，正在彩云盆地。于是俺马不停蹄一路追赶至此。
entries.current_text: The Academy teachers told me the Master was presiding over the Guixu Dream Trial in the Caiyun Basin. So, I've been chasing after him without a moment's rest.

entries.source_text: 你们是在维修这些飞行机关吗？
entries.current_text: Are you fixing these lanterns?

entries.source_text: 你们是在维修这些飞行机关吗？
entries.current_text: Are you fixing these lanterns?

entries.source_text: 不知道观星群山和奇门水榭的飞车比赛怎么样了。
entries.current_text: I wonder how the flying car race between the Star-Gazing Mountains and the Qimen Water Pavilion is going.

entries.source_text: 如果飞车时还能获得小辣鸡精灵，无敌时间能大幅延长。
entries.current_text: If you can get a Little Spicy Chicken sprite while flying, your invincibility time will be significantly extended.

entries.source_text: 一路走来，老夫所能给出的答案，也不过是“守护”二字。
entries.current_text: Having walked this path, the only answer I can give is 'protection'.

entries.source_text: 坚如磐石的力量，协作同行的默契，亦或是一颗真心，这些都只是诠释守护的方式。
entries.current_text: Strength as solid as a rock, the tacit understanding of working together, or simply a sincere heart—these are all just ways to interpret protection.

entries.source_text: 当然，人生海海，也总有……竭尽全力却无法守护所爱的时刻。
entries.current_text: Of course, life is vast, and there are always... moments when you try your best but cannot protect what you love.

entries.source_text: 别紧张，这只是为了帮你熟悉一下接下来会遇到的机关。
entries.current_text: Don't be nervous. This is just to help you get familiar with the mechanisms you'll encounter later.

entries.source_text: 眼前这台控制仪能切换<001>武道</>、<001>魔道</>、<001>机关</>试炼区，三个分区设有三种不同的机关挑战。
entries.current_text: This control console can switch between the <001>Martial Arts</>, <001>Magic</>, and <001>Automaton</> trial zones. Each zone features a different type of mechanical challenge.

entries.source_text: 你要做的，是熟悉并<001>利用三种机关，击碎面前塔身的核心</>。
entries.current_text: What you need to do is familiarize yourself with and <001>utilize the three types of mechanisms to shatter the core of the tower in front of you</>.

entries.source_text: 可别小看它们。这些机关是应对试炼的关键，摸清它们的原理对后续的挑战有很大帮助。
entries.current_text: Don't underestimate them. These mechanisms are key to the trials, and understanding how they work will be a big help for future challenges.

entries.source_text: 对了，机关核心外部有<001>防护罩</>，用于防止机关意外启动，踩一下旁边的<001>踏板</>就能解除。
entries.current_text: Oh, right, the mechanism core has a <001>protective shield</> to prevent accidental activation. You can disable it by stepping on the <001>pedal</> nearby.

entries.source_text: 你对机关的反应和领悟力都很出色，上手也利落。这么快能吃透这几个机关的人可不多。
entries.current_text: Your reaction and comprehension regarding the mechanisms are excellent, and you're quick to pick them up. Not many people can master these mechanisms so quickly.

entries.source_text: 我是圭蝶。你就是龙牙吧？来做个交易。
entries.current_text: I am Guidie. You must be Longya, right? Let's make a deal.

entries.source_text: 我自小生长在南荒，从前只是听人聊起，来到稷下后才真正见到了大海。
entries.current_text: I grew up in the Southern Wilderness. I only ever heard people talk about it before, but I didn't truly see the ocean until I came to Jixia.

entries.source_text: 哇！这个是机关小兵的同款盔甲吗！没想到能在稷下看见真的！多少钱？我全要了！
entries.current_text: Wow! Is this the same armor as the mechanical soldiers? I never expected to see the real thing in Jixia! How much? I'll take it all!

entries.source_text: 孙大小姐，想买衣服的话，我带你去云根镇最时髦的……
entries.current_text: Miss Sun, if you want to buy clothes, I can take you to the trendiest place in Yungen Town...

entries.source_text: 这位置不错，海边的景色尽收眼底。
entries.current_text: This is a nice spot; you can see the entire seaside view.

entries.source_text: 我相信如果他能得到名师指点，一定能学有所成，发扬和传承您的艺术成就。
entries.current_text: I believe that if he can get guidance from a master, he will surely achieve success and carry forward your artistic achievements.

entries.source_text: 当务之急，我们要写篇报道帮玄啸澄清一下那些流言蜚语。相信之后他也会打消对我们记者行业的成见。
entries.current_text: First things first, let's write a report to clear things up for him. I'm sure he'll have a better opinion of our line of work after that.

entries.source_text: 据说归虚梦演之后，彩云盆地游荡着一只残暴的食铁兽，它总是找人打架惹事，凡所到之处更是将所有食物风卷残云，粒米不留！
entries.current_text: It is said that after the Void Dream Performance, a brutal Iron-Eater roams the Colorful Cloud Basin. It always picks fights and causes trouble, and wherever it goes, it devours all food, leaving not a single grain behind!

entries.source_text: 人们为了生存，总要磨平些棱角、丢掉些坚持，所谓坚守初心，谈何容易。
entries.current_text: To survive, people often have to smooth out their edges and discard their persistence. Staying true to one's original intentions is easier said than done.

entries.source_text: 林萌初与主编冯薇烟谈及初心。冯薇烟认为，人为了生存难免会磨平棱角、放下坚持；可林萌初却觉得，即便前路艰难，也应坚守初心。
entries.current_text: Lin Mengchu talks to editor-in-chief Feng Weiyan about her original intentions. Feng Weiyan believes that people inevitably lose their edges and give up their persistence for the sake of survival; however, Lin Mengchu feels that even if the road ahead is difficult, one should stick to their original intentions.

entries.source_text: 他在照风庵老师的指点下，已经成为彩云盆地小有名气的青年画家了！
entries.current_text: Influenced by his master, he's become a young painter renowned in Iridescent Cloud!

entries.source_text: 前不久，他给我寄了两幅画，上面画的正是这荣耀塔的风光。
entries.current_text: Not long ago, he sent me a postcard with the picture of the most beautiful glorious tower in Iridescent.

entries.source_text: 据说那个食铁兽还会吃人……我们作为彩云盆地的本地媒体有必要查清楚这件事情的原委。
entries.current_text: It is said that the Iron-Eater even eats people... As local media in the Colorful Cloud Basin, we must get to the bottom of this.

entries.source_text: 所以我们准备深入赛场，去往<001>武俊之路·终</>，采访那些锲而不舍挑战玲珑塔的学子们。
entries.current_text: Next, we'll head deep into the venue to <001>Path of Martial Prowess: Final Stage</> to interview the students in action.

entries.source_text: 我准备和主编一起采风，写一系列全新的，关于彩云盆地风土人情的报道。
entries.current_text: I'm planning to go on a field trip with the editor-in-chief to write a series of brand-new reports on the local customs of the Caiyun Basin.

entries.source_text: 第一条线索，我们听说有部分学子正在描绘整个玲珑峡谷的景色。
entries.current_text: The first clue: we heard that some students are painting the scenery of Linglong Gorge.

entries.source_text: 听说他们就在<001>玲珑阙东南</>，我想听听日复一日面对赛场的他们对玲珑峡谷有什么独特的见解。
entries.current_text: I heard they're at the <001>southeast of Prisma Pavilion</>. I want to hear what unique insights they have on the Linglong Canyon after facing the arena day after day.

entries.source_text: 第二条线索，虽然归虚梦演未能决出冠军，但稷下学子们仍在玲珑峡谷中挥洒汗水。
entries.current_text: The second clue: Although the Guixu Dream Performance didn't determine a champion, the Jixia students are still sweating in Linglong Gorge.

entries.source_text: 你好！我是<001>《彩云周刊》</>的记者林萌初，我正做一个关于彩云盆地的专题，能简单采访你几句吗？
entries.current_text: Hello there! I'm a reporter from <001>Iridescent Weekly</>. Do you have a moment for an interview?

entries.source_text: 老师性喜清静，不涉俗务。此刻……大约又在哪处云深不知地了吧。对了，最近倒是听说有人在<001>荣耀塔东侧的瀑布下</>见过他老人家。
entries.current_text: Master prefers peace and quiet and avoids worldly affairs. At this moment... he is probably somewhere deep in the clouds. By the way, I recently heard someone saw him <001>under the waterfall on the east side of the Tower of Glory</>.

entries.source_text: 嗯，告诉你个好消息，我们后来拜访了隐居在彩云盆地的绘画名师照风庵大师。
entries.current_text: Hmm, I have some good news. We later visited the reclusive master painter, Zhaofeng'an, in the Colorful Cloud Basin.

entries.source_text: 嗯，告诉你个好消息，我们后来拜访了隐居在彩云盆地的绘画名师照风庵大师。
entries.current_text: Hmm, I have some good news. We later visited the reclusive master painter, Zhaofeng'an, in the Colorful Cloud Basin.

entries.source_text: 这里有一对<001>荧光棒</>，是我为了在梦演决赛给圭蝶队加油，卖了好几幅画换来的，虽不成敬意，但请收下。
entries.current_text: Here is a pair of <001>glow sticks</>. I sold several paintings to exchange for them to cheer for the Guidie team in the Dream Performance finals. It's not much, but please accept them.

entries.source_text: 想了解彩云盆地的新鲜事，请多关注我们<001>《彩云周刊》</>！
entries.current_text: To learn the latest news in the Colorful Cloud Basin, please keep an eye on our <001>Colorful Cloud Weekly</>!

entries.source_text: 云丝云根这些材料难以替代，稷下的技术又对材料比较依赖……
entries.current_text: Materials like cloud silk and cloud roots are hard to replace, and Jixia's technology is quite dependent on them...

entries.source_text: 玲珑峡谷破坏严重，维修需要人手。神纹怪物出没，也需要人手抵御。
entries.current_text: The Linglong Canyon is severely damaged and needs manpower for repairs. We also need people to defend against the Divine Rune monsters.

entries.source_text: 直到，老夫子携云蚕来到稷下！他一声号召，三贤就此齐聚。
entries.current_text: Until the Old Master brought the Cloud Silkworm to Jixia! With his call, the Three Sages were finally reunited.

entries.source_text: 庄周得知战争，唏嘘不已，决心留于稷下，传承魔道之力。
entries.current_text: Upon learning of the war, Zhuangzi sighs deeply and decides to remain at Jixia to pass on the power of sorcery.

entries.source_text: 墨子眼看满是疮痍的稷下，挺身而出，以机关之力重整稷下。
entries.current_text: Seeing Jixia in ruins, Mozi stepped forward to rebuild it with the power of his mechanisms.

entries.source_text: 三贤协力，建立学院，并于古代遗迹上修建而成了通天塔！
entries.current_text: The Three Sages joined forces to establish the academy and built the Heaven-Reaching Tower atop ancient ruins!

entries.source_text: 不好说，也不知道那神秘人到底是何目的，以后会不会再对稷下出手……
entries.current_text: Hard to say. I don't know what the mysterious person's goal is, or if they will strike at Jixia again...

entries.source_text: 众所周知，稷下一大特产便是云丝云根，今后产量大减，要是缺了数据支撑，相关的课题自然是不好做……
entries.current_text: As everyone knows, a major specialty of Jixia is Cloud Silk and Cloud Roots. If production drops significantly and we lack data support, it will naturally be difficult to conduct related research...

entries.source_text: 还做生意，整个稷下的机关制造怕都成问题！
entries.current_text: Still doing business? I'm afraid the entire mechanical production of Jixia is in trouble!

entries.source_text: 这是我们工巧家的手工制造坊。你看那边，陈列着稷下顶级工匠们的得意作品。
entries.current_text: Craftworks is the Crafters' workshop. We showcase our finest work here.

entries.source_text: 这份工作不仅能让大家更了解工巧家，还能帮助稷下百姓更高效地生活，我当然喜欢了。
entries.current_text: I hope people understand our work and live a more comfortable life.

entries.source_text: 关于云丝机关。
entries.current_text: About the Cloud Silk mechanism.

entries.source_text: 这段时间或许确实会有一些云丝机关逐渐停摆。
entries.current_text: It's possible that some Cloud-Silk mechanisms will gradually shut down during this time.

entries.source_text: 但同学不必太过担心，等墨子院长他们夺回云蚕之后，那些机关很快就会恢复运转的！
entries.current_text: But you don't need to worry too much, classmate. Once Dean Mozi and the others reclaim the Cloud Silkworm, those mechanisms will soon return to operation!

entries.source_text: 关于霜鬃狂熊。
entries.current_text: About Imprinted Spike Bear.

entries.source_text: 关于霜鬃狂熊。
entries.current_text: About Imprinted Spike Bear.

entries.source_text: 哇，好漂亮的玉佩，上面写的是……遥望秋水唤枫落？
entries.current_text: Wow, what a beautiful jade pendant. It says... 'Gazing at the autumn water, calling for the maple to fall'?

entries.source_text: 早知道不一个人来这个遗迹研究了，机关人打在身上可真疼。
entries.current_text: I shouldn't have come to these ruins alone to do research. Those automatons really hurt when they hit you.

entries.source_text: 你师姐拜托凌云卫帮忙找你。
entries.current_text: Your senior sister asked the Lingyun Guard to help find you.

entries.source_text: 你师姐拜托凌云卫帮忙找你。
entries.current_text: Your senior sister asked the Lingyun Guard to help find you.

entries.source_text: 说起青铜机关人，我倒是想研究研究它们的来历，不如我们去弄些零件来研究吧！
entries.current_text: Speaking of bronze automatons, I'd like to study their origins. Why don't we go get some parts to research?

entries.source_text: 真要感谢那些好心的武道学生啊，帮我们解决一路遇到的危险青铜机关人。
entries.current_text: We really have to thank those kind martial arts students for helping us deal with the dangerous bronze automatons we encountered along the way.

entries.source_text: 说的也是，真后悔在武道学院没有把功夫练扎实。
entries.current_text: That's true. I really regret not practicing my martial arts more diligently at the Martial Arts Academy.

entries.source_text: 如果有个好心的武道或者魔道高手刚好准备去消灭几只青铜机关人就好了。
entries.current_text: If only some kind-hearted martial or magic expert happened to be on their way to eliminate a few bronze automatons.

entries.source_text: 同学我信你，只要你能弄到我们需要的青铜机关人零件！
entries.current_text: I trust you, student, as long as you can get the bronze automaton parts we need!

entries.source_text: 这是你们要的青铜机关人零件。
entries.current_text: Here are the bronze mech parts you asked for.

entries.source_text: 这是你们要的青铜机关人零件。
entries.current_text: Here are the bronze mech parts you asked for.

entries.source_text: 多亏了同学的帮忙，现在可以开始安安分分地研究青铜机关人了吧。
entries.current_text: Thanks to your help, classmate, can we finally get back to studying the bronze automaton in peace?

entries.source_text: 毕竟那些青铜机关人三番五次地围堵我们，看得出都是些硬茬。
entries.current_text: Those bronze automatons have blocked our path time and time again; they're clearly tough nuts to crack.

entries.source_text: 你就是失踪风物家的同伴么？凌云卫这边需要了解一下失踪事件的前因后果。
entries.current_text: Are you the companion of the missing collector? The Lingyun Guard needs to understand the ins and outs of this disappearance.

entries.source_text: 是这样的，我和我的师弟想去归陵边上，但是路上有很多机关人，所以决定绕路。
entries.current_text: My junior brother and I want to go to the edge of Guiling, but there are many mechanical soldiers on the road, so we decided to take a detour.

entries.source_text: 只是有这个可能性。你先别紧张，我们凌云卫会立刻搜寻你师弟的踪迹。
entries.current_text: It's just a possibility. Don't be nervous; our Lingyun Guard will immediately search for traces of your junior brother.

entries.source_text: 好危险……那就静观其变，说不定有人有办法能替我们调查那副<001>机关残躯</>呢。
entries.current_text: Too dangerous... let's just wait and see. Maybe someone has a way to help us investigate that <001>mechanical husk</>.

entries.source_text: 这位同学绝对是我们的贵人！看来研究机关残躯有希望了。
entries.current_text: This classmate is definitely our savior! It seems there's hope for researching the mech remains after all.

entries.source_text: 是呀，连学长都难以靠近，可能没人能好好研究那些机关残躯了吧……
entries.current_text: Yes, even the seniors find it hard to get close. Perhaps no one can properly study those mechanical remains anymore...

entries.source_text: 学长，我们这次要研究的就是前面那片遗迹里的机关残躯吗？
entries.current_text: Senior, are we here to study the mechanical remains in those ruins ahead?

entries.source_text: 但是，我先前对那片遗迹进行了踩点，除了那具机关残躯外……遗迹里全是机关人，根本没法靠近观察！
entries.current_text: But I scouted those ruins earlier. Aside from that mechanical wreckage... the place is full of automatons. There's no way to get close and observe!

entries.source_text: 同学，我看你刚才进到了那片遗迹！有没有看到那个机关残躯？
entries.current_text: Classmate, I saw you enter those ruins! Did you see the remains of that mechanism?

entries.source_text: 那个机关残躯还有什么特别之处？
entries.current_text: Is there anything else special about those mechanical remains?

entries.source_text: 机关上有黄色纹路。
entries.current_text: There are yellow patterns on the mechanism.

entries.source_text: 果然，和以及寻常可见的青铜纹路的机关人不同。
entries.current_text: Indeed, unlike the common bronze-patterned automatons.

entries.source_text: 不知是不同功用的机关人，还是不同阵营……
entries.current_text: I wonder if they are different types of mechanical beings, or different factions...

entries.source_text: 在那么危险的环境里还能近距离接触到机关残躯，已经很厉害了！
entries.current_text: It's already impressive that you were able to get so close to the remains of the mechanism in such a dangerous environment!

entries.source_text: 所以机关人才是机关学派的浪漫啊！
entries.current_text: That's why mechanical beings are the romance of the Mechanist school!

entries.source_text: 好不容易爬上了山上的遗迹，没想到里面全是机关人。
entries.current_text: I finally climbed up to the ruins on the mountain, only to find it full of mechanical puppets.

entries.source_text: 甚至我想，如果再次对上机关人的话，我也不会害怕了。
entries.current_text: I even think that if I face the mechanical constructs again, I won't be afraid anymore.

entries.source_text: 这么多机关都不能用了，应该不只是巧合那么简单……
entries.current_text: So many mechanisms are broken; it shouldn't be just a simple coincidence...

entries.source_text: 我们慕英团打算找个时间去探望一下西施学姐，你要去吗？
entries.current_text: The Mu Ying Troupe is planning to visit Senior Xishi soon. Are you coming?

entries.source_text: 云流这么多年都没出过异常……云蚕间里到底发生了什么？
entries.current_text: The Aerflow has never been abnormal for so many years... What on earth happened in the Aer-silkworm room?

entries.source_text: 还有一些百草家和魔道学院合作研制的稀有药方，只是上面的材料有点不太好找。
entries.current_text: There are also some rare prescriptions developed in collaboration between the Hundred Herbs Clan and the Academy of Magic, but the ingredients are a bit hard to find.

entries.source_text: 庄周老师的梦鲲状态也有些奇怪……最近老是围着通天塔飞来飞去……
entries.current_text: Master Zhuangzi's Dream Kun is also acting a bit strange... It's been flying around the Heaven-Reaching Tower lately...

entries.source_text: 秘诀嘛，庄周院长早就说过了，就是洞察规律，寻找本质。
entries.current_text: Headmaster Zhuangzi says the key is to grasp the laws and uncover their essence.

entries.source_text: 一定是云蚕出了问题，所以云蚕间才会封闭起来！对，一定是这样！
entries.current_text: It must be that something went wrong with the Cloud Silkworms, which is why the Cloud Silkworm Room was sealed! Yes, that must be it!

entries.source_text: 要不去找魔道学院的人问问？
entries.current_text: Why don't we go ask someone from the Magic Academy?

entries.source_text: 魔道学子的生活里，向来少不了那些美的事物。
entries.current_text: In the life of an Arcana student, there is never a shortage of beautiful things.

entries.source_text: 为此我可是专门前来魔道学院，同学们才能随心所欲地选购呀。
entries.current_text: That's why I'm here, bringing you all the goodies.

entries.source_text: 你怎么说的学姐跟地狼一样……
entries.current_text: Why do you talk about the senior sister like she's a ground wolf...

entries.source_text: 之前我检查了下，机关本身没有问题，问题应该出在其他地方……
entries.current_text: I checked it before, the mechanism itself is fine, the problem must be somewhere else...

entries.source_text: 所以我跟大家商量了下，决定发挥滑板优越的机动性，协助凌云卫进行巡逻。
entries.current_text: So I discussed it with everyone and decided to use the skateboard's superior mobility to assist the Lingyun Guard with patrols.

entries.source_text: 虽然派遣了大量凌云卫来巡逻，但我们也想为学院出份力。
entries.current_text: Although a large number of Lingyun Guards have been dispatched to patrol, we also want to do our part for the academy.

entries.source_text: 云流织机连接的三座大厅是学院的主体，学生们分别在此制造机关、学习机关设计。
entries.current_text: The main halls, connected by the Aerflow Weaver, are where they study and craft.

entries.source_text: 不如说，整个机关学院就是一台严密运作的巨大机械，是机关术最完美的展现。
entries.current_text: The entire school is a marvel of engineering, showcasing the pinnacle of Mechcraft.

entries.source_text: 机关学院的现任院长是墨子，也是学院的创始人。
entries.current_text: The current headmaster, Mozi, is also the founder of the school.

entries.source_text: 墨子位列三贤之一，精通机关术。我是因为仰慕墨子的学识才立志要加入机关学院的。
entries.current_text: He's one of the Three Sages, known for his Mechcraft expertise. He inspired me to join the School of Mechcraft.

entries.source_text: 咳，虽然现在机关学院引以为豪的云流织机，与塑织机暂时无法使用。
entries.current_text: Cough, although the Academy's pride and joy, the Cloud-Weave Loom and the Plastic-Weave Loom, are temporarily out of commission.

entries.source_text: 但仍可以从每一个齿轮，每一条转轴中窥见机关术的奥妙。
entries.current_text: But one can still glimpse the wonders of mechanism arts in every gear and every axle.

entries.source_text: 要是状况得不到改善……建立在云丝基础之上的机关术研究会受到极大阻碍……
entries.current_text: If the situation doesn't improve... the research on mechanism arts based on Cloud Silk will be severely hindered...

entries.source_text: 那海都，长安，没有云丝就没有机关术了？
entries.current_text: So, without Cloud Silk, there is no mechanism art in Haidu or Chang'an?

entries.source_text: 这下可就没有足够的云丝拿来研究机关术了……
entries.current_text: Now there won't be enough Cloud Silk to research mechanism arts...

entries.source_text: 是时候拿出这些机关晒晒太阳了，机关设计就是需要不断迭代啊。
entries.current_text: It's time to take these mechanisms out to soak up some sun. Mechanism design requires constant iteration, after all.

entries.source_text: 这些是咕呱火炮和小机关人的初代版本！
entries.current_text: These are the first-generation versions of the Gugu Cannons and small automatons!

entries.source_text: 首先得承认，这些机关设计再好，也有不足之处……
entries.current_text: I must admit, no matter how well-designed these mechanisms are, they have their flaws...

entries.source_text: 比如这个小机关人的手臂，就很容易脱落。
entries.current_text: For example, the arms of this little automaton fall off quite easily.

entries.source_text: 如果你们机关学子能去我们那儿开课讲解就好了。
entries.current_text: It would be great if some of you could visit our place for lectures sometime.

entries.source_text: 是时候拿出这些机关晒晒太阳了。
entries.current_text: It's time to take these mechanisms out to soak up some sun.

entries.source_text: 这些是咕呱火炮和小机关人的初代版本！
entries.current_text: These are the first-generation versions of the Gugu Cannons and small automatons!

entries.source_text: 首先得承认，这些机关设计再好，也有不足之处。
entries.current_text: I must admit, no matter how well-designed these mechanisms are, they have their flaws.

entries.source_text: 比如这个小机关人的手臂，就很容易脱落。
entries.current_text: For example, the arms of this little automaton fall off quite easily.

entries.source_text: 今天的火器机关课，不会点名吧……算了，不想了，逃都逃了。
entries.current_text: Hope there's no roll call at today's cannon class... Anyway, won't make a difference now.

entries.source_text: 火器机关课?
entries.current_text: Firearm Mechanism Class?

entries.source_text: 那以后我要拿什么材料迭代我的肴馔机关人才好呢……
entries.current_text: Then what materials should I use to iterate on my culinary mechanisms in the future...

entries.source_text: 云丝越来越少，农具机关做不出来……三位院长没一个有人影……
entries.current_text: Cloud silk is getting scarcer, and we can't make the farming mechanisms... None of the three Deans are anywhere to be seen...

entries.source_text: 唉，别提了，我机关核的原理还不敢说完全掌握，现在又来了个更难的……
entries.current_text: Sigh, don't get me started. I haven't even fully mastered the principles of my mechanism core, and now there's something even harder...

entries.source_text: 关于冥想。
entries.current_text: Chat.

entries.source_text: 但现在云流有些下降，难以起到冲刷身体的作用，但冥想吐纳，仍然有利于修炼心灵。
entries.current_text: But the cloud flow has decreased, so it's not as effective for cleansing the body, though meditation and breathing exercises are still good for cultivating the mind.

entries.source_text: 而静思堂正是通过冥想来帮助武道学子磨砺心性，锤炼意志的地方。
entries.current_text: The Hall of Meditation is a place where martial arts students hone their character and temper their will through meditation.

entries.source_text: 关于冥想。
entries.current_text: Chat.

entries.source_text: 冥想旨在练心，云流淬体是助力，而不是目的。
entries.current_text: Meditation is meant to train the mind; Cloud Flow tempering is an aid, not the goal.

entries.source_text: 静思堂是武道学院最精华之处，同学可以在这儿进行冥想和吐纳的练习。
entries.current_text: The Hall of Contemplation is the most essential part of the Martial Arts Academy, where students can practice meditation and breathing exercises.

entries.source_text: 本来此处流云充沛，可在冥想时起到锻体功效。但……
entries.current_text: This place used to be full of flowing clouds, perfect for meditation and body tempering. But...

entries.source_text: 我们问机关学院借来了仪器检测，发现云流浓度下降了数倍不止。
entries.current_text: We borrowed instruments from the Mechanism Academy for testing and found that the cloud flow concentration had dropped significantly.

entries.source_text: 这下看来，云蚕间的封锁和云流浓度下降肯定有所联系……
entries.current_text: It seems the lockdown of the Cloud Silkworm Room is definitely linked to the drop in Cloud Stream concentration...

entries.source_text: 武道学院有什么奇怪的事吗？
entries.current_text: Is there anything strange happening at the Martial Arts Academy?

entries.source_text: 奇怪的事……说来，不知是不是我的错觉，总觉得武道学院的云流变稀薄了……
entries.current_text: Strange... Come to think of it, I don't know if it's just my imagination, but the Cloud Flow at the Martial Arts Academy seems to be getting thinner...

entries.source_text: 我跟人说好了待会去击退周边异变的野兽……
entries.current_text: I promised someone I'd go repel the mutated beasts in the area later...

entries.source_text: 演武场的云流肉眼可见地变稀薄了……不止是魔道学院受到了影响……
entries.current_text: The flow of clouds over the training grounds has visibly thinned... It's not just the Academy of Magic that's been affected...

entries.source_text: 难道……学院把云蚕间封了起来是真的想隐瞒什么……
entries.current_text: Could it be... that the academy sealing off the Cloud Silkworm Room is really trying to hide something...

entries.source_text: 唉，百无一用是垂钓啊，要是当年入学的是武道学院就好了……
entries.current_text: Sigh, fishing is useless. If only I had enrolled in the Martial Arts Academy back then...

entries.source_text: 墨炎阁也为了应对神纹怪物，不得不把重心放在火器上。
entries.current_text: The Moyan Pavilion also had to focus on firearms to deal with the Divine Pattern monsters.

entries.source_text: 可惜……要不是西施学姐重伤，就能跟我们一起挖掘古物了。
entries.current_text: It's a pity... if Senior Xishi hadn't been seriously injured, she could have joined us in excavating the artifacts.

entries.source_text: 等西施学姐醒了，看到你们找的古物，指不定会有多开心呢。
entries.current_text: Once Senior Sister Xishi wakes up and sees the artifacts you found, she'll be so happy.

entries.source_text: 这，这怎么回事！通天塔的外环怎么变成这样了？
entries.current_text: W-what's going on! How did the outer ring of the Tongtian Tower end up like this?

entries.source_text: 得联系工巧家……不对不对，先跟机关学院上报……
entries.current_text: I need to contact the Gongqiao family... No, no, report to the Mechanism Academy first...

entries.source_text: 欸，你看，通天塔的外环是不是碎了？
entries.current_text: Hey, look, is the outer ring of the Tongtian Tower broken?

entries.source_text: 学院一定是在掩饰什么！说不定，这和通天塔的外环碎了有关……
entries.current_text: The Academy must be hiding something! Maybe this has to do with the outer ring of the Tongtian Tower shattering...

entries.source_text: 怎么去了趟丰云野，感觉学院氛围怪怪的。
entries.current_text: Why does the academy atmosphere feel so strange after a trip to Fengyunya?

entries.source_text: 机关精密复杂，但归根结底必有维修之法……
entries.current_text: The mechanism is precise and complex, but there must be a way to repair it...

entries.source_text: 没关系，我虎头说一不二，买卖不在仁义在。
entries.current_text: It's okay. I, Hu Tou, keep my word. Even if the deal doesn't go through, the friendship remains.

entries.source_text: 没关系，我虎头说一不二，买卖不在仁义在。
entries.current_text: It's okay. I, Hu Tou, keep my word. Even if the deal doesn't go through, the friendship remains.

entries.source_text: 没关系，我虎头说一不二，买卖不在仁义在。
entries.current_text: It's okay. I, Hu Tou, keep my word. Even if the deal doesn't go through, the friendship remains.

entries.source_text: 没关系，我虎头说一不二，买卖不在仁义在。
entries.current_text: It's okay. I, Hu Tou, keep my word. Even if the deal doesn't go through, the friendship remains.

entries.source_text: 没关系，等你想赚一些百工币的时候尽管来找我吧。
entries.current_text: It's okay. Whenever you want to earn some Artisan Coins, feel free to come find me.

entries.source_text: 没关系，等你想赚更多百工币的时候尽管来找我吧。
entries.current_text: It's okay. Whenever you want to earn more Artisan Coins, feel free to come find me.
Want <001>Crafting Coins</>

entries.source_text: 新机关？
entries.current_text: New mechanism?

entries.source_text: 新机关？
entries.current_text: New mechanism?

entries.source_text: 化身而已，今天我在野外做机关测试，想让你看看我最近研发的新机关，或许你会用上。
entries.current_text: It's just an avatar. I'm testing some mechanisms in the wild today and wanted to show you what I've been working on. You might find it useful.

entries.source_text: 想要百工币
entries.current_text: Want Crafting Coins

entries.source_text: 要试试这个新机关么？
entries.current_text: Want to try out this new mechanism?

entries.source_text: 什么好玩的机关？
entries.current_text: What kind of fun contraption?

entries.source_text: 什么好玩的机关？
entries.current_text: What kind of fun contraption?

entries.source_text: 好久不见，我今日在野外做机关测试，恰好路过，让你看看我最近研发的新机关，或许你会用上。
entries.current_text: It's been a while. I was out in the wild testing some mechanisms and happened to pass by. Let me show you the new device I've been developing; you might find a use for it.

entries.source_text: 新机关？
entries.current_text: New mechanism?

entries.source_text: 新机关？
entries.current_text: New mechanism?
Want <001>Crafting Coins</>

entries.source_text: 想要百工币
entries.current_text: Want Crafting Coins
Want <001>Crafting Coins</>

entries.source_text: 想要百工币
entries.current_text: Want Crafting Coins

entries.source_text: 唉，还想着机关术再发展几年就能抓老鼠了……
entries.current_text: Sigh, I was hoping that if mechanism arts developed for a few more years, I'd be able to catch mice...

entries.source_text: 看起来是一台耕地的机关，怎么会倒在这里……
entries.current_text: It looks like a farming mechanism. How did it end up here...

entries.source_text: 看起来是一台耕地的机关，怎么会倒在这里……
entries.current_text: It looks like a farming mechanism. How did it end up here...

entries.source_text: 这是什么机关？好方便！本小姐能摸摸吗？婆婆，那个飘在天上的又是什么机关？
entries.current_text: What kind of mechanism is this? So convenient! Can I touch it? Granny, what is that other mechanism floating in the sky?

entries.source_text: 我们历来重金诚聘学院资深设计师，制作采风严谨，成品细节还原。
entries.current_text: We have always hired senior academy designers at high prices to ensure rigorous field research and authentic details in the final products.

entries.source_text: 你是西施学姐的新队友吗？来喝点饮品歇歇吧，我请客。
entries.current_text: Are you Senior Xishi's new teammate? Come have a drink and rest, it's on me.

entries.source_text: 但如今，可能得暂时下架相关的饮品了……希望西施学姐能平安吧……
entries.current_text: But now, I might have to temporarily take the related drinks off the menu... I hope Senior Xishi is safe...

entries.source_text: 再见。若是想滋养精神，常来喝杯饮品！
entries.current_text: Goodbye. If you want to nourish your spirit, come by for a drink often!

entries.source_text: 对对对，希望西施学姐早点出现吧，她那么厉害，一定会没事的。
entries.current_text: Yes, yes, yes, I hope Senior Xishi appears soon. She's so strong, she'll be fine.

entries.source_text: 本来，这可是饱含了西施学姐祝福的饮品呢……
entries.current_text: This was supposed to be a drink filled with Senior Xishi's blessings...

entries.source_text: 从这里看云根镇，虽是山水依旧，却又物是人非……
entries.current_text: Looking at Yungen Town from here, though the mountains and waters remain, the people and things have changed...

entries.source_text: 这可是西施代言的，本来是云根镇特产，可以补充精力。但听说也要下架了。
entries.current_text: This was endorsed by Xishi. It was originally a specialty of Yungen Town and can replenish energy. But I heard it's being discontinued.

entries.source_text: 可怜我所有的积蓄砸下去也不够修房，是西施带我找了临时的住所。
entries.current_text: It's a pity that all my savings weren't enough to repair the house, so Xishi helped me find a temporary place to stay.

entries.source_text: 说起来，西施当时没有当着孩子们的面说我，是我最感谢她的地方。
entries.current_text: Come to think of it, the thing I'm most grateful to Xishi for is that she didn't scold me in front of the children back then.

entries.source_text: 云根家具，纯木典范，欢迎选购。
entries.current_text: Cloud root furniture, the pinnacle of pure wood, welcome to browse.

entries.source_text: 我力求维持稷下传统的风格，坚持使用云根材料，传承人与自然的和谐理念。
entries.current_text: I strive to maintain the traditional Jixia style, insisting on using cloud-root materials to pass on the philosophy of harmony between man and nature.

entries.source_text: 更愁的是，现在云根材料几乎断供，订下来的单子还不知道怎么交货呢。
entries.current_text: What's more worrying is that the supply of cloud root materials is almost cut off, and I don't know how to deliver the orders that have already been placed.

entries.source_text: 对了，说到归虚梦演，听说西施在梦演中下落不明？
entries.current_text: Oh, right, speaking of the Guixu Dream Performance, I heard Xishi went missing during it?

entries.source_text: 要是当初去看，说不定本来可以见到西施！
entries.current_text: If I had gone to see it back then, I might have actually met Xishi!

entries.source_text: 西施本就住在云根镇，若她平安归来，或许还是能见到的……
entries.current_text: Shye lived in Yungen Town. If she returned safely, perhaps we could still see her...

entries.source_text: 这云根镇处在交通要道，商贩、学子、本地居民，都是我的客人。
entries.current_text: This Cloud-Root Town is a major thoroughfare. Merchants, scholars, and locals—they're all my customers.

entries.source_text: 这……西施姐姐很忙的，柚柚要懂事哦。柚柚乖乖的，说不定西施姐姐就回来了……
entries.current_text: This... Sister Xishi is very busy, Youyou needs to be sensible. If you're a good girl, maybe Sister Xishi will come back...

entries.source_text: 怀念云根镇的声音了吗？
entries.current_text: Do you miss the sounds of Yungen Town?

entries.source_text: 稷下音乐传承久远，它承载了历史的旋律，我会把它的声音传承下去。
entries.current_text: Jixia's music has a long heritage; it carries the melody of history, and I will pass its sound on.

entries.source_text: 慢走，要记得我们云根镇的声音哦。
entries.current_text: Take care, and don't forget the sounds of Yungen Town.

entries.source_text: 但是我们界北，尤其是云根镇内的每间商家，都是历经沉浮而屹立的精品。
entries.current_text: But here in Jiebei, especially every shop in Cloud Root Town, they are all quality establishments that have stood the test of time.

entries.source_text: 云贝商人。
entries.current_text: Cloud Shell Merchant.

entries.source_text: 有人坚守技艺，就得一直熬着，有人灵活改行，就能先把日子过下去。
entries.current_text: Some stick to their craft and endure, while others adapt and change trades just to get by.

entries.source_text: 我本来只是想看看这条路的尽头到底有什么，可没想到居然碰上了破门生和成群的地狼。
entries.current_text: I originally just wanted to see what was at the end of this path, but I never expected to run into a Po Men Sheng and a pack of Earth Wolves.

entries.source_text: 激怒的地狼。
entries.current_text: Enraged Earth Wolf.

entries.source_text: 碰上了地狼和破门生，不过已经脱离危险了。
entries.current_text: Ran into some Earth Wolves and Door-Breakers, but I'm out of danger now.

entries.source_text: 碰上了地狼和破门生，不过已经脱离危险了。
entries.current_text: Ran into some Earth Wolves and Door-Breakers, but I'm out of danger now.

entries.source_text: 机关助农是一个很棒的思路，或许未来我们可以聘请工巧家前往江郡……
entries.current_text: Using mechanisms to assist farming is a great idea. Perhaps in the future, we can hire some craftsmen to go to Jiangjun...

entries.source_text: 错！鱼都是机关人钓的，跟他有什么关系！
entries.current_text: Wrong! The fish were caught by the automaton; what does that have to do with him?

entries.source_text: 错！鱼都是机关人钓的，跟他有什么关系！

entries.current_text: Wrong! The fish were caught by the automaton; what does that have to do with him?

entries.source_text: 精彩，比起上次机关拆解迭代，快了一倍。
entries.current_text: Impressive. Twice as fast as the last mechanism disassembly iteration.

entries.source_text: 机关重甲，变形，出发！
entries.current_text: Mechanical heavy armor, transform, let's go!

entries.source_text: 警报：高能时刻！机关重炮来袭！
entries.current_text: Alert: High-energy moment! Incoming mechanical heavy artillery!

entries.source_text: 心怀恐惧，方能无畏。用机关造物改造世界！
entries.current_text: Only with fear can one be fearless. Use mechanical creations to reshape the world!

entries.source_text: 原来这就是第三个谜面。听起来似乎和“机关”有关……不如去问问<001>鲁班大师</>吧。
entries.current_text: So this is the third riddle. It sounds like it has something to do with "mechanisms"... I should go ask <001>Master Luban</>.

entries.source_text: 原来这就是第三个谜面。听起来似乎和“机关”有关……不如去问问<001>鲁班大师</>吧。
entries.current_text: So this is the third riddle. It sounds like it has something to do with "mechanisms"... I should go ask <001>Master Luban</>.

entries.source_text: 复原第二把钥匙后，第三道谜面也得到揭示——那似乎与机关有关，你决定去巧才之路问问鲁班大师。
entries.current_text: After restoring the second key, the third riddle was revealed—it seems related to mechanisms. You decide to ask Master Luban on the Path of Ingenuity.

entries.source_text: 年轻的学子啊，欢迎来到荣耀塔！真正的荣耀来自智慧的碰撞！
entries.current_text: Young student, welcome to the Tower of Glory! True glory comes from the collision of wisdom!

entries.source_text: 可是，他们折腾了一整天，最后却两手空空地出来了，还被失控的机关所伤。
entries.current_text: But they struggled all day, only to come out empty-handed, and were even injured by the out-of-control mechanisms.

entries.source_text: 他想要提前摸清古塔的机关，甚至……对机关进行了改动？
entries.current_text: He wanted to figure out the ancient tower's mechanisms in advance, and even... tampered with them?

entries.current_text: That day, Qiaoshou Gua, out of vanity and insecurity, secretly tampered with the mechanism ahead of time, sowing the seeds of disaster.

entries.source_text: 行动开始，铁壁呱被荣耀冲昏头脑，无视计划率先冲出，立刻触发了机关，陷入绝境。
entries.current_text: The operation begins. Iron-Wall Frog, blinded by glory, ignores the plan and rushes out first, immediately triggering the trap and falling into a desperate situation.

entries.source_text: 一个只想着自己的团队，就像搭错了零件的机关，一动起来就会从内部崩坏。
entries.current_text: A team that only cares about itself is like a machine with the wrong parts installed—it falls apart from the inside the moment it starts moving.

entries.source_text: 年轻的学子啊，欢迎来到荣耀塔！真正的荣耀来自智慧的碰撞！

entries.source_text: 是守护机关出问题了吗？
entries.current_text: Is there a problem with the guardian mechanism?

entries.source_text: 嘎！是！但机关原本是没有问题的！
entries.current_text: Gaa! Yes! But there was nothing wrong with the mechanism originally!

entries.source_text: 你看，他们把金麦穗当成了韭菜，所以金麦穗很生气，跟他们吵了一架，启动了古塔机关。
entries.current_text: Look, they mistook the Golden Wheat Ears for leeks, so the Golden Wheat Ears got angry, had an argument with them, and activated the ancient tower mechanism.

entries.current_text: That day, Qiaoshou Gua, out of vanity and insecurity, secretly tampered with the mechanism ahead of time, sowing the seeds of disaster.

entries.source_text: 行动开始，铁壁呱被荣耀冲昏头脑，无视计划率先冲出，立刻触发了机关，陷入绝境。
entries.current_text: The operation begins. Iron-Wall Frog, blinded by glory, ignores the plan and rushes out first, immediately triggering the trap and falling into a desperate situation.

entries.source_text: 一个只想着自己的团队，就像搭错了零件的机关，一动起来就会从内部崩坏。
entries.current_text: A team that only cares about itself is like a machine with the wrong parts installed—it falls apart from the inside the moment it starts moving.

entries.source_text: 是守护机关出问题了吗？
entries.current_text: Is there a problem with the guardian mechanism?

entries.source_text: 嘎！是！但机关原本是没有问题的！
entries.current_text: Gaa! Yes! But there was nothing wrong with the mechanism originally!

entries.source_text: 你看，他们把金麦穗当成了韭菜，所以金麦穗很生气，跟他们吵了一架，启动了古塔机关。
entries.current_text: Look, they mistook the Golden Wheat Ears for leeks, so the Golden Wheat Ears got angry, had an argument with them, and activated the ancient tower mechanism.
