entries.source_text: 年轻的学子啊，欢迎来到荣耀塔！真正的荣耀来自智慧的碰撞！
entries.current_text: Young student, welcome to the Tower of Glory! True glory comes from the collision of wisdom!

entries.source_text: 还有个<001>龚未成</>，整天待在<001>南边</>的<001>武库遗址</>，研究什么机关机关的。
entries.current_text: There's also <001>Gong Weicheng</>, who spends all day at the <001>Armory Ruins</> in the <001>south</>, researching some kind of mechanism.

entries.source_text: 终于集齐了三枚玲珑机巧，真是不容易啊，可喜可贺！
entries.current_text: It wasn't easy, but you did it! Congratulations!

entries.source_text: 不过这玲珑机巧到底有什么用呢？
entries.current_text: But what's the point of collecting all three Contrivance?

entries.source_text: 不过这玲珑机巧到底有什么用呢？
entries.current_text: But what's the point of collecting all three Contrivance?

entries.source_text: 可惜，出了五号的事。可它也没什么错，只是想守护一些东西罢了。
entries.current_text: It's a pity about what happened with Number Five. But it wasn't wrong; it just wanted to protect something.

entries.source_text: 苑如松，演梦机动队负责人。也算是……闲人一个。欢迎来到玲珑峡谷。
entries.current_text: Yuan Rusong, head of the Dream-Weaving Task Force. You could say I'm... just an idler. Welcome to Linglong Canyon.

entries.source_text: 夫子留下的纸条提到了谜题的传承。那……我接下来该做什么？
entries.current_text: The note Master left mentions the inheritance of the puzzle. Then... what should I do next?

entries.source_text: 夫子留下的纸条提到了谜题的传承。那……我接下来该做什么？
entries.current_text: The note Master left mentions the inheritance of the puzzle. Then... what should I do next?

entries.source_text: 白梅馆离此不远，我这就启程，同学请稍等。
entries.current_text: The White Plum Pavilion is not far from here. I will set off now, please wait a moment, fellow student.

entries.source_text: 你在荣耀塔顶见到了“夫子”，听他讲述了他所认为的最珍贵的宝藏……
entries.current_text: You meet the "Master" at the top of the Tower of Glory and hear him describe what he considers the most precious treasure...

entries.source_text: 检测到机关玲珑塔已被突破，播放夫子留言。
entries.current_text: Exquisite Pagoda mechanism breakthrough detected, playing Master's message.

entries.source_text: 老夫总是想机关试炼最需要智慧与随机应变，这挑战想必也难不倒你。
entries.current_text: I always think that mechanism trials require the most wisdom and adaptability; this challenge surely won't stump you.

entries.source_text: 我记得这里的防御塔在紧急状况下，会自动启动，保卫赛场安全的。
entries.current_text: I remember that the defensive towers here activate automatically in emergencies to keep the arena safe.

entries.source_text: 玲珑塔的力量，甚至考虑到了蔚蓝神兽与猩红神兽来袭的情况而专门加强过。
entries.current_text: The power of the Linglong Tower was even reinforced to account for potential attacks from the Azure and Scarlet Divine Beasts.

entries.source_text: 这么短的时间内就修复了神秘人砸下的坑。
entries.current_text: The pit left by the mysterious person was repaired in such a short time.

entries.source_text: 虽然你的魔道之力被庄周所封印，但是运用并掌握流的方式是可以融会贯通。
entries.current_text: Although your magic power has been sealed by Zhuangzi, you can still master the way of Flow through practice and integration.

entries.source_text: 只是老夫总是害怕当你成为英雄的那一天，却没有能力与智慧去守护你想要守护的人。
entries.current_text: It's just that I always fear that when the day comes for you to be a hero, you won't have the ability or wisdom to protect those you want to protect.

entries.source_text: 老夫早有准备！这次的水晶核心必须要同时打破，三位一体，生生不息。
entries.current_text: Next time, she'll have to break all three crystal cores at once!

entries.source_text: 机关人里面掉出来的核心……我该怎么同时打破三个水晶核心呢？
entries.current_text: The core that fell out of the mech-boy... How am I supposed to break all three crystal cores at once?

entries.source_text: 机关人里面掉出来的核心……我该怎么同时打破三个水晶核心呢？
entries.current_text: The core that fell out of the mech-boy... How am I supposed to break all three crystal cores at once?

entries.source_text: 以后会如何应对魔道、机关、武道的敌人？
entries.current_text: How will you deal with enemies using magic, mechanisms, and martial arts in the future?

entries.source_text: 魔道需随机应变，机关需看准关键，武道需以力打力。
entries.current_text: Arcana requires adaptability, mechanisms require precision, and Martial Arts requires using force against force.

entries.source_text: 魔道需随机应变，机关需看准关键，武道需以力打力。
entries.current_text: Arcana requires adaptability, mechanisms require precision, and Martial Arts requires using force against force.

entries.source_text: 为“守护”而战后。
entries.current_text: After fighting for 'protection'.

entries.source_text: 为“守护”而战后。
entries.current_text: After fighting for 'protection'.

entries.source_text: “查询到特殊留言……收信人：老夫子”
entries.current_text: "Special message detected... Recipient: Old Master"

entries.source_text: “查询到特殊留言……收信人：老夫子”
entries.current_text: "Special message detected... Recipient: Old Master"

entries.source_text: 你连老夫的荣耀塔都敢拆，还怕那点浪头？
entries.current_text: You dared to dismantle my Tower of Glory, so why are you afraid of a little wave?

entries.source_text: 此去海都，也只能让这机关人代替老夫，再啰嗦啰嗦你了。
entries.current_text: Since I'm off to Hai Du, I can only let this automaton stand in for me to nag you a bit more.

entries.source_text: 测试——测试——播报机关也修好了，嗯？
entries.current_text: Testing—testing—the broadcast mechanism is fixed too, huh?

entries.source_text: 这入机关三分的力道，肯定是小满学姐！难道当时她直接把偏转仪拆下来了？
entries.current_text: This force that penetrates three inches into the mechanism must be Senior Mayene! Did she dismantle the deflector right then and there?

entries.source_text: ……差点就背上了破坏荣耀塔公共设施的罪名。
entries.current_text: ...I almost got charged with damaging public facilities at the Tower of Glory.

entries.source_text: ……差点就背上了破坏荣耀塔公共设施的罪名。
entries.current_text: ...I almost got charged with damaging public facilities at the Tower of Glory.

entries.source_text: 嗯？看这些机关臂的断痕，像是被人掰坏过。
entries.current_text: Hmm? Look at the breaks on these mechanical arms. They look like they were snapped off by someone.

entries.source_text: 破损的机关上遍布拳脚的痕迹，一看便是姬小满的杰作。你和元芬长舒一口气，决定先将偏转仪恢复原位。
entries.current_text: The broken mechanism is covered in scuff marks, clearly the handiwork of Mayene. You and Yuan Fen breathe a sigh of relief and decide to restore the deflector to its original position first.

entries.source_text: 这些机关……虽然位置无法更改，但方向可以调整。
entries.current_text: These mechanisms... their positions can't be changed, but their orientation can be adjusted.

entries.source_text: 这些机关……虽然位置无法更改，但方向可以调整。
entries.current_text: These mechanisms... their positions can't be changed, but their orientation can be adjusted.

entries.source_text: 请前往我左侧的机关塔接受试炼。
entries.current_text: Please head to the Automaton Tower on my left to undergo the trial.

entries.source_text: 机关塔突破……进度同步中，影像记录恢复……
entries.current_text: Mechanism tower breakthrough... synchronizing progress, restoring video records...

entries.source_text: 夫子您也瞧见啦，是这机关人突然失控，真不赖我啊！
entries.current_text: Master, you saw it too, this automaton suddenly went out of control. It really wasn't my fault!

entries.source_text: 啊对了夫子！说起机关，您之前送的小烦最近总是很吵，是不是坏了呀？
entries.current_text: Oh, right, Master! Speaking of mechanisms, that little 'Trouble' you gave me has been very noisy lately. Is it broken?

entries.source_text: 这机关试炼，本就是——
entries.current_text: This mechanism trial was always meant to be—

entries.source_text: 机关一道，需眼观全局，洞悉规律，可不是靠小聪明就能解决的。
entries.current_text: The way of mechanisms requires a global perspective and insight into patterns; it cannot be solved by mere cleverness.

entries.source_text: 快看，用来反弹攻击的偏转仪就在机关人护盾后面，得想办法打开护盾才行。
entries.current_text: Look, the deflector used to bounce back attacks is behind the mechanical guard's shield. We have to find a way to open the shield.

entries.source_text: 快看，用来反弹攻击的偏转仪就在机关人护盾后面，得想办法打开护盾才行。
entries.current_text: Look, the deflector used to bounce back attacks is behind the mechanical guard's shield. We have to find a way to open the shield.

entries.source_text: 要想通过试炼，必须利用三座防御塔击破大门核心，进入大厅。你与元芬决定分工合作，他负责研究每座塔的机制，从旁协助，而你则需要启动转盘，参加试炼。
entries.current_text: To pass the trial, you must use the three defensive towers to break the gate's core and enter the hall. You and Yuanfen decide to divide the work: he will study the mechanics of each tower to assist you, while you must activate the turntable to participate in the trial.

entries.source_text: 利用这些机关的位置，或许能将魔道塔的攻击导向大厅核心。
entries.current_text: Perhaps we can use the positions of these mechanisms to redirect the Magic Tower's attacks toward the hall's core.

entries.source_text: 利用这些机关的位置，或许能将魔道塔的攻击导向大厅核心。
entries.current_text: Perhaps we can use the positions of these mechanisms to redirect the Magic Tower's attacks toward the hall's core.

entries.source_text: 利用这些机关的位置，将魔道塔的攻击导向大厅核心。
entries.current_text: Use the positions of these mechanisms to redirect the Magic Tower's attacks toward the hall's core.

entries.source_text: 嘶，这机关可比其他防御塔难上不少……夫子这场试炼，到底是为谁设下的？
entries.current_text: Hiss, this mechanism is much harder than the other defensive towers... Who exactly did Master set this trial for?

entries.source_text: 对了，这机关弈我也修好了。收下吧，就当做陪我参加试炼的谢礼了。
entries.current_text: Oh, right, I've fixed this mechanism game too. Take it as a thank-you gift for joining me in the trial.

entries.source_text: 试炼与过去一同落下帷幕，元芬继续投入到荣耀塔修复工作之中，还将修好的机关弈赠给你当做谢礼。
entries.current_text: The trial and the past came to an end together. Yuan Fen continued to devote himself to the restoration of the Honor Tower and even gifted you the repaired Mechanism Yi as a token of gratitude.

entries.source_text: 不知夫子在机关塔试炼里……留下了什么样的嘱托？
entries.current_text: I wonder what kind of instructions the Master left behind in the Mechanism Tower trial...

entries.source_text: 不知夫子在机关塔试炼里……留下了什么样的嘱托？
entries.current_text: I wonder what kind of instructions the Master left behind in the Mechanism Tower trial...

entries.source_text: 夫子的用意……是想让小满学姐多熟悉不同流派的战斗方式吧？
entries.current_text: Master's intention... was probably to let Senior Mayene get more familiar with the combat styles of different schools, right?

entries.source_text: 夫子的用意……是想让小满学姐多熟悉不同流派的战斗方式吧？
entries.current_text: Master's intention... was probably to let Senior Mayene get more familiar with the combat styles of different schools, right?

entries.source_text: 你连老夫的荣耀塔都敢拆，还怕那点浪头？
entries.current_text: You dared to dismantle my Tower of Glory, so why are you afraid of a little wave?

entries.source_text: 此去海都，也只能让这小机关人代替老夫，再啰嗦啰嗦你了。
entries.current_text: Since I'm off to Hai Du, I can only let this little automaton stand in for me to nag you a bit more.

entries.source_text: 嗯？这枚机关球……似乎能储存武道塔的攻击能量？
entries.current_text: Hmm? This mechanical sphere... does it store the attack energy of the Martial Tower?

entries.source_text: 嗯？这枚机关球……似乎能储存武道塔的攻击能量？
entries.current_text: Hmm? This mechanical sphere... does it store the attack energy of the Martial Tower?

entries.source_text: 这防御塔怎么不启动呢？
entries.current_text: Why isn't this defensive tower activating?

entries.source_text: 这防御塔怎么不启动呢？
entries.current_text: Why isn't this defensive tower activating?

entries.source_text: ……荣耀塔怎么没动静？走，回去看看。
entries.current_text: ...Why is there no movement from the Tower of Glory? Let's go back and check.

entries.source_text: ……荣耀塔怎么没动静？走，回去看看。
entries.current_text: ...Why is there no movement from the Tower of Glory? Let's go back and check.

entries.source_text: 我看看……其实就是用储魔核心吸收塔的攻击能量，然后朝大厅发射就好。
entries.current_text: Let me see... It's actually just using the Magic Core to absorb the tower's energy and firing it at the hall.

entries.source_text: 这只是魔道镜像……是被魔道机关模拟出来的投影。
entries.current_text: This is just a magic-path reflection... a projection simulated by magic-path mechanisms.

entries.source_text: 这第一场试炼，便从<001>魔道塔</>开始。此处机关移转无常，又环环相扣，你该如何破局？
entries.current_text: This first trial begins at the <001>Martial Arts Tower</>. The mechanisms here shift constantly and are all interconnected. How will you break the deadlock?

entries.source_text: 我想留在这研究一下机关弈，要不你去大厅看看？
entries.current_text: I want to stay here and study the mechanism chess. Why don't you go check the lobby?

entries.source_text: 元芬要留在这里研究机关弈，拜托你去大厅看看通关试炼的奖品是什么。
entries.current_text: Yuanfen needs to stay here to study the Mechanism Chess. He asks you to go to the hall and see what the rewards for clearing the trial are.

entries.source_text: 机关弈
entries.current_text: Mechanism Chess

entries.source_text: 机关弈
entries.current_text: Mechanism Chess

entries.source_text: 机关弈
entries.current_text: Mechanism Chess

entries.source_text: 机关弈
entries.current_text: Mechanism Chess

entries.source_text: 对，就是这样，与其胡思乱想，还不如行动起来……守护好学院，等夫子回家！
entries.current_text: Yes, that's it. Instead of overthinking, we should take action... Protect the academy and wait for the Master to return!

entries.source_text: 星之队是在云蚕间休养，又有冷春医生照顾，我相信他们一定很快就能好起来的，你别太担心了。
entries.current_text: The Star Team is recuperating in the Cloud Silkworm Chamber under the care of Dr. Leng Chun. I'm sure they'll be fine soon, so don't worry too much.

entries.source_text: 你太过执拗，就让老夫亲自设计的机关弈来帮你开开窍！
entries.current_text: You are too stubborn. Let me use the mechanism game I designed myself to help you see the light!

entries.source_text: 同学你好，欢迎来到万众瞩目的荣耀塔！
entries.current_text: Hello, student. Welcome to the highly anticipated Tower of Glory!
Participate in the <001>Linglong Qualification Trial</>, challenge the <001>Six Linglong Towers</>, <001>Honor Tower</>, <001>Crimson Spirit Beast</>, and <001>Azure Spirit Beast</>.

entries.source_text: 以及体验<001>云息营地</>、<001>云来驿</>、<001>缮机亭</>、<001>玲心苑</>皆可获得一枚梦演奖牌。
entries.current_text: You can also earn a Dream Performance Medal by experiencing the <001>Cloud Breath Camp</>, <001>Cloud Arrival Post</>, <001>Mechanism Pavilion</>, and <001>Exquisite Heart Garden</>.

entries.source_text: 其实是白梅馆的纪妙来让我找你要<001>冰渊瓶</>的……
entries.current_text: Actually, Ji Miao from the White Plum Pavilion asked me to ask you for the <001>Ice Abyss Bottle</>...

entries.source_text: 其实是白梅馆的纪妙来让我找你要<001>冰渊瓶</>的……
entries.current_text: Actually, Ji Miao from the White Plum Pavilion asked me to ask you for the <001>Ice Abyss Bottle</>...

entries.source_text: 你说的是永无林吧，据说那边通往织梦者的家乡，但我也没去过。
entries.current_text: You're talking about the Never-Ending Forest, right? It's said to lead to the Dreamweaver's hometown, but I've never been there.

entries.source_text: 海境岩地，那可是个很神奇的地方！
entries.current_text: The Sea Realm Rocklands—that's a truly magical place!

entries.source_text: 这边是百鸣港的方向，来时路……
entries.current_text: This is the direction to Baiming Port, the way we came...

entries.source_text: 这边是百鸣港的方向，来时路……
entries.current_text: This is the direction to Baiming Port, the way we came...

entries.source_text: 看到了百鸣港，有点怀念，那是我第一次抵达稷下的地方。
entries.current_text: I see Baiming Port. It brings back memories; that was the first place I arrived at in Jixia.

entries.source_text: 看到了百鸣港，有点怀念，那是我第一次抵达稷下的地方。
entries.current_text: I see Baiming Port. It brings back memories; that was the first place I arrived at in Jixia.

entries.source_text: 同学，恭喜你登上荣耀塔！
entries.current_text: Classmate, congratulations on reaching the Tower of Glory!

entries.source_text: 那不如，就先送他一个玩偶，激励激励他好了。
entries.current_text: How about we give him a figurine for motivation?

entries.source_text: 欸，通天塔的外环……形状是不是不太一样了？
entries.current_text: Hey, the outer ring of the Tongtian Tower... doesn't the shape look a bit different?

entries.source_text: 与万法狂剑交锋、完成他们的试练后，万法试炼之证与狂剑试炼之证也已熔铸为一，成为铸灵符印重回你的手中。
entries.current_text: After clashing with the Ten Thousand Dharma Mad Sword and completing their trials, the Proof of Ten Thousand Dharma Trial and the Proof of Mad Sword Trial have fused into one, returning to your hands as the Spirit Casting Seal.

entries.source_text: 将万法试炼之证与狂剑试炼之证放入至高台内，铸灵符印终于冉冉升起，昭示着前路已经明晰。
entries.current_text: Placing the Proof of Ten Thousand Laws and the Proof of the Mad Sword into the Supreme Platform, the Spirit-Casting Seal finally rises slowly, signaling that the path ahead is clear.

entries.source_text: 读者们刚刚又给《稷下奇侠录》留下好多信件……再不回应就来不及了，这可怎么办？
entries.current_text: Readers have just left so many letters for the "Chronicles of Strange Heroes"... If we don't respond soon, it'll be too late. What should we do?

entries.source_text: 它旨在激励在校同学努力学习，追求卓越，并借此提升学院的声誉和形象。
entries.current_text: It aims to motivate students to study hard, pursue excellence, and thereby enhance the academy's reputation and image.

entries.source_text: 你看这篇早期报道，称赞红尘剑“大情大义，此姝举世无双”。但在今年这篇中，却称她”为施展抱负，多次置羽青侠伤势于不顾”。
entries.current_text: Look at this early report, praising the Red Dust Sword for her "great love and righteousness, a peerless woman." But in this year's report, it claims she "repeatedly disregarded the injuries of the Yuqing Hero in order to pursue her own ambitions."

entries.source_text: 自春溪原一别后，我四处游历，发现这观星台风景别致，因此在这里作画。
entries.current_text: Since we parted at Springbrook Plains, I have been traveling around. I found the scenery at this Star-Gazing Platform unique, so I am painting here.

entries.source_text: 墨染和你分别后，四处游历。发现观星台风景别致，因此在这里作画，他拜托你站在这里，让他尝试将人物融入画作。
entries.current_text: After parting ways with you, Moxian traveled around. Finding the scenery at the Star-Gazing Platform unique, he decided to paint here. He asked you to stand there so he could try to incorporate a figure into his painting.

entries.source_text: 同学，我的朋友陷入瓶颈，我需要用这个机关助他一臂之力，拜托了。
entries.current_text: Classmate, my friend is stuck in a bottleneck, and I need to use this mechanism to help him out. Please.

entries.source_text: 同学，我的朋友陷入瓶颈，我需要用这个机关助他一臂之力，拜托了。
entries.current_text: Classmate, my friend is stuck in a bottleneck, and I need to use this mechanism to help him out. Please.

entries.source_text: 我正打算在这里进行飞行试验，你看，这是彩云盆地的飞行气球。
entries.current_text: I'm planning to conduct a flight test here. Look, this is a flight balloon from the Colorful Cloud Basin.

entries.source_text: 我正想观察附近景色，这机关可以借我一用么？
entries.current_text: I'd like to observe the scenery nearby. Could I borrow this mechanism?

entries.source_text: 我正想观察附近景色，这机关可以借我一用么？
entries.current_text: I'd like to observe the scenery nearby. Could I borrow this mechanism?

entries.source_text: 这……这机关是我费了好大力气才借来的，可不能出意外，实在抱歉。
entries.current_text: This... I went to great lengths to borrow this mechanism, so it can't have any accidents. I'm truly sorry.

entries.source_text: 肖晨向你介绍这是彩云盆地的飞行气球，但由于要进行试验，他拒绝将气球借给你。
entries.current_text: Xiao Chen introduces this as a flying balloon of the Colorful Cloud Basin, but because he needs to conduct experiments, he refuses to lend it to you.

entries.source_text: 对了，他提到过机关学子设置的机关，去看看吧。
entries.current_text: Oh, right, he mentioned the mechanisms set up by the Jixia students. Let's go take a look.

entries.source_text: 对了，他提到过机关学子设置的机关，去看看吧。
entries.current_text: Oh, right, he mentioned the mechanisms set up by the Jixia students. Let's go take a look.

entries.source_text: 看来，还是得用机关飞上高处才能找到合适的景色，去问问那个人吧。
entries.current_text: Looks like I'll have to use a mechanism to fly up high to find a good view. I'll go ask that person.

entries.source_text: 看来，还是得用机关飞上高处才能找到合适的景色，去问问那个人吧。
entries.current_text: Looks like I'll have to use a mechanism to fly up high to find a good view. I'll go ask that person.

entries.source_text: 唉，这我哪知道啊。不过……这种鱼我只在安虞池附近的水域见过，<001>池中小岛</>罕有人至，说不定就是它们的巢穴！
entries.current_text: Sigh, how would I know? But... I've only seen this kind of fish in the waters near Anyu Pool. The <001>small island in the pool</> is rarely visited; maybe that's their nest!

entries.source_text: 小十四，瞧瞧这位贴心的好同学，可是很关心你呢……对了，忘了自我介绍，我叫库伊，是安虞野新来的兽医。
entries.current_text: Little Fourteen, look at this thoughtful classmate, they're very concerned about you... Oh, I forgot to introduce myself. My name is Kui, the new veterinarian in Anyu Ye.

entries.source_text: 是最近才出现在安虞野的怪物。听营地里的大家说，它们非常残忍，经常袭击其他动物，甚至连落单的路人也遭了殃……
entries.current_text: These are monsters that only recently appeared in Anyu Wilds. Everyone in the camp says they're incredibly cruel, often attacking other animals and even lone travelers...

entries.source_text: 听说你们准备去狩猎……呃……水猴子？
entries.current_text: I heard you're planning to hunt... uh... a water monkey?

entries.source_text: 听说你们准备去狩猎……呃……水猴子？
entries.current_text: I heard you're planning to hunt... uh... a water monkey?

entries.source_text: 是啊，你要是想打听消息，可以去<001>上面的帐篷边</>找他。这家伙被吓得啊，就差没变成铠鼠，把自己裹起来了。
entries.current_text: Yeah, if you want to ask around for information, you can find him <001>by the tent over there</>. The guy is so scared, he's practically turned into an Armored Rat, curling himself up.

entries.source_text: 倒也不用，动物之间存在着强烈的领地意识，贸然行动反而容易激怒它们伤害那只小家伙。
entries.current_text: That's not necessary. Animals have a strong sense of territory, and acting rashly might provoke them to hurt the little one.

entries.source_text: 如今它们把安虞池作为临时的栖息地，想来也是出于无奈的选择……我想帮帮他们。
entries.current_text: They are using the Anyu Pool as a temporary habitat, which I suppose was a choice born of necessity... I want to help them.

entries.source_text: 这是我拜托博物会的工巧家帮忙打造的水文监测仪，其中装载了多个传感机关核，能同时实现位移监测和渗压监测。
entries.current_text: This is a hydrological monitor I asked the artisans of the Museum Society to help build. It's equipped with multiple sensor mechanism cores, capable of monitoring both displacement and seepage pressure simultaneously.

entries.source_text: 除此之外还能……呃，又说多了。总之，我打算对安虞池的水文进行一次全面调查，以帮助祭鱼儿们选择最适合的“家”。
entries.current_text: Besides that, I can also... uh, I've said too much. Anyway, I plan to conduct a comprehensive survey of the Anyu Pool's hydrology to help the fish choose the most suitable 'home'.

entries.source_text: 接下来就拜托你把两台监测仪放到安虞池东西最深的位置，随着水波的运动，其中的机关核会将我需要的数据都记录下来。
entries.current_text: Next, I need you to place the two monitors at the deepest points of the Anyu Pool, east and west. As the water ripples, the mechanism cores inside will record all the data I need.

entries.source_text: 你们从蜥蜴手中救下了祭鱼儿，发现它们在寻找新的巢穴，辰藏拜托你利用检测仪在安虞池内寻找合适的地点。
entries.current_text: You save the sacrificial fish from the lizards and discover they are looking for a new nest. Chen Cang asks you to use the detector to find a suitable location in Anyu Pond.

entries.source_text: 至于祭鱼儿，是一种罕见的神奇生物。它们捕鱼能力极强，常把捕到的鱼摆放在岸边，就像陈列祭祀的贡品，这也是它们名字的由来。
entries.current_text: As for the sacrificial fish, they are a rare and magical creature. They are extremely capable of catching fish and often place the fish they catch on the shore, like offerings for a sacrifice, which is how they got their name.

entries.source_text: 对，还是用石头引走吧，能不伤害它们最好。
entries.current_text: Yes, let's lure them away with a stone. It's best not to hurt them.

entries.source_text: 果然跟我们之前想的一样，这群蜥蜴就是被驯养的，收到的命令多半是捕猎和驱赶，所以攻击性没那么强。
entries.current_text: Just as we thought, these lizards are domesticated. They were likely ordered to hunt and drive away, so they aren't that aggressive.

entries.source_text: 请您放心，我的许诺无比真诚。我虽然很爱财，但辰藏先生的价值远不是环金可以衡量的。
entries.current_text: Rest assured, my promise is sincere. While I do love money, Mr. Chenzang's value is far beyond what gold can measure.

entries.source_text: 我会先把这些动物带回安虞野诊治，然后找人一起想办法处理祭鱼儿的事。
entries.current_text: I'll take these animals back to the Anyu field clinic first, then find someone to help figure out how to handle the sacrificial fish.

entries.source_text: 辰藏打算先把动物带回安虞野诊治，邀请你明晚相见，他准备了惊喜给你。
entries.current_text: Chenzang plans to take the animal back to Anyu Wild Clinic for treatment first and invites you to meet tomorrow night. He has prepared a surprise for you.

entries.source_text: 但这台仪器竟然装载了多点固定探测感应机关核，还自带可回收的监测浮标！
entries.current_text: But this instrument is actually equipped with a multi-point fixed detection sensor core and even has a recoverable monitoring buoy!

entries.source_text: 稷下磅礴的云流之力滋养构建了丰富的物种生态，简直就是博物学者的乐园。我相信我会在这里完成最厚的一本图鉴。
entries.current_text: Jixia's majestic cloud-flow power nourishes and builds a rich ecological system; it's simply a paradise for naturalists. I believe I will complete my thickest encyclopedia here.

entries.source_text: 唉，对于生物和环境，有人保护，就有人破坏。我见过太多人为了利益对珍稀生物下手，也见过很多人为了保护一方环境奉献生命。
entries.current_text: Sigh, when it comes to nature and wildlife, there will always be those who protect and those who destroy. I've seen too many people harm rare creatures for profit, but I've also seen many give their lives to protect the environment.

entries.source_text: 我的故乡，在云中漠地的一片绿洲之中。那里的环境非常复杂，也因此造就了多样的生态。
entries.current_text: My hometown is in an oasis in the Cloud Desert. The environment there is very complex, which has led to a diverse ecosystem.

entries.source_text: 你说藏狐先生的双节棍到底是什么材质的？我也好想打造一套……同学，能不能用你的头去试试？
entries.current_text: What exactly are Mr. Tibetan Fox's nunchucks made of? I'd love to craft a set... Hey, classmate, mind if we test them on your head?

entries.source_text: 至于祭鱼儿族群，它们暂时被妥善安置在了安虞池，之前的监测结果显示，符合它们筑巢所需的环境。
entries.current_text: As for the sacrificial fish population, they have been temporarily and properly settled in Anyu Pond. Previous monitoring results show that it meets the environment they need for nesting.

entries.source_text: 接下来我要回安虞野的游猎家营地驻留一段时间。等你空了，不妨来找我，虽然可能会被我拉去参与书籍整编工作，哈哈哈……
entries.current_text: I'll be staying at the hunter camp in Anyuye for a while. Feel free to look me up when you're free, though I might drag you into helping with book organization, haha...

entries.source_text: 那个时候的博物学家曾有记载，祭鱼儿会在每年开春冰雪消融之时，在河边跳起“祭鱼舞”，感恩春回大地，万物复苏。
entries.current_text: Naturalists of that era recorded that the Fish-Offering people would perform the 'Fish-Offering Dance' by the river every spring when the ice melted, giving thanks for the return of spring and the renewal of all things.

entries.source_text: 对了，重建沼泽地这边的家园的还要一段时间，如果现在想见它们，可以去安虞池看看。
entries.current_text: Oh, right, it will take some time to rebuild the home here in the swamp. If you want to see them now, you can check Anyu Pond.

entries.source_text: 同学你好，我，我是秘禁阁的秘禁使翟吉，有什么事么？
entries.current_text: Hello, student. I... I am Zhai Ji, the Secret Keeper of the Secret Pavilion. Is there something you need?

entries.source_text: 秘禁阁……秘禁阁要被吃掉了！我们要阻止它！它逃跑了！
entries.current_text: The Forbidden Archive... the Forbidden Archive is going to be eaten! We have to stop it! It's running away!

entries.source_text: 它，它就在秘禁阁，阻止它！一定要阻止它！
entries.current_text: It, it's in the Secret Forbidden Pavilion, stop it! You must stop it!

entries.source_text: 刚刚我看到秘禁阁内部空间结构异常变化，还有一些奇怪的笔记，像是……有人被困在秘禁阁出不去。
entries.current_text: I just saw an abnormal change in the internal spatial structure of the Secret Forbidden Pavilion, along with some strange notes, as if... someone is trapped inside and can't get out.

entries.source_text: 刚刚我看到秘禁阁内部空间结构异常变化，还有一些奇怪的笔记，像是……有人被困在秘禁阁出不去。
entries.current_text: I just saw an abnormal change in the internal spatial structure of the Secret Forbidden Pavilion, along with some strange notes, as if... someone is trapped inside and can't get out.

entries.source_text: 从你的描述可以判断，刚刚你去的地方并非是秘禁阁，而是甲乙庚内部生出的幻象。
entries.current_text: Based on your description, the place you just went to was not the Secret Forbidden Pavilion, but an illusion generated within the Jia-Yi-Geng.

entries.source_text: 我也是实在没办法了，秘禁阁内能控制住它的人寥寥无几。
entries.current_text: I really had no other choice. There are very few people in the Secret Forbidden Pavilion who can control it.

entries.source_text: 那可真是太好了，我代表秘禁阁感谢你的鼎力帮助。
entries.current_text: That's wonderful. On behalf of the Secret Forbidden Pavilion, I thank you for your tremendous help.

entries.source_text: 秘禁阁我已经去过了，问问他需要什么信息吧。
entries.current_text: I've already been to the Forbidden Archive. Let's ask him what information he needs.

entries.source_text: 秘禁阁我已经去过了，问问他需要什么信息吧。
entries.current_text: I've already been to the Forbidden Archive. Let's ask him what information he needs.

entries.source_text: 虽然没有理解他说了什么，但似乎与秘禁阁相关，去看看吧。
entries.current_text: I didn't understand what he said, but it seems related to the Secret Forbidden Pavilion. Let's go check it out.

entries.source_text: 虽然没有理解他说了什么，但似乎与秘禁阁相关，去看看吧。
entries.current_text: I didn't understand what he said, but it seems related to the Secret Forbidden Pavilion. Let's go check it out.

entries.source_text: 同学是遇到什么困难了吗？无论怎样都不能放弃生命啊。
entries.current_text: Have you encountered any difficulties, student? No matter what, you shouldn't give up on life.

entries.source_text: 同学是遇到什么困难了吗？无论怎样都不能放弃生命啊。
entries.current_text: Have you encountered any difficulties, student? No matter what, you shouldn't give up on life.

entries.source_text: 说来话长，我们最近有一场表演，但是主演研究火药机关时意外受伤了……
entries.current_text: It's a long story. We have a performance coming up, but the lead actor was accidentally injured while researching gunpowder mechanisms...

entries.source_text: 冢中枯骨，半朽之人，不过是等着生命最后一刻消逝罢了……
entries.current_text: Bones in a grave, a half-decayed person, just waiting for the last moment of life to fade away...

entries.source_text: 老夫既为工巧家，所作所为，自然也都是些地形和谜题机关的设置……
entries.current_text: As a craftsman, everything I do is naturally just setting up terrain and puzzle mechanisms...

entries.source_text: 说来惭愧，稷下山区不少解谜机关，多少都有老夫协助参与的地方。
entries.current_text: I'm ashamed to say, I've assisted in the creation of many of the puzzle mechanisms in the Jixia mountains.

entries.source_text: 年轻人，那些解谜机关你应当见识过不少……体验下来后，可有什么感觉？
entries.current_text: Young one, you must have seen many of those puzzle mechanisms by now... After experiencing them, what are your thoughts?

entries.source_text: 稷下学院和山区附近，为了考验学生素养，我等工巧家经历了许久建设才逐渐有些起色……
entries.current_text: To test the students' skills, we craftsmen spent a long time building in the area around the Academy and the mountains, and it's finally starting to show some progress...

entries.source_text: 现今机关的数量已经足够了么？我一直想着，到底还要坚持多久，才算到尽头……
entries.current_text: Are there enough mechanisms now? I keep wondering how much longer I have to hold on before it all comes to an end...

entries.source_text: 那时我正在研究一套机关工具，想起当年教导我的叔父，这他所提出的设计理念非常相似。
entries.current_text: I was researching a set of mechanism tools at the time, and I remembered the uncle who taught me; this is very similar to the design philosophy he proposed.

entries.source_text: 羽纶丘下面，藏禁林附近……去找找吧。
entries.current_text: Below Yu Lun Hill, near the Forbidden Forest... go take a look.

entries.source_text: 羽纶丘下面，藏禁林附近……去找找吧。
entries.current_text: Below Yu Lun Hill, near the Forbidden Forest... go take a look.

entries.source_text: 观察神奇生物需要隐匿行踪，迅速敏捷，不过是基本操作而已。
entries.current_text: Observing magical creatures requires stealth and agility; it's just basic procedure.

entries.source_text: 靠临现象可能会引发灾厄陨星坠落，因此需观星台应对，以免成灾。
entries.current_text: The proximity phenomenon may cause calamitous meteors to fall, so the Star Observatory must handle it to prevent disaster.

entries.source_text: 李然生告诉你，七宝是自己外出游玩时捡到的，他本以为大家会慢慢接受七宝，大家却一直对七宝抱有偏见。而所谓伤害村民，大概也是七宝看到有人受伤想去帮助，却被误会。因此，李然生再次下定决心一定要找到真凶。
entries.current_text: Li Ransheng tells you that he found Qibao while out wandering. He thought everyone would eventually accept Qibao, but they remained prejudiced. The alleged attacks on villagers were likely misunderstandings when Qibao tried to help someone who was injured. Thus, Li Ransheng is determined to find the real culprit.

entries.source_text: 醒过来了。他说他在山间遭遇了地狼的攻击，幸好七宝及时出现救了他。
entries.current_text: He woke up. He said he was attacked by earth wolves in the mountains, and fortunately, Qibao appeared in time to save him.

entries.source_text: 你通过林森得知曾经的伤者伤得不重，已经醒来，而他也并非七宝所伤，反而是七宝及时出现救了他，才没有继续被地狼攻击。问起李然生，林森说他留下一封信，应该不会回来了。
entries.current_text: Through Lin Sen, you learn that the injured person wasn't hurt badly and has already woken up. It wasn't Qibao who hurt him; rather, Qibao appeared just in time to save him from further attacks by the Ground Wolves. When asked about Li Ransheng, Lin Sen says he left a letter and likely won't be coming back.

entries.source_text: 我知道，刚扫描了，那你纯粹是来分散注意力？在你进秘禁阁那一刻，警报就被触发了。
entries.current_text: I know, I just scanned it. So you're just here to distract me? The alarm was triggered the moment you entered the Secret Pavilion.

entries.source_text: 刚才你自称本阁主？所以秘禁阁主是一台巡逻机？
entries.current_text: You just referred to yourself as 'this Pavilion Master'? So, the Secret Forbidden Pavilion Master is a patrol drone?

entries.source_text: 刚才你自称本阁主？所以秘禁阁主是一台巡逻机？
entries.current_text: You just referred to yourself as 'this Pavilion Master'? So, the Secret Forbidden Pavilion Master is a patrol drone?

entries.source_text: 哎，头疼，状况都搞不清楚的家伙，本阁主是借着机关和你说话啊。
entries.current_text: Sigh, what a headache. You don't even understand the situation—I'm using this mechanism to speak with you.

entries.source_text: 算是最早那一批出问题的机关核吧，有很强大的力量，但不稳定，所以封在这里。
entries.current_text: It's one of the earliest batches of faulty mechanical cores. It has great power, but it's unstable, so it's sealed here.

entries.source_text: 稍等我检查一下秘禁阁的存货……嗯，绝密区还一切正常……书籍也是……
entries.current_text: Wait a moment while I check the Forbidden Archive's inventory... Hmm, the top-secret area is normal... The books are too...

entries.source_text: 反之，我可要求把你从学院开除，秘禁阁阁主拥有一票决定权哦，考虑一下吧？
entries.current_text: Otherwise, I can demand your expulsion from the academy. The Master of the Secret Pavilion has the power of a deciding vote, you know. Think about it?

entries.source_text: 阁主借着机关告诉你，甲甲子刚才被人偷走了，经过调查发现是几个破门生所为。为了自证清白，你只能亲自去把东西找回来。
entries.current_text: The Pavilion Master uses a mechanism to tell you that the Jiajiazi was stolen just now, and investigation reveals it was the work of some rogue students. To prove your innocence, you must retrieve it yourself.

entries.source_text: 只要触摸控制器中间的装置，就能关闭整个秘禁阁的防御系统一分钟。
entries.current_text: Just touch the device in the center of the controller to disable the entire Secret Pavilion's defense system for one minute.

entries.source_text: 对不起，要不是我太大意，你也不会被那机关巡枢打伤了……
entries.current_text: I'm sorry, if I hadn't been so careless, you wouldn't have been hurt by that mechanism patrol...

entries.source_text: 机关守卫？你们是要进入秘禁阁？
entries.current_text: Mechcraft Guards? Are you trying to enter the Forbidden Pavilion?

entries.source_text: 机关守卫？你们是要进入秘禁阁？
entries.current_text: Mechcraft Guards? Are you trying to enter the Forbidden Pavilion?

entries.source_text: 几日前我们收到线报，秘禁阁阁主在进行危险的秘密实验。
entries.current_text: A few days ago, we received intelligence that the Master of the Secret Forbidden Pavilion was conducting dangerous, secret experiments.

entries.source_text: 控制器就在秘禁阁底层的图书馆附近，一扇<001>蓝色旋钮标识</>的门内。
entries.current_text: The controller is near the library on the bottom floor of the Secret Forbidden Pavilion, inside a door with a <001>blue knob</>.

entries.source_text: 信号在接近山顶的位置，没想到这几只“小迷离兔”跑得这么快。
entries.current_text: The signal is near the top of the mountain. I didn't expect these "Little Lost Rabbits" to run so fast.

entries.source_text: 半年为期，不得出秘禁阁半步。但可以自行前往非绝密区的任何一处活动。
entries.current_text: You are restricted to the Secret Forbidden Pavilion for half a year. However, you may visit any area outside the top-secret zones.

entries.source_text: 阁主的意思莫非是我们可以在秘禁阁内进行研究？
entries.current_text: Does the Pavilion Master mean we can conduct research inside the Secret Forbidden Pavilion?

entries.source_text: 至于新同学嘛，这次一笔勾销。但你两次三番入我秘禁阁，这笔账我还是记下了。
entries.current_text: As for the new student, we'll call it even this time. But you've broken into my Secret Pavilion time and again, and I'm still keeping track of that.

entries.source_text: 秘禁阁中这么多威力巨大的藏品，谁知道你有没有拿来做实验。
entries.current_text: With so many powerful artifacts in the Forbidden Archive, who knows if you've been using them for experiments.

entries.source_text: 多谢相助，机关人在改装中暴走了，应该是回路链接上的问题。
entries.current_text: Thanks for the help. The automaton went berserk during the modification; it must be a circuit connection issue.

entries.source_text: 机关人暴走的原因是因为甲甲子吧？
entries.current_text: Is Jiajiazi the reason the mech-boy went berserk?

entries.source_text: 机关人暴走的原因是因为甲甲子吧？
entries.current_text: Is Jiajiazi the reason the mech-boy went berserk?

entries.source_text: 如果我们想要精进自己的机关造诣，又无法查阅学院资料、取得机关核，应该怎么做？
entries.current_text: If we want to improve our mastery of mechanisms but cannot access academy materials or obtain mechanism cores, what should we do?

entries.source_text: 秘禁阁的技术和知识是整体高于学院的，要想要做出超越学院的东西，那里才是宝库。
entries.current_text: The technology and knowledge in the Forbidden Archive are generally superior to the Academy's. If you want to create something that surpasses the Academy, that place is a treasure trove.

entries.source_text: 这里有机关碎片，会是甲甲子的吗？
entries.current_text: There are mechanism fragments here. Could they belong to Jiajiazi?

entries.source_text: 这里有机关碎片，会是甲甲子的吗？
entries.current_text: There are mechanism fragments here. Could they belong to Jiajiazi?

entries.source_text: 我从未抵达到这一步，魔道学院可以御风，武道就得借力了。
entries.current_text: I have never reached this stage. The School of Magic can ride the wind, but the School of Martial Arts must rely on external force.

entries.source_text: 机关的话……机关翼应该能行。
entries.current_text: As for mechanisms... the Mechanical Wings should work.

entries.source_text: 最后一个试炼是悬空置物，似乎是说要把那个蛋放到悬空的法阵机关上？
entries.current_text: The final trial is about suspending an object. Does it mean I have to put that egg on the floating mechanical array?

entries.source_text: 最后一个试炼内容是将蛋放置在悬空的机关法阵上，金石武正在思索升空的办法，而你表示自己可以用钩锁做到。
entries.current_text: The final trial involves placing an egg on a floating mechanical array. Jin Shi-Wu is pondering how to make it rise, while you suggest you can do it with a grappling hook.

entries.source_text: 有个机关人，这也是考验的一环吗？
entries.current_text: There's a puppet? Is this also part of the test?

entries.source_text: 有个机关人，这也是考验的一环吗？
entries.current_text: There's a puppet? Is this also part of the test?

entries.source_text: 不久前我找到了一张老旧的设计图纸，是一个联动射击模组的机关核心。
entries.current_text: Not long ago, I found an old design blueprint. It's a mechanical core for a linked shooting module.

entries.source_text: 话说回来这个控制膛压的机关核心还是阁主和林馥前辈一起设计的。
entries.current_text: Speaking of which, the mechanism core that controls the chamber pressure was designed by the Pavilion Master and Senior Lin Fu together.

entries.source_text: 据说她们当年被誉为墨焰阁百年难遇的两大天才来着。
entries.current_text: It is said that they were once hailed as the two greatest geniuses of the Ink Flame Pavilion in a century.

entries.source_text: 客气什么，墨焰阁的大家都很热情，我也受了他们不少帮助。
entries.current_text: Don't mention it. Everyone at the Ink Flame Pavilion is very enthusiastic, and I've received a lot of help from them too.

entries.source_text: 你向御炙询问有什么材料可以增强爆炎弹的爆炸效果，她建议你尝试绯花晶。谈话间她提及，墨炎很像以前的老阁主。
entries.current_text: You ask Yuzhi what materials can enhance the explosive effect of the flame bombs, and she suggests you try Scarlet Flower Crystal. During the conversation, she mentions that Moyan is very much like the old Pavilion Master.

entries.source_text: 那你是又有什么想要的机关零件了？
entries.current_text: Are you looking for more mechanical parts again?

entries.source_text: 阳逸，麻烦你去趟机关学院，把之前订制的几套平衡机取回来。
entries.current_text: Yang Yi, please go to the Institute of Mechanics and retrieve the sets of balancers ordered earlier.

entries.source_text: 我叫朝希，是此处墨焰阁之主墨炎的弟子。
entries.current_text: My name is Zhao Xi, and I am a disciple of Mo Yan, the master of the Ink Flame Pavilion here.

entries.source_text: 辛苦同学你去收集一些吧，墨焰阁<001>附近的山谷</>里就有。
entries.current_text: Could you please go collect some? You can find it in the <001>valley near</> Moyan Pavilion.

entries.source_text: 辛苦同学你去收集一些<001>鹿青草</>吧，墨焰阁<001>附近的山谷</>里就有。
entries.current_text: Could you please go collect some <001>Deer-Green Grass</>? You can find it in the <001>valley near</> Moyan Pavilion.

entries.source_text: 不过你为什么要挑战这个机关阵？莫非……你也参加了这次考试？
entries.current_text: But why are you challenging this mechanism array? Could it be... that you're taking the exam too?

entries.source_text: 除了现有的备用零件，就只能从附近悬崖上的巡狩枢上获取了。
entries.current_text: Aside from the spare parts we have, the only way is to get them from the patrol hubs on the nearby cliffs.

entries.source_text: 我得事先提醒你，这些造物的攻击性可不小，你可得小心。
entries.current_text: I must warn you beforehand: these constructs are quite aggressive, so be careful.

entries.source_text: 慕思鸢得知你是来寻找备用零件，告诉你可以从附近悬崖的巡狩枢上获取。
entries.current_text: Mu Siyuan learns you are looking for spare parts and tells you that you can get them from the hunting hub on the nearby cliff.

entries.source_text: 关于机关阵……
entries.current_text: About the Mechanical Array...

entries.source_text: 看那方向，是去了机关阵附近。我还要做监察工作，抽不开身，就麻烦你啦。
entries.current_text: Looking at that direction, they went near the mechanism array. I still have inspection work to do and can't get away, so I'll leave it to you.

entries.source_text: 管理员告诉你，这是一三五的裁云模组，它自己恢复了运作还带着另一个废品去了机关阵附近。
entries.current_text: The admin tells you this is a 135-series Cloud-Cutting Module. It restored itself and took another piece of junk near the mechanical array.

entries.source_text: 这个嘛，听说奇门水榭仓库里存放了一些老古董，或许仓库管理员会知道……
entries.current_text: Well, I heard the Qimen Water Pavilion warehouse stores some antiques. Maybe the warehouse manager would know...

entries.source_text: 附近的机关造物……说的就是它们了吧，看来得清理掉他们才能拿到所需零件。
entries.current_text: Nearby mechanical constructs... so that's what they are. Looks like I'll have to clear them out to get the parts I need.

entries.source_text: 附近的机关造物……说的就是它们了吧，看来得清理掉他们才能拿到所需零件。
entries.current_text: Nearby mechanical constructs... so that's what they are. Looks like I'll have to clear them out to get the parts I need.

entries.source_text: 已检索到备用零件的词条，关联地点为东部机关阵。
entries.current_text: Spare parts entry retrieved. Associated location: Eastern Mechanism Array.

entries.source_text: 请同学前往东部机关阵，寻回左右肩部各需的零件。
entries.current_text: Students, please head to the eastern mechanism array and retrieve the parts needed for the left and right shoulders.

entries.source_text: 实验体一三五告诉你它要继续执行验证冲云翼原型机的任务，拜托你前往东部机关阵，寻找左右肩部需要的零件。
entries.current_text: Subject 135 tells you it needs to continue the mission of verifying the Cloud-Piercing Wing prototype. Please head to the Eastern Mechanism Array to find the parts needed for the left and right shoulders.

entries.source_text: 这里就是一三五提到的机关阵了。
entries.current_text: This is the mechanism array that Yisansan mentioned.

entries.source_text: 这里就是一三五提到的机关阵了。
entries.current_text: This is the mechanism array that Yisansan mentioned.

entries.source_text: 他支使大眼枭到处发消息，宣称在指定位置放下作业和环金，隔天就可以到同一位置取货。
entries.current_text: He sent the Great-Eyed Owls everywhere to spread the word, claiming that if you left your homework and gold rings at a designated spot, you could pick up your goods the next day.

entries.source_text: 求你了，我不会让你白出力的。我的生活费如果能讨回来，我把环金分你一半；讨不回来，我也给你当牛做马，任你差使一个月！
entries.current_text: Please, I won't let your efforts go to waste. If I can get my living expenses back, I'll give you half the gold rings; if I can't, I'll be your servant for a month!

entries.source_text: 恩人啊！那可恨的骗子最近都在潭影营地东北边的山崖处交易，让可怜的学子们在<001>夜间十九时</>前准备好环金和作业。
entries.current_text: Benefactor! That hateful swindler has been trading at the cliff northeast of the Tanying Camp recently, making the poor students prepare Ringild and homework before <001>19:00 at night</>.

entries.source_text: 哎呀，事后少不了重谢的！到时候我带上学纪司的人在<001>潭影营地</>路口等你，你要是抓到骗子了我们就去找你。恩人加油！
entries.current_text: Oh, there will be a generous reward afterwards! I'll wait for you at the entrance of <001>Tanying Camp</> with the Academic Affairs people. If you catch the swindler, we'll come find you. Good luck, benefactor!

entries.source_text: 现在万事具备，出发前往潭影营地东北边的山崖吧。
entries.current_text: Everything is ready. Let's head to the cliff northeast of the Tanying Camp.

entries.source_text: 现在万事具备，出发前往潭影营地东北边的山崖吧。
entries.current_text: Everything is ready. Let's head to the cliff northeast of the Tanying Camp.

entries.source_text: 来晚了，骗子跑了，环金也带走了吗？
entries.current_text: Too late, the swindler ran away, and did they take the gold ring too?

entries.source_text: 来晚了，骗子跑了，环金也带走了吗？
entries.current_text: Too late, the swindler ran away, and did they take the gold ring too?

entries.source_text: 环金和空白作业已经放好了，接下来只有等待。
entries.current_text: The gold ring and blank assignments are ready. Now, we just wait.

entries.source_text: 环金和空白作业已经放好了，接下来只有等待。
entries.current_text: The gold ring and blank assignments are ready. Now, we just wait.

entries.source_text: 咱只是给他们上反诈课而已！顺便收点环金当学费。
entries.current_text: We're just teaching them a lesson on anti-fraud! And collecting a bit of gold as tuition.

entries.source_text: 但你要把环金还给同学们，并且保证以后不再犯。
entries.current_text: But you must return the gold ring to your classmates and promise not to do it again.

entries.source_text: 但你要把环金还给同学们，并且保证以后不再犯。
entries.current_text: But you must return the gold ring to your classmates and promise not to do it again.

entries.source_text: 恩人，地点就在潭影营地东北边山崖处，拜托了！
entries.current_text: Benefactor, the location is at the cliff northeast of Tanying Camp, please!

entries.source_text: 等待动物成长的过程中，也别忘了去<001>升级一下动物摊</>！跟蔬菜摊一样，等级越高摊位卖掉小动物产出的东西获取的百工币就越多。
entries.current_text: While waiting for the animals to grow, don't forget to go to <001>upgrade the Animal Stall</>! Just like the vegetable stall, the higher the level, the more Gong Coins you'll get from selling the animals' produce.

entries.source_text: 让我们来<001>养锦狐</>吧，它不仅可爱，产品收益也更高一点。
entries.current_text: Let's <001>raise a Brocade Fox</>. It's not only cute, but the product yield is also higher.

entries.source_text: 来养一只锦狐吧，它可是赚取百工币的好帮手！
entries.current_text: Raise a Brocade Fox! It's a great helper for earning Artisan Coins!

entries.source_text: 有了收获，就可以去<001>动物铺卖掉了</>，这也是一个赚取百工币的方式哦。
entries.current_text: Once you have your harvest, you can go to the <001>Animal Shop to sell it</>. This is also a way to earn Craftsman Coins.

entries.source_text: 看到西施了！
entries.current_text: I see Shi!

entries.source_text: 看到西施了！
entries.current_text: I see Shi!

entries.source_text: 这里是大姐的点心铺，我来这里打杂的，至于西施……
entries.current_text: This is Big Sister's snack shop, I'm here to do odd jobs. As for Xishi...

entries.source_text: 我相信西施不会骗我们的，反正……也就是改一下家具布局，即便失败了也没什么损失。你说对吧，同学？
entries.current_text: I believe Shi doesn't lie to us. Anyway... it's just changing the furniture layout, even if it fails, there's no loss. Don't you agree, classmate?

entries.source_text: 嗯……虽然我也觉得不可思议，但我相信西施能做到。
entries.current_text: Hmm... Even though I find it hard to believe, I trust that Shi Yi can do it.

entries.source_text: 嗯……虽然我也觉得不可思议，但我相信西施能做到。
entries.current_text: Hmm... Even though I find it hard to believe, I trust that Shi Yi can do it.

entries.source_text: 真是多亏有西施同学啊，这些点心送你们当谢礼，如果还有什么风水建议，随时欢迎指教！
entries.current_text: We really owe it to Xishi. Please take these snacks as a token of our gratitude. If you have any more feng shui advice, you're always welcome to share it!

entries.source_text: 唉？虎头！怎么是你？
entries.current_text: Huh? Hutou! Why are you here?

entries.source_text: 那不是虎头吗？他在……铲石头？
entries.current_text: Isn't that Hutou? Is he... shoveling stones?

entries.source_text: 那不是虎头吗？他在……铲石头？
entries.current_text: Isn't that Hutou? Is he... shoveling stones?

entries.source_text: 虎头，你怎么在这？
entries.current_text: Hutou, why are you here?

entries.source_text: 虎头，你怎么在这？
entries.current_text: Hutou, why are you here?

entries.source_text: 虎头，你怎么在这？
entries.current_text: Hutou, why are you here?

entries.source_text: 虎头哥，居然是你？
entries.current_text: Brother Hutou, it's actually you?

entries.source_text: 虎头哥一直这样……总想着照顾身边每一个人，不让他帮忙还会生气。
entries.current_text: Brother Hutou is always like this... always wanting to take care of everyone around him. He gets angry if you don't let him help.

entries.source_text: 虎头哥！你怎么了！
entries.current_text: Brother Hutou! What happened to you!

entries.source_text: 所以我们应该彼此“劳烦”呀，虎头哥。
entries.current_text: So we should 'trouble' each other, Brother Hutou.

entries.source_text: 虎头哥还是那么干劲十足啊。
entries.current_text: Brother Hutou is still as full of energy as ever.

entries.source_text: 制作配方在这，等虎头把塑织机搬来，能辛苦你……
entries.current_text: The recipe is here. Once Hutou brings the weaving machine, could you please...

entries.source_text: 嗯……工巧家一般研究机关造物，最基础的便是制作各种投掷物。
entries.current_text: Hmm... the Gongqiao family usually researches mechanical creations, and the most basic of these is making various projectiles.

entries.source_text: 咳，这点小伤算啥，比在南荒那会儿轻松多了！
entries.current_text: Cough, what's a little scratch like this? It's way easier than back in the Southern Wilds!

entries.source_text: 还好意思提，当时在南荒你怎么教我的，都忘啦？
entries.current_text: You still have the nerve to bring that up? How did you teach me back in the Southern Wilderness? Have you forgotten?

entries.source_text: 来得正好！同学你看，这些小动物在机关上越飞越高，都快看不见影子了。
entries.current_text: You've come at the right time! Look, student, these little animals are flying higher and higher on the mechanism, their shadows are almost invisible.

entries.source_text: 就算是高处观光的实验设施，但万一机关出故障，从高的地方摔下来……
entries.current_text: Even if it's an observation facility at a high altitude, if the mechanism malfunctions and you fall from up there...

entries.source_text: 抱歉，让大家担心了，这是我和班叔一起制作的宠物派遣机关。
entries.current_text: Sorry to keep everyone waiting. This is the pet dispatch mechanism that Uncle Ban and I built together.

entries.source_text: 之前，我和班叔反复验证过机关的各项性能，从目前的数据来看，至少安全性和稳定性是可以保证的……
entries.current_text: Previously, Uncle Ban and I repeatedly verified the performance of the mechanism. Based on the current data, at least the safety and stability can be guaranteed...

entries.source_text: 唔，它胆子有点小，大概有些应激。看来机关的自适应模块还需要加强，尤其是舒缓情绪这方面……
entries.current_text: Hmm, it's a bit timid, probably a bit stressed. It seems the mechanism's adaptive module needs improvement, especially regarding emotional soothing...

entries.source_text: 嗯！要不趁现在，换个新地方摆上派遣机关，再运行一次吧……
entries.current_text: Hmm! Why don't we take this chance to set up the dispatch mechanism in a new spot and run it again...

entries.source_text: 这些小动物曾经在外流浪，不过现在学舍是它们的新家，而派遣机关也会看护照料它们。
entries.current_text: These little animals used to be strays, but the dormitory is their new home now, and the Dispatch Automatons will look after them.

entries.source_text: 等小动物们想出门玩的时候，派遣机关就会定制专属路线，护送它们去最想去的地方。
entries.current_text: When the little animals want to go out, the mechanism will set a custom route to escort them to wherever they want to go most.

entries.source_text: 摆放机关前.
entries.current_text: Before placing the mechanism.

entries.source_text: 别客气，照顾它们我也很开心。而且改进机关，积累数据，也是为了完成班叔的心愿。
entries.current_text: Don't mention it, I'm happy to look after them. Besides, improving the mechanisms and gathering data is all to fulfill Master Ban's wish.

entries.source_text: 其实……这台派遣机关，是过去班叔为了寻找七号而设计的。
entries.current_text: Actually... this dispatch mechanism was designed by Uncle Ban in the past to find Number Seven.

entries.source_text: 因为初代机关的很多功能还需要完善，就先被搁置了。
entries.current_text: Because many functions of the first-generation mechanism needed refinement, it was shelved for now.

entries.source_text: 不过，经过这次改进之后，希望它能陪伴新的伙伴们在属于自己的乐园玩耍，守护它们安心回家。
entries.current_text: However, after this improvement, I hope it can accompany new friends as they play in their own paradise and keep them safe on their way home.

entries.source_text: 派遣机关就交给你了。如果使用起来不顺手，或者有其它想添加的功能模组，都可以跟我说……
entries.current_text: I'll leave the dispatch mechanism to you. If it's not working smoothly, or if there are other functional modules you'd like to add, just let me know...

entries.source_text: 顺便，感觉我有个朋友的宠物也会想体验一下机关派遣……以后我多来串门几次，应该可以吧？
entries.current_text: By the way, I feel like a friend's pet would also want to experience mechanism dispatch... I'll come visit more often, that should be okay, right?

entries.source_text: 难道那个机关被落石压住了？
entries.current_text: Could that mechanism be pinned down by falling rocks?

entries.source_text: 不过以你的身手，如果想要挑战诸葛亮留下的试炼，区区几个机关人不足挂齿啦。
entries.current_text: Given your abilities, you should have no trouble handling a few Mechanoids before challenging Kongming's trail.

entries.source_text: 哈哈，不愧是稷下的学生。不过，你觉得这个游戏对小朋友来说，怎么样？
entries.current_text: Haha, I'm impressed. So, what do you think of this game for kids?

entries.source_text: 这次飞车活动规模不小，观星群山和彩云盆地都设有点位！
entries.current_text: The scale of this flying car event is quite large; there are checkpoints in both the Star-Gazing Mountains and the Colorful Cloud Basin!

entries.source_text: 听说奇门水榭和彩云盆地这次也有飞车比赛活动！
entries.current_text: I heard there's a speeder race event in Qimen Water Pavilion and Caiyun Basin this time too!

entries.source_text: 帮踩机关。
entries.current_text: Pressure plate.

entries.source_text: 这个山洞底部有一些试炼机关人，我经常以它们为对手，磨练自己的战斗技巧。
entries.current_text: There are some trial Mechanoids at the bottom of the cave. I often use them to practice my combat skills.

entries.source_text: 年轻人，好身手，刚才你在底部与试炼机关人的战斗我都看到了。
entries.current_text: Young man, impressive skills. I watched your battle with the Trial Mechanoid below.

entries.source_text: 好精彩的战斗，这可是师傅平时修炼的机关人。
entries.current_text: What a fight! You defeated all those Mechanoids alone!

entries.source_text: 放肆！你是何人？竟敢破坏这里的试炼机关人！
entries.current_text: Hey, who are you!? How dare you sabotage the Mechanoids like that!?

entries.source_text: 这个机关确实难开……要不，再用斧子试试？
entries.current_text: This device is tough to crack... How about we try an axe instead?

entries.source_text: 那上次看到地狼你为什么跑了？
entries.current_text: Then why did you run the last time you saw one?

entries.source_text: 这些蘑菇长得也太千奇百怪了吧？不过说不定是因为稷下云根的影响……
entries.current_text: These mushrooms look so weird! Could they be affected by Aerux...?

entries.source_text: 云舟，去云舟栈吧！起码坐云舟，刚刚说的这些地方都可以看到。
entries.current_text: Take the Aership! It'll give you a view of all the places I mentioned.

entries.source_text: 学姐说，这边的试炼比赤隼馆简单多了！枫羽非常严格！
entries.current_text: She said these trials are much easier than those at the Red Falcon Training Hall. Feng Yu is very strict!

entries.source_text: 那巨炮，或许也能发射机关人？
entries.current_text: Could that cannon launch Mechanoids too?

entries.source_text: 看了半天，这书上都没有青眠兽的进食记录……难道它们不吃东西吗？
entries.current_text: I've been reading for ages, and there's no record of the Azure Slumberstone Beast eating... Do they not eat at all?

entries.source_text: 能观察到青眠兽的进食情况，今年的游猎家报告就有东西写了！
entries.current_text: I can already picture this year's Hunting Society report: "Observations of the Slumberstone Beast's Feeding Habits."

entries.source_text: 嘘，我正在观察那边的机关人呢。
entries.current_text: Shh, I'm observing the Mechanoid over there.

entries.source_text: 看在眼里，疼在心里啊！我们往西走吧，碧苔丘那边风景多好啊！
entries.current_text: It hurts to see the things you love get destroyed. Let's head to Emerald Knoll instead, a place with gorgeous views!

entries.source_text: 不、不用担心！我只是……今天的机关课又没听明白，小组作业也找不到人一起……
entries.current_text: No, no need to worry! It's just... I didn't understand the mechanics class today, and I couldn't find anyone for the group project...

entries.source_text: 这是依据周瑜学长的火系魔道原理设计的，其他机关我不拿手，只对火器还算了解……
entries.current_text: This was designed based on Senior Zhou Yu's fire-based sorcery principles. I'm not good with other mechs, but I know a thing or two about firearms...

entries.source_text: 哇真的吗，你是怎么拿到的……等等，这里面的机关核是激活状态，当心！
entries.current_text: Wow, really? How did you get that... Wait, the mechanism core inside is active. Careful!

entries.source_text: 好徒弟，这是本小姐给你定制的机关大炮，来！点火吧！
entries.current_text: Good apprentice, this is a custom-made mechanical cannon I made for you. Come on! Light it up!

entries.source_text: 不管哪一处，乍看之下都有喜人的景色，细细琢磨更是蕴含着绝妙的趣味。
entries.current_text: Every place is full of delight. If you look closely, it reveals great beauty.

entries.source_text: 这里是通天塔一层礼堂，学事委办公处在二层哦。
entries.current_text: This is the main hall. The Student Affairs Committee is on the second floor.

entries.source_text: 奇怪……云蚕间怎么封起来了了……
entries.current_text: Strange... why is the Cloud Cocoon room sealed off...

entries.source_text: 巍巍学府，作育英才，这就是稷下学院的建校史。
entries.current_text: This is the story of our academy's founding—a place dedicated to fostering exceptional talents.

entries.source_text: 本来看到莲花就会难以自抑地想起西施学姐……更何况这下……
entries.current_text: Seeing lotus flowers always makes me think of Senior Xishi uncontrollably... especially now...

entries.source_text: 是呀，西施学姐也再没露面过……实在是让人担心她的安危……
entries.current_text: Yes, Senior Xishi hasn't appeared since... It's truly worrying for her safety...

entries.source_text: 嗯……魔道学院的这些仪器也得想想办法……
entries.current_text: Hmm... I need to figure out something for these instruments at the Magic Academy as well...

entries.source_text: 唉，这赏莲也只让人了无趣味……
entries.current_text: Sigh, even this lotus viewing has become so dull...

entries.source_text: 我日夜苦思冥想，却仍感觉真相潜藏在迷雾之后……
entries.current_text: I've been thinking about it day and night, but I still feel the truth is hidden behind the mist...

entries.source_text: 钟无艳学姐天资聪慧，战力极强，一手大锤使得出神入化，一时风头无两。
entries.current_text: She is talented and powerful, wielding a giant hammer. A true legend.

entries.source_text: 关于钟无艳的传说。
entries.current_text: About her legends.

entries.source_text: 这可就说来话长了，钟无艳学姐的威名可是在武道学院都传遍了。
entries.current_text: That's a long story. Senior Zhong Wuyan's fame has spread throughout the Martial Arts Academy.

entries.source_text: 她当时可是绝对的大姐头，打遍整个学院无敌手，甚至打败过凌虎师父。
entries.current_text: Back then, she already showed strong leadership and even defeated Master Ling Hu.

entries.source_text: 你说的是虎啸堂的堂主凌虎吗？天呐钟无艳学姐也太厉害了吧！
entries.current_text: Head of Roaring Tiger Training Hall? Incredible!

entries.source_text: 武道学院注重训练体魄，机关学院注重实践塑造，魔道学院注重参悟规律。
entries.current_text: Each focuses on a different area—physical training for Martial Arts, practical inventions for Mechcrafts, and perception of rules for Sorcery.

entries.source_text: 唉，每当看到长安制的机关人，就会激起我的思乡之情。
entries.current_text: Sigh, whenever I see a mechanism puppet made in Chang'an, it stirs up my homesickness.

entries.source_text: 了解了！不过姐姐，你真的是机关人吗？看上去好像真人啊。
entries.current_text: Thanks! I'm curious, are you really a Mechanoid? You look so human.

entries.source_text: 结果因为星之队和圭蝶队的比赛，不小心把那东西引爆了。
entries.current_text: It ended up exploding because of the match between the Star Team and the Gui Die Team.

entries.source_text: 行，对了，要是见到西施学姐，替我打声招呼。
entries.current_text: Alright. By the way, if you see Senior Shi, say hello for me.

entries.source_text: 唉，本来还期待着能看到鲁班大师的新机关呢……
entries.current_text: Sigh, I was really looking forward to seeing Master Luban's new mechanisms...

entries.source_text: 怪了，我印象中通天塔外环不是这个形状啊……
entries.current_text: Strange, I don't remember the outer ring of the Tongtian Tower being this shape...

entries.source_text: 都怪那群机关学院的，天天检查，这么大的隐患都没发现？
entries.current_text: It's all the fault of those people from the Institute of Mechanics. They inspect everything every day, how did they miss such a huge hazard?

entries.source_text: 如果有进展，我们凌云卫一定会通知大家的。
entries.current_text: If there is any progress, we of the Lingyun Guard will certainly notify everyone.

entries.source_text: 在事件当时受伤的，就是圭蝶队和星之队的成员了……
entries.current_text: The ones who were injured during the incident were members of the Guidie Team and the Star Team...

entries.source_text: 啧，盖燎菇的菌伞就算磨成粉还是很难入口啊！
entries.current_text: Tsk... Burnhead Mushrooms taste terrible, even as powder!

entries.source_text: 但也不全是，你看这处零件，它被更改成了可以控制攀云塔机关变化的模组。
entries.current_text: It may look like it's part of the Cloudreach Tower, but it actually controls all the obstacles there.

entries.source_text: 真是打出了我们武道学院的风采！
entries.current_text: That really showed the spirit of our Martial Arts Academy!

entries.source_text: 听说圭蝶队针对星之队做了许多特殊对策，星之队要想卫冕难度可不低。
entries.current_text: I heard the Guidie Team has prepared many special countermeasures against the Star Team. It won't be easy for the Star Team to defend their title.

entries.source_text: 圭蝶队这运气也太差了……
entries.current_text: Team Gui Die's luck is just too bad...

entries.source_text: 看看圭蝶队能不能克服强敌吧。
entries.current_text: Let's see if the Guidie team can overcome their strong opponents.

entries.source_text: 圭蝶破茧，以梦为翼，所向披靡！
entries.current_text: Gui Die breaks from her cocoon, using dreams as wings, unstoppable!

entries.source_text: 圭蝶振翅，全力以赴，不负热爱！
entries.current_text: Gui Die flaps her wings, giving it her all, living up to her passion!

entries.source_text: 圭蝶展翅，光芒万丈，无人能敌！
entries.current_text: Gui Die spreads her wings, shining with immense light, invincible!

entries.source_text: 圭蝶出征，蝶丝相伴，一路登顶！
entries.current_text: Gui Die sets out, accompanied by butterfly silk, all the way to the top!

entries.source_text: 圭蝶逐光，心之所向，必达巅峰！
entries.current_text: Gui Die chases the light, following her heart, destined for the peak!

entries.source_text: 我得再去一趟赛事支持区看看还有什么没见过的机关。
entries.current_text: I need to go back to the competition support area and see if there are any mechanisms I haven't seen yet.

entries.source_text: 玲珑阙是什么地方？
entries.current_text: What is the Linglong Palace?

entries.source_text: 这里是玲珑峡谷赛事的入口，是每一支参赛队伍的起点。
entries.current_text: This is the entrance to the Linglong Canyon competition, the starting point for every participating team.

entries.source_text: 同学，你对机关了解如何？要不，你看看？
entries.current_text: Classmate, how much do you know about mechanisms? Why don't you take a look?

entries.source_text: 留心观察棱镜的形状，引导魔道飞弹透过棱镜，攻击玲珑核心即可通过此项试炼。
entries.current_text: Observe the shape of the prism carefully. Guide the magic missile through the prism to strike the Linglong Core to pass this trial.

entries.source_text: 玲珑峡谷的挑战正等着你呢！
entries.current_text: The challenge of the Linglong Canyon is waiting for you!

entries.source_text: 玲珑峡谷中日常的试炼可比你们在比赛中遇到的凶险多了。
entries.current_text: The daily trials in the Linglong Canyon are far more dangerous than anything you've encountered in the tournament.

entries.source_text: 总而言之，不经过我们演梦机动队的培训，贸然进入玲珑峡谷参与试炼，可是要栽跟头的！
entries.current_text: In short, without training from our Dream-Acting Task Force, rushing into Linglong Canyon to participate in the trial will only lead to trouble!

entries.source_text: 只要攻击偏转仪把它转到合适的方向，让魔道力量随着轨道运动就好了！
entries.current_text: Just use the deflector to turn it to the right angle, and the magic power will flow along the track!

entries.source_text: 三种机关的基本原理，想必你已了然于心！
entries.current_text: I trust you have mastered the basic principles of the three mechanisms!

entries.source_text: 三生万物，万物归一。这也正是机关之道的基础理念。
entries.current_text: Three gives birth to all things, and all things return to one. This is the fundamental philosophy of the Way of Mechanism.

entries.source_text: 嗯！在哪里调整机关、怎样控制机关方向我都记下来了。
entries.current_text: Hmm! I've noted down where to adjust the mechanisms and how to control their direction.

entries.source_text: 这是被蔚蓝神兽的冰晶冻住了吗……
entries.current_text: Is it frozen by Princess Frost?

entries.source_text: 这个机关应援餐看起来也很好吃……
entries.current_text: This Mech-support meal looks delicious too...

entries.source_text: 上个月有人试图把它改造成“魔道爆炸机关”……结果被自己储存的能量炸飞了三米半。
entries.current_text: Last month, someone tried to modify it into a 'Magic-Dao Explosive Mechanism'... They ended up getting blown three and a half meters away by the energy stored inside.

entries.source_text: 很好。记住，在机关术领域，最危险的从来不是繁复的机关，而是愚蠢的创意。
entries.current_text: Good. Remember, in the field of mechanics, the most dangerous thing is never a complex mechanism, but a stupid idea.

entries.source_text: 看这流畅的转向轨道！这才是真正的机关艺术！
entries.current_text: Look at this smooth steering track! This is true mechanical art!

entries.source_text: 不过效果绝对物超所值！它们能让飞弹像迷鼻鼠一样精准而快速的找到目标！
entries.current_text: But the effect is definitely worth it! They allow missiles to find their targets as accurately and quickly as a Maze-Nose Mouse!

entries.source_text: 去吧去吧！记得要是有人问起来，一定要说这是全峡谷最好用的机关！
entries.current_text: Go on, go on! Remember, if anyone asks, be sure to say this is the best mechanism in the entire Canyon!

entries.source_text: 圭蝶队和星之队……真是咬紧了差距。
entries.current_text: Team Gui Die and Team Star... the gap is really tight.

entries.source_text: 唔，都跟春溪原的布色茹一样——俯拾皆是。
entries.current_text: Hmm, they're just like the Buse-ru in Chunxi Plain—everywhere you look.

entries.source_text: 嗯……确实奇怪，我记得以前有人目睹她和夫子去了<001>荣耀塔</>，也不知发生了什么。
entries.current_text: Hmm... It is strange indeed. I remember someone once saw her and the Master go to the <001>Tower of Glory</>, but I don't know what happened.

entries.source_text: 你们太瞻前顾后了，玲珑阙这边的荣耀之证我们不是早就拿到了吗！
entries.current_text: You're too hesitant! Didn't we already get the Proof of Honor from Linglong Palace a long time ago!

entries.source_text: 我们小队当时有人来玲珑阙看比赛吗，听说转播到一些画面呢？
entries.current_text: Did anyone from our squad come to Linglong Tower to watch the match? I heard some footage was broadcast?

entries.source_text: 也不知道花了多少环金才修好……
entries.current_text: I wonder how much gold it cost to fix it...

entries.source_text: 玲珑峡谷到底发生什么了？怎么这么扑朔迷离的……
entries.current_text: What exactly happened in the Linglong Canyon? It's all so mysterious...

entries.source_text: 也有可能是圭蝶队准备的秘密魔道术！
entries.current_text: Or maybe it's a secret magic technique prepared by the Guidie team!

entries.source_text: 巧才之路那边的机关已经都维护过了。
entries.current_text: The mechanisms on the path of ingenuity have all been maintained.

entries.source_text: 好，武俊之路这边的机关也要抓紧规划检修了。
entries.current_text: Alright, we need to speed up the planning and maintenance of the mechanisms on the Path of Wujun.

entries.source_text: 这边……还有这边，都有学子反映说遇到过机关异常的情况。
entries.current_text: Here... and here, students have reported encountering abnormal mechanisms.

entries.source_text: 不知道救援队找到曜和西施学姐没有……
entries.current_text: I wonder if the rescue team has found Yao and Senior Xishi yet...

entries.source_text: 我来说吧，当时我们在玲珑峡谷内扮演小兵，经历了那场爆炸……
entries.current_text: Let me explain. We were acting as soldiers in Linglong Canyon when we experienced that explosion...

entries.source_text: 我来说吧，当时我们在玲珑峡谷内扮演小兵，经历了那场爆炸……
entries.current_text: Let me explain. We were acting as soldiers in Linglong Canyon when we experienced that explosion...

entries.source_text: 异常的地方……对了！动物……玲珑峡谷里的动物都好似发狂了一般……而且……身上还出现了奇怪的纹路……
entries.current_text: Something is wrong... Right! The animals... The animals in Linglong Canyon seem to have gone mad... And... strange patterns have appeared on their bodies...

entries.source_text: 最近还能进玲珑峡谷吗？
entries.current_text: Is it still possible to enter Linglong Canyon lately?

entries.source_text: 必须优先联络凌云卫，不可擅自处置！
entries.current_text: We must contact the Lingyun Guard first! Do not act on your own!

entries.source_text: 你好，凌云卫人手有些短缺，能借一下这个机兵吗？
entries.current_text: Hello, the Lingyun Guards are a bit short-handed. Could I borrow this mech?

entries.source_text: 不过，倒是可以趁现在把机关都召回检修一下。
entries.current_text: However, I could take this opportunity to recall the mechanisms for maintenance.

entries.source_text: 嗯，赛事转播机关，还有诸多小型机关的修缮正准备开始。
entries.current_text: Hmm, the repairs for the tournament broadcast mechanisms and various smaller devices are about to begin.

entries.source_text: 关于玲珑阙。
entries.current_text: About Linglong Palace.

entries.source_text: 玲珑阙是什么地方？
entries.current_text: What is the Linglong Palace?

entries.source_text: 这里本是玲珑峡谷赛事的入口，也是每一支参赛队伍的起点。
entries.current_text: This was originally the entrance to the Linglong Canyon competition, and the starting point for every participating team.

entries.source_text: 您这问得……哎呀，其实我私下里当然是希望西施的队伍能胜出啦！您可别笑哦。
entries.current_text: That's a tough question... Oh, well, privately, I'm rooting for Xishi's team to win! Don't laugh at me.

entries.source_text: 不是啥难事，你只要把你那张圭蝶的海报给我……
entries.current_text: It's not hard. Just give me that poster of yours of Gu Die...

entries.source_text: 物资可是稷下的生命线，咱们要做好后勤支援嘛！
entries.current_text: Supplies are the lifeline of Jixia; we must provide good logistical support!

entries.source_text: 这算什么，有空我带你去武道学院看看，那才叫厉害！
entries.current_text: What's so special about that? When I have time, I'll take you to the Martial Arts Academy to see what real talent looks like!

entries.source_text: 是是是，就你们武道学院厉害。
entries.current_text: Yes, yes, yes, your Martial Arts Academy is just so amazing.

entries.source_text: 依我看，今年这圭蝶队要更值得看好！
entries.current_text: In my opinion, the Guidie team is more promising this year!

entries.source_text: 小木篱任务。
entries.current_text: Little Wood-Fence Quest.

entries.source_text: 小木篱呼唤
entries.current_text: Little Wood-Fence Call

entries.source_text: 小木篱引导。
entries.current_text: Little Wood-Fence Guidance.

entries.source_text: 小木篱们会把山泉水和一些野果送到我这里，这些东西意外的很能补充精力。
entries.current_text: The Little Wood-Fences bring me mountain spring water and some wild fruits. These things are surprisingly good for restoring energy.

entries.source_text: 似乎这股强大的能量来自深渊对面，位置应该在木篱狩猎的区域。
entries.current_text: It seems this powerful energy comes from across the abyss, likely in the area where the Mu-Li hunt.

entries.source_text: 似乎这股强大的能量来自深渊对面，位置应该在木篱狩猎的区域。
entries.current_text: It seems this powerful energy comes from across the abyss, likely in the area where the Mu-Li hunt.

entries.source_text: 梦能盈满，万梦复苏，感谢您外来者...
entries.current_text: Dream Energy is overflowing, all dreams are reviving. Thank you, outsider...

entries.source_text: 这里的怪物似乎有些奇怪，似乎有什么神秘力量守护着它们。
entries.current_text: The monsters here seem a bit strange; it's as if some mysterious power is protecting them.

entries.source_text: 这里的怪物似乎有些奇怪，似乎有什么神秘力量守护着它们。
entries.current_text: The monsters here seem a bit strange; it's as if some mysterious power is protecting them.

entries.source_text: 并且转换了原本守护梦境的法阵，想把我控制并侵蚀。
entries.current_text: And they transformed the magic array that originally guarded the dream, intending to control and corrupt me.

entries.source_text: 那个巨大的地狼散发着奇怪的梦能波动和伯屠的很像。
entries.current_text: That massive Earth Wolf is emitting strange dream energy fluctuations, much like Bo Tu's.

entries.source_text: 已被彻底驯化，那些还在抵抗的地狼不知道还能撑多久，要是有<001>醒梦果</>...
entries.current_text: They have been completely domesticated. I wonder how long the Earth Wolves still resisting can hold out. If only there were <001>Dream-Awakening Fruit</>...

entries.source_text: 冰冻机关已就位，请受检体注意！
entries.current_text: The freezing mechanism is ready. Subjects, take note!

entries.source_text: 好热，外面这是怎么了？两侧的机关也被启动了？总之小心一些吧。
entries.current_text: It's so hot, what's going on outside? Were the mechanisms on both sides activated too? Anyway, be careful.

entries.source_text: 好热，外面这是怎么了？两侧的机关也被启动了？总之小心一些吧。
entries.current_text: It's so hot, what's going on outside? Were the mechanisms on both sides activated too? Anyway, be careful.

entries.source_text: 警告！警告！检测到不明生物！供能中断，实施防御措施！
entries.current_text: Warning! Warning! Unknown creature detected! Power supply interrupted, implementing defensive measures!

entries.source_text: 火焰机关已就位，请受检体注意！
entries.current_text: Fire mechanism is ready. Subjects, please take note!

entries.source_text: 检测完成，受检机关性能大幅度超出预期，结果……异常……
entries.current_text: Detection complete. Mechanism performance significantly exceeds expectations. Results... abnormal...

entries.source_text: 不过，那么多年前的机关就要经过这么严苛的测试？
entries.current_text: But why does a mechanism from so many years ago need such rigorous testing?

entries.source_text: 不过，那么多年前的机关就要经过这么严苛的测试？
entries.current_text: But why does a mechanism from so many years ago need such rigorous testing?

entries.source_text: 这些机关，究竟是被造出来做什么用的？
entries.current_text: What were these mechanisms even built for?

entries.source_text: 这些机关，究竟是被造出来做什么用的？
entries.current_text: What were these mechanisms even built for?

entries.source_text: 这个巨大机关……似乎需要非常大的力量才能启动……
entries.current_text: This giant mechanism... it seems to require immense power to start...

entries.source_text: 这个巨大机关……似乎需要非常大的力量才能启动……
entries.current_text: This giant mechanism... it seems to require immense power to start...

entries.source_text: 这是……机关被启动了！
entries.current_text: This is... the mechanism has been activated!

entries.source_text: 这是……机关被启动了！
entries.current_text: This is... the mechanism has been activated!

entries.source_text: 受检机关已进入测试场地，现在开始进行——机关耐火性测试。
entries.current_text: The mechanism under inspection has entered the test site. Commencing—mechanism fire resistance test.

entries.source_text: 这个机关构形的动作，貌似有些异样？
entries.current_text: The movement of this mechanical configuration seems a bit unusual, doesn't it?

entries.source_text: 这个机关构形的动作，貌似有些异样？
entries.current_text: The movement of this mechanical configuration seems a bit unusual, doesn't it?

entries.source_text: 检测到神纹图谱接口变更，目前接口为——鸟形机关。
entries.current_text: Divine Pattern Atlas interface change detected, current interface is—Bird-shaped Mechanism.

entries.source_text: 检测到神纹图谱接口变更，目前接口为——人形机关。
entries.current_text: Divine Pattern Atlas interface change detected, current interface is—Humanoid Mechanism.

entries.source_text: 检测到神纹图谱接口变更，目前接口为——蟹形机关。
entries.current_text: Divine Pattern Atlas interface change detected, current interface is—Crab-shaped Mechanism.

entries.source_text: 检测到神纹图谱接口变更，目前接口为——鱼形机关。
entries.current_text: Divine Pattern Atlas interface change detected, current interface is—Fish-shaped Mechanism.

entries.source_text: 风驰推进模组......应该是用来进行快速移动装置，或许可以安装在沧原甲身上。
entries.current_text: A Wind-Speed Propulsion Module... This must be for a high-speed movement device. Maybe it can be installed on the Cangyuan Armor.

entries.source_text: 风驰推进模组......应该是用来进行快速移动装置，或许可以安装在沧原甲身上。
entries.current_text: A Wind-Speed Propulsion Module... This must be for a high-speed movement device. Maybe it can be installed on the Cangyuan Armor.

entries.source_text: 乘信鳍，收集三条乘信鳍……
entries.current_text: Letter-Fin, collect three Letter-Fins...

entries.source_text: 故人的思念让这些草木复苏了吗……出现了……一个冰晶？
entries.current_text: Did the longing of an old friend revive these plants... Wait... is that an ice crystal?

entries.source_text: 故人的思念让这些草木复苏了吗……出现了……一个冰晶？
entries.current_text: Did the longing of an old friend revive these plants... Wait... is that an ice crystal?

entries.source_text: 这些铸铜甲……貌似只被输入了单一指令……
entries.current_text: These bronze armors... they seem to have only been given a single command...

entries.source_text: 这些铸铜甲……貌似只被输入了单一指令……
entries.current_text: These bronze armors... they seem to have only been given a single command...

entries.source_text: 这个冰晶，似乎蕴含着北荒的能量……
entries.current_text: This ice crystal seems to contain energy from the Northern Wilderness...

entries.source_text: 这个冰晶，似乎蕴含着北荒的能量……
entries.current_text: This ice crystal seems to contain energy from the Northern Wilderness...

entries.source_text: 这个机关核心中似乎还蕴含着充沛的能量，看看能用在哪！
entries.current_text: This mechanical core still seems to contain plenty of energy. Let's see what it can be used for!

entries.source_text: 这个机关核心中似乎还蕴含着充沛的能量，看看能用在哪！
entries.current_text: This mechanical core still seems to contain plenty of energy. Let's see what it can be used for!

entries.source_text: 这些铸铜甲……似乎有些与众不同……
entries.current_text: These bronze armors... they seem a bit unusual...

entries.source_text: 这些铸铜甲……似乎有些与众不同……
entries.current_text: These bronze armors... they seem a bit unusual...

entries.source_text: 这一个机关舱坏了，年久失修了吗……
entries.current_text: This mechanism cabin is broken. Has it fallen into disrepair...

entries.source_text: 这一个机关舱坏了，年久失修了吗……
entries.current_text: This mechanism cabin is broken. Has it fallen into disrepair...

entries.source_text: 这个铸铜甲似乎故障了。
entries.current_text: This cast-copper armor seems to be malfunctioning.

entries.source_text: 这个铸铜甲似乎故障了。
entries.current_text: This cast-copper armor seems to be malfunctioning.
