entries.current_text: This cast-copper armor seems to be malfunctioning.

entries.source_text: 这个铸铜甲似乎故障了。
entries.current_text: This cast-copper armor seems to be malfunctioning.

entries.source_text: 这个机关……似乎需要非常大的力量才能启动……
entries.current_text: This mechanism... it seems to require immense power to start...

entries.source_text: 这个机关……似乎需要非常大的力量才能启动……
entries.current_text: This mechanism... it seems to require immense power to start...

entries.source_text: 机关梯已经在下层了。
entries.current_text: The mechanical lift is already on the lower level.

entries.source_text: 机关梯已经在下层了。
entries.current_text: The mechanical lift is already on the lower level.

entries.source_text: 机关突然发生损坏了吗？嗯……看来左边这个没法使用了。
entries.current_text: Did the mechanism suddenly break? Hmm... looks like the one on the left is unusable.

entries.source_text: 机关突然发生损坏了吗？嗯……看来左边这个没法使用了。
entries.current_text: Did the mechanism suddenly break? Hmm... looks like the one on the left is unusable.

entries.source_text: 古老机关
entries.current_text: Ancient Mechanism

entries.source_text: 古老机关
entries.current_text: Ancient Mechanism

entries.source_text: 古老机关
entries.current_text: Ancient Mechanism

entries.source_text: 这里有好多机关组件！
entries.current_text: There are so many mechanism components here!

entries.source_text: 这里有好多机关组件！
entries.current_text: There are so many mechanism components here!

entries.source_text: 唔，这杯云根梦饮里……喙颜草和鳞球花的配比不准确啊……
entries.current_text: Uh... the Beakshade and Bushtail aren't in the right proportions...

entries.source_text: 风绮将一些环金交给你，原来他的弟弟沉迷研究，经常需要她接济，因此拜托你将环金交给她弟弟。
entries.current_text: Feng Qi gives you some gold rings. It turns out her brother was obsessed with research and often needed her financial support, so she asks you to deliver the rings to him.

entries.source_text: 唔……平安就好。不过看来他又身无分文了，同学如果有空，能否帮我将这些环金带给他？
entries.current_text: Hmm... I'm glad you're safe. But it seems he's penniless again. If you have a moment, could you help me deliver these coins to him?

entries.source_text: 风绮其实早就知道自己的弟弟出了意外，只是两人相依为命，即使察觉出些许不对，她也不愿相信自己的弟弟已经离世。如今一切了结，她将那些环金当作了给你的报酬。
entries.current_text: Feng Qi actually knew her brother had met with an accident long ago. But since they only had each other, she refused to believe he was gone, even when she sensed something was wrong. Now that everything is settled, she gives you the gold rings as your reward.

entries.source_text: 嗯，我叫屹川，目前在龙旗谷中进行风物研究。
entries.current_text: Hmm, my name is Yichuan, and I'm currently conducting research on natural phenomena in Longqi Valley.

entries.source_text: 你怎么会来龙旗谷？
entries.current_text: How did you come to Longqi Valley?

entries.source_text: 你怎么会来龙旗谷？
entries.current_text: How did you come to Longqi Valley?

entries.source_text: 他竟然从云根镇追过来了？
entries.current_text: He actually followed us from Yungen Town?

entries.source_text: 嗯，它的鳞片似乎有强力的治疗效果。
entries.current_text: Hmm, its scales seem to have powerful healing properties.

entries.source_text: 嗯，它的鳞片似乎有强力的治疗效果。
entries.current_text: Hmm, its scales seem to have powerful healing properties.

entries.source_text: 实不相瞒，我在此处研究的就是龙旗谷的昆虫生态。
entries.current_text: To be honest, I'm here to study the insect ecology of Dragon Banner Valley.

entries.source_text: 你们正打算在这里休息一晚，这时阳和方发现墙壁裂缝后好像有什么东西，让你在附近看看是不是有什么机关。
entries.current_text: Just as you intend to rest here for the night, Yang and Fang discover something behind a crack in the wall and ask you to check nearby for any mechanisms.

entries.source_text: 在附近看看吧，或许有什么<001>机关</>。
entries.current_text: Take a look around; there might be some kind of <001>mechanism</>.

entries.source_text: 放心，我还不会伤害它，毕竟是重要的诱饵。
entries.current_text: Don't worry, I won't hurt it yet; it's an important piece of bait.

entries.source_text: 壁画上的内容看起来是龙旗谷的历史，传言人族和龙族曾发生过一场大战，可壁画上却是人族和龙族并肩作战的场景。阳和方看过后，对此嗤之以鼻，
entries.current_text: The murals seem to depict the history of Dragon Banner Valley. Rumor has it that a great war once broke out between humans and dragons, but the murals show them fighting side by side. Yang and Fang scoffed at this after seeing it.

entries.source_text: 是上古时期的壁画，记录的应该是龙旗谷的历史？
entries.current_text: These are ancient murals. They should be recording the history of Dragon Banner Valley, right?

entries.source_text: 有传言说龙族曾与人类发生过一场大战，人类最终凭借机关和魔道逆转了劣势战局。
entries.current_text: Rumor has it that the Dragon race once fought a great war against humanity, and humans eventually turned the tide using mechanisms and magic.

entries.source_text: 放心，我还不会伤害它，毕竟是重要的诱饵。
entries.current_text: Don't worry, I won't hurt it yet; it's an important piece of bait.

entries.source_text: 放心，我还不会伤害它，毕竟是重要的诱饵。
entries.current_text: Don't worry, I won't hurt it yet; it's an important piece of bait.

entries.source_text: 圭蝶她们……会在做什么呢？
entries.current_text: I wonder what Gui Die and the others... are doing?

entries.source_text: 嘿嘿，妃寒能帮上忙就好。
entries.current_text: Hehe, I'm glad I could help.

entries.source_text: 我的回声，不会就此消散……
entries.current_text: My echo will not fade away just like that...

entries.source_text: 我们身后这条河流，发源自蝶使的摇篮——绮梦窟。
entries.current_text: The river behind us originates from the cradle of the Butterfly Envoys—the Dream-Weaving Grotto.

entries.source_text: 真的吗？我怎么觉得你有点像那个经常接悬赏清理地狼的高手？
entries.current_text: Really? Why do you remind me of that expert who often takes bounties to clear out ground wolves?

entries.source_text: 那一带地狼活动猖獗，桑弧在武道课上跑个步都勉强，别提遇到地狼了。
entries.current_text: Earth wolves are rampant in that area. Sanghu can barely run in martial arts class, let alone deal with earth wolves.

entries.source_text: 我也怕地狼。
entries.current_text: I'm afraid of Earth Wolves too.

entries.source_text: 桑弧向你介绍自己发明的傀儡篷矢，经过他的改造，它已经成为了美梦映射的装置，只是几个机关模组被地狼咬坏了。
entries.current_text: Sanghu introduces you to the puppet 'Pengshi' he invented. After his modifications, it has become a device for dream mapping, but several mechanism modules were bitten by earth wolves.

entries.source_text: 但不小心惊动了地狼，导致蓬矢启动了保护我的指令。
entries.current_text: But I accidentally startled the Earth Wolf, which caused Pengshi to initiate its protection protocol for me.

entries.source_text: 潇洒利落，足下生风，一看就是狩猎榜上经常清理地狼的高手，我没猜错吧？
entries.current_text: Stylish and sharp, with a spring in your step. You look like an expert who often clears out Earth Wolves on the hunting board, am I right?

entries.source_text: 它的几个机关模组就这样被地狼咬坏了，哎。
entries.current_text: Several of its mechanical modules were bitten and broken by the earth wolves, sigh.

entries.source_text: 你这裁云模组是被地狼咬了个对穿吗……停下，现在没轮到我出场，先介绍你自己。
entries.current_text: Did your Cloud-Cutting Module get bitten through by a Ground Wolf? ...Stop, it's not my turn yet. Introduce yourself first.

entries.source_text: 让你见笑了，我的蓬矢一开始可不是这样的，都怪那群饿昏头的地狼……
entries.current_text: Pardon the mess. My Pengshi wasn't like this at first; it's all the fault of those starving Earth Wolves...

entries.source_text: 虽然我还没搞清楚美梦化蝶的原理，但梦茧作为映射材料这点我已经实验成功了。
entries.current_text: Although I haven't figured out the principle behind 'Dreams into Butterflies,' I have successfully experimented with using Dream Cocoons as mapping materials.

entries.source_text: 你可以说我有些机关术上的自傲和妄想。
entries.current_text: You could say I have a bit of arrogance and delusion when it comes to mechanism arts.

entries.source_text: 这里就是北边的古代遗址了，确实有很多地狼。
entries.current_text: This is the ancient ruin to the north. There really are a lot of earth wolves.

entries.source_text: 这里就是北边的古代遗址了，确实有很多地狼。
entries.current_text: This is the ancient ruin to the north. There really are a lot of earth wolves.

entries.source_text: 虽然不知道这次失败的原因，但只要再次修复蓬矢，就能弄清楚了。
entries.current_text: Although I don't know the reason for this failure, as long as we repair the Peng Arrow again, we'll be able to figure it out.

entries.source_text: 当心，蓬矢彻底失控了，都怪我没有修好裁云……
entries.current_text: Watch out, the Peng Arrow is completely out of control. It's all my fault for not fixing Caiyun...

entries.source_text: 南湖秋水夜无烟，耐可乘流直上天……
entries.current_text: Autumn water on the southern lake, smokeless at night; how can I ride the current straight to the sky...

entries.source_text: 南湖秋水夜无烟，耐可乘流直上天……
entries.current_text: Autumn water on the southern lake, smokeless at night; how can I ride the current straight to the sky...

entries.source_text: 鲁班大师下令，要鲁班七号歼灭周围的机关小兵。可是，为什么？面对这澄澈孩童的提问，答案是：因为他们是敌人！
entries.current_text: Master Luban ordered Luban No. 7 to annihilate the surrounding mechanical minions. But why? To this innocent child's question, the answer is: because they are the enemy!

entries.source_text: 你帮助鲁班大师拿到材料后，你们闲聊起对于机关造物的看法，鲁班大师告诉你：他认为机关造物于他而言是生命。谈及此，鲁班大师似乎又想起了七号，你好奇七号的开发历程，想要再多了解一些关于七号的研发经历。
entries.current_text: After you help Master Luban obtain the materials, you chat about your views on mechanical creations. Master Luban tells you that he considers his mechanical creations to be life. Mentioning this, he seems to remember No. 7 again, and you are curious about its development history and want to learn more.

entries.source_text: 我刚去了趟安虞野，将这个消息转达给了族长——万幸小家伙伤势并不严重，已经可以下水了。
entries.current_text: I just went to Anyu Wilds and relayed the news to the chieftain—fortunately, the little one's injuries aren't serious, and it's already able to get into the water.

entries.source_text: 你参与编撰的《春溪漫滩博物志》样刊已经送到你的居所了，记得摆在显眼的地方，也替我宣传宣传。
entries.current_text: The sample copy of the "Chunxi Shoal Natural History" you helped compile has been delivered to your residence. Remember to display it prominently and help me promote it too.

entries.source_text: 咱们一起编撰的《云落远山博物志》样刊到货了！你拍的那些家伙，现在可算有了高清合集。
entries.current_text: The sample copies of our co-authored "Chronicles of the Distant Clouds" have arrived! Now those creatures you photographed finally have a high-definition collection.

entries.source_text: 《织梦原野博物志》已经做好了，放在你屋里，保证谁看谁羡慕！
entries.current_text: The "Zhimeng Wilderness Museum Records" is finished. I left it in your room—guaranteed to make anyone who sees it jealous!

entries.source_text: 很好，咱们春溪漫滩没什么稀奇古怪的东西。
entries.current_text: Good, there's nothing strange or weird in our Chunxi Shoals.

entries.source_text: 你在云落远山拍到新影像的话记得给我瞧瞧，解解闷儿。
entries.current_text: If you take any new photos in the Distant Mountains of Yunluo, remember to show them to me to relieve my boredom.

entries.source_text: 织梦原野风景太好，你这孩子看得流连忘返了？
entries.current_text: The scenery in the Dream-Weaving Fields is so beautiful, did you get lost in it, child?

entries.source_text: 你在哪里啊？快来彩云盆地集合，大家都在等你了！
entries.current_text: Where are you? Hurry and gather at the Colorful Cloud Basin, everyone is waiting for you!

entries.source_text: 那个……你可不可以来梦饮茶肆一下？
entries.current_text: Um... could you please come to the Dream Tea House?

entries.source_text: 归虚梦演最终试炼在即。开始之前，老夫尚有些话想当面嘱托于你，到云蚕间来吧。
entries.current_text: The final trial of the Enlightenment Trials is imminent. Before it begins, I have some things I wish to entrust to you in person. Come to the Cloud Silkworm Room.

entries.source_text: 夫子是希望我到云根镇协助守卫军遴选一事，对吗？
entries.current_text: Master, you want me to go to Yungen Town to assist the garrison with the selection process, right?

entries.source_text: 夫子是希望我到云根镇协助守卫军遴选一事，对吗？
entries.current_text: Master, you want me to go to Yungen Town to assist the garrison with the selection process, right?

entries.source_text: 我这就前往云根镇演武擂台，找星芒老师。
entries.current_text: I'm heading to the Yungen Town martial arts arena now to find Master Xingmang.

entries.source_text: 我这就前往云根镇演武擂台，找星芒老师。
entries.current_text: I'm heading to the Yungen Town martial arts arena now to find Master Xingmang.

entries.source_text: 我记住了……那我先去云根镇演武擂台找星芒老师。
entries.current_text: I've got it... I'll head to the Yungen Town martial arts arena to find Master Xingmang first.

entries.source_text: 我记住了……那我先去云根镇演武擂台找星芒老师。
entries.current_text: I've got it... I'll head to the Yungen Town martial arts arena to find Master Xingmang first.

entries.source_text: 诚邀同学于今晚十七时前，莅临美丽的彩云盆地海滨。
entries.current_text: You are cordially invited to visit the beautiful Caiyun Basin seaside before 17:00 tonight.

entries.source_text: 诚邀本群聊内的各位同学，于今晚十七时，莅临美丽的彩云盆地海滨。
entries.current_text: All students in this group are cordially invited to visit the beautiful Caiyun Basin seaside at 17:00 tonight.

entries.source_text: 战斗到最后，守护长城！
entries.current_text: Fight to the end and protect the Great Wall!

entries.source_text: 守护大家的，故乡！哈！
entries.current_text: Protecting everyone's hometown! Ha!

entries.source_text: 我们也是在求助秘禁阁与庄周院长之后，才推测出案件与海都的月亮家族有关。
entries.current_text: It was only after seeking help from the Secret Forbidden Pavilion and Dean Zhuangzi that we deduced the case was related to the Moon Family of Sea City.

entries.source_text: 而<001>月亮家族</>，正是管理海都的三大执政家族之一。据说他们力量不俗，尤其精通剑术和魔道术，不过……
entries.current_text: And the <001>Moon Family</> is one of the three ruling families that manage Hai Du. It is said that they possess formidable power and are especially proficient in swordsmanship and magic, but...

entries.source_text: 不过，他突然间举止异常，还将刀刃指向了血亲……也不知是受魔铠影响失去理智，还是另有原因。
entries.current_text: However, he suddenly started acting abnormally and even turned his blade against his own kin... I don't know if he lost his mind due to the magic armor or if there's another reason.

entries.source_text: 阁主放心，我已经派人全面搜查了，一旦发现，立即带回秘禁阁封存。
entries.current_text: Don't worry, Pavilion Master, I have already sent people to conduct a thorough search. Once found, it will be immediately brought back to the Secret Forbidden Pavilion for safekeeping.

entries.source_text: 绯哥哥的那起案件，我是第一个到现场的凌云卫……
entries.current_text: I was the first Lingyun Guard to arrive at the scene of Brother Fei's case...

entries.source_text: 愿月光照亮心之所向，再无迷惘。
entries.current_text: May the moonlight illuminate your heart's desire, and may you be lost no more.

entries.source_text: 愿月光照亮心之所向，再无迷惘。
entries.current_text: May the moonlight illuminate your heart's desire, and may you be lost no more.

entries.source_text: 铠，因守护而存在。
entries.current_text: Kai, exists for the sake of protection.

entries.source_text: 失去魔铠的那一刻，你就输了。
entries.current_text: The moment you lost your magic armor, you lost the fight.

entries.source_text: 以人为祭的仪式，两名受害者，还有越发异常的魔铠，难道说……
entries.current_text: Her brother and that girl... both died in a human-sacrifice ritual...

entries.source_text: 果然难以使用魔铠，看来那仪式会削弱我对它的控制。
entries.current_text: I was right...

entries.source_text: 我摸着他的脸，却突然裂开，像碎了的杯子……哗啦哗啦，就那样，一块一块地掉下来……我想捡起来，凌云卫却来了……
entries.current_text: I touched his face, but it suddenly cracked like a broken cup... Clatter, clatter, it just fell off piece by piece... I wanted to pick them up, but the Lingyun Guard arrived...

entries.source_text: 我曾经很喜欢看日出，尤其是羽栖峰山崖边的日出。哥哥，总是会陪着我一起。
entries.current_text: I used to love watching the sunrise, especially the sunrise from the cliffs of Yuxi Peak. My brother would always keep me company.

entries.source_text: 同行的凌云卫
entries.current_text: The Lingyun Guard who accompanied us

entries.source_text: 但那里是一座被秘术封锁的机关迷宫，还有重兵把守……
entries.current_text: But that's a mechanical labyrinth sealed by secret arts, and it's heavily guarded...

entries.source_text: 值岗的凌云卫
entries.current_text: Lingyun Guard on duty

entries.source_text: 值岗的凌云卫
entries.current_text: Lingyun Guard on duty

entries.source_text: 唉，最新的卷宗已经往秘禁阁送了，希望阁主能查出真相，不要出现新的受害者了……
entries.current_text: Sigh, the latest files have already been sent to the Secret Pavilion. I hope the Pavilion Master can uncover the truth so there won't be any more victims...

entries.source_text: 卷宗就在秘禁阁……
entries.current_text: The files are in the Secret Forbidden Pavilion...

entries.source_text: 我去看望了伤员，听他们的描述，伤人的极有可能是失心者。
entries.current_text: I visited the wounded, and based on their descriptions, it's highly likely that the attackers were the Heartless.

entries.source_text: 但愿如此……李寻对失心者也很熟悉，待会再问问他的看法。
entries.current_text: I hope so... Li Xun is also familiar with the Heartless. I'll ask for his thoughts later.

entries.source_text: 入了守卫军，每个抉择都是不归路。这曲子……唱的就是这份觉悟。
entries.current_text: Once you join us, there is no return. And that song... it's about accepting that fate.

entries.source_text: 李小苗安排你们先到河边见赵大顺，意外吓跑了他的鱼……她声称你是钓鱼高手，引来了钓利戟鳅的挑战。
entries.current_text: Li Xiaomiao arranges for you to meet Zhao Dashun by the river, but accidentally scares away his fish... She claims you are a master angler, prompting a challenge to catch the Profit-Seeking Loach.

entries.source_text: 特来请教二姐——守卫军的那把机关弩又卡壳了。
entries.current_text: Hi there. I've come to seek your help—my crossbow seems to be jammed... again.

entries.source_text: 木兰早已洞察你们的行踪，可她却没有苛责你们，而是顺势点拨小苗带你们前往李家驿站。
entries.current_text: Mulan had long since sensed your movements, but instead of reprimanding you, she takes the opportunity to nudge Xiaomiao to lead you to the Li Family Post Station.

entries.source_text: 长城守卫军浴血抗击魔物，李寻的舍命相救彻底点燃了花木兰破釜沉舟的战意……
entries.current_text: The Great Wall Garrison fights the monsters in blood. Li Xun's sacrifice ignites Hua Mulan's desperate resolve...

entries.source_text: 你传信归来，却发现木兰在供桌前祭拜，才得知李寻的死讯……
entries.current_text: You return from delivering a message only to find Mulan praying at the altar, and learn of Li Xun's death...

entries.source_text: 木兰询问李婶伤情，李婶吞吞吐吐解释在后山遭遇，你帮木兰去屋外传信凌云卫……
entries.current_text: Mulan asks Aunt Li about her injuries. Aunt Li gives a hesitant explanation about an encounter at the back mountain, so you help Mulan by delivering a message to the Lingyun Guard outside.

entries.source_text: 木兰悼念李寻，李婶挽留你们用膳，木兰想到替李寻尽孝，提出亲自下厨的请求……
entries.current_text: Mulan mourns Li Xun. Aunt Li invites you both to stay for a meal, and Mulan, wanting to fulfill Li Xun's filial duties, offers to cook herself...

entries.source_text: 木兰在饭桌上询问李婶有关李寻的过往，并提及“失心者”细节，李婶流露真情之余，似乎在隐瞒什么……
entries.current_text: At the dinner table, Mulan asks Aunt Li about Li Xun's past and mentions details regarding the "Heartless." Aunt Li reveals her true feelings, but seems to be hiding something...

entries.source_text: 木兰以菜式追忆李寻，你和小苗听闻后都不禁伤神……
entries.current_text: Mulan reminisces about Li Xun through her cooking. You and Xiaomiao are both deeply moved...

entries.source_text: 石像见证下，花木兰以军令唤醒李寻残存意志，共唱戍军谣中令行斩魔，断弦绝唱间人性归位，唯余“壮士莫回还”的悲歌回荡。
entries.current_text: Under the witness of the stone statues, Hua Mulan uses military orders to awaken Li Xun's remaining will. Together, they sing the ballad of the garrison, executing demons with discipline. Amidst the broken strings and final songs, humanity is restored, leaving only the tragic echo of "Warrior, do not return."

entries.source_text: 所向披靡！
entries.current_text: Unstoppable!

entries.source_text: 李寻听令！
entries.current_text: Li Xun, awaiting orders!

entries.source_text: 木兰激战“失心者”，惊见其昔日救己伤痕。李妈泣血揭露“为救你被咬”真相……
entries.current_text: Mulan battles the "Heartless," only to be shocked by the very scar that once saved her. Aunt Li tearfully reveals the truth: "I was bitten while trying to save you..."

entries.source_text: 李寻！
entries.current_text: Li Xun!

entries.source_text: 花木兰欣赏你的身手……在星芒建议下，木兰将军委托你担任云根镇的向导，与她随访退伍守卫军。
entries.current_text: Mulan admires your skills... At Xingmang's suggestion, General Mulan entrusts you to act as a guide for Yungen Town and accompany her to visit the retired guards.

entries.source_text: 你受夫子所托，到云根镇擂台寻找星芒导师……他正邀请你担任临时考核官，却突遇擂台争执事件。
entries.current_text: Entrusted by the Master, you go to the Cloud Root Town arena to find the Star-Gazing Mentor... He invites you to be a temporary examiner, but a dispute suddenly breaks out in the arena.

entries.source_text: 李小苗恳求为你和花木兰带路，木兰因在过招时发现她身上的守卫军令牌，答应同行。
entries.current_text: Li Xiaomiao begs to lead the way for you and Mulan. Mulan agrees to travel together after discovering her Guardian token during their spar.

entries.source_text: 李小苗使诈险胜遭质疑，花木兰三招看破其剑式，令其狼狈落败并意外显露守卫军令牌。
entries.current_text: Li Xiaomiao wins a narrow victory through trickery, but Mulan sees through her sword style in three moves, causing her to lose in embarrassment and accidentally reveal her Guardian token.

entries.source_text: 长城守卫军队长花木兰轻松击退李小苗，并镇场终结争端。
entries.current_text: Great Wall Garrison Captain Hua Mulan easily repels Li Xiaomiao and settles the dispute.

entries.source_text: 妃寒其实是想找圭蝶元芬帮忙，但手下破门生带错了人。你们解开误会后，妃寒向你提到和大白因北荒天灾来到稷下的过往。
entries.current_text: Nivie actually wanted to find Guidie Yuanfen for help, but her subordinates brought the wrong person. After you clear up the misunderstanding, Nivie mentions her past of coming to Jixia with Dabai due to the Northern Wasteland disaster.

entries.source_text: 巫颜老师告诉你们前往绮梦窟或许可以得到愈流灵石，但她要求魔种大白同去。妃寒则请求你同往，你们约定绮梦窟门口相见。
entries.current_text: Teacher Wu Yan told you that you might find the Healing Spirit Stone in the Dream Cave, but she insisted that the magic creature Da Bai accompany you. Pei Han asked you to go as well, and you agreed to meet at the entrance of the Dream Cave.

entries.source_text: 巫颜老师被困在书堆底下，你和妃寒急忙把她营救出来。
entries.current_text: Teacher Wu Yan was trapped under a pile of books, and you and Pei Han rushed to rescue her.

entries.source_text: 妃寒曾读过其中提到“幸福宝石”的北荒童话，而她找到的和灵石有关的笔记中，似乎有人在崩溃中涂掉“治愈”二字。
entries.current_text: Nivie had once read a Northern Wasteland fairy tale that mentioned a "Happiness Gem," and in the notes she found regarding Spirit Stones, it seemed someone had frantically scratched out the word "Healing."

entries.source_text: 妃寒隐瞒了自己牺牲生命复活大白的真相，只说自己是法力消耗过度。在离开前，她想再问巫颜一个问题。
entries.current_text: Nivie hid the truth that she had sacrificed her life to revive Dabai, claiming only that she had overexerted her magic. Before leaving, she wanted to ask Wu Yan one more question.

entries.source_text: 妃寒在回忆中看到，是父亲在临死前用生命复活了大白，将自己托付给他。她思索自己是否也能做到父亲使用的招式。
entries.current_text: Nivie sees in her memory that her father used his life to revive Dabai before he died, entrusting her to him. She wonders if she can also perform the techniques her father used.

entries.source_text: 怎么、怎么哭了？放心吧，他们不会再伤害你了。
entries.current_text: Why, why are you crying? Don't worry, they won't hurt you anymore.

entries.source_text: 你猜测出妃寒其实是用自己的流，才延续了大白的生命。她安慰你，相比于拥有多长的生命，她更希望能有大白陪伴。
entries.current_text: You guessed that Nivie actually used her own flow to extend Da Bai's life. She comforted you, saying that compared to how long she lives, she would rather have Da Bai's company.

entries.source_text: 圭蝶和元芬感谢你对妃寒的帮助，约定等她恢复后再找你一叙。
entries.current_text: Gui Die and Yuanfen thank you for your help with Nivie, agreeing to meet again once she has recovered.

entries.source_text: 大白的记忆展开。原来大白早就知道，妃寒父亲所谓的“复生之术”实则是以命换命。父亲牺牲生命，是为了更为强大的大白能够保护自己幼小的女儿。大白担心妃寒知道这一点后也牺牲生命拯救自己，于是决定掩盖真相。
entries.current_text: Dabai's memories unfold. It turns out Dabai knew all along that Nivie's father's so-called 'Resurrection Art' was actually a life-for-life exchange. The father sacrificed his life so that a more powerful Dabai could protect his young daughter. Fearing that Nivie would sacrifice her own life to save him if she knew, Dabai decided to hide the truth.

entries.source_text: 人类有的时候真是不可理喻，放着自己的生命不要，却要换给别人。
entries.current_text: Humans are truly incomprehensible sometimes. They'd rather give up their own lives for someone else.

entries.source_text: 妃寒与大白就前往绮梦窟一事发生争执，你前去劝说大白。
entries.current_text: Nivie and Dabai argue over going to the Dream Cave; you go to persuade Dabai.

entries.source_text: ……真倔。那本兔这么问你吧，如果世上真有灵石，生命是不是就没有尽头了？你见过永远不会死的人吗？
entries.current_text: ... Stubborn. Let me ask you this: if Spirit Stones truly existed, would life have an end? Have you ever met someone who never dies?

entries.source_text: 绮梦窟中巫颜使大白困入梦魇，为了不让学院封印发狂的大白，你们决定用法阵连接他和妃寒的梦境，以此唤醒他。
entries.current_text: In the Cave of Painted Dreams, Wu Yan trapped Dabai in a nightmare. To prevent the academy from sealing the rampaging Dabai, you decide to use a magic circle to connect his dream with Nivie's to wake him up.

entries.source_text: 走吧，我们去梦语湖北面的山坡上会合。
entries.current_text: Let's meet on the slope north of Lake Aersilk.

entries.source_text: 圭蝶、李元芬和你准备启动法阵，妃寒决定独自进入大白的梦境之中，将大白唤回。
entries.current_text: Gui Die, Li Yuanfen, and you prepare to activate the magic array, while Nivie decides to enter Dabai's dream alone to wake him up.

entries.source_text: 你与圭蝶、李元芬开始仪式，法阵点亮，妃寒在法阵中间，抱着法杖闭目祈祷。不久后，大白果然被引来，法阵继续运行，大白和妃寒一同睡去，此刻的妃寒，已经进入了大白的梦境。
entries.current_text: You and Gui Die and Li Yuanfen begin the ritual. The magic circle lights up, and Nivie stands in the center, clutching her staff and praying with her eyes closed. Soon after, Da Bai is lured in. The circle continues to run, and Da Bai and Nivie fall asleep together. At this moment, Nivie has entered Da Bai's dream.

entries.source_text: 哟，不是吧！你这消息属实有点闭塞了，这事儿在彩云盆地都传遍了！
entries.current_text: Yo, no way! You're really out of the loop; this has already spread all over the Colorful Cloud Basin!

entries.source_text: 闲言碎语咱不多讲，来表一表，千驷英雄少年郎！
entries.current_text: Let's skip the small talk and tell the tale of the heroic youth with a thousand steeds!

entries.source_text: 千驷家在丰云野，自幼体壮功夫强，金榜题名入稷下，梦演夺魁美名扬。
entries.current_text: Qiansi is from Fengyun Wilds, strong and skilled in martial arts since childhood. He topped the imperial exams to enter Jixia, and his name is renowned for his dream-performance victory.

entries.source_text: 后来大家就猜测，是有位名叫“千驷”的少年英雄，在多年前将一只云根怪封印在了地下。
entries.current_text: Later, people speculated that a young hero named 'Qiansi' had sealed a Cloud-Root Monster underground many years ago.

entries.source_text: 云根怪？
entries.current_text: Cloud root monster?

entries.source_text: 云根怪？
entries.current_text: Cloud root monster?

entries.source_text: 嘶……既然你亲眼见过下面的情况……确实该对云根怪有更多了解……
entries.current_text: Hiss... since you've seen the situation below with your own eyes... you really should know more about the Cloud-Root Monsters...

entries.source_text: 可谁知，彩云盆地行路险，还有云根怪物地里藏，巴掌一伸簸箕大，利爪好比棒槌长！
entries.current_text: Who knew the Caiyun Basin paths were so treacherous? With Cloudroot monsters hiding in the earth, their palms are as big as winnowing baskets, and their claws are as long as clubs!

entries.source_text: 那云根怪登时拔地起，吓得众人逃命慌！恰此时，千驷少年挺身出，拔刀站在了乡亲旁！
entries.current_text: The Cloud-Root Monster rose from the ground, scaring everyone into a panicked flight! Just then, a youth from Qiansi stepped forward, drawing his blade to stand by the villagers' side!

entries.source_text: 千驷挥手甩出饼，再瞧那云根怪，也弱了提防，眼盯着大饼放光芒……
entries.current_text: Qiansi waves his hand and tosses a pancake. The Cloud-Root monster, caught off guard, stares at the pancake with glowing eyes...

entries.source_text: 这云根怪，是身又高来体又强，但也难抵，那丰云大饼喷喷香……喷喷……
entries.current_text: The Cloud-Root beast is tall and strong, but it can't resist the scent of a steaming Cloud-Cake... so fragrant...

entries.source_text: 千驷挥手甩出饼，再瞧那云根怪，也弱了提防，眼盯着大饼放光芒……
entries.current_text: Qiansi waves his hand and tosses a pancake. The Cloud-Root monster, caught off guard, stares at the pancake with glowing eyes...

entries.source_text: 是那时丢在归云壤的徽记……这是我的？还是……千驷当年的？
entries.current_text: It's the emblem I lost in Guyun Soil back then... Is this mine? Or... Qiansi's from all those years ago?

entries.source_text: 是那时丢在归云壤的徽记……这是我的？还是……千驷当年的？
entries.current_text: It's the emblem I lost in Guyun Soil back then... Is this mine? Or... Qiansi's from all those years ago?

entries.source_text: 关于云根。
entries.current_text: About Cloud Root.

entries.source_text: 所以这么说，丰云饼能战胜“云根怪”，也不算全是我瞎编的吧？哈哈！
entries.current_text: So, in that case, it's not entirely a lie that the Fengyun Cake can defeat the 'Cloud Root Monster,' right? Haha!

entries.source_text: ……哎好了不开玩笑，其实吧，我原先住在丰云野，就是个很平常的农家。
entries.current_text: ...Alright, no more jokes. Actually, I used to live in Fengyunya, just a very ordinary farm family.

entries.source_text: 要守护，学院……
entries.current_text: Must protect... the Academy...

entries.source_text: 丰云庆典的时候……
entries.current_text: During the Abundant Cloud Festival...

entries.source_text: 哈哈，这才对嘛！我们那时候，撑着稷下挺过去的……不是仇恨、愤怒，更不是自怨自艾。
entries.current_text: Haha, that's the spirit! Back then, we held on at Jixia... not through hatred, anger, or self-pity.

entries.source_text: 浣游正在尝试一段新说书“千驷大战云根怪”，想请你提提建议。
entries.current_text: Huanyou is trying out a new storytelling piece, "The Battle of a Thousand Chariots Against the Cloud-Root Monster," and wants your advice.

entries.source_text: 等等，原来是你呀，上次在丰云野，可还要多谢你呢！
entries.current_text: Wait, it's you! I really have to thank you for last time in Fengyun Wilds!

entries.source_text: 我呀，正在试一段名叫“千驷大败云根怪”的新词儿。
entries.current_text: I'm working on a new verse called 'The Thousand Chariots' Defeat of the Cloud-Root Monster'.

entries.source_text: 那云根怪，也难挡，丰云大饼扑鼻香……扑鼻……好像还是“喷喷香”好些。
entries.current_text: That Cloud-Root Monster, hard to resist, the scent of the Fengyun pancake is so fragrant... so fragrant... actually, 'deliciously fragrant' sounds better.

entries.source_text: 原来小四就是千驷，而那故事中的云根怪也是他自己。
entries.current_text: So Xiao Si is Qian Si, and he is also the Cloud-Root Monster from the story.

entries.source_text: 是千驷才对吧。
entries.current_text: It's 'Thousand Chariots,' isn't it?

entries.source_text: 嘿，老实说我也觉得奇怪，有可能……在云根“病房”里住了那么久，想死也不是件容易事吧。
entries.current_text: Hey, honestly, I find it strange too. Maybe... after living in the Yungen "ward" for so long, dying isn't such an easy thing, right?

entries.source_text: 对啊！她词里的千驷是我，可她不知道，那“云根怪”也是我呀，哈哈！
entries.current_text: Yeah! She meant me when she wrote 'Qiansi' in her lyrics, but she didn't know that the 'Cloud Root Monster' was also me! Haha!

entries.source_text: 啊？这里离丰云野可远着呢，去哪儿找稷狐麦？
entries.current_text: Huh? That's nowhere near Fengyunya. Where are we supposed to find Jixia Fox Wheat?

entries.source_text: 啊？这里离丰云野可远着呢，去哪儿找稷狐麦？
entries.current_text: Huh? That's nowhere near Fengyunya. Where are we supposed to find Jixia Fox Wheat?

entries.source_text: 又是萤火虫和木篱……难道木篱是在守护向阳花？
entries.current_text: Fireflies and wooden fences again... Could the wooden fence be guarding the sunflowers?

entries.source_text: 又是萤火虫和木篱……难道木篱是在守护向阳花？
entries.current_text: Fireflies and wooden fences again... Could the wooden fence be guarding the sunflowers?

entries.source_text: 这么多年过去，稷下仍然难逃战争的命运，唉……可我已经无法再次守护它了。
entries.current_text: After all these years, Jixia still cannot escape the fate of war. Sigh... but I can no longer protect it.

entries.source_text: 放心，如今也有许多学子在守护着稷下，就像你们当初也一样。
entries.current_text: Don't worry, there are many students guarding Jixia now, just like you all were back then.

entries.source_text: 放心，如今也有许多学子在守护着稷下，就像你们当初也一样。
entries.current_text: Don't worry, there are many students guarding Jixia now, just like you all were back then.

entries.source_text: 最奇怪的是，附近的警戒岗哨也撤除了，难道这里不再需要守备了么？
entries.current_text: The strangest thing is that the nearby guard posts have been withdrawn. Is there no longer a need for defense here?

entries.source_text: 只是彩云盆地的地形似乎有些变化，曾经做的标记也不见了，所以我就找了个巡逻学子问方向……
entries.current_text: It's just that the terrain of the Colorful Cloud Basin seems to have changed, and the markers I made are gone, so I asked a patrolling student for directions...

entries.source_text: 那是……天雷隼？
entries.current_text: Is that... the Sky-Thunder Falcon?

entries.source_text: 那是……天雷隼？
entries.current_text: Is that... the Sky-Thunder Falcon?

entries.source_text: 那时候的我或许还远不如现在，可他们从来没有放弃过我，还不断鼓励我克服阴影，陪伴我一同战胜天雷隼。
entries.current_text: I might have been far from who I am today back then, but they never gave up on me. They kept encouraging me to overcome my shadows and stood by me as we defeated the Sky-Thunder Falcon together.

entries.source_text: 所以……我将天雷隼的兽骨收集起来，想给他们做一件象征勇气的礼物，也想告诉他们，他们的信任……从来没有错付。
entries.current_text: So... I collected the bones of the Sky-Thunder Falcon, wanting to make them a gift symbolizing courage, and to tell them that their trust... was never misplaced.

entries.source_text: 原来这就是你着急打败天雷隼的原因。
entries.current_text: So this is why you were in such a hurry to defeat the Sky-Thunder Falcon.

entries.source_text: 原来这就是你着急打败天雷隼的原因。
entries.current_text: So this is why you were in such a hurry to defeat the Sky-Thunder Falcon.

entries.source_text: 我想到了一个地方，不过……总之，你先来荣耀塔这边吧。
entries.current_text: I thought of a place, but... anyway, just come to the Tower of Glory first.

entries.source_text: 到达昭君。
entries.current_text: Arrived at Zhaojun.

entries.source_text: 根据资料记载，在那场表演赛中，昭君所在的队伍还处于对抗的劣势。
entries.current_text: According to historical records, Zhaojun's team was at a disadvantage during that exhibition match.

entries.source_text: 队友正在挑战湛蓝灵兽，但敌方四人过来骚扰……留影就中断在这里了。
entries.current_text: My teammates were challenging the Azure Spirit Beast, but four enemies came to harass them... The recording ends here.

entries.source_text: 东方曜一个人牵制住了对面边路，他深入敌阵，抗住防御塔的攻击，直面两名对手。他一个逐星接裂空斩后果断回撤。
entries.current_text: Novar held off the opposing side lane by himself. He went deep into the enemy formation, withstood the attacks of the defense tower, and faced two opponents head-on. He decisively retreated after a Star-Chasing followed by a Rift-Slash.

entries.source_text: 两次逐星拉开距离，但被控制住了。又是归尘！回身，再回身，靠星辰之力带来的赐福再使出两次逐星——
entries.current_text: Twice he used Star-Chasing to create distance, but he was controlled. It's 'Return to Dust' again! Turning back, turning again, relying on the blessing of starlight to use Star-Chasing twice more—

entries.source_text: 防御塔下三抓一还逃出生天！
entries.current_text: They escaped even after a 3-on-1 gank under the tower!

entries.source_text: 守护荣耀塔的机关！强拆！夫子老师，戒尺舞影——
entries.current_text: The mechanism guarding the Honor Tower! Demolish it! Master Fuzi, dance of the ruler's shadow—

entries.source_text: 众人讨论后发现还缺了一幕名场面，有一人曾提着长枪独闯荣耀塔，听说和某个能让人短暂无敌的装备有关。
entries.current_text: After discussing, everyone realized one iconic scene was missing: someone once charged into the Honor Tower alone with a spear, which was rumored to be related to a piece of equipment that grants temporary invincibility.

entries.source_text: 稍等，我想一下……传说姑射山有得天独厚的锻造绝学，打造过一件让持有者短暂无敌的兵器。
entries.current_text: Wait, let me think... Legend says Mount Guye has a unique forging technique that created a weapon capable of granting its wielder temporary invincibility.

entries.source_text: 要是没有你的提示，我根本不会往姑射山的方向去想，又怎么会想到他出了一把——一把——
entries.current_text: If it weren't for your hint, I wouldn't have thought about Gu She Mountain at all, and how would I have thought that he produced a—a—

entries.source_text: 我忍不住了学长，我现在就要去翻姑射山的记载！同学，等我成了首席记者之后肯定回来给你做个专访！
entries.current_text: I can't help it, Senior! I'm going to look up the records of Guxie Mountain right now! Classmate, once I become the lead reporter, I'll definitely come back and give you an exclusive interview!

entries.source_text: 他带的这把兵器为他抵挡了最后一次致命攻击，争取到攻破荣耀塔最后一击所需的时间，这就是他胜利的秘密保障。
entries.current_text: The weapon he carried blocked the final fatal blow for him, buying the time needed for the strike that broke the Tower of Glory. That is the secret behind his victory.

entries.source_text: 那时学院邀请到了北荒的王昭君作为嘉宾，给学子们做了一场战术演示……可惜留影缺少了最关键的一刻。
entries.current_text: Back then, the academy invited Princess Frost from the Northern Wilderness as a guest to give a tactical demonstration to the students... Unfortunately, the recording is missing the most crucial moment.

entries.source_text: 昭君姑娘竟然也来当过嘉宾……
entries.current_text: I can't believe Lady Zhaojun was a guest here too...

entries.source_text: 昭君姑娘竟然也来当过嘉宾……
entries.current_text: I can't believe Lady Zhaojun was a guest here too...

entries.source_text: 直接采访……那霜云镇东方曜传奇的最新素材又有了。
entries.current_text: An interview... I've got fresh material for the legend of Di Renjie in Frostcloud Town.

entries.source_text: 直接采访……那霜云镇东方曜传奇的最新素材又有了。
entries.current_text: An interview... I've got fresh material for the legend of Di Renjie in Frostcloud Town.

entries.source_text: 这边队伍看来是想走一波赤红灵兽。
entries.current_text: It looks like this team wants to go for the crimson spirit beast.

entries.source_text: 越墙牵制的敌方正要撤退，王昭君出手了，先用冰锥减速，随后使出禁锢寒霜！王昭君冻，冻两个！
entries.current_text: The enemy attempting to retreat while being pinned against the wall is targeted by Princess Frost! She uses her Ice Cone to slow them down, then unleashes Frigid Frost! Princess Frost freezes them—she froze two!

entries.source_text: 紧跟释放凛冬已至，队友紧随其后！
entries.current_text: Follow up with Winter's Arrival, teammates right behind!

entries.source_text: 这是！来自北荒的王昭君！
entries.current_text: This is! Princess Frost from the Northern Wilderness!

entries.source_text: 不！控制解除后鲁班大师不退反进，机关臂放出能量链接敌人，拉回来了！
entries.current_text: No! After the control was broken, Master Luban didn't retreat but advanced instead. His mechanical arms released energy to link with the enemies, pulling them back!

entries.source_text: 星芒斥责崔然违规试验，得知一神秘人将火龙炮图纸交给崔然，崔然不愿放弃，逃离了这里。
entries.current_text: Star-Gleam reprimands Cui Ran for unauthorized experiments. Learning that a mysterious person gave Cui Ran the blueprints for the Fire Dragon Cannon, Cui Ran refuses to give up and flees.

entries.source_text: 别拍马屁了！违规改造核心，火药量过载，机关学院火器安全条例第七条和二十三条是什么？
entries.current_text: Stop flattering me! Unauthorized core modification, gunpowder overload—what are Articles 7 and 23 of the Mechanism Academy's Firearm Safety Regulations?

entries.source_text: 教不严，师之过。我会赔上这张老脸，去凌云卫那里说情。但机关学院的惩戒你别想逃过。
entries.current_text: A teacher's failure is the student's fault. I will stake my reputation to plead with the Lingyun Guard, but don't expect to escape punishment from the School of Mechcraft.

entries.source_text: 这些机关都是你做的？
entries.current_text: Did you make all these mechanisms?

entries.source_text: 这些机关都是你做的？
entries.current_text: Did you make all these mechanisms?

entries.source_text: 最近仓库里丢失了大量火药和零件，凌云卫怀疑星芒的得意弟子崔然，因此星芒拜托你调查真相。
entries.current_text: A large amount of gunpowder and parts have been missing from the warehouse recently. The Lingyun Guard suspects Cui Ran, the star pupil of Xingmang, so Xingmang has asked you to investigate the truth.

entries.source_text: 不必说了，三天！给我三天时间，我一定查明情况，给凌云卫一个交代。
entries.current_text: Enough. Three days! Give me three days, and I will investigate the situation and give the Lingyun Guard an answer.

entries.source_text: 行，那<001>崔然</>一事，凌云卫就交由星芒老师调查了，三日为期，若超过……
entries.current_text: Fine. Then the Lingyun Guard will leave the investigation of <001>Cui Ran</> to Master Xingmang. You have three days; if it exceeds...

entries.source_text: 若超过三日，我和崔然都按学院规矩，任凌云卫处置！
entries.current_text: If it takes more than three days, both Cui Ran and I will submit to the Lingyun Guard's disposal according to academy rules!

entries.source_text: 强硬吗……确实，凌云卫最近也忙得焦头烂额，我不应该对他们如此。
entries.current_text: Hard-headed... True, the Lingyun Guard has been overwhelmed lately; I shouldn't be like that toward them.

entries.source_text: 其中崔然天赋出众，对于机关尤其火器一道更是匠心独具，是个难得的好苗子。
entries.current_text: Cui Ran is exceptionally talented, especially in mechanisms and firearms. He is a rare, promising talent.

entries.source_text: 可谁知道，凌云卫来报，盆地的仓库里，最近丢失了大量的火药和零件，嫌疑人直指崔然。
entries.current_text: But who would have thought? The Lingyun Guard reported that a large amount of gunpowder and parts have gone missing from the basin's warehouse, and the prime suspect is Cui Ran.

entries.source_text: 只要再调整下参数就不会失误了！你看这枚核心，我用了更耐高温的材质，并以云流充能，能承受住强力的火药燃料。
entries.current_text: As long as I adjust the parameters, there won't be any mistakes! Look at this core, I used a more heat-resistant material and charged it with cloud flow; it can withstand powerful gunpowder fuel.

entries.source_text: 还设置了守卫炮台在这，到底是在搞什么啊……
entries.current_text: They even set up guard turrets here. What on earth are they up to...

entries.source_text: 还设置了守卫炮台在这，到底是在搞什么啊……
entries.current_text: They even set up guard turrets here. What on earth are they up to...

entries.source_text: 报道上竟然是真的……原来，那个挖掘你的神秘人，就是夫子。
entries.current_text: The report was actually true... So, the mysterious person who excavated you was Master.

entries.source_text: 报道上竟然是真的……原来，那个挖掘你的神秘人，就是夫子。
entries.current_text: The report was actually true... So, the mysterious person who excavated you was Master.

entries.source_text: 我们在彩云盆地深处搭建了实验场地，一切都很顺利，直到那天深夜的爆炸……
entries.current_text: We set up an experimental site deep in the Colorful Cloud Basin, and everything was going smoothly, until the explosion that night...

entries.source_text: 无咎的面部严重损毁，双手致残，我的眼睛也被炸伤……对附近巡逻的十几名凌云卫也造成不同程度的伤害……
entries.current_text: Wujiu's face is severely damaged, his hands are crippled, and my eyes were also injured in the explosion... It also caused varying degrees of harm to the dozen Lingyun Guards patrolling nearby...

entries.source_text: 我需要先和凌云卫去通报情况，到时候我们在观云崖下面会合。
entries.current_text: I need to report the situation to the Lingyun Guards first. We'll meet up under Guanyun Cliff later.

entries.source_text: 凌云卫负责人韵妜表示火龙炮相关资料已经被销毁，星芒和你约定在彩云潭碰头，共同寻找崔然。
entries.current_text: Aerwatch lead Yun'e stated that the documents related to the Fire Dragon Cannon have been destroyed. Xingmang has arranged to meet you at Colorful Cloud Pool to search for Cui Ran together.

entries.source_text: 星芒……莫非彩云盆地仓库失窃的火器零件和火龙炮有关？
entries.current_text: Star-Gleam... Could the stolen firearm parts from the Colorful Cloud Basin warehouse be related to the Fire Dragon Cannon?

entries.source_text: 我是这里的凌云卫负责人，严锐已经传信给我了。
entries.current_text: I'm the person in charge of the Lingyun Guard here. Yan Rui has already sent word to me.

entries.source_text: 诶，等有时间再细说。司马贡已经招了，他们和无咎约定在彩云潭碰头，你先过来。
entries.current_text: Hey, we'll talk in detail when there's time. Sima Gong has already confessed. They agreed to meet Wujiu at Colorful Cloud Pool. You go there first.

entries.source_text: 你将徽章交给赛事鹅，进入了观云庄。
entries.current_text: You hand the badge to the tournament goose and enter Guanyun Manor.

entries.source_text: 年轻的学子，欢迎来到观云庄！嘎，不对，此处是鹅的地盘，你有何贵干？
entries.current_text: Young student, welcome to Guan Yun Manor! Quack—no, wait, this is my turf. What business do you have here?

entries.source_text: 小心！怎么有机关人？
entries.current_text: Watch out! Why are there mechanical constructs here?

entries.source_text: 小心！怎么有机关人？
entries.current_text: Watch out! Why are there mechanical constructs here?

entries.source_text: 这小子……他私自改装了守卫机关人，先赶跑它！
entries.current_text: This kid... he modified the guard automaton without permission. Drive it away first!

entries.source_text: 原来星芒老师年轻时候这么叛逆……这神秘人是谁也没写……
entries.current_text: So Teacher Xingmang was this rebellious when she was young... And it doesn't say who this mysterious person is...

entries.source_text: 原来星芒老师年轻时候这么叛逆……这神秘人是谁也没写……
entries.current_text: So Teacher Xingmang was this rebellious when she was young... And it doesn't say who this mysterious person is...

entries.source_text: 星芒认出神秘人就是他当年的伙伴无咎，而崔然不顾星芒的阻止，决心完成火龙炮，保护稷下。
entries.current_text: Star-Gleam recognizes the mysterious person as his former partner, Wujiu. Despite Star-Gleam's attempts to stop him, Cui Ran is determined to complete the Fire Dragon Cannon to protect Jixia.

entries.source_text: 邢慧敏告诉你，秘闻社的人已经离开，只有凌云卫的赛事鹅还在看管资料，劝你小心应对。
entries.current_text: Xing Huimin tells you that the people from the Secret Society have left, and only the Lingyun Guard's competition goose is still guarding the materials, advising you to be careful.

entries.source_text: 扯远了，总之，现在只留下一个凌云卫的“人”，看管秘闻社的资料，喏，就在那边。
entries.current_text: Getting off track, anyway, there's only one Lingyun Guard "person" left to look after the Secret Society's archives. See, right over there.

entries.source_text: 听说老师总算脱离危险了，这两天凌云卫守着不让进，真让人焦心，得赶紧拉上崔然过去……
entries.current_text: I heard the teacher is finally out of danger. The Lingyun Guards haven't let anyone in for the past two days, which is really worrying. I must hurry and get Cui Ran over there...

entries.source_text: 听说老师总算脱离危险了，这两天凌云卫守着不让进，真让人焦心，得赶紧拉上崔然过去……
entries.current_text: I heard the teacher is finally out of danger. The Lingyun Guards haven't let anyone in for the past two days, which is really worrying. I must hurry and get Cui Ran over there...

entries.source_text: 老师醒了！速来云来驿！我、我不敢进，你能不能……
entries.current_text: Master is awake! Come to Cloud-Arrival Post quickly! I... I'm afraid to go in, could you...

entries.source_text: 嗯，你还算明辨是非。另外，无咎已被押入秘禁阁。你，要见他吗？
entries.current_text: Hmm, you have a good sense of right and wrong. Besides, Wujiu has already been taken to the Secret Forbidden Pavilion. Do you... want to see him?

entries.source_text: 我不需要这样的怜悯，这样的事，以后不必再做了。至于无咎，你也要施舍他吗？
entries.current_text: I don't need such pity. You don't have to do this kind of thing again. As for Wujiu, are you going to bestow your charity upon him too?

entries.source_text: 不，他必须承担自己的恶果，在秘禁阁服役，无令禁止外出，也算给当年的人有所交代了。
entries.current_text: No, he must bear the consequences of his own evil deeds and serve in the Secret Forbidden Pavilion. He is forbidden from leaving without orders. This should be considered an explanation to those from back then.

entries.source_text: 面对往日的师弟，即使在黑暗中你更有优势、情愿将自身置于险地，也不愿伤害到他。
entries.current_text: Facing your former junior, even though you have the advantage in the dark and are willing to put yourself in danger, you still do not want to hurt him.

entries.source_text: 不止是脸，还有这双手！也被炸得血肉模糊，不得不换成机关了。
entries.current_text: It's not just my face, but these hands too! They were blown to shreds, and I had to replace them with mechanical ones.

entries.source_text: 怎么听不见攻击声了……这是哪里？
entries.current_text: Why can't I hear the sounds of battle anymore... Where is this?

entries.source_text: 嘘——小声点，你怎么到宿舍来了，不是让你直接去通天塔吗？
entries.current_text: Shh—keep it down. Why are you in the dormitory? Weren't you told to go straight to the Tongtian Tower?

entries.source_text: 记住，今日之后——我们两清。但往后时间还很长，希望你会在凌云卫的监管下想清楚。
entries.current_text: Remember, after today—we are even. But there is still a long road ahead, I hope you will think it through under the supervision of the Lingyun Guard.

entries.source_text: 这火龙炮，不会再出现了，也不会再伤害任何人。
entries.current_text: This Fire Dragon Cannon will never appear again, and it will never hurt anyone again.

entries.source_text: 导致凌云卫增多，让我进来也费了一番力气，还好有崔然。那小子可没说过什么夫子不在了！你休想骗我！
entries.current_text: It caused the Lingyun Guards to increase, and it took me a lot of effort to get in, but luckily I had Cui Ran. That kid never said the Master was gone! Don't try to lie to me!

entries.source_text: 机关收紧了……这些力量好汹涌！唔……好痛……
entries.current_text: The mechanism is tightening... This power is so overwhelming! Ugh... it hurts...

entries.source_text: 黑暗之中，星芒知道只有找到机关核心才能结束一切，而无咎却又一次发动了进攻……
entries.current_text: In the darkness, Xingmang knows that only by finding the mechanism core can everything end, but Wujiu has launched another attack...

entries.source_text: 找到机关核心，才能结束这一切……
entries.current_text: I must find the mechanism core to end all of this...

entries.source_text: （说起来，我们最早在霜云镇和丰云野认识的时候，感觉还是挺不错的。）
entries.current_text: (Come to think of it, it was quite nice when we first met in Frostcloud Town and Fengyun Wild.)

entries.source_text: （她没参加归虚梦演，她是魔道学院的马上毕业的同学。）
entries.current_text: (She didn't participate in the Guixu Dream Performance. She is a student at the Magic Academy who is about to graduate.)

entries.source_text: （她没参加归虚梦演，她是魔道学院的马上毕业的同学。）
entries.current_text: (She didn't participate in the Guixu Dream Performance. She is a student at the Magic Academy who is about to graduate.)

entries.source_text: （我们魔道学院的吗？哎，你们说是不是每天都会来玲珑阙的那位师姐啊？）
entries.current_text: (Are they from our Magic Academy? Hey, are you talking about that senior sister who comes to the Linglong Pavilion every day?)

entries.source_text: （<001>今天不辞而别的同学</>，就是司马一一吧。她<001>负责机关一塔</>，我们可以去那里找她。）
entries.current_text: (<001>The student who left without saying goodbye today</> is Sima Yiyi. She is <001>in charge of Mechanism Tower One</>, we can go there to find her.)

entries.source_text: （<001>今天不辞而别的同学</>，就是司马一一吧。她<001>负责机关一塔</>，我们可以去那里找她。）
entries.current_text: (<001>The student who left without saying goodbye today</> is Sima Yiyi. She is <001>in charge of Mechanism Tower One</>, we can go there to find her.)

entries.source_text: （<001>义工活动刚巧有人不辞而别</>，看来<001>负责机关一塔的义工很大概率就是司马一一</>。）
entries.current_text: (<001>Someone left the volunteer activity without saying goodbye</>, it seems <001>the volunteer in charge of Mechanism Tower One is very likely Sima Yiyi</>.)

entries.source_text: （<001>义工活动刚巧有人不辞而别</>，看来<001>负责机关一塔的义工很大概率就是司马一一</>。）
entries.current_text: (<001>Someone left the volunteer activity without saying goodbye</>, it seems <001>the volunteer in charge of Mechanism Tower One is very likely Sima Yiyi</>.)

entries.source_text: （<001>机关一塔今天需要一名临时义工</>，<001>之前每天负责的同学今天突然没来</>了。除此之外的事，我就不太清楚了。）
entries.current_text: (<001>Mechanism Tower One needs a temporary volunteer today</>, <001>the student who was responsible every day before didn't show up today</>. Other than that, I don't know much.)

entries.source_text: （今天不辞而别的同学，就是司马一一吧，我们可以去<001>她负责的机关一塔</>找她。）
entries.current_text: (The student who left without saying goodbye today must be Sima Yiyi. We can go find her at <001>the mechanism tower she is in charge of</>.)

entries.source_text: （今天不辞而别的同学，就是司马一一吧，我们可以去<001>她负责的机关一塔</>找她。）
entries.current_text: (The student who left without saying goodbye today must be Sima Yiyi. We can go find her at <001>the mechanism tower she is in charge of</>.)

entries.source_text: （司马一一啊，是魔道学院的一个同学。）
entries.current_text: (Sima Yiyi? She's a classmate at the Magic Academy.)

entries.source_text: （司马一一啊，是魔道学院的一个同学。）
entries.current_text: (Sima Yiyi? She's a classmate at the Magic Academy.)

entries.source_text: （对不起，我们来晚了，刚才周小鱼给我传音说遇袭了，我就立马赶来了。）
entries.current_text: (Sorry, we're late. Zhou Xiaoyu sent me a message saying she was attacked, so I rushed over immediately.)

entries.source_text: （这是药品，周小鱼你赶紧擦一下吧。）
entries.current_text: (This is medicine. Zhou Xiaoyu, hurry and apply it.)

entries.source_text: （周小鱼，你别打趣我了，袁戈作证，真的是无意中发现的）
entries.current_text: (Zhou Xiaoyu, stop teasing me. Yuan Ge can testify, I really found it by accident.)

entries.source_text: （原来司马一一<001>最近</>一直在<001>机关一塔</>做义工，赶快把这个消息告诉朱歌凉他们吧。）
entries.current_text: (So Sima Yiyi <001>has been</> volunteering at the <001>Mechanism Tower</> lately. I should tell Zhuge Liang and the others about this quickly.)

entries.source_text: （原来司马一一<001>最近</>一直在<001>机关一塔</>做义工，赶快把这个消息告诉朱歌凉他们吧。）
entries.current_text: (So Sima Yiyi <001>has been</> volunteering at the <001>Mechanism Tower</> lately. I should tell Zhuge Liang and the others about this quickly.)

entries.source_text: （我刚才打听到，司马一一每天都在机关一塔做义工，现在也有很大的可能在那里。）
entries.current_text: (I just heard that Sima Yiyi volunteers at the Mechanism Tower every day, so there's a high chance she's there now.)

entries.source_text: （我刚才打听到，司马一一每天都在机关一塔做义工，现在也有很大的可能在那里。）
entries.current_text: (I just heard that Sima Yiyi volunteers at the Mechanism Tower every day, so there's a high chance she's there now.)

entries.source_text: （我们一起去机关一塔找司马一一吧，和她当面问个清楚。）
entries.current_text: (Let's go to the Mechanism Tower together to find Sima Yiyi and ask her about it in person.)

entries.source_text: （我们一起去机关一塔找司马一一吧，和她当面问个清楚。）
entries.current_text: (Let's go to the Mechanism Tower together to find Sima Yiyi and ask her about it in person.)

entries.source_text: （唔……周小鱼，只能拜托你去了，袁戈这里还需要我照顾。）
entries.current_text: (Well... Zhou Xiaoyu, I can only rely on you to go. I still need to take care of Yuan Ge here.)

entries.source_text: （这里就是机关一塔啊。）
entries.current_text: (So this is Mechanism Tower 1.)

entries.source_text: （这里就是机关一塔啊。）
entries.current_text: (So this is Mechanism Tower 1.)

entries.source_text: 机关一塔竟然被如此快速的破解，真乃奇才，比之当年的司马懿都有过之而无不及。
entries.current_text: To crack the first mechanism tower so quickly... you are a genius, even surpassing Sima Yi back in the day.

entries.source_text: 将药给周小鱼。
entries.current_text: Give the medicine to Zhou Xiaoyu.

entries.source_text: （朱歌凉说自己需要照顾周小鱼，这一路很危险，袁戈已经恢复了，可以由袁戈和主角一同前往机关一塔。）
entries.current_text: (Zhu Geliang says he needs to take care of Zhou Xiaoyu. The road is dangerous, and since Yuan Ge has recovered, Yuan Ge and the protagonist can head to the Mechanism Tower together.)

entries.source_text: （周小鱼大大咧咧的说自己没办法去抓司马一一了）
entries.current_text: (Zhou Xiaoyu carelessly says she can't go catch Sima Yiyi anymore)

entries.source_text: （主角安慰周小鱼，一定会查个水落石出。）
entries.current_text: (The protagonist comforts Zhou Xiaoyu, promising to get to the bottom of this.)

entries.source_text: （主角安慰周小鱼，一定会查个水落石出。）
entries.current_text: (The protagonist comforts Zhou Xiaoyu, promising to get to the bottom of this.)

entries.source_text: （这位同学经常一个人去<001>机关一塔</>做义工，好像是她的什么偶像在那里？）
entries.current_text: (This student often goes to <001>Mechanism Tower 1</> alone to volunteer. It seems like one of her idols is there?)

entries.source_text: （没事，我现在在找司马一一同学，她是魔道学院的，女生，是马上要毕业的学生，你们知道吗？）
entries.current_text: (It's nothing. I'm looking for a student named Sima Yiyi. She's from the Magic Academy, a girl, and she's about to graduate. Do you know her?)

entries.source_text: （没事，我现在在找司马一一同学，她是魔道学院的，女生，是马上要毕业的学生，你们知道吗？）
entries.current_text: (It's nothing. I'm looking for a student named Sima Yiyi. She's from the Magic Academy, a girl, and she's about to graduate. Do you know her?)

entries.source_text: （周小鱼你别闹了。）
entries.current_text: (Zhou Xiaoyu, stop it.)

entries.source_text: （上面就是机关一塔了，上去看看吧。）
entries.current_text: (Mechanism Tower One is up there, let's go up and take a look.)

entries.source_text: （上面就是机关一塔了，上去看看吧。）
entries.current_text: (Mechanism Tower One is up there, let's go up and take a look.)

entries.source_text: （他决定在这里等待朱歌凉等人，拜托主角一个人前往机关一塔。）
entries.current_text: (He decides to wait here for Zhuge Liang and the others, and asks the protagonist to head to the mechanism tower alone.)

entries.source_text: （周小鱼质问司马一一）
entries.current_text: (Zhou Xiaoyu questions Sima Yiyi)

entries.source_text: （周小鱼再次质问司马一一）
entries.current_text: (Zhou Xiaoyu questions Sima Yiyi again)

entries.source_text: 之前我为了追寻司马懿的脚步，压制实力加入了奇门小队。
entries.current_text: I joined the Qimen team to suppress my strength while following in Sima Yi's footsteps.

entries.source_text: （此处之前一直被怪雾笼罩，但前阵子怪雾散去后这里就出现了几只天雷隼盘旋，似乎是被什么东西所吸引，）
entries.current_text: (This area was covered in strange fog, but after it cleared recently, a few Sky-Thunder Falcons appeared, circling as if attracted by something.)

entries.source_text: （没想到刚来到附近就被天雷隼袭击，直到他奋力逃回城里，天雷隼才停止攻击。）
entries.current_text: (Unexpectedly, he was attacked by a Sky-Thunder Falcon as soon as he arrived nearby. The falcon didn't stop attacking until he struggled his way back to the city.)

entries.source_text: （而经过他的观察，天雷隼似乎在围绕某一个范围攻击，但他无法确定，）
entries.current_text: (After observing, it seems the Sky-Thunder Falcon is attacking within a certain range, but he can't be sure.)

entries.source_text: （担心天雷隼在<001>此处（需台词指引地点）</>仍然会有安全隐患，因此请求你帮忙解决掉此处的天雷隼，）
entries.current_text: (Worried that the Sky-Thunder Falcons at <001>this location</> still pose a safety risk, you are requested to help eliminate them.)

entries.source_text: （听到天雷隼与纪念碑的线索，你想起之前在这里与小五的那段经历，怀疑可能与此有关，因此答应帮忙。）
entries.current_text: (Hearing the clues about the Sky-Thunder Falcon and the monument, you recall your previous experience with Xiao Wu here and suspect it might be related, so you agree to help.)

entries.source_text: （听到天雷隼与纪念碑的线索，你想起之前在这里与小五的那段经历，怀疑可能与此有关，因此答应帮忙。）
entries.current_text: (Hearing the clues about the Sky-Thunder Falcon and the monument, you recall your previous experience with Xiao Wu here and suspect it might be related, so you agree to help.)

entries.source_text: （杀死天雷隼后，发现天雷隼盘旋的地方似乎残存着一些古老的魔道术痕迹。）
entries.current_text: (After killing the Sky-Thunder Falcon, I discovered some ancient magic traces where it was circling.)

entries.source_text: （杀死天雷隼后，发现天雷隼盘旋的地方似乎残存着一些古老的魔道术痕迹。）
entries.current_text: (After killing the Sky-Thunder Falcon, I discovered some ancient magic traces where it was circling.)

entries.source_text: （这些应该就是李沧提到的天雷隼了。）
entries.current_text: (These must be the Sky-Thunder Falcons that Li Cang mentioned.)

entries.source_text: （这些应该就是李沧提到的天雷隼了。）
entries.current_text: (These must be the Sky-Thunder Falcons that Li Cang mentioned.)

entries.source_text: 李沧还告诉你，他打听到这些天雷隼一直生活在彩云盆地北方，
entries.current_text: Li Cang also tells you that he heard these Thunder Falcons have been living in the north of the Colorful Cloud Basin,

entries.source_text: 但前阵子有人打死了北面的天雷隼，后来这些天雷隼就飞来，似乎是专门顺着魔道术的气息过来寻仇的，
entries.current_text: But some time ago, someone killed the Thunder Falcon in the north. Later, these Thunder Falcons flew over, seemingly seeking revenge by following the scent of magic arts.

entries.source_text: 还说自己真是倒霉，撞到了这些天雷隼，
entries.current_text: I was just saying how unlucky I was to run into these Sky-Thunder Falcons,

entries.source_text: 你说起干驷当年就和天雷隼不对付，没想到梁子这么深，
entries.current_text: You mentioned that Gan Si and the Sky-Thunder Falcon never got along, but I didn't realize the grudge went this deep.

entries.source_text: 你说起干驷当年就和天雷隼不对付，没想到梁子这么深，
entries.current_text: You mentioned that Gan Si and the Sky-Thunder Falcon never got along, but I didn't realize the grudge went this deep.

entries.source_text: 彼时学长的精神定会激励我们共克时艰。
entries.current_text: At that time, the senior's spirit will surely inspire us to overcome these difficult times together.

entries.source_text: 你居然比我还快，有什么事吗！生命在于运动，世界需要运动，我还能为你停留一句话的时间。
entries.current_text: You're actually faster than me—what's up? Life is movement, the world needs movement, and I can spare you a sentence's worth of time.

entries.source_text: 再多求我一点，你越痛苦我的根就扎得越深。
entries.current_text: Beg me more; the more you suffer, the deeper my roots will take hold.

entries.source_text: 你发现两株刺藤芽，惊觉它们会说人话。
entries.current_text: You discover two thorn vine sprouts and are shocked to find they can speak human language.

entries.source_text: 刺藤芽当然会说话了，你才奇怪咧。
entries.current_text: Of course Thorn Vine Buds can talk. You're the strange one.

entries.source_text: 奇怪，刺藤芽说话了？
entries.current_text: Strange, did the Thorn Bud just speak?

entries.source_text: 奇怪，刺藤芽说话了？
entries.current_text: Strange, did the Thorn Bud just speak?

entries.source_text: 这里之前长着刺藤芽吗？
entries.current_text: Were there thorn vine buds growing here before?

entries.source_text: 这里之前长着刺藤芽吗？
entries.current_text: Were there thorn vine buds growing here before?

entries.source_text: 这是……梦境的花？怎么会出现在彩云盆地？
entries.current_text: This is... a dream flower? How could it appear in the Caiyun Basin?

entries.source_text: 这是……梦境的花？怎么会出现在彩云盆地？
entries.current_text: This is... a dream flower? How could it appear in the Caiyun Basin?

entries.source_text: 青岚难道……再去看看那堵墙吧。
entries.current_text: Could it be Qing Lan...? Let's go check that wall again.

entries.source_text: 青岚难道……再去看看那堵墙吧。
entries.current_text: Could it be Qing Lan...? Let's go check that wall again.

entries.source_text: 青岚告诉你，在梦里有一个影子在自己的大脑中翻找自己的记忆，并且提到了云蚕和沧浪楼船。
entries.current_text: Qing Lan tells you that in his dream, a shadow was rummaging through his memories in his brain, mentioning the Cloud Silkworm and the Littoral Towership.

entries.source_text: 它在找什么东西，它、它在找……云蚕，还有……沧、沧浪楼船！
entries.current_text: It's looking for something. It, it's looking for... Cloud Silkworms, and... the Can, Canglang Treasure Ship!

entries.source_text: 沧浪楼船？
entries.current_text: The Canglang Treasure Ship?

entries.source_text: 沧浪楼船？
entries.current_text: The Canglang Treasure Ship?

entries.source_text: 参与试炼的青岚自昨日起就失去了联络，德衡推测他被幽影影响，拜托你找到他。
entries.current_text: Qinglan, who was participating in the trial, has been out of contact since yesterday. Deheng suspects he has been affected by the Umbra and asks you to find him.

entries.source_text: 你来了……抱歉，要再次借助你的力量。我希望你能帮忙找到青岚。
entries.current_text: You're here... Sorry, I have to rely on your strength again. I hope you can help me find Qing Lan.

entries.source_text: 唯有青岚，昨日开始便失了联络，陆续派了些队员去找，也没有任何音讯。
entries.current_text: Only Qinglan has been out of contact since yesterday. We've sent several team members to look for her, but there's been no word.

entries.source_text: 但最要紧的还是先找到青岚，确认他的安危。
entries.current_text: But the most important thing is to find Qing Lan and ensure his safety.

entries.source_text: 队员们最后一次看到青岚，是在望云岸附近。
entries.current_text: The last time the team saw Qinglan was near Wangyun Bank.

entries.source_text: 德衡听完你的报告，决定开启对沧浪楼船的调查，他托你找澜光修复一枚核心，复原其中的信息。
entries.current_text: After hearing your report, Deheng decides to start an investigation into the Canglang treasure ship. He asks you to find Languang to repair a core and restore the information within.

entries.source_text: 沧浪楼船？他在学子们的记忆中翻找，竟然是想探寻能替代云蚕，助他获得自由的力量？
entries.current_text: The Canglang Treasure Ship? He searched through the students' memories—was he actually trying to find a power to replace the Cloud Silkworm and gain his freedom?

entries.source_text: 那艘深眠在春溪地下的青铜巨轮，确实守护着神秘的宝藏……
entries.current_text: That giant bronze ship sleeping deep beneath the Spring Creek really does guard a mysterious treasure...

entries.source_text: 如果那些宝藏中，真有能让他自由的力量……会不会和神铸者有关？
entries.current_text: If there really is power among those treasures that could set him free... could it be related to the God-Forgers?

entries.source_text: 如果那些宝藏中，真有能让他自由的力量……会不会和神铸者有关？
entries.current_text: If there really is power among those treasures that could set him free... could it be related to the God-Forgers?

entries.source_text: 你的重心，还是放在沧浪楼船，那片遗迹的入口封闭许多年了，得先找到进入的办法……
entries.current_text: You should focus on the Canglang Treasure Ship. The entrance to those ruins has been sealed for many years; we must first find a way in...

entries.source_text: 这样吧，你去溯洄营地找一名名叫澜光的机关学子，请他尝试修好这枚核心，复原其中的信息。
entries.current_text: How about this: go to the Suhui Camp and find a mechanical student named Languang. Ask him to try and repair this core and recover the information inside.

entries.source_text: 他主攻的便是机关核心技术，还曾跟随墨子院长学习，是如今我能想到的最合适的人选。
entries.current_text: He specializes in core mechanism technology and once studied under Dean Mozi. He is the most suitable candidate I can think of right now.

entries.source_text: 你还记得么，学院曾调拨一批机动队员，加入一支风物家小队，去春溪原参与古代遗迹的抢修。
entries.current_text: Do you remember when the academy dispatched a team of mobile operatives to join a group of scholars to repair ancient ruins in Chunxi Plain?

entries.source_text: 青岚也曾加入那支队伍帮忙，不久前，他们在沧浪洞附近找到了一枚破碎的核心，并送来我这儿保管。
entries.current_text: Qing Lan also joined that team to help. Not long ago, they found a broken core near Littoral Cave and sent it to me for safekeeping.

entries.source_text: 我只来得及检查了它的做工和材质……发现制造它的技艺，与楼船似乎同出一脉。
entries.current_text: I only had time to check its craftsmanship and material... The technique used to make it seems to be of the same origin as the tower ships.

entries.source_text: 幽影蛊惑青岚，意在利用他获知楼船消息，这倒是提醒了我。你说会不会……
entries.current_text: The Shadow is manipulating Qinglan, intending to use him to learn about the treasure ship. That reminds me. Do you think...

entries.source_text: 嗯。如此一来，也能解释为何青岚会多次被那幽影给盯上了。
entries.current_text: Hmm. This also explains why Qinglan was targeted by that Shadow so many times.

entries.source_text: 这样吧，你去溯洄营地找一名名叫澜光的机关学子，请他尝试修好这枚核心，复原其中的信息。
entries.current_text: How about this: go to the Suhui Camp and find a mechanical student named Languang. Ask him to try and repair this core and recover the information inside.

entries.source_text: 他主攻的便是机关核心技术，还曾跟随墨子院长学习，是如今我能想到的最合适的人选。
entries.current_text: He specializes in core mechanism technology and once studied under Dean Mozi. He is the most suitable candidate I can think of right now.

entries.source_text: 痛苦的学子
entries.current_text: Suffering Student

entries.source_text: 你找到了青岚，他却已深陷在噩梦之中。
entries.current_text: You found Qinglan, but he is already trapped deep within a nightmare.

entries.source_text: 醒醒，青岚！
entries.current_text: Wake up, Qinglan!

entries.source_text: 醒醒，青岚！
entries.current_text: Wake up, Qinglan!

entries.source_text: 青岚……？
entries.current_text: Qing Lan...?

entries.source_text: 青岚……？
entries.current_text: Qing Lan...?

entries.source_text: 奇怪的黑色雾气突然袭来，将你与青岚包围，而源头，正是多日不见的幽影……
entries.current_text: A strange black mist suddenly strikes, surrounding you and Qinglan. The source is none other than the Youying, who hasn't been seen for days...

entries.source_text: 好，沧浪楼船再见。
entries.current_text: Alright, see you on the Canglang ship.

entries.source_text: 好，沧浪楼船再见。
entries.current_text: Alright, see you on the Canglang ship.

entries.source_text: 它的仇恨是因，也是诞生的根源，执念的起点。它并非凭空而生，而是来自一段被刻意遗忘的过去……
entries.current_text: Its hatred is the cause, the root of its birth, and the starting point of its obsession. It was not born out of thin air, but from a past that was deliberately forgotten...

entries.source_text: 地下空间，莫非是……归云壤？
entries.current_text: An underground space? Could it be... the Return Cloud Soil?

entries.source_text: 地下空间，莫非是……归云壤？
entries.current_text: An underground space? Could it be... the Return Cloud Soil?

entries.source_text: 原来，那个地方叫归云壤啊。我只知道它与学院前史有关，涉及古老的力量。
entries.current_text: So that place is called Guiyun Rang. I only know it has to do with the academy's pre-history and involves ancient power.

entries.source_text: 在那里，云根之力和神纹之力此消彼长……神纹之力很不稳定，难道，那时他就有接触？
entries.current_text: There, the power of the Cloud Root and the power of the Divine Runes ebb and flow... The Divine Rune power is very unstable. Could it be that he had contact with it back then?

entries.source_text: 归云壤强大而危险的力量，源自悲剧的宿命，而司马同学的身上，背负着相似的影子。
entries.current_text: The powerful and dangerous power of the Guiyun Soil stems from a tragic fate, and student Sima carries a similar shadow.

entries.source_text: 幽影承认心中仇恨，庄周再次将他封印在大梦之中。
entries.current_text: The Shadow admits the hatred in his heart, and Zhuangzi seals him back into the Great Dream.

entries.source_text: 模糊画面中，庄周似乎正在安慰一个身份不明的学子，这学子忍耐着痛苦还怒吼复仇，为此庄周老师唯有怜悯……
entries.current_text: In the blurred vision, Zhuangzi appears to be comforting an unidentified student. The student endures pain while roaring for revenge, leaving Master Zhuangzi with nothing but pity...

entries.source_text: 子非我，我亦不是你。但至少，我能感觉到你正在承受痛苦。
entries.current_text: You are not me, and I am not you. But at least, I can feel that you are suffering.

entries.source_text: ……结束了？好像，有什么东西在不断散溢，越来越汹涌……
entries.current_text: ...Is it over? It seems like something is constantly dissipating, becoming more and more turbulent...

entries.source_text: ……结束了？好像，有什么东西在不断散溢，越来越汹涌……
entries.current_text: ...Is it over? It seems like something is constantly dissipating, becoming more and more turbulent...

entries.source_text: 那些美好的，珍贵的，都在与你告别。而你，却还在用迷惘的丝线纺织，缠绕自己，制造心的囚笼。
entries.current_text: Those beautiful, precious things are all saying goodbye to you. Yet you are still weaving with threads of confusion, entangling yourself and building a cage for your heart.

entries.source_text: 好，我需要先动身一步，你就稍作休整后，去<001>荣耀塔</>下找我吧。
entries.current_text: Alright, I need to head out first. You can rest for a bit, then meet me under the <001>Tower of Glory</>.

entries.source_text: 在彩云盆地……还是第一次观测到。
entries.current_text: In the Colorful Cloud Basin... this is the first time I've observed this.

entries.source_text: 我，乃是魔道学子——司马懿……留存于稷下的精神之分身。
entries.current_text: I am a student of the Dark Arts—Sima Yi... a spiritual avatar remaining in Jixia.

entries.source_text: 哇，青岚学长这练得可以啊。
entries.current_text: Wow, Senior Qinglan's training is really something.

entries.source_text: 调查对象正是青岚，最近他实力突飞猛进，并表示很多人和自己一样被司马学长选中了，你决定去找学长聊聊。
entries.current_text: The subject of the investigation is Qing Lan. His strength has improved rapidly lately, and he claims many others were chosen by Senior Sima just like him. You decide to go talk to the senior.

entries.source_text: 青岚刚刚说，梦域里开启了更深的梦隙？去那里找司马学长聊聊吧。
entries.current_text: Qing Lan just said that deeper dream rifts have opened in the Dream Realm? Go there and talk to Senior Sima.

entries.source_text: 青岚刚刚说，梦域里开启了更深的梦隙？去那里找司马学长聊聊吧。
entries.current_text: Qing Lan just said that deeper dream rifts have opened in the Dream Realm? Go there and talk to Senior Sima.

entries.source_text: 帮我去学事委和秘禁阁调一下这位学长的档案……对了，还有这届梦演的赛会记录……
entries.current_text: Help me go to the Academic Affairs Committee and the Forbidden Pavilion to pull this senior's file... Oh, and the competition records for this year's Dream Performance...

entries.source_text: 那个……我、我存了很多机关术的问题要问，不知道一次能不能问得完……
entries.current_text: Um... I, I have saved up a lot of questions about mechanics to ask, I don't know if I can finish them all at once...

entries.source_text: 当他带着神铸先民越海而至时，老夫就是在此处，擎起灯火，迎接他们的巨轮靠岸……
entries.current_text: When he arrived across the sea with the God-Forged ancestors, I was right here, holding up the lamp to welcome their giant ship to the shore...

entries.source_text: 哈哈，那奇门水榭，也算是我留下的礼物吧。
entries.current_text: Haha, that Qimen Water Pavilion can be considered a gift I left behind.

entries.source_text: 学事委的若楠得知你收到邀请函，才发现自己忘记撤回，打算去找圭蝶队解释误会。
entries.current_text: Ruonan from the Student Affairs Committee realizes she forgot to retract the invitation you received and plans to find the Guidie team to explain the misunderstanding.

entries.source_text: 那邀请函不会也误发给圭蝶队了吧……哎呀，我得去找一趟他们才行，不能把误会再闹大了。
entries.current_text: The invitation wasn't sent to the Guidie team by mistake, was it... Oh dear, I have to go find them. I can't let this misunderstanding grow any further.

entries.source_text: （摸鱼又八卦的工巧家其实是机关高人营造反差人设）
entries.current_text: (The slacking, gossiping craftsman is actually a master of mechanisms, creating a contrast in character)

entries.source_text: （坏心眼添油加醋回复）
entries.current_text: (Replies with malicious intent, adding fuel to the fire.)

entries.source_text: 哦对了同学，那边那个石头貌似是个隐形机关，附近可能有什么线索。
entries.current_text: Oh, right, student. That stone over there looks like a hidden mechanism. There might be some clues nearby.

entries.source_text: 这座水库可不得了，秘禁阁的绝密资料——战时笔记中记载，它连接着某个避难所，而朝歌士兵意图通过投诚的学子侵入此地……
entries.current_text: This reservoir is incredible. Top-secret records from the Secret Forbidden Pavilion—wartime notes—state that it connects to a shelter, and the Chaoge soldiers intended to infiltrate this place through defecting students...

entries.source_text: 那是秘禁阁特批出借的宝贵史料，来一阵风吹落水中可就不得了了，但我这脚一时半会也……
entries.current_text: Those are precious historical materials specially lent by the Secret Forbidden Pavilion. It would be a disaster if a gust of wind blew them into the water, but my foot is currently...

entries.source_text: 大人，我……唉，实不相瞒，我虽是稷下学子，但学了三年，也只会凝水成冰这一招……
entries.current_text: (The student suggests taking control of the lever themselves, using water as the driving force to propel the boat.)

entries.source_text: 这么简单……不过也是，要是你们稷下守备真有那么严密，也不会让我变了个装就混进来。
entries.current_text: (I have the key. What if you run away if I let you go?)

entries.source_text: 没事就好，不过还是小心点，这么多年了，也不知道这下面的机关还能不能正常使用。
entries.current_text: Glad you're okay. Still, be careful—it's been so many years, who knows if the mechanisms down here still work.

entries.source_text: 打开这个机关，看看还有没有别的线索吧。
entries.current_text: Let's open this mechanism and see if there are any other clues.

entries.source_text: 打开这个机关，看看还有没有别的线索吧。
entries.current_text: Let's open this mechanism and see if there are any other clues.

entries.source_text: 只要战争开始，每分每秒，都在有人为了和平而抗争，不分战场，不惜生命。
entries.current_text: As long as war begins, every minute and every second, someone is fighting for peace, regardless of the battlefield, without sparing their lives.

entries.source_text: 这么简单……不过也是，要是你们稷下守备真有那么严，也不会让我变了个装就混进来。
entries.current_text: So simple... But then again, if your Jixia defenses were really that tight, I wouldn't have been able to sneak in just by changing my clothes.

entries.source_text: 大人，我……唉，实不相瞒，我虽是稷下学子，但学了三年，也只会凝水成冰这一招……
entries.current_text: (The student suggests taking control of the lever themselves, using water as the driving force to propel the boat.)

entries.source_text: 木筏……先打开机关，看看他们接下来去哪儿了吧。
entries.current_text: A wooden raft... Let's trigger the mechanism first and see where they go next.

entries.source_text: 木筏……先打开机关，看看他们接下来去哪儿了吧。
entries.current_text: A wooden raft... Let's trigger the mechanism first and see where they go next.

entries.source_text: 这后面进不去……应该需要打开什么机关。
entries.current_text: I can't get in behind here... I probably need to trigger some mechanism.

entries.source_text: 这后面进不去……应该需要打开什么机关。
entries.current_text: I can't get in behind here... I probably need to trigger some mechanism.

entries.source_text: 甘策告诉你打开暗门需要先破解对应的机关，他推测机关就在水库下方。
entries.current_text: Gance tells you that to open the secret door, you must first crack the corresponding mechanism. He speculates the mechanism is below the reservoir.

entries.source_text: 那个暗门我注意到了，这种暗门一般首先要<001>破解对应的机关</>，再解开上面的禁制魔道术。
entries.current_text: I noticed that hidden door. For this type of door, you generally need to <001>crack the corresponding mechanism</> first, then undo the magic seal on it.

entries.source_text: 魔道术？哦，这种地方的机关为了防止操作失误，都有些魔道术保护。
entries.current_text: Arcana? Oh, the mechanisms in places like this are protected by Arcana to prevent operational errors.

entries.source_text: 裂空——碎地！
entries.current_text: Sky Splitter—Ground Shaker!

entries.source_text: （泉渊大师虽帮我们在武练镇立足，但前路艰辛，不知何日能够报仇）
entries.current_text: (Master Quan Yuan helped us gain a foothold in Wulian Town, but the road ahead is tough. I don't know when we'll be able to take our revenge.)

entries.source_text: （好，这泉渊大师所赠，天地醉的头坛酿，就待净化完成之日满饮）
entries.current_text: (Alright, this first jar of 'Heaven and Earth Drunk' gifted by Master Quanyuan shall be drunk in full on the day the purification is complete.)

entries.source_text: （宗匠伯伯的父亲发明的新型机关猊甲太厉害了，像我这样的小孩也可以轻松操纵）
entries.current_text: (The new type of mechanism, the Ni Armor, invented by Master Zongjiang's father is amazing. Even a child like me can operate it easily.)

entries.source_text: 大白，妃寒为了找你，一刻没停……
entries.current_text: Wow, so much ice... Is this side effect really that strong...?

entries.source_text: 大白，妃寒为了找你，一刻没停……
entries.current_text: Wow, so much ice... Is this side effect really that strong...?

entries.source_text: 妃寒与大白解开心结，保证不再向彼此隐瞒心中所想。看着疲惫的妃寒，你们决定回到梦饮茶肆，让她好好休息。
entries.current_text: Nivie and Dabai resolve their misunderstanding and promise not to hide their thoughts from each other anymore. Seeing the exhausted Nivie, you decide to return to the Dream Tea House so she can get some rest.

entries.source_text: 大白，那是妃寒买给自己备考用的。最近学院的测试一场接一场，她压力太大，需要提神。
entries.current_text: Uh... I think you've got the wrong idea, White.

entries.source_text: 大白，那是妃寒买给自己备考用的。最近学院的测试一场接一场，她压力太大，需要提神。
entries.current_text: Uh... I think you've got the wrong idea, White.

entries.source_text: 误会解开了就好。妃寒……你一晚上都没合过眼吧？
entries.current_text: Now that everything is cleared up, let's head back. You two must be tired?

entries.source_text: 误会解开了就好。妃寒……你一晚上都没合过眼吧？
entries.current_text: Now that everything is cleared up, let's head back. Are you two tired?

entries.source_text: 本兔答应！妃寒，任何事情都要及时告诉本兔，听见没？
entries.current_text: But why were you watching me all this time?

entries.source_text: 妃寒保证！大白你也得答应我，不许再一声不响跑掉！更不许胡乱碰危险的东西！我的心都快被你吓停了！
entries.current_text: White... I—I hope White can have some time for himself, to do what he wants...

entries.source_text: 大白，别想太远。你守护她的时间还长得很，她比你以为的更需要你。
entries.current_text: No problem, happy to help a fellow student.

entries.source_text: 大白，别想太远。你守护她的时间还长得很，她比你以为的更需要你。
entries.current_text: No problem, happy to help a fellow student.

entries.source_text: 哼，算你有福气。这可是稷下最顶尖的兔毛毛球，独一份。
entries.current_text: When did you pull my fur?

entries.source_text: 要是弄坏了，本兔和妃寒可跟你没完！是不是，妃寒？
entries.current_text: Take good care of this furball. It's the coolest bunny furball in the world!

entries.source_text: 等考完了，一起去善生庭吃顿好的。这段日子，你和妃寒……都辛苦了。
entries.current_text: But doesn't she have an exam tomorrow?

entries.source_text: 将来……若我不能像现在这样时刻守着她了……知道还有你和圭蝶队长这样的朋友支撑着她，我也能够放心下来了。
entries.current_text: In the future... if I can't watch over her like I do now... knowing that friends like you and Captain Guidie are supporting her, I can rest easy.

entries.source_text: 哼，没啥。在说……嗯……善生庭新出的招牌菜，对吧？
entries.current_text: Hmph, nothing. Just talking about... um... the new signature dish at Shansheng Court, right?

entries.source_text: 不要再这样伤害自己了！
entries.current_text: Stop hurting yourself like this!

entries.source_text: 妃寒释放魔道术，压制了风雪。
entries.current_text: Nivie unleashed magic arts to suppress the snowstorm.

entries.source_text: 妃寒，你去歇会儿吧？我来看着他。
entries.current_text: No more ice. The effect is wearing off.

entries.source_text: 妃寒，你去歇会儿吧？我来看着他。
entries.current_text: No more ice. The effect is wearing off.

entries.source_text: 喂喂喂，别说得好像妃寒没几天了一样！
entries.current_text: Hey, hey, hey, don't talk like Pei Han doesn't have much time left!

entries.source_text: 呼……圭蝶队能帮上妃寒，真是太好了。
entries.current_text: Hoo... It's great that the Guidie team can help Nivie.

entries.source_text: 去吧，春溪漫滩、云落远山、稷下山区和织梦原野哪里开始都行。
entries.current_text: Go ahead. Springbrook Vast, Cloud-Falling Peaks, the Jixia Mountains, or the Dreamweave Field—anywhere is a fine place to start.

entries.source_text: 我能感觉到，我的身体好像每天都发生着变化，今天我的手指好像藤蔓一样细长生长……
entries.current_text: I can feel my body changing every day. Today, my fingers are growing long and thin like vines...

entries.source_text: 像蛇在地面上爬行，我能感觉到那坚硬的鳞片刮过木板，好像随时会绞杀一切会动的生命。
entries.current_text: Like a snake slithering on the ground, I can feel those hard scales scraping against the wooden boards, as if it could strangle any living thing at any moment.

entries.source_text: 用于秘阁惊变叙事。
entries.current_text: Used for the Secret Pavilion Surprise narrative.

entries.source_text: 凄莫林地里发生了什么？
entries.current_text: What happened there?

entries.source_text: 生命在于运动！
entries.current_text: Life lies in movement!

entries.source_text: 听说这附近特别容易捡到环金……怎么一枚都没发现？
entries.current_text: I heard it's very easy to find gold rings around here... How come I haven't found a single one?

entries.source_text: 您好……笑脸相迎已经变成机关记忆了。
entries.current_text: Hello... Greeting people with a smile has become part of my mechanical memory.

entries.source_text: 别做生命体征维持餐了，那边可以做点好吃的。
entries.current_text: Stop making those 'vital sign maintenance' meals. You can make something tasty over there.

entries.source_text: 生命在于静止，老大，别戳了，来休息吧。
entries.current_text: Life lies in stillness. Boss, stop poking me, let's rest.
